articles.title: This Week In Space podcast: Episode 235 — Robots in Dark and Scary Places
articles.author: Space.com Staff

paras.en: On Episode 235 of This Week In Space, Tariq Malik and Rod Pyle are joined by Dr. Jim Green to talk about the past, present, and future of planetary exploration.
paras.zh: 在《本周太空》第 235 集中，塔里克·马利克和罗德·派尔与吉姆·格林博士一起谈论行星探索的过去、现在和未来。

paras.en: Robots have, and always will, be the first to go to the dark and scary places in space. For many years, Jim oversaw these missions for NASA as their Chief Scientist. He has always been passionate about NASA's science programs and believes we're quite likely to find life off-Earth in the near future. Join us!
paras.zh: 机器人已经并将永远成为第一个前往太空中黑暗和可怕的地方的人。多年来，吉姆作为美国宇航局首席科学家监督这些任务。他一直对美国宇航局的科学项目充满热情，并相信我们很可能在不久的将来发现地外生命。加入我们！

paras.en: Get episodes ad-free with Club TWiT at https://twit.tv/clubtwit
paras.zh: 通过 Club TWiT 获取无广告的剧集：https://twit.tv/clubtwit

paras.en: Finally, did you know you can launch your own SpaceX rocket? Model rocket maker Estes' stunning scale model of a Falcon 9 rocket that you can pick up now. The launchable model is a detailed recreation of the Falcon 9 and retails for $149.99. You can save 10% by using the code IN-COLLECTSPACE at checkout, courtesy of our partners collectSPACE.com.
paras.zh: 最后，您知道您可以发射自己的 SpaceX 火箭吗？火箭模型制造商 Estes 制作的令人惊叹的猎鹰 9 号火箭比例模型，您现在就可以购买。该可发射模型是 Falcon 9 的详细重现，零售价为 149.99 美元。您可以在结帐时使用代码 IN-COLLECTSPACE 节省 10%，这是由我们的合作伙伴collectSPACE.com 提供的。

paras.en: This Week in Space covers the new space age. Every Friday we take a deep dive into a fascinating topic. What's happening with the new race to the moon and other planets? When will SpaceX really send people to Mars?
paras.zh: 本周太空周涵盖了新太空时代。每个星期五我们都会深入探讨一个有趣的话题。新一轮的月球和其他行星竞赛发生了什么？ SpaceX什么时候才能真正把人送上火星？

paras.en: Rod Pyle is an author, journalist, television producer and Editor-in-Chief of Ad Astra magazine. He has written 18 books on space history, exploration, and development, including Space 2.0, Innovation the NASA Way, Interplanetary Robots, Blueprint for a Battlestar, Amazing Stories of the Space Age, First On the Moon, and Destination Mars
paras.zh: 罗德·派尔 (Rod Pyle) 是一位作家、记者、电视制片人和《Ad Astra》杂志的主编。他撰写了 18 本有关太空历史、探索和发展的书籍，包括《Space 2.0》、《Innovation the NASA Way》、《Interplanetary Robots》、《Battlestar 蓝图》、《Amazing Stories of the Space Age》、《First On the Moon》和《Destination Mars》

paras.en: In a previous life, Rod produced numerous documentaries and short films for The History Channel, Discovery Communications, and Disney. He also worked in visual effects on Star Trek: Deep Space Nine and the Battlestar Galactica reboot, as well as various sci-fi TV pilots. His most recent TV credit was with the NatGeo documentary on Tom Wolfe's iconic book The Right Stuff.
paras.zh: 罗德曾为历史频道、探索传播公司和迪士尼制作了大量纪录片和短片。他还参与了《星际迷航：深空九号》和《太空堡垒卡拉狄加》重启以及各种科幻电视试播集的视觉效果工作。他最近的电视作品是在国家地理频道 (NatGeo) 纪录片中拍摄的，该纪录片讲述了汤姆·沃尔夫 (Tom Wolfe) 的标志性著作《The Right Stuff》。

paras.en: Responsible for Space.com's editorial vision, Tariq Malik has been the Editor-in-Chief of Space.com since 2019 and has covered space news and science for 18 years. He joined the Space.com team in 2001, first as an intern and soon after as a full-time spaceflight reporter covering human spaceflight, exploration, astronomy and the night sky. He became Space.com's managing editor in 2009. As on-air talent has presented space stories on CNN, Fox News, NPR and others.
paras.zh: Tariq Malik 负责 Space.com 的编辑愿景，自 2019 年起担任 Space.com 的主编，报道太空新闻和科学已有 18 年。他于 2001 年加入 Space.com 团队，首先作为实习生，不久之后成为全职航天记者，报道载人航天、探索、天文学和夜空。 2009 年，他成为 Space.com 的总编辑。作为播音人才，他曾在 CNN、福克斯新闻、NPR 等媒体上讲述太空故事。

paras.en: Tariq is an Eagle Scout (yes, he earned the Space Exploration merit badge), a Space Camp veteran (4 times as a kid, once as an adult), and has taken the ultimate "vomit comet" ride while reporting on zero-gravity fires. Before joining Space.com, he served as a staff reporter for The Los Angeles Times covering city and education beats. He has journalism degrees from the University of Southern California and New York University.
paras.zh: 塔里克是一名鹰级童子军（是的，他获得了太空探索奖章），一名太空营老兵（小时候四次，成年一次），并在报道零重力火灾时乘坐了终极“呕吐彗星”。在加入 Space.com 之前，他曾担任《洛杉矶时报》的特约记者，报道城市和教育动态。他拥有南加州大学和纽约大学的新闻学学位。

paras.en: Space.com is the premier source of space exploration, innovation and astronomy news, chronicling (and celebrating) humanity's ongoing expansion across the final frontier. Originally founded in 1999, Space.com is, and always has been, the passion of writers and editors who are space fans and also trained journalists. Our current news team consists of Editor-in-Chief Tariq Malik; Editor Hanneke Weitering, Senior Space Writer Mike Wall; Senior Writer Meghan Bartels; Senior Writer Chelsea Gohd, Senior Writer Tereza Pultarova and Staff Writer Alexander Cox, focusing on e-commerce. Senior Producer Steve Spaleta oversees our space videos, with Diana Whitcroft as our Social Media Editor.
paras.zh: Space.com 是太空探索、创新和天文学新闻的主要来源，记录（并庆祝）人类在最后疆域的持续扩张。 Space.com 最初成立于 1999 年，一直以来都是太空迷作家和编辑以及训练有素的记者的热情所在。我们目前的新闻团队由主编塔里克·马利克 (Tariq Malik) 组成；编辑 Hanneke Weitering、高级空间作家 Mike Wall；资深作家梅根·巴特尔斯；高级作家 Chelsea Gohd、高级作家 Tereza Pultarova 和特约作家 Alexander Cox，专注于电子商务。高级制作人 Steve Spaleta 负责监督我们的太空视频，Diana Whitcroft 担任我们的社交媒体编辑。

articles.title: Simera Sense and Spacemanic to Collaborate on a New Complete Dual-Use Mission Solution
articles.author: Spacemanic

paras.en: Czech company Spacemanic and Belgian optical leader Simera Sense are teaming up to deliver a new dual-use satellite solution that can compete with bigger and heavier satellites. Simera Sense xScape200 Dual-Use (DU) camera is integrated into Spacemanic 16U CubeSat platform, bringing high-resolution imaging capabilities to a lightweight, compact spacecraft designed for repeatable deployment and constellation growth.
paras.zh: 捷克公司 Spacemanic 和比利时光学领导者 Simera Sense 正在联手提供一种新的两用卫星解决方案，可以与更大、更重的卫星竞争。 Simera Sense xScape200 两用 (DU) 相机集成到 Spacemanic 16U CubeSat 平台中，为专为可重复部署和星座增长而设计的轻型紧凑型航天器带来高分辨率成像功能。

paras.en: The xScape200 DU combines a compact 12U form factor, low SWaP, and standardised integration to give commercial and defence organisations high-resolution, dual-use imaging capabilities without the need for a larger spacecraft, increased launch costs, or power-intensive mission architectures.
paras.zh: xScape200 DU 结合了紧凑的 12U 外形尺寸、低 SWaP 和标准化集成，为商业和国防组织提供高分辨率、两用成像功能，而无需更大的航天器、增加发射成本或功耗密集型任务架构。

paras.en: Spacemanic designs and builds its satellite platforms, core subsystems and deployers in-house. Owning the whole chain lets the company shape the satellite around the camera instead of forcing the camera into a standard form factor. That covers the satellite’s structure and envelope, its mechanical, electrical, thermal and data interfaces, and how the satellite integrates with the deployer.
paras.zh: Spacemanic 在内部设计和建造卫星平台、核心子系统和部署器。拥有整个链条可以让公司围绕相机塑造卫星，而不是强迫相机采用标准的外形尺寸。其中涵盖了卫星的结构和外壳、机械、电气、热和数据接口，以及卫星如何与部署者集成。

paras.en: The SPACE CANNON deployer accommodates CubeSats up to 16U, with an expanded integration envelope for payloads with protruding elements on the sides and a tuna can at the bottom. This additional space supports larger payload configurations such as the xScape200 DU camera. Removable side panels on all four sides provide direct access to the satellite after integration, enabling final adjustments right before launch. SPACE CANNON is designed for integration with launch vehicles including Falcon 9, Ariane 6, Vega-C, HyImpulse SL1, InnoSpace Hanbit, Spectrum by Isar Aerospace, RFA ONE and HyPrSpace Baguette One.
paras.zh: SPACE CANNON 部署器可容纳高达 16U 的立方体卫星，并具有扩展的有效载荷集成外壳，侧面有突出元件，底部有一个金枪鱼罐头。这个额外的空间支持更大的有效负载配置，例如 xScape200 DU 相机。所有四个侧面的可拆卸侧面板可在集成后直接访问卫星，从而在发射前进行最终调整。 SPACE CANNON 设计用于与 Falcon 9、Ariane 6、Vega-C、HyImpulse SL1、InnoSpace Hanbit、Spectrum by Isar Aerospace、RFA ONE 和 HyPrSpace Baguette One 等运载火箭集成。

paras.en: Together, the camera, tailored platform and deployer form a complete mission solution that simplifies the path from payload integration to launch. Beyond the technical development, Spacemanic and Simera are shaping the future of the commercial and dual use market.
paras.zh: 相机、定制平台和部署器共同构成了完整的任务解决方案，简化了从有效载荷集成到发射的路径。除了技术开发之外，Spacemanic 和 Simera 还在塑造商业和军民两用市场的未来。

articles.title: Building a ‘highway to the moon and back’ with Winnie Lai
articles.author: SpaceNews Editor

paras.en: In this episode, SpaceNews’ Mike Gruss speaks with Winnie Lai, CEO of Auriga Space.
paras.zh: 在本集中，SpaceNews 的 Mike Gruss 与 Auriga Space 首席执行官 Winnie Lai 进行了对话。

paras.en: They talk about how electromagnetic launch technology that “catapults” small launch vehicles could cut down on fuel costs. She describes a “paradigm shift” through new technology that could enable new operations in space through low-cost, targeted missions, and what that means for Golden Dome missile defense interceptors.
paras.zh: 他们讨论了“弹射”小型运载火箭的电磁发射技术如何降低燃料成本。她描述了新技术的“范式转变”，可以通过低成本、有针对性的任务实现太空新行动，以及这对金顶导弹防御拦截器意味着什么。

paras.en: Space Minds is a new audio and video podcast from SpaceNews that focuses on the inspiring leaders, technologies and exciting opportunities in space.
paras.zh: Space Minds 是 SpaceNews 推出的新音频和视频播客，重点关注太空中鼓舞人心的领导者、技术和令人兴奋的机会。

paras.en: The weekly podcast features compelling interviews with scientists, founders and experts who love to talk about space, covers the news that has enthusiasts daydreaming, and engages with listeners. Join Mike Gruss and journalists from the SpaceNews team for new episodes every Thursday.
paras.zh: 每周播客对热爱谈论太空的科学家、创始人和专家进行引人注目的采访，报道让爱好者们做白日梦的新闻，并与听众互动。每周四与 Mike Gruss 和 SpaceNews 团队的记者一起观看新剧集。

articles.title: Cork Takes the Heat So DRACO’s Data Can Survive
articles.author: Amorim Cork Solutions

paras.en: Mozelos, Portugal, September 2, 2026 – Amorim Cork Solutions is contributing its P50 cork-based thermal protection material to DRACO, a European Space Agency (ESA) mission designed to capture rare in-flight data on how satellites break apart during atmospheric reentry.
paras.zh: 葡萄牙莫泽洛斯，2026 年 9 月 2 日 – Amorim Cork Solutions 正在向 DRACO 贡献其 P50 软木热防护材料，DRACO 是欧洲航天局 (ESA) 的一项任务，旨在捕获有关卫星在重返大气层期间如何分解的罕见飞行数据。

paras.en: Scheduled for launch in 2027, DRACO, short for Destructive Reentry Assessment Container Object, will deliberately reenter Earth’s atmosphere and break apart. Around 200 sensors and four cameras will record what happens to the spacecraft throughout the process, generating data that could help improve reentry models and support the development of safer, more sustainable spacecraft.
paras.zh: DRACO（破坏性再入评估容器物体的缩写）计划于 2027 年发射，将故意重新进入地球大气层并解体。大约 200 个传感器和四个摄像头将记录航天器在整个过程中发生的情况，生成有助于改进再入模型并支持开发更安全、更可持续的航天器的数据。

paras.en: At the heart of this unusual engineering challenge is a 40 cm survival capsule. While the spacecraft around it is designed to break apart, the capsule must survive long enough to preserve and transmit the mission’s critical scientific data. Its heat shield will use Amorim P50, a cork-based ablative thermal protection material developed for demanding aerospace environments.
paras.zh: 这项不同寻常的工程挑战的核心是一个 40 厘米的救生舱。虽然它周围的航天器被设计为会分解，但太空舱必须存活足够长的时间才能保存和传输任务的关键科学数据。其隔热罩将使用 Amorim P50，这是一种为要求苛刻的航空航天环境而开发的基于软木的烧蚀热防护材料。

paras.en: During reentry, DRACO will encounter intense thermal and mechanical conditions as the spacecraft progressively breaks apart. Data collected by its sensors and cameras will be processed onboard, with the most valuable information transferred to the survival capsule.
paras.zh: 在重返大气层期间，随着航天器逐渐解体，DRACO 将遇到强烈的热和机械条件。其传感器和摄像头收集的数据将在船上进行处理，最有价值的信息将传输到救生舱中。

paras.en: Protecting that capsule is therefore essential to the mission.
paras.zh: 因此，保护​​该太空舱对于此次任务至关重要。

paras.en: The von Karman Institute for Fluid Dynamics (VKI), which is responsible for key aspects of the capsule’s design, aerothermodynamics, and thermal protection development and validation, selected Amorim P50 for its heat shield.
paras.zh: 冯卡门流体动力学研究所 (VKI) 负责胶囊设计、空气热力学以及热防护开发和验证的关键方面，选择 Amorim P50 作为其隔热罩。

paras.en: P50 is a lightweight, cork-based ablative material designed to provide thermal protection in demanding aerospace applications. Its selection for DRACO builds on approximately 15 years of collaboration between Amorim and VKI in the field of aerothermodynamics and thermal protection.
paras.zh: P50 是一种轻质软木烧蚀材料，旨在为要求苛刻的航空航天应用提供热保护。 DRACO 的选择建立在 Amorim 和 VKI 在空气热力学和热防护领域约 15 年的合作基础上。

paras.en: “DRACO represents a remarkable engineering challenge: designing a spacecraft to break apart while ensuring that the knowledge generated during that process survives,” said Sofia Paixão, Global Technical & Product Manager at Amorim Cork Solutions. “We are proud to see Amorim P50 contributing to that challenge and to a mission that could deepen our understanding of atmospheric reentry and help inform the design of future spacecraft.”
paras.zh: Amorim Cork Solutions 全球技术和产品经理 Sofia Paixão 表示：“DRACO 代表了一项非凡的工程挑战：设计一艘能够分解的航天器，同时确保该过程中产生的知识得以保存。” “我们很自豪看到 Amorim P50 为这一挑战和任务做出贡献，该任务可以加深我们对大气层再入的理解，并有助于为未来航天器的设计提供信息。”

paras.en: Ahead of the mission, the capsule’s thermal protection system has undergone experimental validation at VKI.
paras.zh: 在执行任务之前，太空舱的热保护系统已在 VKI 进行了实验验证。

paras.en: A half-scale version of the capsule was exposed to plasma flows in VKI’s facilities to reproduce key aspects of the aerothermal environment expected during atmospheric reentry. The tests allowed the team to evaluate the heat shield and overall thermal protection design under reentry-like conditions before progressing toward the full-scale capsule.
paras.zh: 半比例版本的太空舱在 VKI 设施中暴露于等离子流中，以重现大气再入期间预期的气热环境的关键方面。这些测试使团队能够在类似重返大气层的条件下评估隔热罩和整体热防护设计，然后再进入全尺寸太空舱。

paras.en: “We have extensively tested P50 within the DRACO programme. It is a highly insulating, robust, and predictable ablative material that is readily available on the commercial market,” said Dr. Bernd Helber, Research Expert in Aerothermochemistry at the von Karman Institute for Fluid Dynamics (VKI).
paras.zh: “我们在 DRACO 计划中对 P50 进行了广泛的测试。它是一种高度绝缘、坚固且可预测的烧蚀材料，在商业市场上很容易买到，”冯卡门流体动力学研究所 (VKI) 空气热化学研究专家 Bernd Helber 博士说。

paras.en: The DRACO mission is not the first time Amorim P50 has been used by VKI for an experimental reentry spacecraft. The material was previously selected for QARMAN, the QubeSat for Aerothermodynamic Research and Measurements on AblatioN, developed by VKI to collect data during atmospheric reentry.
paras.zh: DRACO 任务并不是 VKI 第一次将 Amorim P50 用于实验性再入航天器。该材料之前曾被用于QARMAN（用于空气热力学研究和烧蚀测量的QubeSat）选择，该卫星由VKI 开发，用于收集大气再入过程中的数据。

paras.en: DRACO marks the next chapter in this long-standing collaboration, bringing cork-based thermal protection technology to a new European mission with an ambitious scientific objective.
paras.zh: DRACO 标志着这一长期合作的新篇章，将基于软木塞的热防护技术带入新的欧洲使命，实现雄心勃勃的科学目标。

paras.en: Once DRACO begins its final descent, its sensors and cameras will document the spacecraft’s breakup and transfer the most important information to the protected capsule.
paras.zh: 一旦 DRACO 开始最后的下降，它的传感器和摄像机将记录航天器的解体并将最重要的信息传输到受保护的太空舱。

paras.en: The data collected by DRACO is expected to provide valuable insight into how spacecraft structures and materials behave during atmospheric reentry. The findings will help improve reentry models and support ESA’s work on Design for Demise, an approach aimed at designing spacecraft so that they break up more completely during reentry, reducing the risk posed by surviving debris.
paras.zh: DRACO 收集的数据预计将为航天器结构和材料在重返大气层期间的行为提供有价值的见解。这些发现将有助于改进再入模型，并支持欧空局的“死亡设计”工作，该方法旨在设计航天器，使其在再入过程中更彻底地解体，从而降低残存碎片带来的风险。

paras.en: The mission contributes to ESA’s broader Zero Debris approach, which aims to significantly reduce the creation of debris in Earth and lunar orbits by 2030.
paras.zh: 该任务为欧空局更广泛的零碎片方法做出了贡献，该方法的目标是到 2030 年大幅减少地球和月球轨道上碎片的产生。

paras.en: For Amorim Cork Solutions, DRACO further demonstrates the role cork-based thermal protection materials can play in demanding space applications, combining the natural thermal properties of cork with engineered solutions developed to perform under extreme conditions.
paras.zh: 对于阿莫林软木解决方案，DRACO 进一步展示了基于软木的热防护材料在要求苛刻的空间应用中可以发挥的作用，将软木的自然热性能与为在极端条件下运行而开发的工程解决方案相结合。

articles.title: Hubble Learns Galactic History From Stars

paras.en: This NASA/ESA Hubble Space Telescope image provides a lesson in galactic history. The sparkling collection of stars is named Messier 30 (M30) after the French astronomer, Charles Messier, who cataloged M30 and other diffuse objects that might be mistaken for comets in the early telescopes of Messier’s time. M30 lies about 27,500 light-years away in the constellation Capricornus.
paras.zh: 这张美国宇航局/欧洲航天局哈勃太空望远镜的图像为银河历史提供了教训。这个闪闪发光的恒星集合被命名为梅西耶 30 (M30)，以法国天文学家查尔斯·梅西耶 (Charles Messier) 的名字命名，他对 M30 和其他在梅西耶时代的早期望远镜中可能被误认为彗星的漫射天体进行了编目。 M30 位于摩羯座，距离我们约 27,500 光年。

paras.en: M30 is a globular cluster: a roughly spherical grouping of stars containing anywhere from tens of thousands to millions of stars. These clusters generally reside on the outskirts of galaxies, orbiting within a vast, diffuse region called the halo like a swarm of moths around a lightbulb. Our Milky Way galaxy has at least 150 globular clusters, the nearest of which is about 6,000 light-years away. These clusters are impressively ancient: astronomers estimate their ages are between 11.5 to 13.5 billion years, making certain globular clusters nearly as old as the universe itself.
paras.zh: M30 是一个球状星团：大致呈球形的恒星群，包含数万到数百万颗恒星。这些星团通常位于星系的外围，在一个巨大的、分散的区域（称为光环）内绕轨道运行，就像一群飞蛾围绕着灯泡一样。我们的银河系至少有 150 个球状星团，其中最近的球状星团距我们约 6000 光年。这些星团非常古老：天文学家估计它们的年龄在 11.5 至 135 亿年之间，使得某些球状星团几乎与宇宙本身一样古老。

paras.en: Globular clusters have long played an important role in helping us learn about our galaxy. More than a century ago, astronomer Harlow Shapley used observations of a particular type of variable star to measure the locations of and distances to dozens of globular clusters within our galaxy. His work showed that the Sun is not in the center of our galaxy, and that the galactic center lies toward the constellation Sagittarius. (His distance measurements were incorrect, however, and he concluded that our galaxy is about twice as large as it really is.)
paras.zh: 球状星团长期以来在帮助我们了解银河系方面发挥着重要作用。一个多世纪前，天文学家哈洛·沙普利利用对特定类型变星的观测来测量银河系内数十个球状星团的位置和距离。他的工作表明太阳并不位于我们银河系的中心，银河系中心位于人马座附近。 （然而，他的距离测量是不正确的，他得出的结论是，我们的星系大约是实际大小的两倍。）

paras.en: Today, astronomers continue to learn about our galaxy by observing globular clusters. Because globular clusters are so ancient, they can give us clues about how our galaxy developed long ago. Globular clusters that formed within our galaxy can act as time capsules, preserving the original chemistry of our young galaxy.
paras.zh: 今天，天文学家继续通过观察球状星团来了解我们的星系。由于球状星团非常古老，它们可以为我们提供有关银河系很久以前如何发展的线索。在我们的星系内形成的球状星团可以充当时间胶囊，保留我们年轻星系的原始化学成分。

paras.en: However, it’s possible that not all globular clusters that orbit within our galaxy today formed there. Researchers have discovered that M30 and many other globular clusters orbit in the direction opposite from the way our galaxy spins. This may mean that these clusters did not form within our galaxy at all. Instead, our Milky Way galaxy may have captured them in the distant past!
paras.zh: 然而，今天在我们银河系内运行的所有球状星团可能并非都是在那里形成的。研究人员发现，M30 和许多其他球状星团的轨道运行方向与我们星系的自转方向相反。这可能意味着这些星团根本不是在我们的银河系内形成的。相反，我们的银河系可能在遥远的过去捕获了它们！

paras.en: Hubble has observed M30 multiple times. A previously released image of M30 featured data from Hubble’s Advanced Camera for Surveys (ACS) and was part of an observing program (#10775; PI: Sarajedini) that surveyed dozens of Milky Way globular clusters in red and near-infrared light, revealing stars down to just 20% of the mass of the Sun. A more recent program (#13297; PI: Piotto) returned to M30 and other globular clusters in our galaxy, this time observing the clusters with Hubble’s Wide Field Camera 3 and using three filters that captured bluer light. This program collected data that was critical for studying exotic objects like “blue straggler” stars as well as for investigating the multiple populations of stars that can inhabit a single globular cluster.
paras.zh: 哈勃曾多次观测到 M30。之前发布的 M30 图像包含来自哈勃高级巡天相机 (ACS) 的数据，并且是观测计划 (#10775；PI：Sarajedini) 的一部分，该计划在红光和近红外光下观测了数十个银河系球状星团，揭示了质量仅为太阳质量 20% 的恒星。最近的一个项目（#13297；PI：Piotto）返回了 M30 和我们银河系中的其他球状星团，这次用哈勃的广域相机 3 观察这些星团，并使用三个捕捉蓝光的滤光片。该计划收集的数据对于研究“蓝散乱”恒星等奇异天体以及研究可以居住在单个球状星团中的多个恒星群体至关重要。

paras.en: More recently, Hubble’s ACS viewed many of these globular clusters again. Those observations were part of a program (#16298, PI: Libralato) that looked at how different populations of stars in globular clusters moved over the 15 years since Hubble first observed them — a feat made possible by Hubble’s longevity and ability to discern fantastically small details in distant objects.
paras.zh: 最近，哈勃的 ACS 再次观测到了许多这样的球状星团。这些观测是一个项目（#16298，PI：Libralato）的一部分，该项目研究了自哈勃首次观测球状星团中不同恒星群以来的 15 年间如何移动——哈勃的长寿和辨别遥远天体中极其微小细节的能力使这一壮举成为可能。

paras.en: The image above was created with data from all three observing programs and includes the wide range of wavelengths Hubble can see — ultraviolet, visible, and near-infrared light. Each wavelength helps us better understand how these groups of stars formed and evolved.
paras.zh: 上面的图像是根据所有三个观测计划的数据创建的，包括哈勃可以看到的广泛波长范围——紫外线、可见光和近红外光。每个波长都有助于我们更好地了解这些恒星群是如何形成和演化的。

articles.title: NASA Astronauts to Answer Questions from Florida Students
articles.author: Gerelle Q. Dodson

paras.en: Students in Florida will hear from NASA astronauts Jessica Watkins and Luke Delaney as they answer prerecorded STEM questions while aboard the International Space Station.
paras.zh: 佛罗里达州的学生将在国际空间站上听到 NASA 宇航员 Jessica Watkins 和 Luke Delaney 回答预先录制的 STEM 问题。

paras.en: The Earth-to-space call will begin at 10:40 a.m. EST Tuesday, Nov. 10, and will stream live on the agency’s Learn With NASA YouTube channel.
paras.zh: 地对空通话将于美国东部时间 11 月 10 日星期二上午 10:40 开始，并将在该机构的 Learn With NASA YouTube 频道上进行直播。

paras.en: This event is hosted by Freedom Crossing Academy in St. Johns, Florida, for students in grades K-12, and the community. This unique opportunity aims to deepen understanding of space exploration and enhance awareness of STEM careers.
paras.zh: 该活动由佛罗里达州圣约翰斯的 Freedom Crossing Academy 为 K-12 年级的学生和社区举办。这一独特的机会旨在加深对太空探索的理解并增强对 STEM 职业的认识。

paras.en: Media interested in covering the event must RSVP no later than 5 p.m. EST, Monday, Nov. 9, to Christina Upchurch at (904) 547-7517, or at christina.upchurch@stjohns.k12.fl.us.
paras.zh: 有兴趣报道该活动的媒体必须在下午 5 点之前回复。美国东部时间，11 月 9 日星期一，致电 Christina Upchurch，电话 (904) 547-7517，或发送电子邮件至 christina.upchurch@stjohns.k12.fl.us。

paras.en: For more than 26 years, people have lived and worked continuously aboard the International Space Station, advancing scientific knowledge and making research breakthroughs not possible on Earth. The space station helps NASA understand and overcome the challenges of human spaceflight, expand commercial opportunities in low Earth orbit, and build on the foundation for long-duration missions to the Moon, as part of the Artemis program, and to Mars.
paras.zh: 26 年多来，人们在国际空间站上持续生活和工作，推进科学知识进步，取得地球上不可能的研究突破。该空间站帮助美国宇航局了解和克服载人航天的挑战，扩大近地轨道的商业机会，并为长期月球任务（作为阿尔忒弥斯计划的一部分）和火星任务奠定基础。

paras.en: For more information on NASA in-flight calls, visit:
paras.zh: 有关 NASA 飞行通话的更多信息，请访问：

articles.title: UN peacekeeping chief warns of ‘security vacuum’ as Blue Helmets leave Lebanon and Western Sahara

paras.en: UN peacekeeping chief warns of ‘security vacuum’ as Blue Helmets leave Lebanon and Western Sahara
paras.zh: 联合国维和负责人警告蓝盔部队离开黎巴嫩和西撒哈拉将出现“安全真空”

paras.en: The UN’s peacekeeping chief warned on Wednesday that the withdrawal of “Blue Helmets” from Lebanon and Western Sahara risks leaving a dangerous security vacuum, while the Security Council remains divided over what, if anything, should replace them.
paras.zh: 联合国维和事务负责人周三警告说，从黎巴嫩和西撒哈拉撤出“蓝盔”部队可能会造成危险的安全真空，而安理会对于应该用什么来取代他们（如果有的话）仍存在分歧。

paras.en: The UN mission in Western Sahara closed on 31 October after 35 years. In Lebanon, the peacekeeping force that has patrolled the border with Israel since 1978 is due to cease operations at the end of the year.
paras.zh: 联合国西撒哈拉特派团在 35 年后于 10 月 31 日结束。在黎巴嫩，自 1978 年以来一直在以色列边境巡逻的维和部队将于今年年底停止行动。

paras.en: “What happens when there is no longer a third-party presence between the Lebanese army and the Israel Defense Forces?” asked Jean-Pierre Lacroix, Under-Secretary-General for Peace Operations.
paras.zh: “当黎巴嫩军队和以色列国防军之间不再有第三方存在时，会发生什么？”负责和平行动的副秘书长让-皮埃尔·拉克鲁瓦问道。

paras.en: Briefing journalists at UN Headquarters in New York, Mr. Lacroix said the organization was losing some of its longest-standing military deployments, with no guarantee that the countries concerned could maintain stability on their own.
paras.zh: 拉克鲁瓦在纽约联合国总部向记者通报情况时表示，该组织正在失去一些历史最悠久的军事部署，无法保证有关国家能够自行维持稳定。

paras.en: Around 7,500 peacekeepers are still serving with the UN Interim Force in Lebanon (UNIFIL). The force acts as a go-between for the Lebanese and Israeli armies, monitors violations and helps humanitarian aid get through.
paras.zh: 大约 7,500 名维和人员仍在联合国驻黎巴嫩临时部队（联黎部队）服役。该部队充当黎巴嫩和以色列军队的中间人，监视违规行为并帮助人道主义援助顺利通过。

paras.en: Mr. Lacroix has just returned from Lebanon. He said President Joseph Aoun and Prime Minister Nawaf Salam had told him they feared a “security vacuum” once the peacekeepers leave, with no one left to stop border incidents from turning into clashes.
paras.zh: 拉克鲁瓦先生刚刚从黎巴嫩回来。他说，总统约瑟夫·奥恩和总理纳瓦夫·萨拉姆告诉他，他们担心一旦维和人员离开，就会出现“安全真空”，因为没有人能够阻止边境事件演变成冲突。

paras.en: He also raised questions over the future of the Blue Line, which the UN drew to mark Israel’s withdrawal from Lebanon in 2000.
paras.zh: 他还对蓝线的未来提出了疑问，蓝线是联合国为纪念以色列于 2000 年从黎巴嫩撤军而绘制的。

paras.en: There is a humanitarian cost too. Mr. Lacroix offered a cautious estimate that about 10,000 people are still living between the Blue Line and the forward defence line Israel has set up inside Lebanese territory. Their access to aid depends heavily on UNIFIL.
paras.zh: 还有人道主义成本。拉克鲁瓦先生谨慎估计，约有 10,000 人仍居住在蓝线和以色列在黎巴嫩境内设立的前沿防线之间。他们获得援助的机会在很大程度上取决于联黎部队。

paras.en: UN Secretary-General António Guterres put forward options in June, but the Security Council has yet to agree on any follow-on arrangement. Mr. Lacroix urged council members to decide what form a future international presence could take.
paras.zh: 联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯在六月提出了选择，但安理会尚未就任何后续安排达成一致。拉克鲁瓦先生敦促安理会成员决定未来的国际存在可以采取什么形式。

paras.en: The same deadlock has already ended the UN’s presence in Western Sahara. The UN Mission for the Referendum in Western Sahara (MINURSO) shut down on 31 October after council members failed to agree on renewing its mandate.
paras.zh: 同样的僵局已经结束了联合国在西撒哈拉的存在。由于安理会成员未能就延长其任务授权达成一致，联合国西撒哈拉全民投票特派团 (MINURSO) 于 10 月 31 日关闭。

paras.en: Russia vetoed a United States draft that would have reshaped the mission around a solution based on autonomy under Moroccan sovereignty. A rival Russian text calling for a one-year renewal fell short of the nine votes needed to pass.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯否决了美国的一项草案，该草案将围绕基于摩洛哥主权下的自治的解决方案重新调整任务。一份要求续签一年的俄罗斯竞争对手文本未能达到通过所需的九票。

paras.en: MINURSO was set up in 1991 to monitor a ceasefire between Morocco and the Polisario Front. It never held the self-determination referendum it was created to organize, and hostilities in the territory resumed in 2020.
paras.zh: 西撒特派团成立于 1991 年，负责监督摩洛哥与波利萨里奥阵线之间的停火。它从未举行过其创建目的的自决公投，该领土的敌对行动于 2020 年重新爆发。

paras.en: Mr. Lacroix confirmed that the mission was now in its liquidation phase. The UN is urging the parties to show restraint and remains committed to a political solution that provides for the self-determination of the people of Western Sahara.
paras.zh: 拉克鲁瓦先生证实，该特派团目前正处于清理结束阶段。联合国敦促各方保持克制，并继续致力于实现西撒哈拉人民自决的政治解决方案。

paras.en: Mr. Lacroix also recently visited Syria and peacekeepers serving in the Golan. He said UN observers there were receiving complaints from civilians about detentions, movement restrictions and property seizures linked to the Israeli military presence. He said their mediation had led to several people being released and some property being returned.
paras.zh: 拉克鲁瓦先生最近还访问了叙利亚和在戈兰高地服役的维和人员。他说，那里的联合国观察员收到了平民关于与以色列军事存在有关的拘留、行动限制和财产扣押的投诉。他说，他们的调解导致一些人被释放，一些财产被归还。

paras.en: In Abyei, the territory disputed by Sudan and South Sudan, recent drone attacks have highlighted another growing danger. Blue Helmets are having to adapt to technologies that put both their own personnel and the civilians they protect at risk.
paras.zh: 在苏丹和南苏丹有争议的领土阿卜耶伊，最近的无人机袭击凸显了另一个日益严重的危险。蓝盔部队必须适应那些将他们自己的人员和他们保护的平民置于危险之中的技术。

paras.en: The UN is reviewing its military and technological capabilities. But Mr. Lacroix said the answer could not be purely technical. Above all, he said, it was a matter of “political responsibility”.
paras.zh: 联合国正在审查其军事和技术能力。但拉克鲁瓦先生表示，答案不可能纯粹是技术性的。他说，最重要的是，这是一个“政治责任”的问题。

articles.title: Two new Ebola vaccines to join DR Congo clinical trial

paras.en: Two new Ebola vaccines to join DR Congo clinical trial
paras.zh: 两种新的埃博拉疫苗将参加刚果民主共和国临床试验

paras.en: Two new Ebola vaccine candidates will be added to a clinical trial in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) as the country continues to battle a deadly outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo species of the virus.
paras.zh: 刚果民主共和国 (DRC) 正在继续抗击由本迪布焦 (Bundibugyo) 病毒引起的致命疫情，两种新的埃博拉候选疫苗将被添加到刚果民主共和国 (DRC) 的临床试验中。

paras.en: The announcement by the UN World Health Organization (WHO) follows the recommendation of its independent Technical Advisory Group on Candidate Vaccines Prioritization.
paras.zh: 联合国世界卫生组织（WHO）的这一宣布是根据其候选疫苗优先顺序独立技术咨询小组的建议而做出的。

paras.en: This will mark the first time that vaccines specifically designed for Bundibugyo virus will be evaluated during an outbreak of the disease.
paras.zh: 这将标志着专门针对本迪布焦病毒设计的疫苗将首次在疾病爆发期间进行评估。

paras.en: “The fact that these vaccines are ready to enter clinical trials is a testament to the power of science and partnership,” said WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus.
paras.zh: 世卫组织总干事谭德塞表示：“这些疫苗已准备好进入临床试验，这证明了科学和伙伴关系的力量。”

paras.en: He stressed that while vaccines alone will not end the outbreak, “they could become a powerful new tool for bringing it under control”.
paras.zh: 他强调，虽然疫苗本身并不能结束疫情，但“它们可以成为控制疫情的强大新工具”。

paras.en: The two vaccine candidates are ChAdOx1, developed by the University of Oxford with the Serum Institute of India, and mRNA-1469, developed by the American pharmaceutical and biotech company Moderna.
paras.zh: 这两种候选疫苗分别是牛津大学与印度血清研究所合作开发的 ChAdOx1 和美国制药和生物技术公司 Moderna 开发的 mRNA-1469。

paras.en: WHO convened the expert group which this week recommended them for further clinical evaluation, based on available evidence.
paras.zh: 世卫组织召集了专家组，本周建议他们根据现有证据进行进一步的临床评估。

paras.en: The DRC has been battling a deadly outbreak of Ebola disease caused by the rare Bundibugyo virus species for nearly six months and it has become the largest in the country’s history. As of 1 November, there were more than 10,500 confirmed cases and 5,126 deaths.
paras.zh: 近六个月来，刚果民主共和国一直在与罕见的本迪布焦病毒引起的致命埃博拉疫情作斗争，这已成为该国历史上规模最大的一次。截至11月1日，确诊病例超过10,500例，死亡病例5,126例。

paras.en: WHO is supporting the Tumaini multi-vaccine trial, named after the Swahili word for “hope”. It was launched on 23 October in the eastern city of Bunia, capital of Ituri province, which remains the epicentre of the outbreak.
paras.zh: 世卫组织正在支持图迈尼多种疫苗试验，该试验以斯瓦希里语“希望”一词命名。它于 10 月 23 日在伊图里省省会东部城市布尼亚启动，该省仍然是疫情爆发的中心。

paras.en: The Ervebo vaccine, used to treat the Zaire species of the Ebola virus, is already being tested to determine if it is effective against Bundibugyo species. The two new vaccine candidates will enter the trial following national approvals.
paras.zh: 用于治疗扎伊尔埃博拉病毒的 Ervebo 疫苗已经过测试，以确定它是否对本迪布焦病毒有效。这两种新候选疫苗将在国家批准后进入试验。

paras.en: Tumaini is designed to test multiple vaccine candidates within a single trial, using a ring-vaccination approach that focuses on contacts of people with confirmed Ebola Bundibugyo.
paras.zh: Tumaini 旨在在一次试验中测试多种候选疫苗，采用环疫苗接种方法，重点关注已确诊的埃博拉本迪布焦患者的接触者。

paras.en: WHO and partners pioneered the strategy during the West Africa Ebola outbreak a decade ago, where a trial in Guinea established the efficacy of the Ervebo vaccine.
paras.zh: 十年前，世卫组织和合作伙伴在西非埃博拉疫情爆发期间率先采用了这一战略，几内亚的一项试验证实了 Ervebo 疫苗的功效。

paras.en: Four vaccination rings have been set up and several more are being prepared, while research into other potential treatments is also moving forward.
paras.zh: 四个疫苗接种环已经建立，另外几个疫苗接种环正在准备中，同时对其他潜在治疗方法的研究也在进行中。

articles.title: Children at risk as war zone attacks on water and sanitation more than triple

paras.en: Children at risk as war zone attacks on water and sanitation more than triple
paras.zh: 战区对水和卫生设施的攻击使儿童面临三倍以上的危险

paras.en: Attacks that damaged or destroyed water and sanitation systems in conflict zones tripled between 2021 and 2025, increasing children’s risk of exposure to disease outbreaks, malnutrition and violence.
paras.zh: 2021 年至 2025 年间，冲突地区破坏或破坏供水和卫生系统的袭击增加了两倍，增加了儿童遭受疾病爆发、营养不良和暴力的风险。

paras.en: That’s one key finding from the latest Water Under Fire report by the UN Children’s Fund (UNICEF), published on Thursday.
paras.zh: 这是联合国儿童基金会 (UNICEF) 周四发布的最新《水下火灾》报告中的一项重要发现。

paras.en: It documents airstrikes and other assaults on water, sanitation and hygiene (WASH) systems – and their personnel and communities that depend on these facilities – in 23 countries and territories.
paras.zh: 它记录了 23 个国家和地区对水、环境卫生和个人卫生 (WASH) 系统以及依赖这些设施的人员和社区的空袭和其他攻击。

paras.en: Attacks rose from fewer than 45 incidents across eight countries in 2021 to more than 135 incidents across 15 countries in 2025.
paras.zh: 攻击事件从 2021 年在 8 个国家发生的不到 45 起事件增加到 2025 年在 15 个国家发生的超过 135 起事件。

paras.en: UNICEF Executive Director Catherine Russell stressed that attacks on water and sanitation systems “deprive children of safe drinking water and the essential services that rely on water to function effectively”.
paras.zh: 联合国儿童基金会执行主任凯瑟琳·拉塞尔强调，对供水和卫生设施系统的攻击“剥夺了儿童的安全饮用水和依赖水有效运作的基本服务”。

paras.en: Water Under Fire 4 covers the period from January 2021 to June 2026, revealing an increasing pattern of attacks worldwide.
paras.zh: 《Water Under Fire 4》涵盖了 2021 年 1 月至 2026 年 6 月期间，揭示了全球范围内不断增加的攻击模式。

paras.en: The report identified seven assault categories, ranging from strikes on treatment plants, pipelines and wells, to contamination of water sources, and imposing restrictions on the supply of spare parts and chemicals needed for water treatment.
paras.zh: 该报告确定了七种攻击类别，包括袭击处理厂、管道和水井，污染水源，以及限制水处理所需的备件和化学品的供应。

paras.en: It cited examples from places such as Sudan, where by March 2024, only one of the 13 water treatment plants in Khartoum state was fully operational, while more than 130,000 meters of sewage pipelines have been destroyed in the Gaza Strip since October 2023.
paras.zh: 报告列举了苏丹等地的例子，截至2024年3月，喀土穆州13座水处理厂中只有1座全面投入运营，而加沙地带自2023年10月以来已毁坏了超过13万米的污水管道。

paras.en: The report revealed how water supply disruptions can occur even if pipes and pumps remain intact.
paras.zh: 该报告揭示了即使管道和水泵完好无损，供水也会发生中断。

paras.en: In Iraq, a drone attack on a gas field in November 2025 reduced electricity production in the Kurdistan region by about 80 per cent, forcing authorities to ration and distribute power between water projects, hospitals and cities.
paras.zh: 在伊拉克，2025 年 11 月，无人机袭击了一个气田，导致库尔德斯坦地区的发电量减少了约 80%，迫使当局在水利项目、医院和城市之间进行配给和分配电力。

paras.en: Beyond access to drinking water, attacks also have indirect and long-term consequences – what the UNICEF report called “reverberating effects”.
paras.zh: 除了获得饮用水之外，袭击还会产生间接和长期的后果——联合国儿童基金会的报告称之为“回响效应”。

paras.en: The agency said lack of clean water means that health systems cannot sterilize equipment, deliver babies safely or prepare therapeutic milk for children suffering from severe malnutrition.
paras.zh: 该机构表示，缺乏清洁水意味着卫生系统无法对设备进行消毒、安全分娩或为患有严重营养不良的儿童准备治疗性牛奶。

paras.en: The report also documented instances of children being killed, injured, or harmed while waiting in line for water, citing numerous examples from the Gaza Strip.
paras.zh: 报告还引用了加沙地带的许多例子，记录了儿童在排队取水时被杀、受伤或伤害的情况。

paras.en: It highlighted the threats faced by women and girls, who are often responsible for fetching water for their families, including risk of sexual violence and loss of educational opportunities.
paras.zh: 它强调了经常负责为家人取水的妇女和女孩所面临的威胁，包括性暴力风险和失去教育机会。

paras.en: Attention was also given to the risks faced by workers in water facilities, with the UN, for example, recording the killing of 14 water facility employees in Lebanon during the 2024 conflict.
paras.zh: 人们还关注供水设施工人面临的风险，例如，联合国记录了 2024 年冲突期间黎巴嫩有 14 名供水设施员工被杀。

paras.en: UNICEF's Louise Wateridge in Ukraine reports on attacks that disrupted water supply in Kyiv this week:
paras.zh: 联合国儿童基金会驻乌克兰办事处的路易丝·沃特里奇 (Louise Wateridge) 报告了本周基辅供水中断的袭击事件：

paras.en: UNICEF called on warring parties, Member States, donors, and humanitarian and development actors to:
paras.zh: 儿童基金会呼吁交战各方、会员国、捐助者以及人道主义和发展行为体：

paras.en: 🔹 Protect water, sanitation and hygiene systems in conflict zones as an indispensable element for the survival of civilians, especially children.
paras.zh: 🔹 保护冲突地区的供水、环境卫生和个人卫生系统，这是平民（尤其是儿童）生存不可或缺的要素。

paras.en: 🔹 Establish a mechanism to systematically collect data on attacks targeting water, sanitation and hygiene facilities in conflict contexts.
paras.zh: 🔹 建立机制，系统收集冲突背景下针对水、环境卫生和个人卫生设施的攻击的数据。

paras.en: 🔹 Protect children and communities seeking access to water, sanitation and hygiene services, as well as protecting workers in these sectors and in the energy sector.
paras.zh: 🔹 保护寻求水、环境卫生和个人卫生服务的儿童和社区，并保护这些部门和能源部门的工人。

paras.en: 🔹 Facilitate safe and unhindered access for humanitarian, water and energy workers to those in need, and to the essential supplies necessary for the continued operation of water and energy systems, and
paras.zh: 🔹 帮助人道主义工作者、水务和能源工作者安全、不受阻碍地接触有需要的人，并获得水和能源系统持续运行所需的基本物资，以及

paras.en: 🔹 Invest in approaches that are resilient to conflict, and supporting locally led service continuity arrangements.
paras.zh: 🔹 投资能够抵御冲突的方法，并支持当地主导的服务连续性安排。

paras.en: The report noted that funding cuts are undermining humanitarian efforts to ensure access to clean water.
paras.zh: 报告指出，资金削减正在破坏确保获得清洁水的人道主义努力。

paras.en: Among countries experiencing a coordinated humanitarian response in the WASH sector, 137.9 million people need assistance in this area, while only 26 per cent of the funding required this year has been received.
paras.zh: 在 WASH 领域经历协调人道主义响应的国家中，有 1.379 亿人需要该领域的援助，而今年所需资金只收到了 26%。

paras.en: “Humanitarian workers do their best to keep water flowing despite increasing attacks,” said Ms. Russell. “However, repairs cannot substitute for the protection of these facilities that is required under international humanitarian law.”
paras.zh: “尽管袭击不断增加，人道主义工作者仍尽最大努力保持水源流动，”拉塞尔女士说。 “但是，修复不能替代国际人道法所要求的对这些设施的保护。”

paras.zh: 在电视转播的底牌中，伦敦选手丹泽尔·本特利 (Denzel Bentley) 与拳击传奇人物肖恩·莫斯利 (Shane Mosley) 的儿子小肖恩·莫斯利 (Shane Mosley Jr) 进行了一场世界级的中量级对决。

paras.en: American heavyweight destroyer Da'Mazion Vanhouter will face Ivan Balaz. Vanhouter had an eye-opening performance on the Garcia vs Benn card in September, demolishing Raphael Akpejiori in the first round.
paras.zh: 美国重量级驱逐舰达马齐恩·范胡特号将对阵伊万·巴拉兹。范胡特在九月份加西亚对阵本的比赛中表现出色，在第一轮就击败了拉斐尔·阿克佩吉奥里。

paras.en: Scottish middleweight phenom Sam Hickey boxes Amaury Massenaux, while Kayla Allen has her second professional fight against Julia Igel.

paras.en: Rising cruiserweight Lucas Roehrig will fight Scottish champion Connal McDonald in an eight-rounder.
paras.zh: 轻量级新秀卢卡斯·罗里格将与苏格兰冠军康纳尔·麦克唐纳进行八回合比赛。

articles.title: Odegaard clinches Arsenal win over stubborn Hull

paras.en: Arsenal 1-0 Hull City: Martin Odegaard breaks Tigers' resistance to clinch victory for Premier League champions
paras.zh: 阿森纳1-0赫尔城：马丁·厄德高打破老虎队的抵抗，为英超冠军锁定胜利

paras.en: Report and free highlights as Arsenal go six points clear thanks to Martin Odegaard's 72nd-minute goal against Hull; Tigers frustrated hosts before Arsenal skipper made breakthrough; Gunners go six points clear before Man City face Nottingham Forest
paras.zh: 报告和免费精彩集锦，阿森纳凭借马丁·厄德高在对阵赫尔城的第 72 分钟的进球领先 6 分；在阿森纳队长取得突破之前，老虎队让主队感到沮丧；曼城对阵诺丁汉森林之前枪手领先六分

paras.en: Martin Odegaard's goal clinched a 1-0 win over Hull to send Arsenal six points clear at the top of the Premier League table.
paras.zh: 马丁·厄德高的进球帮助阿森纳1-0战胜赫尔城，使阿森纳在英超积分榜上以6分的优​​势领先。

paras.en: Hull defended resolutely for over an hour at the Emirates Stadium but the pressure told when Odegaard reacted quickest to convert a rebound after Konstantinos Tzolakis had saved from Noni Madueke.
paras.zh: 赫尔城在酋长球场顽强地防守了一个多小时，但在康斯坦丁诺斯·佐拉基斯扑出诺尼·马杜克的扑救后，厄德高反应最快，将篮板球转化为篮板球，压力告诉了球队。

paras.en: Arsenal struggled to create clear openings for much of the contest and lacked cutting edge in the first half as Kai Havertz wasted a one-on-one chance and Christos Tzolis spurned opportunities.
paras.zh: 阿森纳在比赛的大部分时间里都在努力创造明显的空档，并且在上半场缺乏领先优势，因为凯·哈弗茨浪费了一对一的机会，而克里斯托·佐利斯则拒绝了机会。

paras.en: The hosts were also controversially denied a penalty following a VAR check when Havertz was adjudged to have been offside as his shirt was pulled by Nobel Mendy near the end of the first period.
paras.zh: 在第一节比赛即将结束时，哈弗茨的球衣被诺贝尔门迪拉扯，经VAR检查后，主队也被判定越位，从而导致主队判罚点球。

paras.en: Hull were difficult to break down and went close to an opener when Elliot Stroud forced a fine save from a full-stretch David Raya, but Arsenal stepped up the intensity in the second half and eventually made the all-important breakthrough.

paras.en: Odegaard's goal, his first since a run of four in five games between August and September, extends their lead over Manchester City before Enzo Maresca's side face Nottingham Forest.
paras.zh: 厄德高的进球是他自八月至九月五场比赛中连续打进四球以来的首个进球，在恩佐·马雷斯卡的球队对阵诺丁汉森林之前，扩大了曼城对曼城的领先优势。

paras.en: Analysis: Konsa sums up Arsenal solidity
paras.zh: 分析：康萨总结了阿森纳的稳定性

paras.en: This was not a vintage attacking display from Arsenal but defensively there were few faults. Their seventh clean sheet in 10 Premier League games, and 10th in 16 overall, owed a lot to their centre-back pairing. Gabriel and Ezri Konsa excelled again.
paras.zh: 这不是阿森纳老式的进攻表现，但防守上却很少有失误。他们在 10 场英超比赛中第 7 次不失球，在 16 场英超联赛中第 10 场不失球，这在很大程度上要归功于他们的中后卫组合。加布里埃尔和埃兹里·孔萨再次表现出色。

paras.en: William Saliba's impending return will put pressure on Konsa to retain his place but on current form he may keep hold of the shirt. Highlights from his display included a last-ditch block on Mohamed Ali-Cho when was suddenly exposed on the break.
paras.zh: 威廉·萨利巴即将回归，这将给孔萨带来保住位置的压力，但以目前的状态，他可能会继续保留这件球衣。他的表演亮点包括在突破时突然暴露出对穆罕默德·阿里·乔的最后一搏阻挡。

paras.en: There was no self-congratulation afterwards. Instead he berated the referee for a perceived Hull foul, then got on with business. By the end of the game, he had won all seven of his duels and completed all but two of his 53 passes, a picture of composure.
paras.zh: 事后并没有自我庆幸。相反，他斥责了裁判认为赫尔城犯规，然后继续做生意。到比赛结束时，他赢得了全部 7 场对决，并完成了 53 次传球中除了 2 次以外的所有传球，表现得十分冷静。

paras.en: He is making an immense contribution at the club. Arsenal had one early scare when Stroud forced a save from Raya but it is now 444 minutes without conceding a goal in the Premier League.
paras.zh: 他为俱乐部做出了巨大贡献。阿森纳一开始就被斯特劳德逼迫拉亚扑出一球而吓了一跳，但现在英超联赛已经 444 分钟没有丢球了。

paras.en: Odegaard won it but Konsa did his bit too.
paras.zh: 厄德高赢得了冠军，但康萨也尽了自己的一份力量。

paras.en: Hull head coach Sergej Jakirovic speaking to Sky Sports:
paras.zh: 赫尔城主教练谢尔盖·雅基罗维奇在接受天空体育采访时表示：

paras.en: "We were brave, especially in the defensive phase. We didn't allow a lot of space. Sometimes we lost duels and they had good transitions.
paras.zh: “我们很勇敢，尤其是在防守阶段。我们没有留出太多空间。有时我们输掉了对决，但他们有很好的过渡。

paras.en: "On the ball, we needed much better decisions to be braver and quicker transitions. If we had this, then we'd be more dangerous.
paras.zh: “在球方面，我们需要更好的决定来变得更勇敢、更快的转变。如果我们有这个，那么我们会更加危险。

paras.en: "We had some good chances but they stopped them."
paras.zh: “我们有一些很好的机会，但他们阻止了它们。”

paras.en: Newcastle thought they had earned a first-half lead when Dan Burn nodded home from a corner but his celebrations in front of his old fans were cut short with Yoane Wissa penalised for a shirt pull on Timothy Castagne.
paras.zh: 当丹·伯恩（Dan Burn）从角球中头球破门时，纽卡斯尔认为他们已经获得了上半场的领先，但他在老球迷面前的庆祝活动被打断了，尤恩·维萨（Yoane Wissa）因拉扯蒂莫西·卡斯塔尼（Timothy Castagne）的球衣而受到处罚。

paras.en: There should have been no need for the VAR had Harvey Barnes buried his chance when played in behind moments earlier, but aimed hisfinish too close to Bernd Leno when clean through.
paras.zh: 如果哈维·巴恩斯在早些时候落后时错失了机会，但在干净利落的时候他的射门距离贝恩德·莱诺太近了，那么就没有必要使用VAR了。

paras.en: The best Fulham could muster, despite their territorial dominance, was a Josh King volley and a glancing header from their internationally-recognised teenager, as their recent struggles in front of goal continued.
paras.zh: 尽管富勒姆在领土上占据统治地位，但他们能拿出的最佳表现是约什·金的凌空抽射和国际公认的少年的一记头球，而他们最近在球门前的挣扎仍在继续。

paras.en: The game appeared to be drifting towards a first draw between these two in 19 Premier League meetings in the capital, until a loose pass from Cesar Palacios across midfield allowed Murphy to run at Antonee Robinson before turning inside and unleashing an unstoppable effort beyond Leno.
paras.zh: 这场比赛似乎正朝着两人在首都举行的 19 场英超联赛中的第一次平局的方向发展，直到塞萨尔·帕拉西奥斯 (Cesar Palacios) 穿过中场的松散传球让墨菲 (Murphy) 跑向安东尼·罗宾逊 (Antonee Robinson)，然后转身内线，在莱诺 (Leno) 之外发动了不可阻挡的射门。

paras.en: The relief in Jaissle's celebration was evident but was only a brief respite with Fulham's messy equaliser coming only three minutes later, as Palacios' pass deflected into the path of Muniz and his inventive flick beat Lukas Hornicek with some help from Burn.
paras.zh: 贾塞尔的庆祝动作明显松了口气，但这只是短暂的喘息，仅仅三分钟后，富勒姆就扳平了比分，帕拉西奥斯的传球偏向穆尼兹，他创造性的轻击在伯恩的帮助下击败了卢卡斯·霍尼切克。

paras.en: It was his first Premier League goal in seven months but came at the perfect time to rescue a point for the hosts, and deny Jaissle a win he would have found so personally valuable.
paras.zh: 这是他七个月来在英超联赛中的第一个进球，但进球的时机恰到好处，为主队挽回了一分，并阻止了贾塞尔赢得一场对他个人来说非常有价值的胜利。

articles.title: Russell Brand found guilty of rape and sexual assault
articles.author: Adela Suliman

paras.en: LONDON — British comedian and actor Russell Brand was found guilty of rape and sexual assault in a London court Thursday.
paras.zh: 伦敦——周四，英国喜剧演员兼演员拉塞尔·布兰德在伦敦一家法院被判犯有强奸和性侵犯罪。

paras.en: Brand, once one of Britain’s highest-profile broadcasters and the former husband of singer Katy Perry, had denied the accusations, saying the incidents had been consensual, reinvented or reimagined.
paras.zh: 布兰德曾经是英国知名度最高的广播公司之一，也是歌手凯蒂·佩里的前夫，他否认了这些指控，称这些事件是双方同意的、经过重新发明或重新想象的。

paras.en: Brand, 51, was accused of three counts of rape, three counts of sexual assault and one count of attempted indecent assault. Ultimately, he was found guilty of one count of rape and three counts of sexual assault. He was acquitted of the other charges.
paras.zh: 51 岁的布兰德被指控犯有三项强奸罪、三项性侵犯罪和一项企图猥亵罪。最终，他被判犯有一项强奸罪和三项性侵犯罪。他的其他指控被宣告无罪。

paras.en: He had pleaded not guilty to all counts and consistently denied all of the allegations.
paras.zh: 他对所有罪名均表示不认罪，并始终否认所有指控。

paras.en: The judge, Justice Joel Bennathan, told Brand in court that the consequence of the verdicts is a “significant custodial term” and that he would have to remain in prison until he is formally sentenced Monday.
paras.zh: 法官乔尔·本纳森(Joel Bennathan)法官在法庭上告诉布兰德，判决的后果是“重大监禁期限”，他将不得不继续留在监狱里，直到周一被正式判刑。

paras.en: “You’ve been convicted of a number of offenses, including rape,” Bennathan said, adding that Brand inevitably faced a “significant” prison sentence.
paras.zh: 本纳森说：“你已被判犯有多项罪行，包括强奸罪。”他补充说，布兰德不可避免地面临“重大”监禁。

paras.en: The maximum sentence for rape is life imprisonment, and it is 10 years for one count of sexual assault, according to Britain’s Sentencing Council.
paras.zh: 据英国量刑委员会称，强奸罪的最高刑罚是无期徒刑，而一项性侵犯罪的最高刑罚是10年有期徒刑。

paras.en: An investigation into allegations of rape made by two women continues, a spokesperson for London’s Metropolitan Police said.
paras.zh: 伦敦大都会警察局发言人表示，对两名妇女强奸指控的调查仍在继续。

paras.en: The accusations date to Brand’s rise as a stand-up comedian and risqué presenter on British television. He also had a prominent radio show on the BBC and wrote several bestselling autobiographies in which he detailed his addictions to drugs and alcohol.
paras.zh: 这些指控源于布兰德作为一名单口喜剧演员和英国电视上的下流主持人的崛起。他还在英国广播公司 (BBC) 上主持了一档著名的广播节目，并写了几本畅销自传，其中详细描述了他对毒品和酒精的成瘾。

paras.en: At the height of his fame, Brand featured in several Hollywood movies, including “Forgetting Sarah Marshall” and “Get Him to the Greek.”
paras.zh: 在他的名声鼎盛时期，布兰德出演了多部好莱坞电影，包括《忘记莎拉·马歇尔》和《带他去希腊》。

paras.en: His fame stateside was cemented when he briefly wed Perry in a lavish ceremony in India in 2010. The couple divorced in 2012.
paras.zh: 2010 年，他在印度与佩里举行了一场奢华的婚礼，短暂结婚后，他在美国的名声进一步巩固。两人于 2012 年离婚。

paras.en: In recent years, Brand has moved away from mainstream media, relocated to Florida and built a large online following with videos that discuss U.S. politics, wellness, conspiracy theories and his newfound Christian faith.
paras.zh: 近年来，布兰德已经远离主流媒体，搬到了佛罗里达州，并通过讨论美国政治、健康、阴谋论和他新发现的基督教信仰的视频在网上建立了大批追随者。

paras.en: In a four-week trial at Southwark Crown Court in London, prosecutors labeled Brand “ruthless.”
paras.zh: 在伦敦南华克刑事法院为期四个星期的审判中，检察官称布兰德“无情”。

paras.en: Prosecutor Riel Karmy-Jones told jurors that Brand at the time had an “indiscriminate and voracious” desire for sexual contact and that “women were simply a means to an end.” Karmy-Jones described Brand as “calculating,” adding, “He was manipulative. And, the prosecution say, he was a sexual predator.”
paras.zh: 检察官里尔·卡米·琼斯告诉陪审员，布兰德当时对性接触有着“不分青红皂白和贪婪”的渴望，“女性只是达到目的的一种手段”。卡米-琼斯形容布兰德“精于算计”，并补充道，“他善于操纵他人。而且，检方称，他是一名性掠夺者。”

paras.en: Brand was found guilty of raping one woman in 2009. She said he anally raped her at his home after she met him at one of his shows.
paras.zh: 2009 年，布兰德被判强奸一名妇女。她说，当她在他的一场演出中遇见他后，布兰德在他家中对她进行了肛交。

paras.en: He was also found guilty of sexually assaulting a woman whose breasts he grabbed at a party in 2004 and another woman who said he had kissed and groped her at a London radio station in 2004 or 2005.
paras.zh: 他还被判犯有2004年在一次聚会上性侵犯一名女子的罪名，该女子曾被他抓住，而另一名女子则称他曾于2004年或2005年在伦敦一家广播电台亲吻并抚摸她。

paras.en: Prosecutors said that the women do not know one another and that they separately went to police after a TV documentary was broadcast in Britain in 2023.
paras.zh: 检察官表示，这些妇女彼此不认识，2023 年一部电视纪录片在英国播出后，她们分别向警方报案。

paras.en: His appearances outside the court, holding hands with his wife and flanked by security guards, made daily headlines in the British media.
paras.zh: 他与妻子手牵着手，在保安陪同下出现在法庭外，成为英国媒体的每日头条新闻。

paras.en: Last week, Brand took the stand and said the claims had had a “devastating” impact on his life, leaving him without a single friend or colleague who could testify in his behalf.
paras.zh: 上周，布兰德出庭表示，这些指控对他的生活产生了“毁灭性”影响，使他没有一个朋友或同事可以为他作证。

paras.en: “My entire life has been consumed by these events,” he said in court, adding later that dealing with the “traumatic” allegations had come “at the expense of my marriage, my children and health.”
paras.zh: “我的一生都被这些事件占据了，”他在法庭上说，后来又补充说，处理这些“创伤性”指控是“以牺牲我的婚姻、孩子和健康为代价的”。

paras.en: He admitted in court to being sex-obsessed as a young and famous man.
paras.zh: 他在法庭上承认，作为一名年轻的名人，他对性有痴迷。

paras.en: “I have been persuasive, seductive, begging and flirting, and have dedicated a lot of my life to what seems now beyond reckless philandering and idiocy,” he told the court last week.
paras.zh: 他上周在法庭上表示：“我一直在劝说、诱惑、乞讨和调情，并将我一生的大部分时间奉献给了现在看来超越了鲁莽的花心和白痴的事情。”

paras.en: “I was in a position of fame. As I became more successful and famous, I was very comfortable allowing that to facilitate sexual access, which I agree was wrong,” he added.
paras.zh: “我当时享有盛誉。随着我变得更加成功和出名，我很乐意允许这种情况促进性接触，我同意这是错误的，”他补充道。

paras.en: Brand also told the court: “Consent is fundamental, essential, necessary and indeed more important than sex itself.”
paras.zh: 布兰德还告诉法庭：“同意是根本、必要、必要的，而且确实比性本身更重要。”

paras.en: Brand’s wife, Laura Gallacher, also made headlines when she testified last week that he was a “caring, kind and a wonderful father.” The couple married in 2017 and have three young children.
paras.zh: 布兰德的妻子劳拉·加拉赫(Laura Gallacher)上周也成为头条新闻，她在证词中称布兰德是一位“有爱心、善良、很棒的父亲”。这对夫妇于 2017 年结婚，育有三个年幼的孩子。

paras.en: Brand and his wife have been posting videos online in which they analyze Bible verses together and discuss their broad experiences of the trial.
paras.zh: 布兰德和他的妻子一直在网上发布视频，他们在视频中一起分析圣经经文，并讨论他们在审判中的广泛经历。

paras.en: When the trial got underway last month, Brand told a scrum of photographers and journalists that he felt “blessed.” He said he was “hopeful that this process will lead to good outcomes for everybody involved.”
paras.zh: 上个月审判开始时，布兰德告诉一群摄影师和记者，他感到“很幸运”。他说，他“希望这一过程将为所有参与者带来良好的结果。”

paras.en: In a statement after the verdict, Detective Superintendent Andy Furphy of the Metropolitan Police said Brand had “used his influence, status and fame to exploit and sexually offend against women.”
paras.zh: 在判决后的一份声明中，大都会警察局侦探警司安迪·弗菲表示，布兰德“利用他的影响力、地位和名气来剥削和性侵犯女性。”

paras.en: “As his profile grew, so too did his sense of entitlement,” he said.
paras.zh: “随着他的知名度不断提高，他的权利感也随之增强，”他说。

paras.en: Praising the victims for their “extraordinary courage,” he added: “Despite intense media and public scrutiny, they relived deeply personal and traumatic experiences and placed their trust in us. Without their bravery, this outcome would not have been possible.”
paras.zh: 他赞扬受害者“非凡的勇气”，并补充道：“尽管受到媒体和公众的强烈监督，他们还是重温了深刻的个人和创伤经历，并对我们表示信任。没有他们的勇敢，就不可能有这样的结果。”

paras.en: If you or someone you know has been sexually assaulted, call the National Sexual Assault Hotline at 1-800-656-4673. The hotline, run by the Rape, Abuse, & Incest National Network (RAINN), can put you in contact with your local rape crisis center. You can also access RAINN’s online chat service at rainn.org/get-help.
paras.zh: 如果您或您认识的人遭到性侵犯，请拨打全国性侵犯热线 1-800-656-4673。该热线由全国强奸、虐待和乱伦网络 (RAINN) 运营，可以让您与当地的强奸危机中心取得联系。您还可以访问 Rainn.org/get-help 访问 RAINN 的在线聊天服务。

articles.title: Clashes erupt in France as ‘Black Thursday’ protests sweep the nation
articles.author: Henry Austin

paras.en: PARIS — Riot police clashed with protesters in Lyon on Thursday as a nationwide public sector strike tapped into growing anger over deteriorating services and the rising cost of living.
paras.zh: 巴黎——周四，防暴警察在里昂与抗议者发生冲突，全国范围内的公共部门罢工引发了人们对服务恶化和生活成本上升的日益高涨的愤怒。

paras.en: Paris’ iconic Eiffel Tower was closed because of the strike.
paras.zh: 巴黎标志性的埃菲尔铁塔因罢工而关闭。

paras.en: Officers clad in black helmets and protective clothing charged at crowds in Lyon after the demonstrations against rising living costs and in support of the high school protest movement turned violent and fires were set in the streets. Water cannons were also deployed. Some of the protesters wore gas masks and safety glasses as a precaution against tear gas.
paras.zh: 在里昂，反对生活成本上涨和支持高中抗议运动的示威活动演变成暴力活动并在街道上纵火后，戴着黑色头盔和穿着防护服的警察向人群发起冲锋。还出动了水炮。一些抗议者戴着防毒面具和安全眼镜，以预防催泪瓦斯。

paras.en: Images from Paris showed students and other protesters facing off against riot police.
paras.zh: 来自巴黎的图像显示学生和其他抗议者与防暴警察对峙。

paras.en: Police were “keeping the situation under control, but it remains tense,” the French Interior Ministry said in a statement at 1 p.m. local time (7 a.m. ET).
paras.zh: 法国内政部下午 1 点在一份声明中表示，警方“正在控制局势，但局势仍然紧张”。当地时间（东部时间上午 7 点）。

paras.en: “Several violent acts have been committed as part of the high school student movement,” the statement said. After fireworks were fired at a school near the southern city of Toulouse, a fire broke out “that burned the student services office,” it added.
paras.zh: 声明称：“高中学生运动中发生了几起暴力行为。”报道补充说，南部城市图卢兹附近的一所学校燃放烟花后，发生火灾，“烧毁了学生服务办公室”。

paras.en: In the city of Rennes in northwest France, metal pétanque balls were thrown at officers, the statement said, adding that police had been pelted with other projectiles in the cities of Pau and Orléans.
paras.zh: 声明称，在法国西北部的雷恩市，有人向警察投掷金属滚球，并补充说，在波城和奥尔良市，警察也遭到其他投掷物投掷。

paras.en: Around 250 rallies against rising living costs had been planned in cities and towns across the country and hundreds of thousands of people would likely turn out, unions said before the events kicked off.
paras.zh: 工会在活动开始前表示，全国城镇计划举行约 250 场反对生活成本上涨的集会，可能会有数十万人参加。

paras.en: France’s main unions, including the CGT and the CNT representing public and private sector workers, and the UNEF, representing students, warned the government of President Emmanuel Macron that the country was on the brink of recession.
paras.zh: 法国主要工会，包括代表公共和私营部门工人的 CGT 和 CNT，以及代表学生的 UNEF，警告总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙 (Emmanuel Macron) 的政府，该国正处于衰退的边缘。

paras.en: “Everything is going up except wages and pensions,” they said in a joint statement. “Anger is immense.”
paras.zh: 他们在一份联合声明中表示：“除了工资和养老金之外，一切都在上涨。” “愤怒是巨大的。”

paras.en: “The situation in this country is fragile. The pressing social and environmental challenges must be addressed without delay,” the statement added.
paras.zh: 声明补充说：“这个国家的局势很脆弱。必须立即解决紧迫的社会和环境挑战。”

paras.en: The movement grew from a student protest over staff shortages at the Antoine de Saint-Exupéry High School in Créteil, a southeastern suburb of Paris. Videos of the blockade spread on social media, and soon protests expanded to high schools across the nation.
paras.zh: 该运动起源于巴黎东南郊区克雷泰伊的安东尼·圣埃克苏佩里高中因学生人手短缺而举行的抗议活动。封锁的视频在社交媒体上传播，抗议活动很快扩展到全国各地的高中。

paras.en: As the movement grew, the list of grievances expanded beyond the failings of the public school system to encompass broader economic, political and social dissatisfaction. Soon, university students, teachers, parents and politicians also joined.
paras.zh: 随着运动的发展，不满的范围超出了公立学校系统的失败，涵盖了更广泛的经济、政治和社会不满。很快，大学生、教师、家长和政界人士也加入进来。

paras.en: Hundreds of thousands of protesters have since taken to the streets as the demonstrations expanded, with participants holding signs criticizing the far-right National Rally party and warning of the risks of climate change and artificial intelligence. A multitude of Palestinian flags have also been seen.
paras.zh: 随着示威活动扩大，数十万抗议者走上街头，参与者举着标语批评极右翼国家集会党，并警告气候变化和人工智能的风险。人们还看到了许多巴勒斯坦旗帜。

paras.en: Macron, who will leave office in May, convened a defense and security meeting Wednesday ahead of the protests. Later, Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez said that 70,000 police officers would be deployed Thursday, backed by armored vehicles, drones and helicopters.
paras.zh: 将于五月离任的马克龙周三在抗议活动前召开了一次国防和安全会议。随后，内政部长洛朗·努涅斯表示，周四将部署 7 万名警察，并配备装甲车、无人机和直升机。

paras.en: Police have previously been criticized for injuring protesters with heavy-handed tactics. Last month, a 15-year-old was maimed by a sting ball grenade fired by police and a 14-year-old suffered a jaw fracture in a similar incident.
paras.zh: 警方此前因使用高压手段伤害抗议者而受到批评。上个月，一名 15 岁的青少年被警方发射的刺球手榴弹致残，一名 14 岁的青少年在类似事件中下巴骨折。

paras.en: Several others have also suffered life-changing injuries and a 59-year-old man, identified as Christophe M., died Oct. 17 of “a critical cardio-respiratory failing” after leaving Paris’ Place de la République, which had been tear-gassed by police. An investigation into his death is ongoing.
paras.zh: 其他几人也遭受了改变生活的伤害，一名名叫 Christophe M. 的 59 岁男子于 10 月 17 日离开被警方发射催泪瓦斯的巴黎共和广场后，因“严重的心肺功能衰竭”死亡。对他死亡的调查正在进行中。

paras.en: Zacharie Petit reported from Paris and Henry Austin from London.
paras.zh: 扎卡里·佩蒂特从巴黎报道，亨利·奥斯汀从伦敦报道。

articles.title: Six people killed, at least a dozen injured in shooting at main market square of Krakow, Poland
articles.author: Shayna Jacobs

paras.en: Authorities in Poland are investigating a shooting that left six people dead and at least a 15 injured in the Main Market Square in Krakow, a cultural center of the historic city, according to officials.
paras.zh: 据官员称，波兰当局正在调查这座历史名城文化中心克拉科夫主市场广场发生的枪击事件，该枪击事件造成 6 人死亡、至少 15 人受伤。

paras.en: The shooter, a Polish national, was shot by police at the scene and taken to the hospital around 3 p.m. local time. The shots were fired from a vehicle moving through the area, Krakow officials said in a series of posts X.
paras.zh: 枪手是波兰人，下午3点左右被警察当场开枪射杀，并被送往医院。当地时间。克拉科夫官员在一系列帖子中表示，枪击是从一辆穿过该地区的车辆发射的。

paras.en: An earlier post from the city’s official municipal government account said that investigators were working to determine the scale of the incident.
paras.zh: 该市官方市政府账户早些时候发布的帖子称，调查人员正在努力确定事件的规模。

paras.en: Katarzyna Cisło, a spokesperson for the Krakow police, told TVN24 that the perpetrator was wearing military-style fatigues and he used a military-type long gun in the attack. Police found many pieces of other weapons, as well as ammunition, in his car.
paras.zh: 克拉科夫警方发言人卡塔齐娜·西斯洛 (Katarzyna Cisło) 告诉 TVN24，行凶者身穿军用迷彩服，在袭击中使用了军用长枪。警方在他的车里发现了许多其他武器和弹药。

paras.en: Dramatic video posted on social media shows what appears to be an injured police officer firing at the suspect before dropping to his knees and rolling over onto his back. The officer, who did not appear to have backup nearby, is seen struggling to reload his firearm and appeared to be clutching his right arm.
paras.zh: 社交媒体上发布的一段戏剧性视频显示，一名受伤的警察向嫌疑人开枪，然后跪倒在地，翻身仰面躺着。这名警官附近似乎没有后备人员，可以看到他正在努力重新装弹，并且似乎紧紧抓住自己的右臂。

paras.en: That officer’s condition was not known. Małopolska Police wrote in an X post that no officer had been killed, citing what they said were incorrect reports.
paras.zh: 该警官的情况尚不清楚。小波兰警方在 X 帖子中写道，没有警员被杀，并援引了他们所说的不正确的报道。

paras.en: Other chilling video clips taken from the scene show a black sedan racing through the square. Dozens of people began running in various directions at the sound of gunfire.
paras.zh: 现场拍摄的其他令人毛骨悚然的视频片段显示，一辆黑色轿车在广场上疾驰。听到枪声，数十人开始向各个方向奔跑。

paras.en: Some social media clips depict responders attempting life-saving measures on victims. Lifeless bodies could be seen scattered around the streets after the attack.
paras.zh: 一些社交媒体剪辑描绘了救援人员试图对受害者采取挽救生命的措施。袭击发生后，街道上散布着毫无生气的尸体。

paras.en: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk also wrote on social media that police were trying to determine the circumstances surrounding the attack.
paras.zh: 波兰总理唐纳德·图斯克也在社交媒体上写道，警方正在试图确定袭击事件的具体情况。

paras.en: “We are just learning details of the horrific mass shooting in Krakow, a savage and murderous attack that’s shattered the peace of Poland,” Tom Rose, the U.S. ambassador to Poland, wrote on X. “America stands with Poland at this dark hour as Poland stands with her beloved citizens of Krakow.”
paras.zh: 美国驻波兰大使汤姆·罗斯在 X 上写道：“我们刚刚了解到克拉科夫发生的可怕大规模枪击事件的细节，这是一场野蛮而凶残的袭击，破坏了波兰的和平。”“在这个黑暗时刻，美国与波兰站在一起，就像波兰与她心爱的克拉科夫公民站在一起一样。”

paras.en: The Main Market Square sits at the heart of Krakow’s medieval Old Town. Laid out in 1257, the sprawling plaza is home to the historic Cloth Hall and St. Mary’s Basilica.
paras.zh: 主集市广场位于克拉科夫中世纪老城区的中心。这座广阔的广场建于 1257 年，是历史悠久的布料馆和圣玛丽大教堂的所在地。

articles.title: What Renée Geyer taught soul protégé Ella Thompson about authenticity
articles.author: Al Newstead

paras.en: Writing her new album, Ella Thompson fell in love with a quote from French philosopher Simone Weil.
paras.zh: 艾拉·汤普森（Ella Thompson）在创作她的新专辑时，爱上了法国哲学家西蒙娜·韦尔（Simone Weil）的一句话。

paras.en: "Attention is the rarest and purest form of generosity," Thompson says.
paras.zh: “关注是最稀有、最纯粹的慷慨形式，”汤普森说。

paras.en: "I'm really interested in how artists and writers have responded to that idea over the centuries. How we give attention to others and ourselves; what we pay attention to and how it can also distort our view of the world."
paras.zh: “我真的很感兴趣几个世纪以来艺术家和作家如何回应这个想法。我们如何关注他人和我们自己；我们关注什么以及它如何扭曲我们的世界观。”

paras.en: When art and attention have become increasingly "commodified and distorted, exploited and manipulated" in our current AI-and-algorithm-saturated world, Thompson's new record is its own form of generosity.
paras.zh: 当艺术和注意力在当今人工智能和算法饱和的世界中变得越来越“商品化和扭曲、剥削和操纵”时，汤普森的新记录就是其自身的慷慨形式。

paras.en: Its title, Triumph & Sadness, conveys the bittersweet.
paras.zh: 它的标题“胜利与悲伤”传达了苦乐参半的感觉。

paras.en: "I'm always drawn to that sweet spot in music, art and writing," Thompson explains, "where you find that balance in between the extremes.
paras.zh: 汤普森解释说：“我总是被音乐、艺术和写作中的最佳点所吸引，在那里你可以在极端之间找到平衡。

paras.en: "For this record, every triumph, there is something sad behind it, of seeing the state of the world."
paras.zh: “对于这张唱片来说，每一次胜利，背后都有一些悲伤的东西，看到世界的现状。”

paras.en: A masterful set of warm, cinematic soul music that would fit snugly into any self-respecting vinyl enthusiast's collection, the album again proves Thompson as one of Australia's underrated masters of the genre's sound and spirit.
paras.zh: 这张专辑是一套精湛的温暖的电影灵魂音乐，可以完美地融入任何有自尊的黑胶唱片爱好者的收藏中，这张专辑再次证明了 Thompson 是澳大利亚被低估的该流派声音和精神大师之一。

paras.en: Boasting tasteful, timeless arrangements — slinky guitars, keys and airtight rhythm section adorned with lush brass, flutes and harp — the music offers the soulful sweetness while Thompson's thoughtful lyrics provide the bitter.
paras.zh: 拥有高雅、永恒的编曲——紧身吉他、琴键和用华丽的铜管、长笛和竖琴装饰的密不透风的节奏部分——音乐提供了深情的甜蜜，而汤普森深思熟虑的歌词则提供了苦涩。

paras.en: She interrogates tricky realities with effortless vocal performances ranging from smouldering to show-stopping.
paras.zh: 她通过轻松的声乐表演质疑棘手的现实，从闷烧到令人惊叹的表演。

paras.en: She scales impressive heights on the jubilant Make You Believe and My Weakness, a song inspired by a Caravaggio painting based on the myth of Narcissus and being "absorbed by things that don't really matter much,"
paras.zh: 她在欢快的《Make You Believe and My Weakness》中达到了令人印象深刻的高度，这首歌的灵感来自卡拉瓦乔的一幅基于水仙神话的画作，并且“被那些并不重要的事情所吸引”，

paras.en: However, Thompson approaches the subject — losing meaningful attention and connection with others to self-obsession — with humour as much as critique.
paras.zh: 然而，汤普森以幽默和批评的方式来处理这个主题——失去有意义的关注和与他人的联系而陷入自我痴迷。

paras.en: "I think tragedy can be funny as well. We beat ourselves up about our phone addictions and all these sorts of thing, but it is kind of funny," she says.
paras.zh: “我认为悲剧也可以很有趣。我们因为手机成瘾和诸如此类的事情而责备自己，但这有点有趣，”她说。

paras.en: "I like dramatic soul music. I don't necessarily like drama in my real life."
paras.zh: “我喜欢戏剧性的灵魂音乐。我不一定喜欢现实生活中的戏剧。”

paras.en: Thompson has been embedded in the Melbourne/Naarm music scene for years.
paras.zh: Thompson 多年来一直融入墨尔本/Naarm 音乐界。

paras.en: She fronted electronic duo GL, genre-shifting pop group Dorsal Fins, and has lent her imperious pipes to Paul Kelly, The Bamboos and even Mark Ronson.
paras.zh: 她领导了电子二人组 GL、流派转变的流行乐队 Dorsal Fins，并将她专横的风笛借给了 Paul Kelly、The Bamboos 甚至 Mark Ronson。

paras.en: But Triumph & Sadness, like her previous solo records Ripple On The Wing (2024) and Domino (2023), reaches back full circle to the jazz and soul of Thompson's childhood.
paras.zh: 但《Triumph & Sadness》，就像她之前的个人专辑《Ripple On The Wing》（2024 年）和《Domino》（2023 年）一样，完全回到了 Thompson 童年的爵士乐和灵魂。

paras.en: She grew up absorbing the personal and political stories, sounds and studio craft of greats like Billie Holiday, Nina Simone and Curtis Mayfield.
paras.zh: 她在成长过程中吸收了比莉·哈乐黛、尼娜·西蒙和柯蒂斯·梅菲尔德等伟人的个人和政治故事、声音和工作室工艺。

paras.en: She was later mentored by her idol, trailblazing Australian jazz, blues and soul artist Renée Geyer, who took Thompson on her first tour at age 16.
paras.zh: 后来她得到了她的偶像、澳大利亚爵士乐、蓝调和灵魂乐先驱者 Renée Geyer 的指导，后者在 16 岁时就带领 Thompson 进行了第一次巡演。

paras.en: "One of the lessons she taught me was, 'Don't take the jewels from the top of the treasure chest. Dig a little deeper.'"
paras.zh: “她教给我的教训之一是，‘不要从宝箱顶部拿走珠宝。挖得更深一点。’”

paras.en: That advice shaped Thompson's entire approach, acutely aware that the tradition she's working in, soul music, has deep social and spiritual roots.
paras.zh: 这个建议塑造了汤普森的整个方法，她敏锐地意识到她所从事的灵魂音乐传统具有深厚的社会和精神根源。

paras.en: "I try to be respectful of where this music is from and not just the aesthetic of it."
paras.zh: “我试着尊重音乐的来源，而不仅仅是它的美学。”

paras.en: Marvin Gaye and Sam Cooke's progressive protest records; Aretha Franklin and Curtis Mayfield's searing emotional deliveries — Thompson recognises that many "of those great records have a brilliant message and they're made from a particular social context".
paras.zh: 马文·盖伊和萨姆·库克的进步抗议记录；艾瑞莎·富兰克林 (Aretha Franklin) 和柯蒂斯·梅菲尔德 (Curtis Mayfield) 的炽热情感表达 — 汤普森 (Thompson) 认识到，许多“这些伟大的唱片都传达着精彩的信息，而且它们是在特定的社会背景下制作的”。

paras.en: "One that isn't too dissimilar from the one that we're living in now… There's definitely parallels. We've come a long way but in a lot of ways, we haven't."
paras.zh: “这与我们现在生活的环境并没有太大不同……肯定有相似之处。我们已经走了很长一段路，但在很多方面，我们还没有。”

paras.en: Lesser contemporaries and countless algorithmic playlists get caught up in reproducing the genre's sound, forgetting that soul is essential, not optional.
paras.zh: 较小的同时代人和无数的算法播放列表都沉迷于再现该流派的声音，忘记了灵魂是必不可少的，而不是可选的。

paras.en: It's a conversation between artist and listener about what it means to be human, Thompson observes.
paras.zh: 汤普森观察到，这是艺术家和听众之间关于人类意义的对话。

paras.en: "For me, soul music is about respecting that interconnectedness between people and our environment and the world we live in."
paras.zh: “对我来说，灵魂音乐就是尊重人与我们的环境以及我们生活的世界之间的相互联系。”

paras.en: Music that emerges from a specific community is something Thompson admires in the records she loves, and an authenticity she commits to.
paras.zh: 汤普森在她喜爱的唱片中欣赏来自特定社区的音乐，并致力于保持真实性。

paras.en: "I love hearing that sense of place in music. I'm making music here in Naarm, with creatives here."
paras.zh: “我喜欢听到音乐中的那种归属感。我在纳尔姆和这里的创意人员一起创作音乐。”

paras.en: Like its predecessors, Triumph & Sadness was made alongside Thompson's regular crew: Liam McGorry, trumpet-toting alumni of Dorsal Fins and Saskwatch, and Henry Jenkins, formerly of The Cactus Channel.
paras.zh: 与前作一样，《胜利与悲伤》是由汤普森的固定团队制作的：利亚姆·麦戈里（Liam McGorry），Dorsal Fins 和 Saskwatch 的校友，以及前仙人掌频道的亨利·詹金斯（Henry Jenkins）。

paras.en: Together, with a crack studio band comprising members from instrumental labelmates Surprise Chef and Karate Boogaloo, Thompson shares an intuition forged through years of collaboration.
paras.zh: Thompson 与一支由乐器厂牌 Surprise Chef 和 Karate Boogaloo 成员组成的顶尖录音室乐队一起，分享了多年合作中形成的直觉。

paras.en: "There's definitely a shared language [and] shorthand."
paras.zh: “肯定有共同的语言[和]速记法。”

paras.en: Cooking on the same wavelength, they dish up tasty grooves on Parable, the sizzling Dandelion and swooning, harp-assisted Lover's Game.
paras.zh: 他们以相同的波长烹饪，在《Parable》、《铁板蒲公英》和令人着迷的、竖琴辅助的《情人游戏》中呈现出美味的节奏。

paras.en: Everything was recorded in four days at an all-analogue studio in Castlemaine.
paras.zh: 一切都是在卡斯尔梅恩的一家全模拟工作室用四天时间录制的。

paras.en: "There's no computers in the building and we cut all the band tracks direct to tape," says Thompson.
paras.zh: “大楼里没有电脑，我们将所有乐队曲目直接剪切到磁带上，”汤普森说。

paras.en: "Usually the third or fourth take… that's the one [and] there's no editing.
paras.zh: “通常是第三次或第四次拍摄……这就是一次，并且没有任何剪辑。

paras.en: "All of the records from the '60s and '70s that we love so much and have studied were recorded in that way."
paras.zh: “我们非常喜爱并研究过的所有 60 年代和 70 年代的唱片都是以这种方式录制的。”

paras.en: The pressure of getting it right is outweighed by the benefit of capturing "that raw feeling in the room. And going back to that bittersweet thing, it's falling in love with those imperfections as well."
paras.zh: 捕捉“房间里的原始感觉”的好处压倒了把事情做好的压力。回到苦乐参半的事情，它也爱上了那些不完美。

paras.en: Starting a solo career, after years of experience in the local scene, still felt in some ways like "beginning again", says Thompson.
paras.zh: 汤普森说，在当地经历了多年的经验后，开始独唱生涯在某些方面仍然感觉像是“重新开始”。

paras.en: "Confidence is something that's taken me a long time to build in my artistic direction. But I feel lucky to have arrived at [this] point now.
paras.zh: “自信是我花了很长时间才在我的艺术方向上建立起来的。但我很幸运现在已经达到了这一点。

paras.en: "There's nothing else I'd rather be doing than making records with my friends," she adds.
paras.zh: “除了和朋友们一起录制唱片之外，我最想做的事情就是，”她补充道。

paras.en: "I'm really grateful for the opportunities to be able to do that."
paras.zh: “我真的很感激有机会做到这一点。”

paras.en: Thompson has just headlined her first international shows in London and Paris, where she undertook an artist residency at Cité internationale des arts, writing "songs for a month thanks to APRA… Always just gathering acorns and see how they grow."
paras.zh: 汤普森刚刚在伦敦和巴黎举办了她的首场国际演出，并在国际艺术城进行了艺术家驻场演出，“感谢 APRA，她花了一个月的时间创作歌曲……总是只是收集橡子，看看它们如何生长。”

paras.en: The sense of development and community she finds in the Melbourne music scene is "really inspiring," she says.
paras.zh: 她说，她在墨尔本音乐界发现的发展和社区意识“真的很鼓舞人心”。

paras.en: "Our music might not reach everybody, but that's OK. It's a craft that people are really dedicated to and have a lot of respect for each other… show up for each other."
paras.zh: “我们的音乐可能无法传达给每个人，但这没关系。这是一种人们真正致力于并相互尊重的手艺……互相展示。”

paras.en: The soul of Triumph & Sadness isn't just in its sumptuous sound but its spirit of resilience.
paras.zh: 《Triumph & Sadness》的灵魂不仅在于其华丽的声音，还在于其坚韧的精神。

paras.en: "Where we go through these difficult parts of our lives, we still need music, art, community, friendships to uplift us out of that and feel triumph and to overcome adversity."
paras.zh: “当我们经历生活中的这些困难部分时，我们仍然需要音乐、艺术、社区、友谊来让我们摆脱困境，感受到胜利并克服逆境。”

paras.en: Ella Thompson's tour for Triumph & Sadness kicks off on November 13 at The Vanguard in Sydney.
paras.zh: 艾拉·汤普森 (Ella Thompson) 的 Triumph & Sadness 巡演将于 11 月 13 日在悉尼 The Vanguard 拉开帷幕。

paras.en: She then plays Melbourne, Adelaide, Healesville and Meredith Music Festival in December.
paras.zh: 随后，她于 12 月在墨尔本、阿德莱德、希尔斯维尔和梅雷迪思音乐节上演出。

articles.title: ABC Wordage quiz: It's time to get to work
articles.author: Lincoln Archer

paras.en: Roll up your sleeves. Let's get down to business.
paras.zh: 卷起袖子吧。让我们言归正传吧。

paras.en: Your challenge in today's Wordage quiz is to sort words and phrases for work according to how old they are.
paras.zh: 在今天的单词测验中，您面临的挑战是根据单词和短语的年龄对工作中的单词和短语进行排序。

paras.en: There's no time for a smoko or to have a bludge. This will require some hard yakka.
paras.zh: 没有时间抽烟或挥拳。这需要一些硬的yakka。

paras.zh: 资料来源：牛津英语词典、Etymonline、格林俚语词典、韦氏词典、麦格理词典

paras.zh: - 将每个名称拖到阴影框中。当您满意时点击“提交”。

articles.title: Has the curtain come down on the age of Trump?
articles.author: Nick Bryant and Lindsay Dunbar

paras.en: The Trump political juggernaut has hit a wall. But while Democrats are celebrating, the battle for America's political future is only just beginning.
paras.zh: 特朗普的政治霸主已经碰壁了。但就在民主党人欢庆之际，美国政治未来之战才刚刚开始。

paras.en: In the year America celebrated its 250th birthday, voters delivered a once-in-a-century election result signalling a break from a president who has dominated US politics for the past 10 years.
paras.zh: 在美国庆祝其 250 岁生日的那一年，选民们公布了百年一遇的选举结果，标志着过去 10 年来主导美国政坛的总统的决裂。

paras.en: Donald Trump, to mark both the US semi-quincentennial and his own 80th birthday in June, put on a cage fight on the South Lawn of the White House. At these midterm elections, he was repeatedly body-slammed by voters. This was a very personal repudiation of a pharaoh-like figure who had tried, implausibly, to convince Americans they were enjoying a "golden age".
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普 (Donald Trump) 在 6 月庆祝美国成立 50 周年和他自己的 80 岁生日时，在白宫南草坪上演了一场笼斗比赛。在这些中期选举中，他多次遭到选民的殴打。这是对一个类似法老的人物的非常个人的否定，他令人难以置信地试图让美国人相信他们正在享受“黄金时代”。

paras.en: It represented the rebuke of a leader with authoritarian leanings who has sought to turn the White House into something akin to a palace, and Washington into a monument to himself.
paras.zh: 它代表了对一位具有独裁倾向的领导人的谴责，他试图将白宫变成类似于宫殿的东西，将华盛顿变成自己的纪念碑。

paras.en: Needless to say, exit polls showed voters were angry about the spike in fuel, food and, in rural states, fertiliser prices caused by a trade war that Trump framed as a "Liberation Day". The conflict with Iran had turned every gas station in America into a billboard for the Democrats. But alleged government corruption was also prominent in voters' minds, even higher in some exit polls than cost-of-living concerns.
paras.zh: 不用说，出口民意调查显示，选民对特朗普称之为“解放日”的贸易战导致燃料、食品以及农村州化肥价格飙升感到愤怒。与伊朗的冲突使美国的每个加油站都变成了民主党的广告牌。但所谓的政府腐败在选民心目中也很突出，在一些出口民意调查中甚至高于对生活成本的担忧。

paras.en: Ahead of the election, a poll by Fox News showed alleged government corruption was actually the number one issue.
paras.zh: 选举前，福克斯新闻的一项民意调查显示，所谓的政府腐败实际上是头号问题。

paras.en: The billionaire president and his family have been getting ostentatiously richer while many Americans are suffering personal recessions.
paras.zh: 这位亿万富翁总统和他的家人一直在炫富，而许多美国人却在遭受个人衰退。

paras.en: Hard-pressed voters eyed decadence in the gold-bedecked walls of the Oval Office when their own quality of life was deteriorating. When Trump flew into the heartland to campaign, he did so aboard a $400 million Boeing 747-8 luxury airliner gifted by the Qatari royal family.
paras.zh: 当生活质量不断恶化时，陷入困境的选民们看到了椭圆形办公室镶金墙壁上的颓废。当特朗普飞往中心地带竞选时，他乘坐的是卡塔尔王室赠送的价值 4 亿美元的波音 747-8 豪华客机。

paras.en: This wasn't simply an "it's the economy, stupid" election. It was also about the self-enrichment of Trump, his family members and acolytes such as Elon Musk, the world's first trillionaire. American voters were rejecting the excesses of an increasingly imperial presidency. Ending his campaign in front of the renovated Reflecting Pool in Washington seemed to many voters the perfect expression of his narcissism and tone-deafness.
paras.zh: 这不仅仅是一场“愚蠢的问题是经济”的选举。这也与特朗普、他的家人和助手（例如世界上第一位万亿富翁埃隆·马斯克）的自我致富有关。美国选民拒绝接受日益帝国化的总统的过度行为。对许多选民来说，在华盛顿翻新的倒影池前结束竞选活动似乎是他自恋和五音不全的完美表达。

paras.en: More so than winning this election through the attractiveness of their policies, Democrats became the beneficiaries of the anti-Trump backlash. And theirs was a landslide win. The stuff of fantasy politics.
paras.zh: 民主党不仅是通过其政策的吸引力赢得了这次选举，还成为了反特朗普浪潮的受益者。他们取得了压倒性的胜利。幻想政治的东西。

paras.en: In regaining control of the US Senate, they took deep red Republican bastions: Texas, Kansas, even South Carolina.
paras.zh: 在重新控制美国参议院的过程中，他们占领了深红色的共和党堡垒：德克萨斯州、堪萨斯州，甚至南卡罗来纳州。

paras.en: In the House of Representatives, Democrats will enjoy at least a 50-seat advantage. It is the kind of lopsided congressional majority not seen since Barack Obama's victory in 2008 which took a couple of successive waves to achieve. The cumulative vote in all the House seats, which gives the national picture, showed the Democrats had close to a 13-point lead over the Republicans.
paras.zh: 在众议院，民主党将享有至少50个席位的优势。这是自 2008 年巴拉克·奥巴马 (Barack Obama) 连续几轮选举才取得胜利以来，从未见过的不平衡的国会多数席位。众议院所有席位的累计投票显示全国情况，显示民主党领先共和党近 13 个百分点。

paras.en: To put that in historical perspective, in the famed "Republican revolution" of 1994 the GOP beat the Democrats by 6.8 points.
paras.zh: 从历史的角度来看，在1994年著名的“共和革命”中，共和党以6.8个百分点的优势击败了民主党。

paras.en: For the first time in 16 years, the Democrats will control a majority of governorships. These include noteworthy racial firsts. In Georgia, Keisha Lance Bottoms became the first Black woman ever elected governor of an American state. Texas will now have a Latina governor, Gina Hinojosa. Disquiet and fear amongst Hispanic voters over ICE raids helped her triumph.
paras.zh: 民主党将 16 年来首次控制多数州长职位。其中包括值得注意的种族第一。在佐治亚州，凯莎·兰斯·博顿斯 (Keisha Lance Bottoms) 成为美国第一位当选州长的黑人女性。德克萨斯州现在将有一位拉丁裔州长吉娜·伊诺霍萨。西班牙裔选民对 ICE 突击搜查的不安和恐惧帮助她取得了胜利。

paras.en: Not only the landscape but the face of US politics changed. For the first time in the country's history, the House of Representatives will have a Black speaker, New York congressman Hakeem Jeffries.
paras.zh: 不仅是景观，而且美国政治的面貌也发生了变化。美国历史上首次将有一位黑人众议院议长、纽约州众议员哈基姆·杰弗里斯。

paras.en: Small wonder, the term "bluenami" is being used. But it is also a red meltdown.
paras.zh: 毫不奇怪，“bluenami”一词正在被使用。但这也是红色的崩溃。

paras.en: This is the first time in the Trump era his Republican Party has been severely punished. This result recalls the post-Watergate midterms in 1974 when Republicans were punished for the transgressions of Richard Nixon. Nixon had been forced to resign the presidency less than three months before Election Day.
paras.zh: 这是特朗普时代他所在的共和党首次受到严厉惩罚。这一结果让人想起1974年水门事件后的中期选举，当时共和党因理查德·尼克松的违法行为而受到惩罚。距离选举日不到三个月，尼克松被迫辞去总统职务。

paras.en: That 1974 election brought about a generational shift. The Class of '74 included the so-called "Watergate babies". Remarkably, 87 members of the new Congress were aged under 40.
paras.zh: 1974 年的选举带来了代际转变。 74 届毕业生中包括所谓的“水门婴儿”。值得注意的是，新一届国会议员中有 87 名年龄在 40 岁以下。

paras.en: This election hasn't produced quite such an infusion of young blood. Still, at a time when Capitol Hill has often looked like a gerontocracy, the average age of lawmakers will be significantly lower. James Talarico, the Presbyterian seminarian with choir boy looks who won in Texas, is 37. Incumbent Democrat Jon Ossoff, who comfortably regained his seat in the Republican target state of Georgia, is 39. Abdul El-Sayed, who will become the first Muslim US Senator, is 42. Annie Andrews, who took South Carolina, is 46. Melat Kiros, who was endorsed by the Democratic Socialists of America in Colorado's first district, became the first Gen Z woman elected to Congress. She is just 29 years old.
