As the president of the flight attendant’s union told an interviewer: “This is really only data that became valuable in the age of AI in order to train models to replace jobs and commodify other portions of working in a work environment.”
paras.zh: 数据收集运动最令人不安的方面可能是，从本质上讲，它招募了工作人员，但并不总是得到明确同意，为最终目标是取代或自动化所有这些文档、消息和电子邮件中的人类工作做出贡献。当 Mercor 说其座右铭是“组织人类智慧，为人工智能经济提供动力”时，不言而喻的信息是，有血有肉的工人的经济工作要做的将减少。正如空姐工会主席告诉采访者的那样：“这实际上只是在人工智能时代变得有价值的数据，以便训练模型来取代工作并使工作环境中的其他工作部分商品化。”

paras.en: When I ask Micro1’s Ansari whether one day the default for corporations will be selling their workflow data to big AI companies on an ongoing basis, he answers affirmatively. “I think it’s going to become more common than ads as a revenue line item for companies,” he says. I note that there is already considerable pushback to AI, and that people might not be happy with the idea that everything they do at work gets funneled into the maw of a big AI model.
paras.zh: 当我问 Micro1 的 Ansari 是否有一天企业会默认将其工作流程数据持续出售给大型人工智能公司时，他给出了肯定的回答。 “我认为作为公司的收入项目，它将比广告变得更加普遍，”他说。我注意到，人工智能已经受到了相当大的抵制，人们可能对他们在工作中所做的一切都被纳入大型人工智能模型的想法感到不满意。

paras.en: “I think it’s a fair point,” says Ansari. But, in his view, such objections will be manageable. He suggests that workers will understand that the fruits of their labor will result in better AI models, which will make their lives easier. “You have to think of the upside, the abundance that AI can result in.” (I’ve found that the future abundance that AI will supposedly produce is a handy justification for all sorts of compromises.)
paras.zh: “我认为这是一个公平的观点，”安萨里说。但在他看来，这种反对意见是可以控制的。他建议工人们会明白，他们的劳动成果将带来更好的人工智能模型，这将使​​他们的生活变得更轻松。 “你必须考虑人工智能的好处，即人工智能可以带来的丰富性。” （我发现人工智能未来将产生的丰富性是各种妥协的一个方便的理由。）

paras.en: I did follow up on one of the cold pitches I got, from a woman whose email domain was gorexen.com. A “gorexen,” by the way, is a fusion of two Pokemon critters that “siphons the body fluids of prey through its thin, tubular mouth.” She set up a meeting with me with a two-year-old company called Tenkara (the name seems to be associated with a type of Japanese fly fishing). I found myself talking to “head of commercialization” Jonah Stillman, a young startup-looking dude sitting in an office in San Francisco.
paras.zh: 我确实跟进了我收到的一个冷冰冰的推销，来自一位电子邮件域名为 gorexen.com 的女士。顺便说一句，“gorexen”是两种神奇宝贝生物的融合体，“通过其薄薄的管状嘴吸取猎物的体液”。她安排我与一家成立两年的公司 Tenkara（这个名字似乎与一种日本飞蝇钓鱼有关）进行会面。我发现自己正在和“商业化主管”乔纳·斯蒂尔曼（Jonah Stillman）交谈，他是一位坐在旧金山办公室里的年轻创业者。

paras.en: I began peppering him with questions. Tenkara’s quest for data seems to be to boost the quality of its AI model to run office operations for manufacturing companies. (How WIRED’s archives would help is a mystery.) He confirmed that a big part of his job is doing calls like this to snap up data. I told him that the set of our meeting gave me a Glengarry Glen Ross vibe, but he wasn’t familiar with the reference.
paras.zh: 我开始向他提问。 Tenkara 对数据的追求似乎是为了提高其人工智能模型的质量，以便为制造公司运营办公室运营。 （《连线》的档案能提供什么帮助还是个谜。）他证实，他的大部分工作就是拨打这样的电话来抢夺数据。我告诉他，我们的会面给了我一种格伦加里·格伦·罗斯的感觉，但他不熟悉这个参考资料。

paras.en: I am, of course, not authorized to sell the documentation of WIRED’s editorial process to an AI company, and I did not risk my job by offering Jonah and his company the goods. I also wouldn’t be too pleased if my bosses made the sale.
paras.zh: 当然，我无权将《连线》编辑流程的文档出售给人工智能公司，而且我也没有冒着丢掉饭碗的风险向乔纳和他的公司提供这些商品。如果我的老板做出了这笔交易，我也不会太高兴。

articles.title: How Stephen Miller Schemed His Way to the Top
articles.author: Hugo Lowell

paras.en: President Donald Trump on Friday announced that Stephen Miller, one of his most powerful and politically aggressive aides, would be his next White House chief of staff following disastrous results for Republicans in the midterm elections.
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统周五宣布，在共和党在中期选举中取得灾难性结果后，他最强大、最具政治侵略性的助手之一斯蒂芬·米勒将成为他的下一任白宫办公厅主任。

paras.en: Miller, whose titles until now were deputy chief of staff for policy and homeland security adviser, has orchestrated the most polarizing policies of Trump’s second term—most notably a brutal crackdown on immigration that has claimed the lives of US citizens.
paras.zh: 米勒迄今为止的头衔是负责政策的副幕僚长和国土安全顾问，他精心策划了特朗普第二任期内最两极分化的政策，其中最引人注目的是对移民的残酷镇压，导致美国公民丧生。

paras.en: Trump made the change public in a statement on his Truth Social platform, writing that Miller would take over from Susie Wiles on Monday—less than a week after Republicans lost the House and Senate in a searing rebuke of Trump’s policy agenda.
paras.zh: 特朗普在其“真相社交”平台上发表声明公开了这一变化，并写道米勒将于周一接替苏西·威尔斯——不到一周前，共和党因对特朗普政策议程的严厉谴责而失去了众议院和参议院。

paras.en: In recent days, Trump has privately blamed Wiles for the worst Republican midterm performance in decades, according to two sources familiar with the matter. Wiles submitted her resignation on Thursday, the sources say.
paras.zh: 据两位知情人士透露，最近几天，特朗普私下指责怀尔斯造成了共和党数十年来最糟糕的中期表现。消息人士称，怀尔斯于周四提交了辞呈。

paras.en: Trump broadly considered three candidates to replace Wiles, the sources say: special envoy Steve Witkoff, director of national intelligence Jay Clayton, and Miller.
paras.zh: 消息人士称，特朗普广泛考虑了三名候选人来取代怀尔斯：特使史蒂夫·威特科夫、国家情报总监杰伊·克莱顿和米勒。

paras.en: But with the looming threat of congressional investigations starting next year, Trump settled on Miller, seemingly because of his zeal in defending the president and his deep loyalty. Miller has been with Trump since his first campaign and stood by him through his political exile in 2021.
paras.zh: 但随着明年开始的国会调查威胁迫在眉睫，特朗普选择了米勒，这似乎是因为他热衷于捍卫总统以及他的忠诚。米勒自特朗普第一次竞选以来就一直与他在一起，并在他 2021 年的政治流亡期间一直支持他。

paras.en: Miller had made his interest in the job known inside the West Wing for weeks, ever since Wiles weathered a series of negative stories before the midterms that suggested her job was at risk, the sources say.
paras.zh: 消息人士称，自从怀尔斯在中期选举前经历了一系列暗示她的工作面临风险的负面报道以来，米勒几周来就在西翼内部表达了他对这份工作的兴趣。

paras.en: In recent months, Trump also started cutting Wiles out of certain decisions, which contributed to the sense among her detractors that she was on shaky ground, sources say. For instance, Trump reportedly hired Katie Zacharia as press secretary without consulting Wiles, though the White House pushed back on the claim.
paras.zh: 消息人士称，近几个月来，特朗普还开始将怀尔斯排除在某些决定之外，这让她的批评者感觉她的立场不稳。例如，据报道，特朗普在没有咨询怀尔斯的情况下聘请凯蒂·扎卡里亚（Katie Zacharia）担任新闻秘书，尽管白宫反驳了这一说法。

paras.en: With Wiles’ departure, White House aides were bracing for further personnel changes. Among other names, Wiles’ deputies James Blair, who put together the GOP midterm strategy, and Richard Walters are seen as vulnerable to being fired by Miller unless they resign first, sources say.
paras.zh: 随着怀尔斯的离职，白宫助手们正准备迎接进一步的人事变动。消息人士称，怀尔斯的副手詹姆斯·布莱尔(James Blair)和理查德·沃尔特斯(Richard Walters)被认为很容易被米勒解雇，除非他们先辞职。

paras.en: The changing of the guard is also likely to bring respite to defense secretary Pete Hegseth, who has had a strained relationship with Wiles as of late but is seen as ideologically aligned with Miller, sources say.
paras.zh: 消息人士称，换岗也可能给国防部长皮特·赫格斯带来喘息的机会，他最近与怀尔斯关系紧张，但被视为在意识形态上与米勒保持一致。

paras.en: Hegseth and Miller worked closely last year when the Trump administration began a campaign of strikes against boats around Venezuela. Miller, who also leads the Homeland Security Council within the White House, orchestrated the campaign through the Pentagon.
paras.zh: 去年，当特朗普政府开始对委内瑞拉周围的船只发动袭击时，赫格斯和米勒密切合作。米勒还领导白宫国土安全委员会，他通过五角大楼精心策划了这次活动。

paras.en: Wiles leaves the White House as arguably the most successful chief of staff to Trump, who infamously cycled through chiefs in his first term. By comparison, Wiles kept Trump’s confidence from the start of his second presidential campaign in 2021.
paras.zh: 怀尔斯离开白宫后，可以说是特朗普最成功的幕僚长，而特朗普在第一个任期内就曾多次更换幕僚长。相比之下，怀尔斯从特朗普 2021 年第二次总统竞选开始时就一直对他保持信心。

paras.en: Still, Wiles weathered a number of challenges in recent months. She underwent a successful course of chemotherapy, but also faced accusations that her daughter had received lucrative contracts in part because of the family’s connection to the president. (The White House and Wiles’ daughter’s firm pushed back on these claims.)
paras.zh: 尽管如此，怀尔斯近几个月来还是经历了许多挑战。她接受了成功的化疗，但也面临着指控，称她的女儿获得了利润丰厚的合同，部分原因是家族与总统的关系。 （白宫和怀尔斯女儿的公司反驳了这些说法。）

paras.en: “Serving President Trump in the White House has been the honor of a lifetime,” Wiles wrote on X. “I’m so proud to have been a part of what we’ve accomplished together from securing our border and cutting taxes to strengthening our economy and putting America First.”
paras.zh: 怀尔斯在 X 上写道：“在白宫为特朗普总统服务是我一生的荣幸。我很自豪能够成为我们共同取得的成就的一部分，从保护边境安全、减税到加强我们的经济和实现美国优先。”

articles.title: The Cybertruck’s Death Is Actually Great News for EVs
articles.author: Brian Kahn

paras.en: Tesla will end production of the Cybertruck at its Texas Gigafactory next year.
paras.zh: 特斯拉将于明年结束其德克萨斯州超级工厂的 Cyber​​truck 生产。

paras.en: It’s a uniquely toxic electric vehicle, between its divisive design and Elon Musk’s embrace of you name it. That toxicity certainly contributed to subpar sales, along with a number of recalls.
paras.zh: 这是一款独特的有毒电动汽车，其独特的设计和埃隆·马斯克(Elon Musk)对你能想到的东西的拥抱。这种毒性无疑导致了销量低于标准，并导致了一些召回。

paras.en: But the end of the Cybertruck is also another sign that the era of big EVs—particularly big trucks—is waning. That’s great news for pedestrian and biker safety, but also for the battery supply chain at a time when more people need to get behind the electric wheel.
paras.zh: 但赛博卡车的终结也是大型电动汽车（尤其是大型卡车）时代正在衰落的另一个迹象。这对于行人和骑自行车者的安全来说是个好消息，对于电池供应链来说也是个好消息，因为现在越来越多的人需要使用电动汽车。

paras.en: The Cybertruck uses a massive 123-kilowatt-hour battery that clocks in at around 1,600 pounds, or around a quarter of the vehicle's weight. That’s on par with the battery that powered Ford’s F-150 Lightning, another electric truck that was canceled late last year. (The company also killed a three-row EV in 2024.) Ford’s behemoth batteries ranged from 98 kilowatt-hours up to 131 kilowatt-hours.
paras.zh: Cyber​​truck 使用 123 千瓦时的大型电池，重量约为 1,600 磅，约为车辆重量的四分之一。这与为福特 F-150 Lightning 提供动力的电池相当，后者是去年年底取消的另一款电动卡车。 （该公司还在 2024 年淘汰了一款三排电动汽车。）福特的庞然大物电池容量从 98 千瓦时到 131 千瓦时不等。

paras.en: Seeing both trucks canceled within a year of each other, while automakers have announced a bevy of smaller EVs and gas-powered autos with electric motors that can extend range, indicates there may be a shift afoot. Ford is planning to launch the Fathom next year. The sub-$30,000 electric pickup is expected to be about the size of the automaker’s compact gas-powered Maverick pickup. Though Ford hasn’t announced the battery sizes available in various trims, it’s a safe bet they won’t be anywhere near the size of the F-150 Lightning's or Cybertruck's. The company is also planning to relaunch the Lightning as an extended-range model.
paras.zh: 这两辆卡车在一年内相继被取消，而汽车制造商已经宣布推出一系列小型电动汽车和配备可延长行驶里程的电动机的汽油动力汽车，这表明可能正在发生转变。福特计划明年推出 Fathom。这款售价低于 30,000 美元的电动皮卡预计与该汽车制造商的紧凑型汽油动力 Maverick 皮卡大小相当。尽管福特尚未公布各种车型的电池尺寸，但可以肯定的是，它们的尺寸不会接近 F-150 Lightning 或 Cyber​​truck 的尺寸。该公司还计划重新推出 Lightning 作为增程型号。

paras.en: Startup Slate is also launching a tiny electric pickup that can be converted to an SUV, with a bare-bones base model starting below $25,000. It also features a svelte battery and has seen a massive surge in preorders—though, to be fair, so did the Cybertruck, and we saw how that turned out.
paras.zh: Startup Slate 还推出了一款可改装为 SUV 的小型电动皮卡，其基本型号的起价低于 25,000 美元。它还配备了超薄电池，并且预订量大幅增加——不过，公平地说，Cyber​​truck 也是如此，我们看到了结果如何。

paras.en: Then there’s the Rivian R2, which launched this year. While the SUV isn’t as tiny or cheap as Ford and Slate’s vehicles—its battery has 88 kilowatt-hours of capacity and weighs in at around 1,200 pounds—it’s still smaller than the company’s flagship R1S. Rivian has also teased the R3, an even more-slimmed down SUV, in the coming years.
paras.zh: 还有今年推出的 Rivian R2。虽然这款 SUV 不像福特和 Slate 的汽车那么小巧或便宜——其电池容量为 88 千瓦时，重量约为 1,200 磅——但它仍然比该公司的旗舰产品 R1S 小。 Rivian 还透露，未来几年将推出 R3，一款更精简的 SUV。

paras.en: That’s not to say big EVs are dead. The Kia EV9, for example, is among the top 10 EVs by sales in the US, as is the R1S. There’s also a torrid resale market for the F-150 Lightning. But the rest of the top 10 new EV sales are all crossovers, sedans, or mid-sized SUVs with moderately sized batteries, and a number of newly announced EVs are trending on the smaller side or function as extended-range vehicles.
paras.zh: 这并不是说大型电动汽车已经消亡。例如，起亚 EV9 和 R1S 均跻身美国销量前 10 名电动汽车之列。 F-150 Lightning 的转售市场也非常火热。但销量前 10 名的新电动汽车中的其余都是跨界车、轿车或配备中等尺寸电池的中型 SUV，并且许多新发布的电动汽车正趋向小型化或增程型汽车。

paras.en: Building smaller vehicles is, of course, one way to make EVs cheaper. With less weight to propel, you can rely on a smaller battery. And given that the battery pack is the most costly component of an EV, that can in turn help automakers offer more affordable vehicles at a time when the price of so many other consumer goods is skyrocketing. That includes the current crop of EVs: The average transaction price for a new model is now $55,800, according to Cox Automotive.
paras.zh: 当然，制造小型车辆是降低电动汽车成本的一种方法。由于驱动重量更轻，您可以依靠更小的电池。鉴于电池组是电动汽车中最昂贵的组件，这反过来可以帮助汽车制造商在许多其他消费品的价格飞涨之际提供更实惠的汽车。其中包括当前的电动汽车：据 Cox Automotive 称，新车型的平均交易价格目前为 55,800 美元。

paras.en: Going small—or smaller, anyway—also means making the most of a limited battery supply chain. The vast majority of Cybertruck drivers are doing the same thing with their vehicles as Hyundai Ioniq 5 drivers: getting groceries, commuting, and driving kids to soccer games. But a standard-range Ioniq 5 driver is doing it with a battery about half the size.
paras.zh: 小型化——或者说更小——也意味着充分利用有限的电池供应链。绝大多数 Cyber​​truck 驾驶员与现代 Ioniq 5 驾驶员使用车辆做同样的事情：买杂货、通勤、开车带孩子去看足球比赛。但标准范围的 Ioniq 5 驱动器却使用大约一半大小的电池来实现这一点。

paras.en: After President Donald Trump’s administration killed EV incentives last year, sales plummeted. The Iran War and rising gas prices have led to an uptick in interest, though sales still lag behind the global average. (Used hybrid sales have also picked up, reflecting the pain people have been feeling at the pump.) Even with a Democratic-controlled Congress, EV incentives coming back under Trump are about as likely as defense secretary Pete Hegseth putting pronouns in his email signature. But should Democrats take the White House in 2028, marking the culmination of Woke 2.0, support for would-be EV buyers becomes much more likely.
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统的政府去年取消了电动汽车激励措施后，销量直线下降。伊朗战争和不断上涨的天然气价格导致人们的兴趣上升，但销量仍落后于全球平均水平。 （二手混合动力汽车销量也有所回升，反映出人们在加油时感受到的痛苦。）即使在民主党控制的国会中，特朗普领导下重新推出电动汽车激励措施的可能性也与国防部长皮特·赫格斯在他的电子邮件签名中添加代词一样。但如果民主党在 2028 年入主白宫，标志着 Woke 2.0 的顶峰，那么对潜在电动汽车买家的支持就会变得更有可能。

paras.en: Automakers pivoting to smaller cars could be much better positioned to meet pent-up demand if that happens, while also lowering the risks of delivery delays.
paras.zh: 如果发生这种情况，转向小型汽车的汽车制造商可能会更好地满足被压抑的需求，同时也降低交付延误的风险。

paras.en: Even Elon’s announcement killing the Cybertruck points to where the market is heading: He claims Tesla is ending production to make room for cranking out more Cybercabs. The battery size in those vehicles? Just 48 kilowatt-hours.
paras.zh: 就连埃隆宣布取消 Cyber​​truck 的声明也指出了市场的发展方向：他声称特斯拉将停止生产，以便为生产更多 Cyber​​cab 腾出空间。这些车辆的电池尺寸？仅48千瓦时。

paras.en: Additional reporting by Aarian Marshall.
paras.zh: 阿里安·马歇尔的补充报道。

articles.title: USPS employee charged with attempted murder in Iowa shooting

paras.en: Nov. 6 (UPI) -- A U.S. Postal Service employee in Iowa was charged with attempted murder Friday following a shooting that injured three people.
paras.zh: 11 月 6 日（合众国际社）——周五，爱荷华州一名美国邮政局员工因枪击事件导致三人受伤，被指控谋杀未遂。

paras.en: Police said suspect Jennifer C. Pledger, 39, shot a group of her co-workers Thursday in a non-public part of the downtown Des Moines post office.
paras.zh: 警方称，39 岁的嫌疑人詹妮弗·C·普莱杰 (Jennifer C. Pledger) 周四在得梅因市中心邮局的非公共区域枪杀了一群同事。

paras.en: The three injured people are expected to survive.
paras.zh: 三名伤者有望生还。

paras.en: Pledger is charged with several felonies, including attempted murder, willful injury and intimidation with a dangerous weapon, CNN reported.
paras.zh: 据美国有线电视新闻网报道，普莱杰被指控犯有多项重罪，包括谋杀未遂、故意伤害和使用危险武器恐吓。

paras.en: She was in court Friday for her first appearance and was held without bond.
paras.zh: 周五，她首次出庭，并被关押，不得保释。

paras.en: Sgt. Paul Parizek, a Des Moines police spokesperson, said Pledger opened fire on a group of her coworkers during a team meeting, the Des Moines Register reported.
paras.zh: 中士。据《得梅因纪事报》报道，得梅因警方发言人保罗·帕里泽克表示，普莱杰在一次小组会议上向她的一群同事开枪。

paras.en: One female victim was struck and fell to the ground.
paras.zh: 一名女性受害者被击倒在地。

paras.en: "Pledger then approached that victim, stood over her, and fired again," Parizek told reporters. "Pledger is then described as firing in the direction of other employees as they fled the area of the shooting."
paras.zh: 帕里泽克告诉记者：“普莱杰随后走近受害者，站在她身边，再次开枪。” “据描述，当其他员工逃离枪击区域时，普莱杰向他们的方向开枪。”

paras.en: Parizek said the suspect continued firing as other postal service workers fled.
paras.zh: 帕里泽克说，当其他邮政工作人员逃跑时，嫌疑人继续开枪。

paras.en: A motive for the shooting remains unclear.
paras.zh: 枪击动机尚不清楚。

paras.en: "Motive is tough because, unless somebody tells us why they did what they did, we may not ever really have a solid answer for that," Parizek told reporters. "Right now, we don't have any answers about what the motive was."
paras.zh: 帕里泽克告诉记者：“动机很艰难，因为除非有人告诉我们他们为什么这么做，否则我们可能永远无法真正找到可靠的答案。” “目前，我们还没有任何关于动机是什么的答案。”

articles.title: Man arrested near White House heard voices telling him to kill Trump

paras.en: Nov. 6 (UPI) -- A Venezuelan man armed with several weapons was arrested near the White House after allegedly telling Secret Service officers that voices in his head told him to kill President Donald Trump, federal officials said Friday.
paras.zh: 11 月 6 日（UPI）——联邦官员周五表示，一名携带多件武器的委内瑞拉男子在白宫附近被捕，据称他告诉特勤局官员，他脑海中的声音告诉他要杀死唐纳德·特朗普总统。

paras.en: Ronny Yordrix Guanipa Chrinos was arrested Thursday evening after officers approached a vehicle on Constitution Avenue and noticed him acting suspiciously.
paras.zh: 周四晚上，罗尼·约德里克斯·瓜尼帕·奇里诺斯 (Ronny Yordrixguanipa Chrinos) 因警察走近宪法大道上的一辆车并发现他行为可疑而被捕。

paras.en: Chrinos allegedly told Secret Service officers he had traveled to Washington because he heard voices directing him to kill the president, the Department of Homeland Security said in a statement.
paras.zh: 美国国土安全部在一份声明中表示，据称奇里诺斯告诉特勤局官员，他前往华盛顿是因为听到有人指示他刺杀总统。

paras.en: Inside the vehicle, which had been stolen, officers found an AR-15-style rifle, a MAC-10 and a Glock 43X handgun, along with dozens of rounds of ammunition.
paras.zh: 在被盗的车内，警方发现了一支 AR-15 式步枪、一支 MAC-10 和一把格洛克 43X 手枪，以及数十发弹药。

paras.en: Chrinos faces multiple weapons and property-related charges, including carrying a rifle outside a home or business, three counts each of unlawful transportation of a firearm, possession of unregistered firearms and possession of unregistered ammunition.
paras.zh: 奇里诺斯面临多项与武器和财产相关的指控，包括在住宅或企业外携带步枪、非法运输枪支、持有未注册枪支和持有未注册弹药各三项罪名。

paras.en: He was also charged with possession of a dangerous weapons, carrying a pistol without a license, unauthorized use of a motor vehicle, theft and receiving stolen property.
paras.zh: 他还被指控持有危险武器、无证携带手枪、未经授权使用机动车辆、盗窃和收受赃物。

paras.en: "This incident reflects the heightened threat environment in which we operate, as well as the continued number of armed individuals who are drawn to the White House complex," Secret Service Director Sean Curran said in a statement.
paras.zh: 特勤局局长肖恩·柯兰在一份声明中表示：“这一事件反映出我们所处的威胁环境加剧，以及不断有大量武装人员被吸引到白宫建筑群。”

paras.en: DHS officials said Chrinos entered the United States illegally through Texas in March 2024.
paras.zh: 国土安全部官员表示，Chrinos 于 2024 年 3 月通过德克萨斯州非法进入美国。

articles.title: Paraguay president impeached, under house arrest amid banking crisis

paras.en: Nov. 6 (UPI) -- Paraguayan President Santiago Peña was removed from office and placed under house arrest Friday amid a banking crisis that has left nearly 3 million people unable to access their money.
paras.zh: 11 月 6 日（合众社）——巴拉圭总统圣地亚哥·佩纳周五被免职并被软禁，原因是银行业危机导致近 300 万人无法提取资金。

paras.en: Peña, 47, was detained minutes after the country's Senate voted 44-0 to remove him from office over allegations of corruption and financial misconduct involving the collapse of Ueno Bank, one of Paraguay's largest digital lenders.
paras.zh: 47 岁的佩纳在巴拉圭参议院以 44 比 0 的投票结果被罢免，原因是他涉嫌腐败和涉及巴拉圭最大数字银行之一上野银行倒闭的金融不当行为。

paras.en: The bank's collapse has frozen the accounts of an estimated 2.9 million customers, representing about 60% of the country's adult population.
paras.zh: 该银行的倒闭导致大约 290 万客户的账户被冻结，约占该国成年人口的 60%。

paras.en: Vice President Pedro Alliana was sworn in as interim president following Peña's removal and is expected to serve until 2028.
paras.zh: 佩纳被免职后，副总统佩德罗·阿利亚纳宣誓就任临时总统，预计任期至 2028 年。

paras.en: "Compatriots who are now going through a difficult time as a result of the financial collapse will be fully compensated," Alliana said following his inauguration, the BBC reported.
paras.zh: 据英国广播公司报道，阿利亚纳在就职后表示：“由于金融崩溃而正在经历困难时期的同胞将得到充分补偿。”

paras.en: Paraguay's Deposit Guarantee Fund began reimbursing eligible depositors Thursday, with initial payments covering aout $18,700 per customer and full guaranteed coverage reaching about $37,000.
paras.zh: 巴拉圭的存款担保基金周四开始向符合条件的储户提供补偿，每位客户的首期付款约为 18,700 美元，全额担保金额约为 37,000 美元。

paras.en: Prosecutors opened an investigation Thursday into allegations that Peña used his political influence to benefit Ueno Bank, where he previously held shares.
paras.zh: 检察官周四对佩纳利用政治影响力为他之前持有上野银行股份的指控展开调查。

paras.en: Authorities are investigating possible illicit enrichment, money laundering, influence peddling and misapproppublic riation of funds.
paras.zh: 当局正在调查可能存在的非法致富、洗钱、兜售影响力和挪用资金等行为。

paras.en: Peña has denied wrongdoing. His attorney, Ricardo Preda, said the allegations were "irresponsible and opportunistic."
paras.zh: 佩纳否认有不当行为。他的律师里卡多·普雷达表示，这些指控是“不负责任和机会主义的”。

paras.en: Peña announced his resignation Thursday as lawmakers moved forward with impeachment proceedings.
paras.zh: 随着立法者推进弹劾程序，佩纳周四宣布辞职。

paras.en: But legislators rejected his resignation, leaving him without the lifetime Senate seat and legal protections afforded to former presidents under Paraguay's Constitution.
paras.zh: 但立法者拒绝了他的辞职，使他失去了终身参议院席位，也失去了巴拉圭宪法为前总统提供的法律保护。

paras.en: The Chamber of Deputies approved impeachment charges with 78 votes before the Senate voted to remove him Friday.
paras.zh: 在周五参议院投票罢免他之前，众议院以 78 票通过了弹劾指控。

paras.en: Prosecutor Elena Fiore Franco said Peña cooperated with authorities when officers arrived at his residence.
paras.zh: 检察官埃琳娜·菲奥雷·佛朗哥表示，当警察到达佩纳的住所时，他与当局合作。

paras.en: "It has been established that he is indeed inside his home," Franco told the Guardian. "He voluntarily allowed officers to enter and made himself available for all procedural purposes."
paras.zh: 佛朗哥告诉《卫报》：“已经确定他确实在自己家里。” “他自愿允许警察进入，并让自己可以执行所有程序目的。”

paras.en: Peña, a close regional ally of President Donald Trump, had been in office since August 2023.
paras.zh: 佩纳是唐纳德·特朗普总统的亲密地区盟友，自 2023 年 8 月起就任。

articles.title: Flo Milli Wins Dismissal of Copyright Lawsuit Over ‘Never Lose Me’ Beat Sample
articles.author: Rachel Scharf

paras.en: A judge threw out copyright claims over Flo Milli’s 2023 hit “Never Lose Me” after ruling that the man bringing the lawsuit does not technically own a beat sampled in the track.
paras.zh: 一名法官驳回了 Flo Milli 2023 年热门单曲《Never Lose Me》的版权主张，裁定提起诉讼的人严格来说并不拥有歌曲中采样的节拍。

paras.en: The Friday (Nov. 6) court ruling, obtained and first reported by Billboard, dismissed the lawsuit without any opportunity to amend. But the case is not over for good; an attorney for the plaintiff said they intend to appeal.
paras.zh: 《公告牌》(Billboard) 获得并首先报道了周五（11 月 6 日）法院的裁决，该裁决驳回了诉讼，且没有任何修改的机会。但案件并没有就此结束。原告的一名律师表示，他们打算上诉。

paras.en: The case was brought last year by Shamar Deal, a Baltimore-based artist who purchased a beat called “Youu” on the rap instrumental marketplace Traktrain in 2019. Deal said that after he paid $200 for a 10-year exclusive license, producer Gerreaux Katana wrongly turned around and relicensed the beat to Babyface Ray and 42 Dugg for their 2023 song “Ron Artest.” Flo Milli then sampled “Ron Artest” on “Never Lose Me,” which peaked at No. 15 on the Billboard Hot 100.
paras.zh: 去年，巴尔的摩艺术家 Shamar Deal 提起此案，他于 2019 年在说唱乐器市场 Traktrain 上购买了一首名为“Youu”的节拍。Deal 表示，在他支付 200 美元购买了 10 年独家授权后，制作人 Gerreaux Katana 错误地转身将这首节拍重新授权给 Babyface Ray 和 42 Dugg 制作他们 2023 年的歌曲“Ron Artest”。随后，弗洛·米利 (Flo Milli) 在《Never Lose Me》中采样了“罗恩·阿泰斯特 (Ron Artest)”，这首歌在公告牌百强单曲榜上最高排名第 15 位。

paras.en: Deal sued all three rappers for copyright infringement. On Friday, however, Judge André Birotte Jr. found that Deal does not actually own the rights to “Youu.” That’s because copyright law requires all exclusive licenses to be signed by both parties — and Traktrain never got Katana’s signature to sell the beat to Deal.
paras.zh: 迪尔起诉所有三位说唱歌手侵犯版权。然而，周五，法官小安德烈·比罗特 (André Birotte Jr.) 发现，迪尔实际上并不拥有“Youu”的权利。这是因为版权法要求所有独家许可​​均需双方签署，而 Traktrain 从未获得 Katana 的签名才能将节拍出售给 Deal。

paras.en: According to Deal, the fact that Katana uploaded the beat to Traktrain and accepted his $200 should be enough to validate the license. But Judge Birotte said there’s no room for ambiguity here. He quoted a decades-old appellate ruling on the topic: “The rule is really quite simple: If the copyright holder agrees to transfer ownership to another party, that party must get the copyright holder to sign a piece of paper saying so.”
paras.zh: 根据 Deal 的说法，Katana 将节拍上传到 Traktrain 并接受他的 200 美元这一事实应该足以验证许可证。但比罗特法官表示，这里没有任何含糊的余地。他引用了几十年前关于该主题的上诉裁决：“规则实际上非常简单：如果版权所有者同意将所有权转让给另一方，该方必须让版权所有者签署一份这样的文件。”

paras.en: The ruling highlights a potential pitfall of online instrumental marketplaces, which have become a common source of beats for aspiring rappers in recent years. As experts have previously told Billboard, casual licensing arrangements can later come back to haunt artists and producers in a business that relies on proper legal paperwork.
paras.zh: 这项裁决凸显了在线乐器市场的潜在陷阱，近年来，该市场已成为有抱负的说唱歌手的常见节拍来源。正如专家此前告诉 Billboard 的那样，随意的许可安排可能会在以后困扰依赖适当法律文书的企业中的艺术家和制作人。

paras.en: Deal’s attorney, Larry Zerner, cited the prevalence of the online beat economy when telling Billboard on Friday that they “respectfully disagree” with Judge Birotte’s decision and plan to appeal it.
paras.zh: 迪尔的律师拉里·泽纳 (Larry Zerner) 在周五告诉 Billboard 时，提到了在线节拍经济的盛行，他们“谨此表示不同意”比罗特法官的决定，并计划提出上诉。

paras.en: “Shamar Deal paid for an exclusive license to this beat,” said Zerner. “The producer listed it for sale as an exclusive, set the price, took the money, and confirmed the sale in his own emails. Shamar also has a contract with the producer that confirms all of these facts. That’s how thousands of independent artists buy beats online every single day, and they deserve to know that the licenses they pay for will hold up. We’re confident the Ninth Circuit will see it that way.”
paras.zh: “Shamar Deal 支付了该节拍的独家许可费用，”泽纳说。 “制作人将其列为独家出售，设定了价格，收了钱，并在自己的电子邮件中确认了销售。Shamar 还与制作人签订了一份合同，确认了所有这些事实。这就是每天成千上万的独立艺术家在网上购买节拍的方式，他们应该知道他们支付的许可证是否有效。我们相信第九巡回法院会这么认为。”

paras.en: David Given, a lawyer representing Babyface Ray and his distributor EMPIRE, told Billboard on Friday, “Our clients are grateful for the court’s carefully reasoned decision dismissing the case for copyright infringement against them.”
paras.zh: Babyface Ray 及其发行商 EMPIRE 的代理律师大卫·吉文 (David Given) 周五对 Billboard 表示：“我们的客户非常感谢法院经过深思熟虑的决定，驳回了针对他们的版权侵权案件。”

paras.en: Reps for Flo Milli and 42 Dugg did not immediately return requests for comment on the ruling.
paras.zh: Flo Milli 和 42 Dugg 的代表没有立即回复对裁决发表评论的请求。

articles.title: Céline Dion Plays Air Bass at Metallica’s Sphere Show
articles.author: Jessica Lynch

paras.en: Céline Dion might be best known for her soaring power ballads, but the Canadian superstar proved she knows her way around a heavy metal concert, too.
paras.zh: 席琳·迪翁（Céline Dion）可能因其高亢有力的民谣而闻名，但这位加拿大巨星证明了她也熟悉重金属音乐会。

paras.en: The “My Heart Will Go On” singer was spotted enthusiastically playing air bass during Metallica‘s Life Burns Faster residency at Sphere in Las Vegas on Thursday (Nov. 5), with fan-filmed footage capturing her enjoying the performance from a suite inside the venue.
paras.zh: 周四（11 月 5 日），这位《My Heart Will Go On》歌手被发现在拉斯维加斯 Sphere 的 Metallica 乐队 Life Burns Faster 驻场演出中热情地演奏低音提琴，粉丝拍摄的镜头捕捉到她在场馆内的一间套房中享受表演的画面。

paras.en: In a video shared on Instagram by user @theordacityyy, Dion can be seen standing and mimicking the bass-playing techniques of Metallica‘s Robert Trujillo, enthusiastically moving her hands as the musician performed alongside guitarist Kirk Hammett.
paras.zh: 在用户 @theordacityyy 在 Instagram 上分享的一段视频中，可以看到迪翁站着模仿 Metallica 乐队的罗伯特·特鲁希略 (Robert Trujillo) 的贝斯演奏技巧，当音乐家与吉他手柯克·哈米特 (Kirk Hammett) 一起表演时，她热情地移动双手。

paras.en: The moment occurred during the band’s customary “Kirk and Rob Doodle,” an instrumental segment that gives Hammett and Trujillo an opportunity to jam together during the show. According to the concert’s reported setlist, the Nov. 5 installment incorporated “Motown Yo Town” and “Copenhagen.”
paras.zh: 这一时刻发生在乐队惯常的“柯克和罗布涂鸦”期间，这是一个器乐片段，为哈米特和特鲁希略提供了在演出期间即兴表演的机会。根据音乐会报道的曲目表，11 月 5 日的演出包括“Motown Yo Town”和“Copenhagen”。

paras.en: Dion wasn’t the only famous face taking in the performance. Guns N’ Roses guitarist Slash was also reportedly spotted in the suite, while members of No Doubt were among the other musicians seen enjoying the concert.
paras.zh: 迪翁并不是参加演出的唯一著名面孔。据报道，Guns N’ Roses 乐队的吉他手 Slash 也出现在套房中，而 No Doubt 乐队的成员也是享受这场音乐会的其他音乐家之一。

paras.en: Although Dion’s enthusiasm might seem unexpected to fans more familiar with her romantic ballads, her appreciation for Metallica is hardly newEarlier this year, the five-time Grammy winner shared a selection of songs from her personal playlist, which included Metallica’s 1996 single “Until It Sleeps.”
paras.zh: 尽管迪翁的热情对于更熟悉她的浪漫民谣的歌迷来说似乎出乎意料，但她对 Metallica 的欣赏并不新鲜。今年早些时候，这位五届格莱美奖得主分享了她个人播放列表中的精选歌曲，其中包括 Metallica 1996 年的单曲“Until It Sleeps”。

paras.en: “Eddy, one of my twins, his favorite band is Metallica,” Dion said in the video, before enthusiastically attempting her own impression of frontman James Hetfield.
paras.zh: “艾迪，我的双胞胎之一，他最喜欢的乐队是 Metallica，”迪翁在视频中说道，然后热情地尝试了她自己对主唱詹姆斯·海特菲尔德的印象。

paras.en: The appearance comes amid an eventful year for Dion, who returned to full-length concerts in September after a six-year absence. Her Paris residency marked a significant milestone following her 2022 announcement that she had been diagnosed with stiff-person syndrome, a rare neurological disorder that had affected her ability to perform.
paras.zh: 此次亮相正值迪翁度过了多事之年，他在阔别六年后于 9 月重返大型音乐会。继 2022 年宣布自己被诊断出患有僵人综合症（一种罕见的神经系统疾病，影响了她的表演能力）之后，她在巴黎的驻场实习标志着一个重要的里程碑。

paras.en: Dion, whose Billboard Hot 100 history includes four No. 1 singles — “The Power of Love,” “Because You Loved Me,” “My Heart Will Go On” and her R. Kelly duet “I’m Your Angel” — completed the first leg of her Paris comeback performances in October.
paras.zh: 迪翁的告示牌百强单曲榜历史上包括四首排名第一的单曲——《The Power of Love》、《Because You Loved Me》、《My Heart Will Go On》和她与 R. Kelly 的二重唱《I'm Your Angel》——于 10 月完成了她在巴黎复出表演的第一站。

paras.en: Meanwhile, Metallica’s Life Burns Faster residency launched at Sphere on Oct. 1, bringing the metal veterans’ No Repeat Weekend concept to the Las Vegas venue. The format, introduced during the band’s M72 World Tour, features different setlists across paired Thursday and Saturday concerts.
paras.zh: 与此同时，Metallica 的 Life Burns Faster 驻场演出于 10 月 1 日在 Sphere 推出，将金属老将的 No Repeat Weekend 概念带到拉斯维加斯场地。这种形式是在乐队的 M72 世界巡演期间引入的，在周四和周六的配对音乐会上有不同的曲目列表。

paras.en: The band concludes the 2026 portion of its Sphere residency on Saturday (Nov. 7), with performances scheduled to resume in January 2027.
paras.zh: 乐队于周六（11 月 7 日）结束了 Sphere 驻场演出的 2026 年部分，演出计划于 2027 年 1 月恢复。

articles.title: Benson Boone Brings Young Fan Battling Cancer Onstage at Brisbane Concert
articles.author: Jessica Lynch

paras.en: Benson Boone opened the Australian leg of his Wanted Man tour with a special guest. He brought a 13-year-old fan who is battling cancer onstage to sing “Beautiful Things” with him on her birthday.
paras.zh: 本森·布恩 (Benson Boone) 与一位特邀嘉宾一起拉开了他的通缉犯之旅澳大利亚站的序幕。他带着一位正在与癌症作斗争的13岁歌迷在她生日那天与他一起唱《美丽的事物》。

paras.en: The moment came at the end of Boone’s set at Brisbane Entertainment Centre on Friday (Nov. 6). The Music reported that the singer stopped to introduce the final song.
paras.zh: 这一刻发生在周五（11 月 6 日）布恩在布里斯班娱乐中心演出结束时。据《音乐》报道，这位歌手停下来介绍最后一首歌。

paras.en: “I’ve had the opportunity of meeting a 13-year-old girl who is battling her second round of cancer,” Boone told the crowd, according to the outlet. “It’s her birthday today and her birthday wish was to come on stage and sing ‘Beautiful Things.’”
paras.zh: 据该媒体报道，布恩对人群说：“我有机会见到一位 13 岁的女孩，她正在与第二轮癌症作斗争。” “今天是她的生日，她的生日愿望是上台演唱《美丽的事物》。”

paras.en: The fan, Kenzie Riddle, then rose from an upper platform and joined Boone on the song. According to The Music, roughly 10,000 people were in the arena.
paras.zh: 这位名叫肯齐·里德尔（Kenzie Riddle）的歌迷随后从楼上的平台上站起来，和布恩一起唱这首歌。据《The Music》报道，竞技场内约有 10,000 人。

paras.en: Riddle has Ewing’s sarcoma. As reported by Nine’s Today, she believed she had beaten the illness after about two and a half years of treatment, but the cancer returned and she is now facing intensive chemotherapy. Her family said they bought tickets to the show in July as her 13th birthday present. Her campaign to meet Boone took off online after a local musician, Fergus Hogan, shared an Instagram video about her story.
paras.zh: 里德尔患有尤文氏肉瘤。据《今日九号》报道，经过大约两年半的治疗，她相信自己已经战胜了疾病，但癌症复发了，她现在面临着强化化疗。她的家人表示，他们在 7 月份购买了演出门票，作为她 13 岁的生日礼物。当地音乐家弗格斯·霍根 (Fergus Hogan) 在 Instagram 上分享了一段关于布恩故事的视频后，她在网上发起了与布恩见面的活动。

paras.en: “I love his energetic style and how he’s so over the top,” Riddle told Today before the concert. “He’s kinda crazy and I love it.”
paras.zh: “我喜欢他充满活力的风格以及他如此夸张的方式，”里德尔在音乐会前告诉《今日》。 “他有点疯狂，我喜欢它。”

paras.en: Her family also told the program: “She’s such an unbelievable inspiration to so many people… But I think even bigger than that is the community behind her.”
paras.zh: 她的家人也告诉该节目：“她对很多人来说都是令人难以置信的灵感......但我认为比这更重要的是她背后的社区。”

paras.en: “Beautiful Things” was Boone’s breakout single. Released in January 2024, it reached No. 2 on the Billboard Hot 100 and became one of the most-streamed songs in the world that year. Boone followed it with his debut album Fireworks & Rollerblades that April. His second album, American Heart, arrived in 2025 and included the single “Mystical Magical.”
paras.zh: 《Beautiful Things》是布恩的突破单曲。它于 2024 年 1 月发行，在公告牌百强单曲榜上排名第二，并成为当年全球流媒体播放量最高的歌曲之一。随后，布恩于四月推出了他的首张专辑《Fireworks & Rollerblades》。他的第二张专辑《American Heart》于 2025 年发行，其中包括单曲“Mystical Magical”。

paras.en: The Brisbane show opened Boone’s Wanted Man tour of Australia. Boone has two additional Brisbane performances scheduled for Nov. 7 and 8 before the tour heads to Melbourne for three concerts at Rod Laver Arena beginning Nov. 12. The Australian leg concludes with three shows at Sydney’s Afterpay Arena from Nov. 17-19.
paras.zh: 布里斯班演出拉开了布恩澳大利亚通缉犯之旅的序幕。布恩计划于 11 月 7 日和 8 日在布里斯班另外举行两场演出，然后巡演将于 11 月 12 日开始前往墨尔本在 Rod Laver Arena 举行三场音乐会。澳大利亚站的最后一场演出将于 11 月 17 日至 19 日在悉尼 Afterpay Arena 举行三场演出。

articles.title: James Bond Surprise: Robert Pattinson Screen Tested to Play 007
articles.author: Aaron Couch

paras.en: In a surprise few saw coming, Robert Pattinson has emerged as a contender for 007. The actor, 40, is among those who have screen tested for the role of James Bond, multiple sources tell The Hollywood Reporter, joining hopefuls Callum Turner, Jack Lowden and Josh O’Connor.
paras.zh: 出人意料的是，罗伯特·帕丁森成为了 007 的竞争者。多位消息人士告诉《好莱坞报道》，这位 40 岁的演员是接受詹姆斯·邦德这一角色银幕试镜的演员之一，加入了有望出演詹姆斯·邦德的演员卡勒姆·特纳、杰克·劳登和乔什·奥康纳的行列。

paras.en: Conventional wisdom has been that the next man to get the license to kill would not be a globally recognized star like Pattinson, one of the biggest actors of his age cohort, and already the face of DC Studios’ Batman franchise. The screen tests are said to have occurred the weekend of Oct. 24. THR previously reported that four, possibly five actors were in the mix but only three names surfaced at the time.
paras.zh: 传统观点认为，下一个获得杀人执照的人不会是像帕丁森这样的全球知名明星，他是同龄人中最伟大的演员之一，并且已经是 DC 影业蝙蝠侠系列的代言人。据说试镜是在 10 月 24 日的周末进行的。THR 此前报道称，有四名、可能是五名演员参演，但当时只透露了三个名字。

paras.en: Another name now surfacing as one of the Bond mystery men is Nicholas Hoult, a runnerup to Pattinson for Batman years ago.
paras.zh: 现在作为邦德神秘人物之一出现的另一个名字是尼古拉斯·霍尔特，几年前在《蝙蝠侠》中仅次于帕丁森。

paras.en: Pattinson is a favorite of auteurs from Robert Eggers and the Safdie brothers to Christopher Nolan, whose 2020 spy movie Tenet might feel like a Bond audition in hindsight. And more importantly, he worked with Bond director Denis Villeneuve on the upcoming Dune: Part 3, which bows Dec. 18 and is said to have gone well for the two men.
paras.zh: 帕丁森是罗伯特·艾格斯、萨夫迪兄弟和克里斯托弗·诺兰等导演的最爱，他的 2020 年间谍电影《信条》事后看来可能感觉像是邦德试镜。更重要的是，他与邦德导演丹尼斯·维伦纽瓦合作拍摄了即将上映的《沙丘：第三部》，该片将于 12 月 18 日上映，据说两人的合作进展顺利。

paras.en: The actor is in the midst of the biggest year of his career, with a key role in Nolan’s The Odyssey and as the co-lead of A24 hit The Drama and anchoring the well-reguarded movie Primetime, also from A24. He’s currently filming The Batman Part II in London, where screen tests have been taking place.
paras.zh: 这位演员正处于职业生涯中最重要的一年，他在诺兰的《奥德赛》中担任关键角色，并担任 A24 热门电影《戏剧》的联合主演，并主持了同样来自 A24 的广受好评的电影《黄金时段》。他目前正在伦敦拍摄《蝙蝠侠第二部》，并正在进行试镜。

paras.en: While conventional wisdom goes against a world famous Bond, these are unprecedented times in the franchise. It is the first Bond movie made under the control of Amazon, which bought out the creative rights from the Broccoli family in February 2025. And producing are Spider-Man‘s Amy Pascal and David Heyman, producer of the Harry Potter movies. A young Pattinson broke out with a tragic role in 2005’s Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire, before gaining global fame a few years later in Twilight.
paras.zh: 虽然传统观点与世界著名的邦德背道而驰，但这是该系列中前所未有的时代。这是亚马逊控制下制作的第一部邦德电影，亚马逊于 2025 年 2 月从 Broccoli 家族手中买下了创作权。制片人是《蜘蛛侠》的艾米·帕斯卡和《哈利·波特》电影的制片人大卫·海曼。年轻的帕丁森在 2005 年的《哈利·波特与火焰杯》中出演了一个悲剧角色，并在几年后的《暮光之城》中蜚声全球。

paras.en: The Bond casting search comes 21 years after Daniel Craig was set as the next James Bond back in October 2005. He retired from the role after five films with 2021’s No Time to Die, his tenure including the franchise’s first and only $1 billion hit, the 2012 feature Skyfall.
paras.zh: 早在 2005 年 10 月，丹尼尔·克雷格 (Daniel Craig) 被确定为下一任詹姆斯·邦德 (James Bond) 之前，距离邦德选角的时间已有 21 年。他在 2021 年的《007：无暇赴死》等五部电影后退休，其中包括该系列第一部也是唯一一部价值 10 亿美元的热门影片，2012 年的故事片《007 天幕杀机》(Skyfall)。

articles.title: After 2026 Midterms, Bill Maher Asks Trump, “Donnie, Are You OK?”
articles.author: McKinley Franklin

paras.en: Bill Maher reacted to the 2026 midterm results during the Friday episode of Real Time, moreso reacting to President Donald Trump‘s response to the election.
paras.zh: 比尔·马赫 (Bill Maher) 在《实时》周五节目中对 2026 年中期结果做出了反应，同时也对唐纳德·特朗普总统对选举的反应做出了反应。

paras.en: During the host’s monologue, he said he predicted the midterms would be positive for Democrats. “Well, look, I hate to gloat, but sorry, I have to do a little bit because everybody was hedging about this election,” he said, as a montage of clips of him predicting the results was played.
paras.zh: 在主持人的独白中，他表示他预计中期选举将对民主党有利。 “好吧，听着，我讨厌幸灾乐祸，但抱歉，我必须做一点，因为每个人都在对这次选举进行对冲，”他说道，同时播放了他预测结果的剪辑片段。

paras.en: One thing Maher said he couldn’t have anticipated? Trump’s response to the results, he said.
paras.zh: 马赫说他无法预料到的一件事是什么？他说，特朗普对结果的反应。

paras.en: “Here’s something I could not have predicted, which was Trump’s reaction to the election. He said, ‘Congratulations to the Democrats, they did a good job,'” Maher said wide-eyed, looking around at his Real Time audience. “Donnie, are you OK? I know we’ve been feuding. You sound unwell. You’re not even going to fake it was rigged?”
paras.zh: “有件事我无法预测，那就是特朗普对选举的反应。他说，‘祝贺民主党，他们做得很好，’”马赫睁大眼睛说道，环顾着他的实时观众。 “唐尼，你还好吗？我知道我们一直在争吵。你听起来不太舒服。你不会假装事情被操纵了吧？”

paras.en: He continued, “And let me tell you something, even with the attempted rigging — and they did try to rig it in every different kind of way; mail-in balloting, intimidating the voters, all that shit — democracy, man. Kind of fucking awesome.”
paras.zh: 他继续说道，“让我告诉你一些事情，即使有企图操纵的事情——他们确实试图以各种不同的方式操纵它；邮寄投票，恐吓选民，所有这些狗屎——民主，伙计。他妈的太棒了。”

paras.en: During an interview with The New York Times shortly before 10:30 p.m. on Tuesday, the president said he was “absolutely willing” to accept the results. Trump added, “We’ll work with the Democrats, and we’ll, you know, look forward to working with them. We’ll probably work something out.”
paras.zh: 晚上 10 点 30 分左右接受《纽约时报》采访时周二，总统表示他“绝对愿意”接受结果。特朗普补充道，“我们将与民主党合作，你知道，我们将期待与他们合作。我们可能会解决一些问题。”

paras.en: However, he also ranted about the midterms, writing on Truth Social that if he was on the ballot, “we would have won IN A LANDSLIDE!”
paras.zh: 然而，他也对中期选举大喊大叫，在《Truth Social》上写道，如果他参加投票，“我们就会以压倒性优势获胜！”

paras.en: Maher’s comment about “feuding” with the president was likely a reference to their recent back-and-forth that was heightened after Trump penned a lengthy social media post where he slammed the comedian as a “complete and total loser,” and shared more details about their recent dinner at the White House.
paras.zh: 马赫关于与总统“不和”的评论很可能是指他们最近的争吵，特朗普在社交媒体上发表了一篇长篇帖子，抨击这位喜剧演员是“彻头彻尾的失败者”，并分享了他们最近在白宫共进晚餐的更多细节，这种争吵加剧了。

paras.en: Maher responded to the rant during last week’s Oct. 30 episode of Real Time, joking that the president “went off on me like Kelly Clarkson in a toy store.”
paras.zh: 马赫在上周 10 月 30 日的《实时》节目中回应了这一咆哮，开玩笑说总统“对我发脾气，就像在玩具店里的凯利·克拉克森一样”。

paras.en: Elsewhere in the episode, the comedian said he thinks the president has been “amazingly humble” amid the results. “I thought by this time, he’d be suing the voters by name, individually, and arresting the poll workers. Instead, even he was like, ‘You know, even I’m sick of me a little bit.’”
paras.zh: 在这一集的其他地方，这位喜剧演员表示，他认为总统在结果中“非常谦虚”。 “我以为这个时候，他会点名起诉选民，并逮捕投票工作人员。相反，就连他也说，‘你知道，连我都有点厌倦了自己。’”

paras.en: He joked that Trump saying he has “a lot of friends in the Democratic party” might open the door for him to visit the White House for a third time. “Wow, I might get to go again. Look at that,” he joked.
paras.zh: 他开玩笑说，特朗普说自己“在民主党有很多朋友”，可能会为他第三次访问白宫打开大门。 “哇，我可能会再去一次。看看那个，”他开玩笑说。

articles.title: ‘Hold Onto Me,’ Cyprus’ First Oscar Hopeful, Stars a Newcomer and a ‘Dogtooth’ Actor in a Very Personal Father-Daughter Drama
articles.author: Georg Szalai

paras.en: It’s summertime in Cyprus. Iris, 11, spends her days with her older best friend, Danae. But then she hears that her grandfather has died. Visiting town for his funeral is Iris’ father, Aris, whom she has never known.
paras.zh: 现在是塞浦路斯的夏季。 11 岁的艾里斯 (Iris) 每天和她最好的朋友达娜厄 (Danae) 在一起。但后来她听说她的祖父去世了。艾里斯的父亲阿里斯来镇上参加他的葬礼，但她素不相识。

paras.en: That is the starting point for Hold Onto Me, the feature debut of writer-director Myrsini Aristidou. Can Iris and Aris find a way to connect, even though he is a petty criminal and doesn’t want to take responsibility? Iris doesn’t give up and gets involved in his various schemes, despite warnings from her mother and her older brother. What begins as a stubborn attempt to reconnect slowly unfolds into a fragile bond. But then, Aris’ dark past gets them into trouble.
paras.zh: 这是编剧兼导演米尔西尼·阿里斯蒂杜 (Myrsini Aristidou) 的处女作《抱紧我》(Hold Onto Me) 的起点。艾里斯和阿里斯能否找到联系的方式，即使他是一个小罪犯并且不想承担责任？尽管母亲和哥哥发出警告，艾丽丝并没有放弃，并参与了他的各种计划。一开始顽固地试图重新建立联系，慢慢地变成了脆弱的纽带。但随后，阿里斯的黑暗过去让他们陷入了麻烦。

paras.en: Hold Onto Me, starring newcomer Maria Petrova and Christos Passalis (Dogtooth), premiered at Sundance, where it won the World Cinema Dramatic Audience Award. It then became Cyprus’ first-ever international feature film Oscar submission.
paras.zh: 《抱紧我》由新人玛丽亚·佩特洛娃和克里斯托斯·帕萨利斯（《狗牙》）主演，在圣丹斯电影节首映，并荣获世界电影戏剧观众奖。随后，它成为塞浦路斯有史以来第一部提交奥斯卡的国际故事片。

paras.en: Now, the film screens in the Just Film youth and children’s event of the 30th edition of the Tallinn Black Nights Film Festival (PÖFF) in Estonia. Cercamon is handling sales.
paras.zh: 现在，这部电影在爱沙尼亚第 30 届塔林黑夜电影节 (PÖFF) 的 Just Film 青少年和儿童活动中放映。 Cercamon 负责销售。

paras.en: Lasse Ulvedal Tolbøll was the cinematographer on the Cyprus-Denmark-Greece co-production. The editors were Jenna Mangulad and Aristidou. Aristidou and Monica Nicolaidou produced the film, with Thomas J. Mangan IV and Mark Hollinger as the executive producers and Anders N.U. Berg, Konstantina Stavrianou and Rena Vougioukalou as co-producers.
paras.zh: 莱塞·乌维达尔·托博尔 (Lasse Ulvedal Tolbøll) 是塞浦路斯、丹麦和希腊合拍片的电影摄影师。编辑是 Jenna Mangulad 和 Aristidou。阿里斯蒂杜和莫妮卡·尼科莱杜制作了这部电影，托马斯·J·曼根四世和马克·霍林格担任执行制片人，安德斯·N.U. Berg、Konstantina Stavrianou 和 Rena Vougioukalou 担任联合制片人。

paras.en: Watch a trailer for the film right here.
paras.zh: 在这里观看电影预告片。

paras.en: Aristidou talked to THR about her bittersweet first feature, pairing an unknown as the young girl at the heart of it with the man who played the son in Dogtooth, her desire to make Hold Onto Me feel different and that first-ever Cypriot Oscar submission.
paras.zh: 阿里斯蒂杜向《好莱坞报道》讲述了她苦乐参半的第一部电影，将一个默默无闻的年轻女孩与《狗牙》中扮演儿子的男人配对，她想让“抱住我”感觉不同的愿望，以及塞浦路斯人首次提交奥斯卡奖。

paras.en: The father-daughter theme is one that the filmmaker has also explored in two shorts. “I feel like this is like a triptych,” Aristidou tells THR. “My first short film called Semele in 2015 is also a father and daughter story and was the first time that I began exploring this theme. Then I did my second short film, Aria, which has a father daughter dynamic again, but with an older daughter – she’s a teenager. They were short, and I wanted to go deeper in this subject matter.”
paras.zh: 电影制片人还在两部短片中探讨了父女主题。 “我觉得这就像一幅三联画，”阿里斯蒂杜告诉《好莱坞报道》。 “我的第一部短片《塞墨勒》是在 2015 年拍摄的，它也是一个父女故事，也是我第一次开始探索这个主题。然后我拍摄了第二部短片《咏叹调》，其中又出现了父女的动态，但还有一个年长的女儿——她才十几岁。它们很短，我想更深入地探讨这个主题。”

paras.en: Hold Onto Me allowed her to do so in feature form, but she wanted it to be surprising and different from other films about similar familial relationships. “I wanted to use the archetypical relationship of father and daughter within a love story,” she explains. “It’s kind of a love story. It’s about two people who don’t know how to be together. They are sort of strangers in the beginning. They meet, then slowly come together, and they end up accepting each other or even loving each other in their own way. And when you set this up within the framework of a father, daughter and their family, it creates a different energy.”
paras.zh: 《抱紧我》让她能够以故事片的形式做到这一点，但她希望它能令人惊讶，并与其他讲述类似家庭关系的电影有所不同。 “我想在爱情故事中使用典型的父女关系，”她解释道。 “这是一个爱情故事。讲述的是两个不知道如何在一起的人。他们一开始有点陌生。他们相遇，然后慢慢走到一起，最终以自己的方式接受对方，甚至彼此相爱。当你把这一切放在父亲、女儿和他们的家庭的框架内时，就会产生一种不同的能量。”

paras.en: That is driven by societal expectations we have for family members. “When someone is your family, you are expected to love them, or you have more expectations than from just any stranger,” Aristidou highlights. “However, they are strangers. They have never really met or had any shared experiences. So this is the first time they are reconnecting, and I wanted to explore this.”
paras.zh: 这是由我们对家庭成员的社会期望推动的。 “当某人是你的家人时，你应该爱他们，或者说你比任何陌生人都有更多的期望，”阿里斯蒂杜强调说。 “然而，他们是陌生人。他们从未真正见过面，也没有任何共同的经历。所以这是他们第一次重新建立联系，我想探索这一点。”

paras.en: The characters and story of Hold Onto Me keep developing as the movie unfolds, and that is by design. “On a first feature, it’s very easy to get very obsessed with what you want to do, so I was very tough on myself,” Aristidou tells THR. “When it comes to narrative structure and characters, I like to move the story forward in every scene. When I was writing, I was really thinking about that.”
paras.zh: 《抱紧我》的角色和故事随着电影的展开而不断发展，这是设计使然。 “在第一部作品中，很容易对自己想做的事情非常着迷，所以我对自己非常严格，”阿里斯蒂杜告诉《好莱坞报道》。 “当谈到叙事结构和人物时，我喜欢在每个场景中推动故事向前发展。当我写作时，我真的在思考这一点。”

paras.en: One key reason that the filmmaker has returned to father-daughter stories lies in her own life experience. “It’s very personal in many ways,” she shares. “My parents divorced when I was very young, and I was not really growing up with my dad. He wasn’t entirely gone like this character, but he was not that present. And he’s not a criminal but a writer. It was only when I turned 12 or 13 that we started having more of a relationship. And when I was 15, 16, we really bonded. We reached a point where we started talking about everything and we really forgave each other. We reconnected, and there was really an understanding and acceptance.”
paras.zh: 电影制片人回归父女故事的一个重要原因在于她自己的生活经历。 “这在很多方面都是非常个人化的，”她分享道。 “我的父母在我很小的时候就离婚了，我并没有真正和父亲一起长大。他并没有像这个角色那样完全消失，但他也没有那么在场。而且他不是一个罪犯，而是一个作家。直到我 12 岁或 13 岁的时候，我们才开始有了更多的关系。当我 15 岁、16 岁的时候，我们真正建立了联系。我们开始谈论一切，我们真的原谅了彼此。我们重新建立了联系，真的有一种感情。”理解和接受。”

paras.en: The film’s setting is also personal. Hold Onto Me was shot in Cyprus, and for the writer-director, it was particularly important to film near the sea. “I grew up near the sea, so there are references that are very personal,” Aristidou tells THR. “My dad used to have a small boat when I was a kid. I also always used to hang out with older kids because I had an older friend who was my best friend. There is a lot of truth in the film.”
paras.zh: 影片的设定也很个人化。 《抱紧我》是在塞浦路斯拍摄的，对于编剧兼导演来说，在海边拍摄尤为重要。 “我在海边长大，所以有些参考资料非常个人化，”阿里斯蒂杜告诉《好莱坞报道》。 “当我还是个孩子的时候，我爸爸曾经有一艘小船。我也经常和大一点的孩子一起出去玩，因为我有一个年长的朋友，他是我最好的朋友。电影中有很多真相。”

paras.en: The chemistry between Iris and Aris in the film is palpable To ensure the right fit, casting took a lot of time. “We were shooting in July. Around April, I decided I was going to work with Christos,” the director recalls. She wanted to see him interact with different kids, most of them in Athens. The actor then went to Cyprus to meet the girl who ended up making the cut. “I saw Christos with Maria, and they felt family in a strange way,” Aristidou tells THR. “They phsically have things in common and look a bit like family. But Maria had zero experience. She had never done anything [in acting]. But I felt that there was something with them.”
paras.zh: 影片中艾里斯和阿里斯之间的化学反应是显而易见的。为了确保合适，选角花了很多时间。 “我们是在七月份拍摄的。四月份左右，我决定要和克里斯托一起工作，”导演回忆道。她想看到他与不同的孩子互动，其中大多数在雅典。然后这位演员前往塞浦路斯会见了最终晋级的女孩。 “我看到克里斯托和玛丽亚在一起，他们以一种奇怪的方式感受到了家人的感觉，”阿里斯蒂杜告诉《好莱坞报道》。 “他们在外表上有共同点，看起来有点像一家人。但玛丽亚的经验为零。她从来没有做过任何事情。但我觉得他们有一些东西。”

paras.en: With the big casting decisions made, she was hoping to rehearse with the two leads, but that didn’t work out. “Christos was shooting something. And then, he got COVID, so he only arrived a day before the shoot,” she recalls. “We only read the script once, and then I just started shooting with both of them. So I just threw Maria into the wild with him. But I think it worked out perfectly because they didn’t know each other really – just like their characters.”
paras.zh: 在做出重大选角决定后，她希望与两位主演一起排练，但这并没有成功。 “克里斯托正在拍摄一些东西。然后，他感染了新冠病毒，所以他在拍摄前一天才到达，”她回忆道。 “我们只读了一遍剧本，然后我就开始和他们一起拍摄。所以我就把玛丽亚和他一起扔到了野外。但我认为效果很完美，因为他们彼此并不真正了解——就像他们的角色一样。”

paras.en: The Oscar submission was, of course, special for the writer-director feel, especially since it’s the first for Cyprus. “It’s a big honor,” Aristidou shares. “I suddenly felt very responsible for my whole country. But in many ways, this film and I are carving this path for Cyprus. There was no film from Cyprus in Sundance before, and then we won an audience award. And then the Oscars. I guess it’s a new thing for everyone here and for me. So I’m learning a lot in the process. I know we’re a bit of the underdogs, but I’m trying to enjoy the ride.”
paras.zh: 当然，对于编剧兼导演的感觉来说，提交奥斯卡奖是很特别的，特别是因为这是塞浦路斯的第一次。 “这是一项巨大的荣誉，”阿里斯蒂杜分享道。 “我突然感到对我的整个国家非常有责任。但从很多方面来说，这部电影和我正在为塞浦路斯开辟这条道路。以前在圣丹斯电影节上没有塞浦路斯的电影，然后我们赢得了观众奖。然后是奥斯卡奖。我想这对这里的每个人和我来说都是新事物。所以我在这个过程中学到了很多东西。我知道我们有点失败，但我正在努力享受这段旅程。”

paras.en: So, what’s next for the filmmaker? “I really love this dynamic of strangers coming together and realizing how similar they are or bonding,” Aristidou says. “I don’t think I would do a father-daughter film again. But there’s something about this narrative arc that I really love. Actually, I’m trying to work on a TV show, which is a crime, spy thriller. But, let’s see. I’m working on a couple of things, and I’m reading a lot of scripts because my agents in the U.S. are sending a lot of scripts to read. So I’m also open to directing something I haven’t written.”
paras.zh: 那么，电影制片人的下一步是什么？ “我真的很喜欢这种陌生人聚集在一起并意识到他们有多么相似或联系的动态，”阿里斯蒂杜说。 “我不认为我会再拍一部父女电影。但我真的很喜欢这种叙事弧线。实际上，我正在尝试制作一部电视节目，这是一部犯罪、间谍惊悚片。但是，让我们看看。我正在做几件事，我正在阅读很多剧本，因为我在美国的经纪人正在发送很多剧本供阅读。所以我也愿意执导一些我还没有写过的东西。”

articles.title: Investors brace for lower Anthropic valuation, calling $1.5 trillion a 'stretch'

paras.en: Following tech's selloff on Wall Street this week, some investors are lowering their expectations for Anthropic.
paras.zh: 继本周华尔街科技股遭遇抛售后，一些投资者降低了对 Anthropic 的预期。

paras.en: The artificial intelligence company had been looking toward a $2 trillion valuation in its IPO up until recently, but stakeholders told CNBC that even $1.5 trillion is now in doubt, with one investor calling that number a "stretch."
paras.zh: 直到最近，这家人工智能公司一直在寻求 2 万亿美元的 IPO 估值，但利益相关者告诉 CNBC，现在甚至连 1.5 万亿美元都存在疑问，一位投资者称这个数字“有些夸张”。

paras.en: The change in sentiment comes alongside growing concerns about the outsized spending by AI companies and a sharp post-midterm slump in the market. The Nasdaq plummeted more than 5% on Thursday, its steepest drop in 19 months, reflecting fears that Democrats' newfound power in Washington, D.C., and a nationwide rebuke of AI will lead to a slowdown in the buildout of data centers.
paras.zh: 这种情绪的变化伴随着人们对人工智能公司巨额支出和市场中期后急剧下滑的日益担忧。纳斯达克指数周四暴跌超过 5%，创 19 个月来最大跌幅，反映出人们担心民主党在华盛顿特区的新权力以及全国范围内对人工智能的谴责将导致数据中心建设放缓。

paras.en: Bearishness on the AI trade was on the rise before the election. The Nasdaq suffered its worst month in October since March 2025, led by declines in chipmakers and neoclouds.
paras.zh: 大选前，对人工智能行业的悲观情绪有所上升。纳斯达克指数在 10 月份遭遇了自 2025 年 3 月以来最糟糕的一个月，其中芯片制造商和 Neoclouds 的跌幅最大。

paras.en: Anthropic is set to list on the Nasdaq, under the ticker ANT, and is gearing up for an expected debut in a matter of weeks. Last month, Anthropic was reportedly seeking a valuation as high as $2 trillion. As of May, the company was privately valued at $965 billion.
paras.zh: Anthropic 将于纳斯达克上市，股票代码为 ANT，并准备在几周内首次亮相。据报道，上个月，Anthropic 寻求高达 2 万亿美元的估值。截至 5 月，该公司的私下估值为 9,650 亿美元。

paras.en: With the latest market turmoil, one investor said $1 trillion to $1.25 trillion is a more likely valuation target, although that could change with market conditions. The investors asked not to be named because they're not authorized to speak about the matter.
paras.zh: 一位投资者表示，鉴于最近的市场动荡，1 万亿美元至 1.25 万亿美元是更有可能的估值目标，尽管这可能会随着市场状况而变化。投资者要求匿名，因为他们无权谈论此事。

paras.en: Gil Luria, an analyst at D.A. Davidson, told CNBC that, "Investors will expect the IPO to be priced at least at the low end of previous expectations."
paras.zh: Gil Luria，D.A. 分析师戴维森向 CNBC 表示，“投资者预计 IPO 定价至少将处于之前预期的低端。”

paras.en: "The market really needs this IPO to go well and the bankers on the deal surely understand that," Luria said. "The best way to set Anthropic up for success is to price the deal well."
paras.zh: 卢里亚表示：“市场确实需要这次 IPO 顺利进行，参与该交易的银行家们肯定明白这一点。” “让 Anthropic 取得成功的最好方法就是为交易定价合理。”

paras.en: The company is expected to kick off its roadshow next week.
paras.zh: 该公司预计将于下周开始路演。

articles.title: Sen. Chris Murphy released from hospital after stroke, will miss votes for 'several weeks' as he rehabs

paras.en: Connecticut Democratic Sen. Chris Murphy said Friday he had been released from a hospital after suffering a stroke last weekend.
paras.zh: 康涅狄格州民主党参议员克里斯·墨菲周五表示，他在上周末中风后已出院。

paras.en: Murphy, 53, said he will be in a rehabilitation center for the next "several weeks," meaning he will miss votes in the Senate when Congress returns on Monday.
paras.zh: 53 岁的墨菲表示，他将在接下来的“几周”里住在康复中心，这意味着他将错过周一国会返回时在参议院的投票。

paras.en: "The doctors are very encouraged by the progress I've made so far," he said in a statement.
paras.zh: 他在一份声明中说：“医生们对我迄今为止所取得的进展感到非常鼓舞。”

paras.en: "In order to take my recovery seriously and get back to work on the quickest timeline possible, I will be spending several weeks at a rehabilitation center after being discharged from the hospital today," said Murphy, who has been discussed as a possible presidential candidate in 2028.
paras.zh: 墨菲表示：“为了认真对待我的康复并尽快恢复工作，我今天出院后将在康复中心度过几周的时间。”墨菲曾被讨论可能成为 2028 年总统候选人。

paras.en: Dr. Jose Suarez, chief of Neurosciences Critical Care at The Johns Hopkins Hospital, in a statement released by Murphy's office, said, "Senator Murphy experienced a small hemorrhagic stroke."
paras.zh: 约翰·霍普金斯医院神经科学重症监护主任何塞·苏亚雷斯博士在墨菲办公室发布的一份声明中表示，“墨菲参议员经历了一次轻微的出血性中风。”

paras.en: "He has shown tremendous progress, and at the current rate of improvement, we expect that he will make a full recovery following rehabilitation," Suarez said.
paras.zh: 苏亚雷斯说：“他已经取得了巨大的进步，按照目前的改善速度，我们预计他在康复后将完全康复。”

paras.en: Murphy had been in the hospital since having a stroke at his son's hockey game.
paras.zh: 墨菲在儿子的曲棍球比赛中中风后一直住院。

paras.en: "Last Saturday afternoon, I felt something was not right with my body and called 9-1-1 out of an abundance of caution, and I'm glad I did," Murphy said in his statement. "I was diagnosed with a small bleed in the thalamus region of my brain."
paras.zh: 墨菲在声明中说：“上周六下午，我感觉自己的身体有些不对劲，出于谨慎而拨打了 9-1-1，我很高兴我这么做了。” “我被诊断出大脑丘脑区域有小出血。”

paras.en: The senator said he was grateful "for the outpouring of support my family and I have received over the last few days."
paras.zh: 这位参议员表示，他非常感谢“我和我的家人在过去几天里得到的大量支持”。

paras.en: "This has been a scary experience for me and my family, and I appreciate the continued respect for our privacy," Murphy said. "As I'm working towards a full recovery, I am staying engaged with my team and colleagues remotely, and my staff continues to carry out our legislative priorities, serve constituents, and ensure the work of my office continues uninterrupted."
paras.zh: 墨菲说：“这对我和我的家人来说是一次可怕的经历，我感谢大家对我们隐私的持续尊重。” “在我努力全面康复的过程中，我与我的团队和同事保持远程联系，我的工作人员继续执行我们的立法优先事项，为选民服务，并确保我办公室的工作继续不间断。”

paras.en: Murphy's stroke came three days before Democratic candidates, in a stunning election result, won more than enough races to flip the Senate and House of Representatives from Republican majority control in January.
paras.zh: 墨菲中风发生的三天前，民主党候选人以惊人的选举结果赢得了足够多的选举，从而在一月份将参议院和众议院从共和党的多数控制权手中夺走。

paras.en: Murphy, who was not up for reelection this year, before the election had campaigned for Democratic candidates around the country, most recently in Michigan, Minnesota and Florida. He had been scheduled to campaign in New Hampshire on Sunday with Rep. Chris Pappas, who on Tuesday won election to the Senate.
paras.zh: 墨菲今年没有竞选连任，但在选举前曾在全国各地为民主党候选人竞选，最近在密歇根州、明尼苏达州和佛罗里达州。他原定于周日与众议员克里斯·帕帕斯一起在新罕布什尔州竞选，后者于周二赢得了参议院选举。

articles.title: OpenAI will keep investing in AI data centers despite election results, CFO tells CNBC

paras.en: OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar on Friday said the company will continue to invest in artificial intelligence infrastructure, even after voters strongly opposed data centers during Tuesday's midterm elections.
paras.zh: OpenAI 首席财务官 Sarah Friar 周五表示，即使选民在周二中期选举期间强烈反对数据中心，该公司仍将继续投资人工智能基础设施。

paras.en: "When I think about the midterms, I need to keep thinking about how do we keep investing to meet that customer demand," Friar told CNBC's Sara Eisen in an interview at the Citi TMT Leadership Summit in Pebble Beach, California. "It starts early with having built relationships with all of the hyperscalers, and it will continue to mean that we raise capital."
paras.zh: “当我考虑中期选举时，我需要不断思考我们如何继续投资来满足客户需求，”弗莱尔在加利福尼亚州圆石滩举行的花旗 TMT 领导力峰会上接受 CNBC 记者萨拉·艾森 (Sara Eisen) 采访时说道。 “一开始就与所有超大规模企业建立了关系，这将继续意味着我们筹集资金。”

paras.en: Out of 41 local ballot measures across 10 states, voters backed restrictions or rejected pro-development measures in all but one, according to an analysis by Ballotpedia and additional results gathered by CNBC on Wednesday. Opposition to the facilities mounted swiftly over the summer as Americans grew worried about their potential to harm the environment, raise utility bills and contribute to job loss.
paras.zh: 根据 Ballotpedia 的分析以及 CNBC 周三收集的其他结果，在 10 个州的 41 项地方投票措施中，除了一项外，选民都支持限制措施或拒绝有利于发展的措施。今年夏天，随着美国人越来越担心这些设施可能会损害环境、提高水电费并导致失业，对这些设施的反对迅速增多。

paras.en: Investors have turned skeptical on the AI trade of late due to a combination of higher borrowing costs, concerns about soaring debt and public backlash toward the industry. The Nasdaq on Thursday suffered its steepest drop in 19 months, led by a plunge in shares of the chipmakers and neocloud companies most closely tied to the AI buildout. The stocks rebounded some on Friday.
paras.zh: 由于借贷成本上升、债务飙升的担忧以及公众对该行业的强烈反对，投资者最近对人工智能行业持怀疑态度。周四，纳斯达克指数遭遇 19 个月以来的最大跌幅，其中与人工智能发展关系最密切的芯片制造商和 Neocloud 公司股价暴跌。周五股市有所反弹。

paras.en: OpenAI depends on data centers to train its AI models and serve customers, and Friar said she doesn't think the election results dramatically changed anything for the company. On Thursday, OpenAI published a policy blueprint and a series of commitments that it pledged to apply to company-owned and -operated data centers in the future.
paras.zh: OpenAI 依靠数据中心来训练其人工智能模型并为客户提供服务，Friar 表示，她认为选举结果不会给公司带来任何重大改变。周四，OpenAI 发布了一份政策蓝图和一系列承诺，承诺未来将适用于公司拥有和运营的数据中心。

paras.en: "If the midterm means more focus on data centers and communities, we're going to keep doing the work to get into those communities and to build trust with them," Friar said.
paras.zh: “如果中期意味着更多地关注数据中心和社区，我们将继续努力进入这些社区并与他们建立信任，”弗里尔说。

paras.en: OpenAI confidentially filed its prospectus with the Securities and Exchange Commission in June, and Friar said Friday that the company would continue to look into a 2027 debut. Anthropic, OpenAI's chief rival, is trying to go public first, with an aim to hit the Nasdaq in mid-November.
paras.zh: OpenAI 于 6 月向美国证券交易委员会秘密提交了招股说明书，Friar 周五表示，该公司将继续考虑 2027 年上市。 OpenAI 的主要竞争对手 Anthropic 正试图首先上市，目标是在 11 月中旬登陆纳斯达克。

paras.en: Anthropic's revenue in the first nine months of the year jumped roughly 1,200% to $33.2 billion, according to its prospectus. The company said it has entered into purchase commitments and lease agreements with an aggregate committed spend of about $895.4 billion, "substantially all of which is related to compute and infrastructure."
paras.zh: 根据其招股说明书，Anthropic 今年前 9 个月的收入增长了约 1,200%，达到 332 亿美元。该公司表示，已签订采购承诺和租赁协议，承诺支出总额约为 8954 亿美元，“基本上所有支出都与计算和基础设施有关”。

paras.en: OpenAI is in talks to raise funding at a $1.25 billion pre-money valuation, Friar said Friday. She said "a good CFO always raises money when she can" and that the round is ongoing.
paras.zh: Friar 周五表示，OpenAI 正在就融资前估值 12.5 亿美元进行谈判。她表示，“优秀的首席财务官总是会在可能的情况下筹集资金”，并且该轮融资正在进行中。

paras.en: The company has closed an initial $11 billion portion of that funding round, CNBC confirmed on Friday, and it could raise up to an additional $9 billion in the coming weeks. Bloomberg was first to report the $11 billion portion.
paras.zh: CNBC 周五证实，该公司已完成该轮融资的初始 110 亿美元部分，并可能在未来几周内额外筹集 90 亿美元。彭博社最先报道了这 110 亿美元的部分。

paras.en: "The demand for AI is real," Friar said. "I don't think anyone's arguing with that, or if they are, I think it's a losing argument."
paras.zh: “对人工智能的需求是真实的，”弗里尔说。 “我认为没有人对此争论，或者即使有人争论，我认为这是一场失败的争论。”

paras.en: WATCH: Watch CNBC’s full interview with OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar
paras.zh: 观看：观看 CNBC 对 OpenAI 首席财务官 Sarah Friar 的完整采访

articles.title: 2026 election results show widespread opposition to AI data centers

paras.en: On Tuesday the artificial intelligence boom was on the ballot 41 times in 10 states. By Wednesday, with most results in, voters had sided with it just once.
paras.zh: 周二，人工智能热潮在10个州进行了41次投票。到周三，以大多数结果，选民只支持过一次。

paras.en: The questions, many of them in Ohio, spanned moratoriums, attempted rezonings and advisory votes for local officials. Another six preceded them this year; a further three are yet to come. In many cases, the margins were staggering. In Wells, Me., more than 80 percent of voters approved a retroactive 180-day moratorium on data center development.
paras.zh: 这些问题（其中许多是在俄亥俄州）涉及暂停、尝试重新分区和对当地官员进行咨询投票等问题。今年在他们之前还有另外六家；另外三个尚未到来。在许多情况下，利润是惊人的。在缅因州威尔斯，超过 80% 的选民批准了追溯性 180 天的数据中心开发暂停计划。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: The lone win came in Harwood, N.D., where voters, by about three to one, rejected a proposal requiring extra review of industrial projects, data centers included. A $3-billion data center called Polaris Forge 2 is already under construction near the city.
paras.zh: 唯一的胜利来自北达科他州哈伍德，那里的选民以大约三比一的比例否决了一项要求对包括数据中心在内的工业项目进行额外审查的提案。一个耗资 30 亿美元、名为 Polaris Forge 2 的数据中心已经在该市附近建设。

paras.en: The skepticism climbed the ballot, too. Governors-elect Gina Hinojosa in Texas, Keisha Lance Bottoms in Georgia, and Amy Acton in Ohio—all Democrats—made data center regulation a key part of their campaigns. Texas is the big one, accounting for about a quarter of the U.S. data center capacity in the works, according to one recent analysis, and tighter rules there could slow the national build-out.
paras.zh: 怀疑论也不断上升。德克萨斯州当选州长吉娜·伊诺霍萨、佐治亚州当选州长凯莎·兰斯·博顿斯和俄亥俄州当选州长艾米·阿克顿——都是民主党人——将数据中心监管作为其竞选活动的关键部分。根据最近的一项分析，德克萨斯州是其中最大的一个，约占美国在建数据中心容量的四分之一，那里更严格的规则可能会减缓全国的建设速度。

paras.en: In the short term, investors got jittery on Wednesday, sending AI data center stocks tumbling. In the long term, the results lend weight to a prediction from OpenAI’s chief global affairs officer, Chris Lehane, that AI will be the defining issue of the 2028 presidential election.
paras.zh: 短期来看，投资者周三感到紧张，导致人工智能数据中心股票暴跌。从长远来看，这些结果印证了 OpenAI 首席全球事务官 Chris Lehane 的预测，即人工智能将成为 2028 年总统选举的决定性问题。

paras.en: We analyzed the initiatives, referrals and advisory questions on the ballot this year to understand what they say about where people do—and overwhelmingly don’t—want the U.S. AI build-out to happen. The full list is below.
paras.zh: 我们分析了今年投票中的倡议、推荐和咨询问题，以了解他们对人们希望（以及绝大多数不希望）美国人工智能发展的看法。完整列表如下。

articles.title: This brain change can make foxes act like pet dogs

paras.en: In the 1950s Russian researchers embarked on an ambitious experiment: they wanted to see if foxes could be selectively bred to become domesticated, doglike animals, complete with wagging tails and affectionate natures. Now, close to 70 years into this long-running breeding project, scientists have pinpointed a specific type of brain cell linked with changes in the foxes’ behavior.
paras.zh: 20 世纪 50 年代，俄罗斯研究人员开始了一项雄心勃勃的实验：他们想看看是否可以选择性地培育狐狸，使其成为家养的、像狗一样的动物，拥有摇尾巴和深情的本性。现在，这个长期育种项目已经进行了近 70 年，科学家们已经查明了与狐狸行为变化有关的特定类型的脑细胞。

paras.en: Specifically, the scientists found that a receptor protein in the ventromedial hypothalamus may form the basis for the foxes’ social behavior. This brain area is known to be involved in fear and defense responses and aggression.
paras.zh: 具体来说，科学家们发现下丘脑腹内侧的受体蛋白可能构成狐狸社会行为的基础。众所周知，这个大脑区域与恐惧、防御反应和攻击性有关。

paras.en: The research “gets to the heart of brain programming” in animals, says Cheryl Rosenfeld, a neuroscientist at the University of Missouri, who was not involved in the study.
paras.zh: 未参与这项研究的密苏里大学神经科学家谢丽尔·罗森菲尔德 (Cheryl Rosenfeld) 表示，这项研究“触及了动物大脑编程的核心”。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: “If this can happen in foxes, it could also mean that, by altering the hormone profile or the receptor profile in us and even other species, it could change our patterns of behavior and last a lifetime,” Rosenfeld says.
paras.zh: 罗森菲尔德说：“如果这种情况发生在狐狸身上，这也可能意味着，通过改变我们甚至其他物种的激素分布或受体分布，它可能会改变我们的行为模式并持续一生。”

paras.en: Eirene Markenscoff-Papadimitriou is the study’s senior author and a molecular biologist at Cornell University. She calls herself an “accidental fox scientist.” Markenscoff-Papadimitriou primarily studies neuroscience in mice, but in 2023 she started looking into the Domesticated Silver Fox Experiment. The project, started in 1959 by a group of Russian researchers, selectively bred the tamest silver foxes.
paras.zh: Eirene Markenscoff-Papadimitriou 是该研究的资深作者，也是康奈尔大学的分子生物学家。她称自己为“偶然的狐狸科学家”。 Markenscoff-Papadimitriou 主要研究小鼠神经科学，但在 2023 年，她开始研究驯养银狐实验。该项目由一群俄罗斯研究人员于 1959 年启动，有选择地培育最温顺的银狐。

paras.en: After just a few generations, the foxes began to look and act more domesticated, with floppy ears, curly tails and an eagerness for human attention and love. The experiment is still going and is a model of the power of selective breeding. Markenscoff-Papadimitriou’s team wanted to know what was happening to the foxes’ brains.
paras.zh: 仅仅几代之后，狐狸的外表和行为就开始变得更加驯化，耳朵耷拉着，尾巴卷曲，渴望人类的关注和爱。该实验仍在进行中，是选择性育种力量的典范。马肯斯科夫-帕帕迪米特里乌的团队想知道狐狸的大脑发生了什么。

paras.en: The team compared the brains of three categories of farm-bred foxes—tame, aggressive and wild—with a special focus on the ventromedial hypothalamus, a brain region that’s been linked to aggressive behaviors in mice. In previous studies, scientists had found that when a receptor protein called estrogen receptor alpha was activated, the mice were more aggressive. In the new study, published on November 2 in Current Biology, Markenscoff-Papadimitriou and her team found that the tame foxes had notably fewer of the estrogen receptor alpha neurons than the aggressive or conventional foxes.
paras.zh: 研究小组比较了三类农场饲养的狐狸（驯服的、攻击性的和野生的）的大脑，特别关注下丘脑腹内侧区，该区域与小鼠的攻击性行为有关。在之前的研究中，科学家们发现，当一种称为雌激素受体α的受体蛋白被激活时，小鼠会更具攻击性。在 11 月 2 日发表在《当代生物学》杂志上的这项新研究中，Markenscoff-Papadimitriou 和她的团队发现，驯服的狐狸的雌激素受体 α 神经元明显少于攻击性或传统狐狸。

paras.en: Markenscoff-Papadimitriou says this experiment made her a “convert” to researching other animals beyond mice.
paras.zh: 马肯斯科夫-帕帕迪米特里乌说，这个实验让她“转变”为研究小鼠以外的其他动物。

paras.en: “This showed me that we should be ambitious and follow our curiosity and that the tools that have been developed for just one species can be applied to others,” she says.
paras.zh: “这告诉我，我们应该雄心勃勃并追随我们的好奇心，并且仅为一个物种开发的工具可以应用于其他物种，”她说。

paras.en: Both Markenscoff-Papadimitriou and Rosenfeld say they’re curious if the same neuron determines social behavior in other animals, such as dogs and wolves. Now that the researchers know how the tame foxes’ brains are different from their more aggressive peers, they’re asking why and how that happens.
paras.zh: 马肯斯科夫-帕帕迪米特里乌和罗森菲尔德都表示，他们很好奇是否同一个神经元决定了其他动物（例如狗和狼）的社会行为。现在研究人员知道温顺的狐狸的大脑与更具攻击性的同类有何不同，他们正在询问为什么会发生这种情况以及如何发生。

paras.en: “How are the genetic differences of these different foxes leading to differences in the cell type composition of this brain region throughout development?” Markenscoff-Papadimitriou says. “It’s a puzzle to solve, but now we know what we need to solve.”
paras.zh: “这些不同狐狸的遗传差异如何导致该大脑区域在整个发育过程中细胞类型组成的差异？”马肯斯科夫-帕帕迪米特里乌说。 “这是一个需要解决的难题，但现在我们知道我们需要解决什么。”

articles.title: Math Puzzle: Secret formula

paras.en: I’m going to pick a secret polynomial with nonnegative whole number coefficients. That is, a formula that looks like “8x3 + 17x + 9” or “x225 + 99x222 + x101 + 2” or “7x234” or something similar. Note that the formula won’t contain any minus signs.
paras.zh: 我将选择一个具有非负整数系数的秘密多项式。也就是说，公式看起来像“8x3 + 17x + 9”或“x225 + 99x222 + x101 + 2”或“7x234”或类似的东西。请注意，公式不会包含任何减号。

paras.en: You don’t know how many terms it contains or what the exponents or coefficients are except that they’re nonnegative whole numbers. You can query my polynomial, though. Give me a nonnegative whole number value for x, and I will plug it into my formula and tell you the result. How can you fully deduce the formula using only two queries? You may base your second query off of the result of the first.
paras.zh: 您不知道它包含多少项，也不知道指数或系数是什么，只是它们是非负整数。不过，您可以查询我的多项式。给我一个 x 的非负整数值，我会将其代入公式并告诉您结果。如何仅使用两个查询就完全推导出公式？您可以根据第一个查询的结果来进行第二个查询。

paras.en: Suppose I told you that every coefficient in my formula is less than 10. If you queried x = 10, what would the output look like? Of course, you don’t know how large the coefficients in my formula are. Is there a simple way to get an upper bound on that, though?
paras.zh: 假设我告诉你公式中的每个系数都小于 10。如果你查询 x = 10，输出会是什么样子？当然，你不知道我公式中的系数有多大。有没有一种简单的方法可以得到上限呢？

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: First query with x = 1. This will give you the sum of the coefficients, which we’ll call S. Because S is the sum of nonnegative coefficients, we know that no single coefficient exceeds S. For the second query, set x to the smallest power of 10 that is greater than S. That is, if S is a one-digit number, then the second query will be x = 10; if S is a two-digit number, then the second query will be x = 100; if S is a three-digit number, then x = 1,000, and so forth.
paras.zh: 第一个查询 x = 1。这将给出系数之和，我们将其称为 S。因为 S 是非负系数之和，所以我们知道没有单个系数超过 S。对于第二个查询，将 x 设置为大于 S 的 10 的最小幂。也就是说，如果 S 是一位数，则第二个查询将为 x = 10；如果S是两位数，那么第二次查询将是x = 100；如果 S 是三位数，则 x = 1,000，依此类推。

paras.en: For example, imagine my formula is 2x5 + x3 + 3x2 + 2. When x = 1, this yields S = 8. This comes from 2 + 0 + 1 + 3 + 0 + 2 = 8, where the zeroes represent missing exponents—there’s no x4 term or x term, so the corresponding coefficients are 0. Now if we query with x = 10, the result is 201,302, coming from 200,000 + 0 + 1,000 + 300 + 0 + 2. This result just lists the six coefficients in order, so it completely reveals the formula.
paras.zh: 例如，假设我的公式是 2x5 + x3 + 3x2 + 2。当 x = 1 时，得出 S = 8。这来自 2 + 0 + 1 + 3 + 0 + 2 = 8，其中零代表缺失的指数 - 没有 x4 项或 x 项，因此相应的系数为 0。现在，如果我们使用 x = 10 查询，结果是 201,302，来自200,000 + 0 + 1,000 + 300 + 0 + 2。这个结果只是按顺序列出了六个系数，因此完全揭示了公式。

paras.en: Setting x = 10 can result in ambiguity if any of the coefficients are 10 or greater, however. For example, if S = 27, then the second query would be x = 100, and the result will list the coefficients in order again, only this time each coefficient will be represented by two digits of the result instead of one. For example, plugging in x = 100 to 21x5 + x3 + 3x2 + 2 gives 210001030002.
paras.zh: 然而，如果任何系数为 10 或更大，则设置 x = 10 可能会导致歧义。例如，如果S = 27，则第二次查询将为x = 100，结果将再次按顺序列出系数，只是这次每个系数将由结果的两位数而不是一位来表示。例如，将 x = 100 代入 21x5 + x3 + 3x2 + 2 得到 210001030002。

paras.en: A slick alternative solution is to make the second query x = S + 1 and then write the result in base S + 1. Figuring out why this works is a bonus exercise.
paras.zh: 一个灵活的替代解决方案是使第二个查询 x = S + 1，然后将结果写入基数 S + 1。弄清楚为什么这样做是一个额外的练习。

paras.en: Curiously, if your queries can be any number, then you can, in principle, fully determine the formula with a single query: x = π. Proving this requires more advanced math. The number π is transcendental, which, among other things, implies that if you plug it into a polynomial with whole number coefficients, it will always give a unique output. There is no ambiguity like there is for many other numbers.
paras.zh: 奇怪的是，如果您的查询可以是任意数字，那么原则上您可以通过单个查询完全确定公式：x = π。证明这一点需要更高级的数学。数字 π 是超越数，这意味着如果将其代入具有整数系数的多项式，它将始终给出唯一的输出。没有像许多其他数字那样含糊不清。

paras.en: The result of setting x = π also bounds the size of the coefficients and the size of the exponents in the formula. For example, if you query x = π and the result is 54.44225..., then you know that all coefficients are between 0 and 55 (otherwise the result would have been larger), and you know that the formula cannot have any exponent greater than 3 because, if it did, then it would, at minimum, contain a π4 term, which equals 97.40909.... From one query, you learn that the polynomial’s coefficients sit between 0 and 55, and its exponents sit between 0 and 3. This narrows the answer to a large yet finite list of possibilities. You could in principle check each one and find which one yields 54.44225... to determine my formula.
paras.zh: 设置 x = π 的结果也限制了公式中系数的大小和指数的大小。例如，如果您查询 x = π 并且结果为 54.44225...，则您知道所有系数都在 0 到 55 之间（否则结果会更大），并且您知道该公式不能有任何大于 3 的指数，因为如果大于 3，那么它至少会包含一个 π4 项，等于 97.40909...从一个查询中，您了解到多项式的系数位于介于 0 到 55 之间，其指数介于 0 到 3 之间。这将答案缩小为一个大而有限的可能性列表。原则上你可以检查每一项并找出哪一项产生 54.44225... 以确定我的公式。

paras.en: We’d love to hear from you! E-mail us at games@sciam.com to share your experience. if you can't see the puzzle answer reveal above, visit this page in a web browser.
paras.zh: 我们很乐意听取您的意见！请发送电子邮件至 games@sciam.com 与我们分享您的经验。如果您看不到上面显示的谜题答案，请在网络浏览器中访问此页面。

articles.title: Newborn survival improves when families receive financial support
articles.author: Aimee Cunningham

paras.en: Extra financial support during pregnancy and after birth can help more babies thrive in their earliest days.
paras.zh: 怀孕期间和产后的额外经济支持可以帮助更多的婴儿在最初的日子里茁壮成长。

paras.en: The Rx Kids program in Flint, Mich., launched in January 2024, provides extra cash to pregnant residents and their infants, unconditionally. Researchers compared neonatal deaths — those in the first four weeks of life — in 2025 with those in 2021 through 2024 in Flint. The city’s neonatal mortality rate dropped from 10 deaths per 1,000 live births to 5 deaths per 1,000 live births, researchers report November 2 in JAMA Pediatrics. The early neonatal mortality rate, covering deaths in the first week of life, fell from 8 per 1,000 to 2. For the rest of Michigan, rates were stable over the study’s time period.
paras.zh: 密歇根州弗林特市的 Rx Kids 计划于 2024 年 1 月启动，无条件为怀孕居民及其婴儿提供额外现金。研究人员将弗林特 2025 年和 2021 年至 2024 年的新生儿死亡率（出生后前 4 周内的死亡率）进行了比较。研究人员 11 月 2 日在《美国医学会儿科杂志》上发表报告称，该市新生儿死亡率从每 1,000 名活产儿 10 人死亡降至每 1,000 名活产儿 5 人死亡。早期新生儿死亡率（涵盖生命第一周内的死亡）从千分之八降至千分之二。在密歇根州其他地区，死亡率在研究期间保持稳定。

paras.en: “As a pediatrician, there is no outcome more important than babies surviving,” says Mona Hanna of the Michigan State University College of Human Medicine in Flint, who is also the founder and director of Rx Kids. “These early findings suggest that something as simple as providing families with financial support during pregnancy and infancy may help save babies’ lives.”
paras.zh: “作为一名儿科医生，没有比婴儿存活下来更重要的结果了，”位于弗林特的密歇根州立大学人类医学学院的莫娜·汉纳 (Mona Hanna) 说道，她也是 Rx Kids 的创始人兼董事。 “这些早期发现表明，像在怀孕和婴儿期为家庭提供经济支持这样简单的事情可能有助于挽救婴儿的生命。”

paras.en: Income tends to drop and expenses rise in the months before and after a birth, making the perinatal period especially difficult financially for many families. Economic precarity can expose moms and babies to health harms. For example, housing instability and homelessness is associated with preterm birth and low birth weight.
paras.zh: 产前和产后几个月的收入往往会下降，支出会增加，这使得围产期对许多家庭来说在经济上尤其困难。经济不稳定会使妈妈和婴儿的健康受到损害。例如，住房不稳定和无家可归与早产和低出生体重有关。

paras.en: Backed by public and private funds, Rx Kids got started in Flint, a city with a high rate of child poverty that has been dealing with the public health fallout of lead contamination in the water distribution system. Nearly 100 percent of the community participates in the program. Flint families receive $1,500 once during pregnancy and $500 per month in the baby’s first year. Anyone who is a resident, at least 16 weeks pregnant or with a newborn up to six months old can enroll. Families have put the extra cash toward diapers, transportation, housing and safe places for their babies to sleep, Hanna says.
paras.zh: 在公共和私人资金的支持下，Rx Kids 在弗林特启动，这是一个儿童贫困率很高的城市，一直在应对供水系统铅污染对公共健康的影响。近 100% 的社区参与了该计划。弗林特家庭在怀孕期间可领取一次 1,500 美元，婴儿第一年每月可领取 500 美元。任何怀孕至少 16 周或新生儿不超过 6 个月的居民都可以报名。汉纳说，家庭将额外的现金用于购买尿布、交通、住房和婴儿安全的睡眠场所。

paras.en: “Every day, we hear from moms who tell us, ‘I can breathe’ or ‘A weight has been lifted off my shoulders.’ They tell us they feel less stressed, more hopeful, more supported and more loved,” Hanna says.
paras.zh: “每天，我们都会听到妈妈们告诉我们，‘我可以呼吸了’或‘我肩上的担子卸下了。’她们告诉我们，她们感到压力减轻了，更有希望了，得到了更多的支持，也得到了更多的爱，”汉纳说。

paras.en: The support has had a measurable health impact, with studies linking the program to more access to prenatal care, a decrease in the preterm birth rate and in low-weight births and fewer neonatal intensive care admissions.
paras.zh: 这项支持对健康产生了可衡量的影响，研究表明该计划与更多获得产前护理、减少早产率和低体重出生以及减少新生儿重症监护入院联系起来。

paras.en: Rx Kids has now expanded to dozens of communities in Michigan and Ohio.
paras.zh: Rx Kids 现已扩展到密歇根州和俄亥俄州的数十个社区。

articles.title: Food contains thousands of overlooked chemicals. This physicist is mapping them
articles.author: Anna Mattson

paras.en: This is a human-written story voiced by AI. Got feedback?
paras.zh: 这是一个由人工智能配音的人类书写的故事。有反馈吗？
