paras.en: Computational physicist Giulia Menichetti is looking for “dark matter” in our food. In addition to known macronutrients, vitamins and minerals, the things we eat contain a whole world of natural chemicals we have no idea about. And those chemicals may affect our health.
paras.zh: 计算物理学家 Giulia Menichetti 正在我们的食物中寻找“暗物质”。除了已知的大量营养素、维生素和矿物质之外，我们吃的东西还含有大量我们不知道的天然化学物质。这些化学物质可能会影响我们的健康。

paras.en: “They have the ability to interact, to bind to human proteins, to modulate our microbiome,” says Menichetti of Harvard Medical School. “We want to leverage this to talk more and more about the role of food and nutrition in human health.”
paras.zh: 哈佛医学院的梅尼凯蒂说：“它们具有相互作用、与人类蛋白质结合、调节我们的微生物组的能力。” “我们希望利用这一点越来越多地谈论食品和营养在人类健康中的作用。”

paras.en: Menichetti leads Foodome, a project to map our food’s full chemical complexity. Her team uses AI to mine scientific papers for every chemical compound that has ever been linked to a food. She singles out ones that haven’t been tracked by epidemiological studies — the “nutritional dark matter.” So far, her team has cataloged about 140,000 molecules.
paras.zh: Menichetti 领导 Foodome，这是一个绘制食物完整化学复杂性的项目。她的团队使用人工智能来挖掘科学论文，寻找与食物有关的每种化合物。她挑选出那些尚未被流行病学研究追踪的物质——“营养性暗物质”。到目前为止，她的团队已经对大约 140,000 个分子进行了编目。

paras.en: When one hears about chemicals in food, they might initially think of artificial additives. Her team addresses those, but she’s also interested in naturally occurring chemicals. Take garlic, for example. Foodome has cataloged almost 7,000 different molecules in raw garlic alone. Some of these compounds have been investigated for health effects, but some are entirely new.
paras.zh: 当人们听说食品中的化学物质时，他们可能首先想到人工添加剂。她的团队致力于解决这些问题，但她也对天然存在的化学物质感兴趣。以大蒜为例。 Foodome 已对生大蒜中近 7,000 种不同的分子进行了分类。其中一些化合物的健康影响已被研究，但有些化合物是全新的。

paras.en: Foodome is still mining the scientific literature for these molecules and building out databases. Eventually, Menichetti would like AI to be able to predict how all these food molecules interact together and in the human body.
paras.zh: Foodome 仍在挖掘这些分子的科学文献并建立数据库。最终，梅尼凯蒂希望人工智能能够预测所有这些食物分子如何在人体内相互作用。

paras.en: “There is a legacy of chemical complexity that comes from organisms that are all around us,” she says. “Food is part of that. It is actually our way to interact with our environment. We need to study it better.”
paras.zh: “我们周围的生物体留下了化学复杂性的遗产，”她说。 “食物是其中的一部分。它实际上是我们与环境互动的方式。我们需要更好地研究它。”

articles.title: Little Ice Age cooling in Europe may have raised the risk of rickets
articles.author: Freda Kreier

paras.en: England isn’t renowned for its weather. But just a few centuries ago, climate change–fueled conditions may have been so bad that they put children’s health at risk.
paras.zh: 英格兰并不以天气而闻名。但就在几个世纪前，气候变化引发的条件可能非常糟糕，以至于使儿童的健康面临风险。

paras.en: Calcium mineralization in the teeth and skeletons of people who lived in rural northern England suggests that children growing up during the height of the Little Ice Age routinely developed vitamin D deficiencies, researchers report November 5 in Frontiers in Environmental Archaeology. In the worst cases, these deficiencies developed into rickets, a bone disorder that can occur when people don’t get enough ultraviolet light.
paras.zh: 研究人员于 11 月 5 日在《环境考古学前沿》中报告称，生活在英格兰北部农村地区的人们牙齿和骨骼中的钙矿化表明，在小冰河时期鼎盛时期长大的儿童通常会缺乏维生素 D。在最糟糕的情况下，这些缺陷会发展成佝偻病，这是一种当人们没有获得足够的紫外线时就会发生的骨骼疾病。

paras.en: Previous skeletal studies suggest that rickets became more common among Europeans during the 18th and 19th centuries. One culprit may have been the Industrial Revolution, when many Europeans lived in UV-poor polluted cities and often worked indoors. The unusually cold climate may have added “an extra layer of difficulty” to getting enough sunlight, says Ellen Kendall, a bioarcheologist at Durham University in England
paras.zh: 先前的骨骼研究表明，佝偻病在 18 世纪和 19 世纪的欧洲人中变得更加常见。罪魁祸首之一可能是工业革命，当时许多欧洲人生活在紫外线污染较少的城市，并且经常在室内工作。英国杜伦大学生物考古学家埃伦·肯德尔表示，异常寒冷的气候可能给获得足够的阳光增加了“额外的困难”

paras.en: The Little Ice Age was a period of global cooling from the 13th to 19th centuries caused by extreme solar cycles and a series of volcanic eruptions, which can cool the planet by ejecting aerosols into the atmosphere that block sunlight. In the last 200 years of the era, 18 major eruptions helped spur a temperature drop of 2 to 3 degrees Celsius over northern Europe.
paras.zh: 小冰河时期是13世纪到19世纪的一段全球变冷时期，由极端的太阳周期和一系列火山喷发引起，火山喷发可以通过向大气中喷射阻挡阳光的气溶胶来冷却地球。在这个时代的最后 200 年里，18 次大规模火山喷发导致北欧气温下降了 2 至 3 摄氏度。

paras.en: Kendall and colleagues wondered how this cold climate affected health. They examined calcium deposition — how the essential mineral is incorporated into bones — in the remains of 21 people buried from 1711 to 1829 in the town of North Shields. Calcium often doesn’t fully mineralize in people with vitamin D delicacies, leaving voids in teeth as they grow.
paras.zh: 肯德尔和同事想知道这种寒冷的气候如何影响健康。他们检查了 1711 年至 1829 年间埋葬在北希尔兹镇的 21 具遗骸中的钙沉积情况，即这种必需矿物质如何融入骨骼中。食用维生素 D 美味佳肴的人体内的钙通常无法完全矿化，从而在牙齿生长过程中留下空隙。

paras.en: The team found bands of failed calcium mineralization in the teeth, suggesting seasonal spates of vitamin D deficiencies. Some skeletons also showed signs of rickets. North Shields was a small rural town that hadn’t yet undergone industrialization, so these deficiencies probably weren’t due to bad air conditions.
paras.zh: 研究小组在牙齿中发现了钙矿化失败的带子，这表明维生素 D 存在季节性缺乏。一些骨骼还表现出佝偻病的迹象。北希尔兹是一个尚未实现工业化的乡村小镇，所以这些缺陷可能不是由于空气条件恶劣造成的。

paras.en: The unusually cold weather may have changed people’s behavior during the winter, Kendall says. Residents may have kept their kids indoors or bundled them up so that little skin was exposed when they did go outside, preventing them from getting enough UV light, she says.
paras.zh: 肯德尔说，异常寒冷的天气可能改变了人们在冬天的行为。她说，居民可能把孩子留在室内或把他们裹得严严实实，这样当他们出去时就很少有皮肤暴露，从而阻止他们接受足够的紫外线。

paras.en: However, climate was still just one factor among many — including gender roles, diet and pollution — that shaped vitamin D deficiencies at the time, says Kendall. “Humans are very messy to study,” she says. “That’s one of the things that makes them so very fascinating.”
paras.zh: 然而，肯德尔说，气候仍然只是当时导致维生素 D 缺乏的众多因素之一，包括性别角色、饮食和污染。 “人类的研究非常混乱，”她说。 “这就是让它们如此迷人的原因之一。”

articles.title: Scientists Used a 'Psychomanteum' to Summon Ghostly Encounters. Then It Got Weird.
articles.author: Esra Öz

paras.en: One woman felt someone stroking her hair. To her, it was a loved one who had died.
paras.zh: 一名妇女感到有人抚摸她的头发。对她来说，死者是一位亲人。

paras.en: Other participants described a smell, felt a touch, or pictured someone they had lost. They had spent 45 minutes looking into a mirror in a dimly lit room, as researchers investigated how an absent person can seem to be nearby.
paras.zh: 其他参与者描述了一种气味，感觉到了一种触摸，或者想象了他们失去的人。他们花了 45 分钟在一间光线昏暗的房间里照镜子，研究人员如何观察一个不在场的人似乎就在附近。

paras.en: In a new study, a team of researchers from the University of West Georgia and Northwest Missouri State University found that the vividness and realism of the experiences were linked with a measure of creativity, but that doesn't explain everything that happened in this strange scenario.
paras.zh: 在一项新的研究中，来自西乔治亚大学和西北密苏里州立大学的一组研究人员发现，体验的生动性和真实性与一定程度的创造力有关，但这并不能解释在这个奇怪的场景中发生的一切。

paras.en: The experiment took place in a small chamber called a psychomanteum, where participants tried to experience the presence of someone who had died.
paras.zh: 该实验在一个名为“psychomanteum”的小房间里进行，参与者试图体验死者的存在。

paras.en: Black velvet covered its walls and ceiling. A reclining chair faced a mirror, tilted so participants couldn't see their own faces. A dim lamp stood at the back.
paras.zh: 黑色天鹅绒覆盖了墙壁和天花板。一张躺椅面对着一面镜子，倾斜的所以参与者看不到自己的脸。后面立着一盏昏暗的灯。

paras.en: Researchers recruited 30 people. Half of the group had a condition called synesthesia, where people automatically link senses or concepts, such as associating letters with colors, or show related tendencies. The other 15 had all previously reported a ghost experience, as had some in the synesthesia group.
paras.zh: 研究人员招募了 30 人。一半的人患有联觉症，人们会自动将感官或概念联系起来，例如将字母与颜色联系起来，或表现出相关的倾向。另外 15 人之前都曾报告过鬼魂经历，联觉组中的一些人也有过这样的经历。

paras.en: Before mirror gazing, each spent 15 minutes remembering someone who had died.
paras.zh: 在照镜子之前，每个人都花 15 分钟纪念死去的人。

paras.en: They thought about the person's appearance, voice, movements, and personality. They could bring photographs or keepsakes, or draw the person.
paras.zh: 他们考虑这个人的外表、声音、动作和性格。他们可以带照片或纪念品，或者画这个人。

paras.en: During the next 45 minutes, a steady background of pink noise masked outside noises. Participants pressed a button whenever they sensed a presence or experienced strong visual imagery.
paras.zh: 在接下来的 45 分钟内，稳定的粉红噪音背景掩盖了外界的噪音。每当参与者感觉到存在或经历强烈的视觉意象时，他们就会按下按钮。

paras.en: Afterward, they rated how vivid and real the experience felt and how much physical space it seemed to occupy. On the post-session questionnaire, 24 of the 30 reported sensing a presence.
paras.zh: 随后，他们评估了这种体验的生动性和真实性，以及它占据了多少物理空间。在会后调查问卷中，30 人中有 24 人报告感觉到存在。

paras.en: For lead author Christine Simmonds-Moore, a psychologist at the University of West Georgia, the strength of people's feelings was striking.
paras.zh: 对于主要作者、西乔治亚大学心理学家克里斯汀·西蒙兹-摩尔来说，人们情感的强度是惊人的。

paras.en: "Oftentimes, these experiences were highly emotional but in a positive manner," Simmonds-Moore told ScienceAlert.
paras.zh: 西蒙兹-摩尔告诉《ScienceAlert》：“通常，这些经历非常情绪化，但却是积极的。”

paras.en: Some described an opportunity to say goodbye or revisit unresolved matters.
paras.zh: 一些人描述了一个告别或重新审视未解决问题的机会。

paras.en: "One participant experienced her hair being stroked by her loved one, which was meaningful and strongly impactful," Simmonds-Moore said.
paras.zh: 西蒙兹-摩尔说：“一名参与者经历了她所爱的人抚摸她的头发，这是有意义的且具有强烈影响力的。”

paras.en: The researchers expected people with synesthesia to report stronger experiences, but the groups didn't differ significantly in whether they reported a presence or in how they rated their experiences.
paras.zh: 研究人员预计有联觉的人会报告更强烈的经历，但各组在是否报告存在或如何评价自己的经历方面没有显着差异。

paras.en: A different pattern emerged from a questionnaire measuring fantasy. People with higher scores on its creative fantasy scale tended to describe more vivid and realistic experiences. A separate imaginative fantasy scale showed no significant association with those qualities.
paras.zh: 一项测量幻想的问卷出现了不同的模式。在创造性幻想量表上得分较高的人倾向于描述更生动、更现实的经历。单独的想象力幻想量表显示与这些品质没有显着关联。

paras.en: This doesn't establish that creativity caused the encounters. Simmonds-Moore suggested that personality, expectations, the bond with the person who died, and a mild dissociative state during prolonged mirror gazing could work together to shape them.
paras.zh: 这并不能证明创造力导致了这些遭遇。西蒙兹-摩尔认为，个性、期望、与死者的联系，以及长时间凝视镜子时的轻微分离状态可以共同塑造它们。

paras.en: A strong tendency toward fantasy, Simmonds-Moore explained, "contributes toward the recipe for ghosts".
paras.zh: 西蒙兹-摩尔解释说，强烈的幻想倾向“有助于创造鬼魂”。

paras.en: A recent study linked childhood imaginary friends to adult feelings of presence, exploring another way someone absent can seem to share our space.
paras.zh: 最近的一项研究将童年想象中的朋友与成人的存在感联系起来，探索不在场的人似乎可以分享我们空间的另一种方式。

paras.en: The team also monitored electromagnetic fields and changes in the intervals between heartbeats. An infrared camera filmed the mirror area, while an electronic device produced random numbers to investigate possible associations between participants' experiences and its output.
paras.zh: 该团队还监测电磁场和心跳间隔的变化。红外摄像机拍摄镜子区域，而电子设备产生随机数来调查参与者的经历与其输出之间可能的关联。

paras.en: A team member who didn't know which sessions included unusual experiences reviewed the footage. Small specks appeared both with and without participants present, with no significant difference in their overall frequency.
paras.zh: 一名不知道哪些会议包含不寻常经历的团队成员查看了这段录像。无论参与者在场还是不在场，都会出现小斑点，但总体频率没有显着差异。

paras.en: However, mirror-gazing sessions containing specks were associated with more reported unusual experiences and different random-number outputs. The generator's overall output didn't differ significantly from chance.
paras.zh: 然而，包含斑点的镜子凝视过程与更多报告的不寻常经历和不同的随机数输出相关。发电机的整体输出与随机输出没有显着差异。

paras.en: The speck–generator relationship emerged in an additional analysis after the researchers examined the data. Simmonds-Moore called it "an intriguing post hoc finding" that needs replication.
paras.zh: 研究人员检查数据后，在进一步的分析中发现了斑点与发生器的关系。西蒙兹-摩尔称其为“一项有趣的事后发现”，需要复制。

paras.en: To recreate the specks, the team tugged the velvet, mimicked participants shifting in their seats, moved the lamp, and blew dust toward the lens. Only changing the mirror's angle or swinging it produced specks, which were fainter and smaller than those originally recorded.
paras.zh: 为了重现斑点，团队拉动天鹅绒，模仿参与者在座位上移动，移动灯，并向镜头吹灰尘。仅改变镜子的角度或摆动它就会产生斑点，这些斑点比最初记录的更暗更小。

paras.en: Dust, airborne particles, and small mirror movements remain possible explanations.
paras.zh: 灰尘、空气中的颗粒和小镜子运动仍然是可能的解释。

paras.en: The study was small, wasn't registered in advance, and involved many statistical comparisons, raising the risk of chance findings. Many participants also reported prior ghost experiences, limiting how widely the results might apply. The findings don't demonstrate communication with the dead or establish a treatment for grief.
paras.zh: 该研究规模较小，没有提前注册，并且涉及许多统计比较，增加了偶然发现的风险。许多参与者还报告了以前的鬼经历，限制了结果的适用范围。这些发现并没有证明与死者的沟通或建立悲伤的治疗方法。

paras.en: Larger experiments could investigate how memories and our surroundings contribute to a felt presence. Simmonds-Moore said the team plans related work with a "wind phone", an unconnected telephone people use to speak to deceased loved ones.
paras.zh: 更大型的实验可以研究记忆和我们的周围环境如何影响存在感。西蒙兹-摩尔表示，该团队计划使用“风电话”进行相关工作，这是一种人们用来与已故亲人通话的未连接电话。

paras.en: The research has been published in Journal of Anomalous Experience and Cognition.
paras.zh: 该研究已发表在《异常经验与认知杂志》上。

articles.title: University Exams Produce a Distinct Chemical Signature in Sewage, Study Suggests
articles.author: Peter Dockrill

paras.en: Stress doesn't just live inside your brain.
paras.zh: 压力不仅仅存在于你的大脑中。

paras.en: The invisible chemical signature of stress and worry can be found all over your body – in your blood, in your saliva, and even in the hair upon your head.
paras.zh: 压力和忧虑的无形化学特征可以在您的身体各处找到——在您的血液中、您的唾液中，甚至在您的头发中。

paras.en: But just how far do these chemical markers of stress extend? Reading a saliva sample is one thing, but if we zoom out, is it possible to detect biological stress at the population level?
paras.zh: 但这些压力的化学标记到底能延伸多远呢？读取唾液样本是一回事，但如果我们缩小范围，是否有可能在人群水平上检测生物压力？

paras.en: In a new study, scientists showed that you can do this, and it's all thanks to human sewage.
paras.zh: 在一项新的研究中，科学家表明你可以做到这一点，而这一切都归功于人类污水。

paras.en: "Wastewater surveillance offers a complementary, non-invasive approach to population health surveillance by quantifying aggregated biological and chemical markers excreted by communities," a team of researchers from the University of Queensland in Australia explains in Nature Water.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚昆士兰大学的一组研究人员在《自然水》杂志上解释说：“废水监测通过量化社区排出的生物和化学标记物，为人口健康监测提供了一种补充性、非侵入性的方法。”

paras.en: Wastewater analysis can be used to track all sorts of things, revealing secrets about how viruses spread, how superbugs spawn, and how human products end up contaminating the marine environment.
paras.zh: 废水分析可用于追踪各种事物，揭示病毒如何传播、超级细菌如何产生以及人类产品如何最终污染海洋环境的秘密。

paras.en: An emerging area in this field of research is using wastewater analysis to measure biomarkers of stress, which is what scientists investigated here.
paras.zh: 该研究领域的一个新兴领域是利用废水分析来测量压力生物标志物，这也是科学家们在此研究的内容。

paras.en: In the study, the University of Queensland team analyzed wastewater collected from an Australian university campus (serving 30,000 people), comparing sewage collected during the teaching semester with samples from an examination period, and also examining wastewater from a nearby general community.
paras.zh: 在这项研究中，昆士兰大学团队分析了从澳大利亚大学校园（为 30,000 人提供服务）收集的废水，将教学学期收集的污水与考试期间的样本进行比较，并检查了附近普通社区的废水。

paras.en: Results showed that during exam weeks, levels of two oxidative stress biomarkers – 8-OHG and 8-OHdG – rose higher on the university campus, compared to the non-examination period, although only the increase in 8-OHG was statistically significant when results were compared with levels seen in the general community.
paras.zh: 结果显示，在考试周期间，与非考试期间相比，大学校园内两种氧化应激生物标志物（8-OHG 和 8-OHdG）的水平升高，但与普通社区的水平相比，只有 8-OHG 的升高具有统计学意义。

paras.en: "A clear and temporary spike in oxidative stress levels was observed during the examination period [aligning] with the expected physiological and psychological burden of academic assessments," the researchers explain.
paras.zh: 研究人员解释说：“在考试期间，观察到氧化应激水平明显且暂时的飙升，与学术评估的预期生理和心理负担相符。”

paras.en: "Together, these findings suggest that examination periods represent a robust, population-level stressor that can be objectively detected through wastewater-derived biomarkers."
paras.zh: “总而言之，这些发现表明，检查期代表了一种强大的、人群水平的压力源，可以通过废水衍生的生物标志物客观地检测到。”

paras.en: But it wasn't just stress biomarkers that fluctuated.
paras.zh: 但波动的不仅仅是压力生物标志物。

paras.en: The exam period was also linked to higher levels of antidepressant chemicals in the wastewater, suggesting greater amounts of amitriptyline, citalopram, fluoxetine, and venlafaxine may have been consumed on campus over that time – but only the increase in amitriptyline was found to be statistically significant.
paras.zh: 考试期间还与废水中抗抑郁化学物质含量较高有关，这表明在那段时间校园内可能消耗了更多的阿米替林、西酞普兰、氟西汀和文拉法辛——但只有阿米替林的增加被发现具有统计显着性。

paras.en: Despite the statistical uncertainty, the researchers think the relative increases seen on campus hint at heightened antidepressant use during the exam window.
paras.zh: 尽管存在统计上的不确定性，研究人员认为校园内的相对增加暗示考试期间抗抑郁药物的使用增加。

paras.en: "The consistent direction of change across multiple antidepressants and metabolites suggests a possible examination-period increase in antidepressant consumption within the university campus, although the evidence remains suggestive rather than conclusive," the team writes in their paper.
paras.zh: 研究小组在论文中写道：“多种抗抑郁药物和代谢物的一致变化方向表明，考试期间大学校园内抗抑郁药物的消费量可能会增加，尽管证据仍然是暗示性的，而不是结论性的。”

paras.en: "This pattern is broadly consistent with the well-established association between academic stress and worsening depressive and anxiety symptoms among university students."
paras.zh: “这种模式与大学生学业压力与抑郁和焦虑症状恶化之间的既定关联大致一致。”

paras.en: Other substances, including ADHD medications, showed no significant exam-related increases, while markers associated with caffeine consumption and artificial sweeteners actually appeared to decline relative to the general community, which might seem a bit surprising during a busy exam period.
paras.zh: 其他物质，包括多动症药物，没有显示出与考试相关的显着增加，而与咖啡因消耗和人工甜味剂相关的标记实际上相对于一般社区似乎有所下降，这在繁忙的考试期间似乎有点令人惊讶。

paras.en: Alcohol consumption, less surprisingly, also appeared to be temporarily suppressed during exam time, with wastewater measurements suggesting a rebound after the exams concluded.
paras.zh: 不出所料，考试期间酒精消耗量似乎也暂时受到抑制，废水测量结果表明考试结束后酒精消耗量出现反弹。

paras.en: The researchers acknowledge several limitations with their study, including that the toilets on campus aren't just used by students, with university staff, contractors, and visitors all contributing to the "mass load of target biomarkers".
paras.zh: 研究人员承认他们的研究存在一些局限性，包括校园里的厕所不仅仅是学生使用的，大学工作人员、承包商和访客都对“目标生物标记物的大量负载”做出了贡献。

paras.en: But they say sewage analysis is an important tool for detecting changes in stress-related biomarkers and substance use among students, giving us an objective tool that can help us monitor fluctuations over short timeframes.
paras.zh: 但他们表示，污水分析是检测学生与压力相关的生物标志物和物质使用变化的重要工具，为我们提供了一个客观的工具，可以帮助我们监测短时间内的波动。

paras.en: "These findings provide a proof of concept for using wastewater surveillance to monitor dynamic stress-related responses in university populations," they write, "[establishing] a foundation for future work to determine whether the magnitude, duration, or recurrence of wastewater-derived biomarker changes has clinically or pathologically meaningful implications, beyond traditional measurement tools."
paras.zh: 他们写道：“这些发现为利用废水监测来监测大学人群中与压力相关的动态反应提供了概念证明，为未来的工作奠定了基础，以确定废水衍生的生物标志物变化的幅度、持续时间或复发是否具有超出传统测量工具的临床或病理意义。”

paras.en: The findings are reported in Nature Water.
paras.zh: 研究结果发表在《自然水》杂志上。

articles.title: A Cheap Daily Vitamin Shows Promise For People at Risk of Leukemia, Early Trial Finds
articles.author: David Nield

paras.en: One way of beating certain cancers could be to stop them from developing in the first place, and there's a growing interest in using vitamin C to tackle pre-cancer blood disorders and early-stage blood cancers.
paras.zh: 战胜某些癌症的一种方法可能是从一开始就阻止它们的发展，而且人们越来越有兴趣使用维生素 C 来治疗癌前血液疾病和早期血液癌症。

paras.en: Vitamin C levels are often chronically low in people with blood cancers, and there's long been debate about whether topping up these levels might work as a cancer therapy.
paras.zh: 血癌患者的维生素 C 水平通常长期偏低，关于补充这些水平是否可以作为癌症治疗方法一直存在争议。

paras.en: So far, the evidence has been pretty mixed.
paras.zh: 到目前为止，证据相当复杂。

paras.en: To gather more data – specifically on vitamin C's effects before the cancer properly gets started – a team led by researchers from the University of Copenhagen in Denmark and the Van Andel Institute has now completed a phase 2 clinical trial involving 109 participants.
paras.zh: 为了收集更多数据，特别是关于维生素 C 在癌症正常发生之前的作用的数据，由丹麦哥本哈根大学和 Van Andel 研究所的研究人员领导的团队现已完成了一项涉及 109 名参与者的 2 期临床试验。

paras.en: The results, published in Cancer, show that a daily oral dose of 1,000 milligrams of vitamin C was linked to a 65 percent lower risk of death compared to a placebo group, in an exploratory analysis over a three-year follow-up.
paras.zh: 发表在《癌症》杂志上的研究结果显示，在为期三年的随访中进行的探索性分析显示，与安慰剂组相比，每日口服 1,000 毫克维生素 C 的死亡风险可降低 65%。

paras.en: "We are tremendously excited and cautiously optimistic that our results could one day translate into a simple way to improve care and outcomes for people with pre-leukemia disorders," says epigeneticist Peter Jones, from the Van Andel Institute.
paras.zh: 范安德尔研究所的表观遗传学家 Peter Jones 表示：“我们非常兴奋并谨慎乐观地认为，我们的结果有一天可能会转化为一种简单的方法来改善白血病前期疾病患者的护理和结果。”

paras.en: "Our approach reflects a growing emphasis on cancer interception – intervening before cancer becomes established."
paras.zh: “我们的方法反映出人们越来越重视癌症拦截——在癌症形成之前进行干预。”

paras.en: All of the participants in the trial had been given a diagnosis of either clonal cytopenia of undetermined significance (CCUS) or a lower-risk myeloid malignancy such as myelodysplastic syndrome (MDS), all of which can lead to the stubborn cancer type acute myeloid leukemia (AML).
paras.zh: 该试验的所有参与者都被诊断为意义未明的克隆性血细胞减少症（CCUS）或低风险骨髓恶性肿瘤，例如骨髓增生异常综合征（MDS），所有这些都可能导致顽固性癌症型急性髓系白血病（AML）。

paras.en: At the moment, there are no treatments available to stop CCUS from turning into AML. MDS can be tackled with stem cell transplantations, but it's not suitable for everyone.
paras.zh: 目前，尚无治疗方法可以阻止 CCUS 转变为 AML。骨髓增生异常综合征可以通过干细胞移植来治疗，但并不适合所有人。

paras.en: "The standard approach for patients with pre-cancer blood disorders is to monitor their blood cell counts over time," says hematologist Casey O'Connell, from the University of Southern California.
paras.zh: 南加州大学的血液学家凯西·奥康奈尔 (Casey O'Connell) 表示：“对于患有癌前血液疾病的患者来说，标准方法是随着时间的推移监测他们的血细胞计数。”

paras.en: "This is, understandably, very frustrating – no one wants to hear that they have a condition that increases leukemia risk but there's nothing that can be done other than watch and wait."
paras.zh: “这是可以理解的，这是非常令人沮丧的——没有人愿意听到自己患有一种会增加白血病风险的疾病，但除了观察和等待之外，没有什么可以做的。”

paras.en: Based on previous research, vitamin C has been identified as an important helper for the TET2 enzyme (a kind of worker protein).
paras.zh: 根据之前的研究，维生素C已被确定为TET2酶（一种工人蛋白）的重要帮助者。

paras.en: TET2 can help protect against cancer cells by controlling gene switches, and in blood conditions like those studied here, TET2 function is often impaired.
paras.zh: TET2 可以通过控制基因开关来帮助预防癌细胞，并且在像本文研究的血液状况中，TET2 功能通常会受损。

paras.en: The thinking is that replenishing vitamin C levels keeps TET2 working properly and doing its job of keeping cancer at bay – though this wasn't directly measured in the trial, and needs to be confirmed in future studies.
paras.zh: 他们的想法是，补充维生素 C 水平可以使 TET2 正常工作，并发挥其预防癌症的作用——尽管这一点在试验中没有直接测量，需要在未来的研究中得到证实。

paras.en: "Vitamin C is important because it is involved in a range of biological functions, including the activity of enzymes that regulate normal cell function," says hematologist Stine Ulrik Mikkelsen, from the University of Copenhagen.
paras.zh: “维生素 C 很重要，因为它涉及一系列生物功能，包括调节正常细胞功能的酶的活性，”哥本哈根大学的血液学家 Stine Ulrik Mikkelsen 说。

paras.en: Outside of the survival rate, fewer people in the vitamin C cohort went on to develop higher-risk, aggressive blood cancers – five participants versus nine – though as there were only 109 patients in total, this isn't statistically significant.
paras.zh: 除了生存率之外，服用维生素 C 的人群中继续患上高风险、侵袭性血癌的人数较少（5 名参与者对 9 名参与者），但由于总共只有 109 名患者，这在统计上并不显着。

paras.en: Other positive signs from the trial included smaller rises in several inflammatory biomarkers than in the placebo group (pointing to a system under stress), and a return to normal vitamin C levels for those who were deficient to begin with.
paras.zh: 该试验的其他积极迹象包括与安慰剂组相比，几种炎症生物标志物的上升幅度较小（表明系统处于压力之下），以及那些本来就缺乏维生素 C 的人恢复到正常水平。

paras.en: Overall, the results are positive and suggest that vitamin C could be a relatively easy, low-cost way of reducing the chances of cancer developing in those at high risk.
paras.zh: 总体而言，结果是积极的，表明维生素 C 可能是一种相对简单、低成本的方法，可以降低高危人群患癌症的机会。

paras.en: However, a larger phase 3 trial will need to be needed to definitively say whether a course of vitamin C can reduce cancer risk or extend lifespans.
paras.zh: 然而，需要进行更大规模的 3 期试验才能明确说明维生素 C 疗程是否可以降低癌症风险或延长寿命。

paras.en: "We are working to build on the trial findings by exploring how exactly vitamin C interacts with pre-cancerous cells, including the idea that it may help restore normal epigenetic function in blood cells at risk of becoming leukemia," says Jones.
paras.zh: 琼斯说：“我们正在努力以试验结果为基础，探索维生素 C 与癌前细胞究竟如何相互作用，包括它可能有助于恢复有白血病风险的血细胞的正常表观遗传功能。”

paras.en: The research has been published in Cancer.
paras.zh: 该研究已发表在《癌症》杂志上。

articles.title: For decades, we were told to avoid full-fat dairy. New research says otherwise

paras.en: For decades, we were told to avoid full-fat dairy. New research says otherwise
paras.zh: 几十年来，我们被告知要避免全脂乳制品。新研究表明情况并非如此

paras.en: - Full-fat dairy may not be the health villain it has long been portrayed as, according to a new study finding that three daily servings did not worsen weight, cholesterol, or insulin resistance over 12 weeks. Researchers also observed improvements in blood pressure and nutrient intake, raising questions about longstanding recommendations to choose low-fat dairy.
paras.zh: - 全脂乳制品可能并不像人们长期以来所描述的那样对健康有害，一项新的研究发现，每天食用 3 份乳制品在 12 周内不会导致体重、胆固醇或胰岛素抵抗恶化。研究人员还观察到血压和营养摄入量有所改善，这对长期以来选择低脂乳制品的建议提出了质疑。

paras.en: For years, people have been encouraged to choose low-fat or fat-free dairy products to protect their hearts and manage their weight. But growing scientific evidence suggests that full-fat dairy may not carry the health risks many have come to expect.
paras.zh: 多年来，人们一直被鼓励选择低脂或无脂乳制品来保护心脏和控制体重。但越来越多的科学证据表明，全脂乳制品可能不会带来许多人预期的健康风险。

paras.en: A new Canadian study led by University of Toronto professor Harvey Anderson adds to that evidence. Researchers found that adults who consumed three servings of full-fat dairy each day for 12 weeks did not experience harmful changes in body weight, body composition, energy metabolism, or blood cholesterol levels compared with participants following a diet containing little dairy.
paras.zh: 由多伦多大学教授哈维·安德森领导的一项新的加拿大研究补充了这一证据。研究人员发现，与遵循少量乳制品饮食的参与者相比，连续 12 周每天食用三份全脂乳制品的成年人的体重、身体成分、能量代谢或血液胆固醇水平并未出现有害变化。

paras.en: Even more surprisingly, participants who consumed more dairy showed improvements in blood pressure and obtained greater amounts of several important nutrients.
paras.zh: 更令人惊讶的是，摄入更多乳制品的参与者血压有所改善，并且获得了更多的几种重要营养素。

paras.en: The findings, published in The Journal of Nutrition, raise new questions about longstanding dietary recommendations and suggest that the health effects of dairy may be more complicated than its saturated fat content alone would indicate.
paras.zh: 发表在《营养杂志》上的研究结果对长期的饮食建议提出了新的问题，并表明乳制品对健康的影响可能比其饱和脂肪含量本身所表明的更为复杂。

paras.en: For decades, nutrition guidelines in Canada and many other countries have recommended choosing low-fat or fat-free milk, yogurt, and other dairy products. The main concern has been saturated fat, which can raise levels of LDL cholesterol in the blood.
paras.zh: 几十年来，加拿大和许多其他国家的营养指南都建议选择低脂或脱脂牛奶、酸奶和其他乳制品。主要问题是饱和脂肪，它会提高血液中低密度脂蛋白胆固醇的水平。

paras.en: Often called "bad" cholesterol, LDL can contribute to fatty deposits in the arteries. Over time, this buildup can increase the risk of heart attacks, strokes, and other cardiovascular problems.
paras.zh: 低密度脂蛋白通常被称为“坏”胆固醇，它会导致动脉中脂肪沉积。随着时间的推移，这种积聚会增加心脏病、中风和其他心血管问题的风险。

paras.en: Because full-fat dairy contains more saturated fat than reduced-fat alternatives, health authorities have traditionally encouraged people to limit their intake.
paras.zh: 由于全脂乳制品比低脂乳制品含有更多的饱和脂肪，卫生当局传统上鼓励人们限制摄入量。

paras.en: However, research examining what happens when people actually consume full-fat dairy has produced a more complicated picture.
paras.zh: 然而，研究人们实际食用全脂乳制品时会发生什么，结果得出了更为复杂的结果。

paras.en: Anderson, a professor of nutritional sciences at the University of Toronto's Temerty Faculty of Medicine, points out that numerous studies involving humans have failed to find a clear association between full-fat dairy consumption and poor health outcomes.
paras.zh: 安德森是多伦多大学特默蒂医学院的营养科学教授，他指出，大量涉及人类的研究未能发现全脂乳制品消费与不良健康结果之间存在明确的关联。

paras.en: Other research has even identified potential protective effects. That includes a recent study led by Temerty Medicine professor Kozeta Milliku, which found an association between whole-fat milk consumption and a lower risk of childhood obesity.
paras.zh: 其他研究甚至发现了潜在的保护作用。其中包括最近由 Temerty Medicine 教授 Kozeta Milliku 领导的一项研究，该研究发现全脂牛奶摄入量与降低儿童肥胖风险之间存在关联。

paras.en: These findings have prompted scientists to investigate whether dairy foods behave differently in the body than their individual nutrients might suggest.
paras.zh: 这些发现促使科学家们研究乳制品在体内的表现是否与其各自的营养成分所暗示的不同。

paras.en: What Happened When Adults Ate Full-Fat Dairy Every Day?
paras.zh: 当成年人每天吃全脂乳制品时会发生什么？

paras.en: To explore the question, Anderson and his colleagues conducted a 12-week study involving 74 adults with overweight or obesity.
paras.zh: 为了探索这个问题，安德森和他的同事进行了一项为期 12 周的研究，涉及 74 名超重或肥胖的成年人。

paras.en: Participants were randomly assigned to one of three dietary approaches. The first group followed a calorie-restricted diet containing little dairy. The second consumed three daily servings of dairy while maintaining an energy-neutral diet, meaning their calorie intake was intended to match the energy their bodies used. The third also consumed three servings of dairy each day but otherwise ate without specific calorie restrictions.
paras.zh: 参与者被随机分配到三种饮食方法中的一种。第一组遵循热量限制饮食，含有少量乳制品。第二个人每天摄入三份乳制品，同时保持能量中性饮食，这意味着他们的卡路里摄入量旨在与身体消耗的能量相匹配。第三个人每天还食用三份乳制品，但在其他方面没有特定的卡路里限制。

paras.en: All participants received guidance based on Canada's food guide, and the researchers supplied full-fat dairy products during the study.
paras.zh: 所有参与者都接受了基于加拿大食品指南的指导，研究人员在研究期间提供了全脂乳制品。

paras.en: At the end of 12 weeks, the team compared several measures of metabolic health, including body weight, body composition, and cholesterol levels.
paras.zh: 12 周结束时，研究小组比较了多项代谢健康指标，包括体重、身体成分和胆固醇水平。

paras.en: The results challenged expectations. Participants who consumed three servings of dairy daily did not show meaningful differences in weight gain, body composition, or blood cholesterol compared with those who ate little dairy.
paras.zh: 结果挑战了预期。与只吃少量乳制品的参与者相比，每天食用三份乳制品的参与者在体重增加、身体成分或血液胆固醇方面没有表现出有意义的差异。

paras.en: The higher-dairy groups also experienced improvements in blood pressure and consumed more calcium, protein, and vitamin D. These nutrients play essential roles in maintaining healthy bones, supporting muscle function, and regulating numerous processes throughout the body.
paras.zh: 较高乳制品群体的血压也得到了改善，并且消耗了更多的钙、蛋白质和维生素 D。这些营养素在维持骨骼健康、支持肌肉功能和调节全身多个过程方面发挥着重要作用。

paras.en: "Those that had three servings of dairy didn't have adverse levels of blood cholesterol or lipids or evidence of insulin resistance," says Anderson.
paras.zh: 安德森说：“那些吃三份乳制品的人没有出现不良的血液胆固醇或血脂水平，也没有出现胰岛素抵抗的证据。”

paras.en: Blood lipids are fats and fat-like substances circulating in the bloodstream, including cholesterol and triglycerides. Insulin resistance occurs when the body's cells become less responsive to insulin, making it harder to regulate blood sugar and increasing the risk of type 2 diabetes.
paras.zh: 血脂是血液中循环的脂肪和类脂肪物质，包括胆固醇和甘油三酯。当身体细胞对胰岛素的反应减弱时，就会出现胰岛素抵抗，从而更难调节血糖并增加 2 型糖尿病的风险。

paras.en: Although the results are encouraging, the study was relatively small and lasted only three months. Longer and larger studies are needed to determine whether the findings translate into lasting health benefits or changes in cardiovascular disease risk.
paras.zh: 尽管结果令人鼓舞，但该研究规模相对较小，仅持续了三个月。需要更长期、更大规模的研究来确定这些发现是否能转化为持久的健康益处或心血管疾病风险的变化。

paras.en: Why might full-fat dairy have different health effects than researchers would predict from its saturated fat content?
paras.zh: 为什么全脂乳制品对健康的影响可能与研究人员根据其饱和脂肪含量预测的不同？

paras.en: One possible explanation is the dairy matrix hypothesis, an idea that emphasizes how the physical structure of food influences the way the body processes its nutrients.
paras.zh: 一种可能的解释是乳制品基质假说，该假说强调食物的物理结构如何影响身体处理营养物质的方式。

paras.en: Rather than treating milk, cheese, or yogurt as simple collections of fat, protein, vitamins, and minerals, this theory considers how those components interact within the food itself.
paras.zh: 该理论没有将牛奶、奶酪或酸奶视为脂肪、蛋白质、维生素和矿物质的简单集合，而是考虑这些成分如何在食物本身内相互作用。

paras.en: "With dairy products, it's got two proteins -- casein and whey -- that are bound together with fat and with nutrients mixed in," says Anderson.
paras.zh: “乳制品中含有两种蛋白质——酪蛋白和乳清——它们与脂肪结合在一起，并混合了营养物质，”安德森说。

paras.en: Casein and whey are the two major types of protein found in milk. Both provide amino acids that the body uses to build and maintain tissues, but they are digested and absorbed at different rates.
paras.zh: 酪蛋白和乳清是牛奶中发现的两种主要蛋白质。两者都提供人体用来构建和维持组织的氨基酸，但它们的消化和吸收速度不同。

paras.en: According to Anderson, the complex arrangement of proteins, fats, and other nutrients in dairy products can help regulate how quickly those nutrients are released during digestion.
paras.zh: 安德森认为，乳制品中蛋白质、脂肪和其他营养素的复杂排列可以帮助调节消化过程中这些营养素释放的速度。

paras.en: This means the body's response to eating a whole dairy food may differ from its response to consuming an equivalent amount of saturated fat on its own.
paras.zh: 这意味着身体对吃全乳制品的反应可能不同于对单独摄入等量饱和脂肪的反应。

paras.en: The broader implication is that a food's health effects cannot always be predicted by examining a single ingredient. Its structure, nutritional composition, and interactions among nutrients may all matter.
paras.zh: 更广泛的含义是，食品对健康的影响不能总是通过检查单一成分来预测。它的结构、营养成分以及营养素之间的相互作用可能都很重要。

paras.en: Why the Findings Could Be Important for Older Adults
paras.zh: 为什么这些发现对老年人很重要

paras.en: The researchers believe these results could be particularly relevant for older people, who often need to obtain sufficient protein and essential nutrients while consuming fewer calories.
paras.zh: 研究人员认为，这些结果可能与老年人特别相关，他们通常需要获得足够的蛋白质和必需营养素，同时消耗更少的热量。

paras.en: As people age, their overall energy requirements frequently decrease. However, maintaining muscle mass, bone strength, and other important bodily functions still requires adequate nutrition.
paras.zh: 随着人们年龄的增长，他们的总体能量需求经常下降。然而，维持肌肉质量、骨骼强度和其他重要的身体功能仍然需要充足的营养。

paras.en: That can make it difficult to meet nutritional needs, particularly for people with smaller appetites.
paras.zh: 这可能会导致难以满足营养需求，尤其是对于胃口较小的人来说。

paras.en: Anderson explains that dairy products offer a familiar, convenient source of concentrated nutrition. They provide protein, calcium, and other nutrients in foods that many older adults already enjoy and regularly consume.
paras.zh: 安德森解释说，乳制品提供了一种熟悉、方便的浓缩营养来源。它们在许多老年人已经喜欢并经常食用的食物中提供蛋白质、钙和其他营养物质。

paras.en: The new findings suggest that including full-fat dairy in a balanced diet may help people meet these nutritional requirements without necessarily worsening cholesterol levels or markers associated with diabetes risk.
paras.zh: 新发现表明，在均衡饮食中加入全脂乳制品可能有助于人们满足这些营养需求，而不必恶化胆固醇水平或与糖尿病风险相关的标志物。

paras.en: However, the study did not directly establish whether long-term consumption prevents or increases diabetes, heart disease, or other chronic conditions.
paras.zh: 然而，该研究并没有直接确定长期食用是否可以预防或增加糖尿病、心脏病或其他慢性疾病。

paras.en: Rethinking Nutrition Advice Beyond Individual Nutrients
paras.zh: 重新思考个人营养素之外的营养建议

paras.en: Beyond the debate over dairy fat, the research highlights a broader challenge in nutrition science: judging the health effects of entire foods rather than focusing exclusively on individual nutrients.
paras.zh: 除了有关乳制品脂肪的争论之外，该研究还强调了营养科学中更广泛的挑战：判断整个食物对健康的影响，而不是仅仅关注单个营养素。

paras.en: Traditional dietary advice has often emphasized reducing specific components, such as saturated fat. Although these recommendations are grounded in evidence about cardiovascular risk, researchers increasingly recognize that different foods containing the same nutrients may not have identical effects on health.
paras.zh: 传统的饮食建议通常强调减少特定成分，例如饱和脂肪。尽管这些建议是基于有关心血管风险的证据，但研究人员越来越认识到，含有相同营养素的不同食物可能对健康产生不同的影响。

paras.en: The University of Toronto findings contribute to this discussion by showing that full-fat dairy can be incorporated into certain diets without the unfavorable short-term metabolic changes that might be expected from its saturated fat content.
paras.zh: 多伦多大学的研究结果表明，全脂乳制品可以纳入某些饮食中，而不会因饱和脂肪含量而产生不利的短期代谢变化，从而为这一讨论做出了贡献。

paras.en: That does not mean saturated fat is harmless or that everyone should switch to full-fat dairy. Instead, it suggests that the overall food, its nutritional structure, and the broader dietary pattern deserve consideration.
paras.zh: 这并不意味着饱和脂肪是无害的，也不意味着每个人都应该转向全脂乳制品。相反，它表明整体食物、其营养结构和更广泛的饮食模式值得考虑。

paras.en: For people trying to navigate changing nutrition recommendations and conflicting health messages, Anderson favors a practical approach rather than complicated dietary rules.
paras.zh: 对于那些试图应对不断变化的营养建议和相互矛盾的健康信息的人来说，安德森更喜欢实用的方法，而不是复杂的饮食规则。

paras.en: "Keep it simple, eat a variety of foods and not too much of anything."
paras.zh: “保持简单，吃多种食物，但不要吃太多。”

paras.en: This research was supported by Dairy Research Cluster 3 under the Canadian Agricultural Partnership AgriScience Program, and the Mitacs Accelerate program.
paras.zh: 这项研究得到了加拿大农业合作伙伴农业科学计划下的乳制品研究集群 3 和 Mitacs Accelerate 计划的支持。

paras.en: Materials provided by University of Toronto. Original written by Betty Zou. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由多伦多大学提供。原创作者：贝蒂·邹。注意：内容的风格和长度可能会被编辑。

paras.en: - Gerald Harvey Anderson, Corrina Zi Chen Zhou, Shirley Vien, Marisa Soo, Shekoufeh Salamat, Maryam Akbarifakhrabadi, Larissa Chomka, Priya Kathirvel, Ferhan Siddiqi, Hrvoje Fabek, Bohdan Luhovyy. The Effect of Three Daily Servings of Full-Fat Dairy for 12 Weeks on Body Weight, Body Composition, Energy Metabolism, Blood Lipids, and Dietary Intake of Adults with Overweight and Obesity. The Journal of Nutrition, 2026; 156 (4): 101373 DOI: 10.1016/j.tjnut.2026.101373
paras.zh: - Gerald Harvey Anderson、Corrina Zi Chen Zhou、Shirley Vien、Marisa Soo、Shekoufeh Salamat、Maryam Akbarifakhrabadi、Larissa Chomka、Priya Kathirvel、Ferhan Siddiqi、Hrvoje Fabek、Bohdan Luhovyy。每日三份全脂乳制品连续 12 周对超重和肥胖成人的体重、身体成分、能量代谢、血脂和膳食摄入量的影响。营养杂志，2026； 156（4）：101373 DOI：10.1016/j.tjnut.2026.101373

articles.title: NASA’s Swift telescope falls to Earth after nearly 22 years in space

paras.en: NASAâs Swift telescope falls to Earth after nearly 22 years in space
paras.zh: NASA 的 Swift 望远镜在太空飞行近 22 年后坠落地球

paras.en: - After nearly 22 years of exploring the universeâs most violent explosions, NASAâs Swift Observatory has re-entered Earthâs atmosphere over Indonesia. Originally designed to last just two years, the pioneering space telescope transformed our understanding of black holes, exploding stars, and mysterious cosmic outbursts.
paras.zh: - 经过近 22 年对宇宙最猛烈爆炸的探索后，美国宇航局的斯威夫特天文台重新进入印度尼西亚上空的地球大气层。这台开创性的太空望远镜最初的设计寿命仅为两年，但它改变了我们对黑洞、爆炸恒星和神秘宇宙爆发的理解。

paras.en: NASA's Neil Gehrels Swift Observatory has returned to Earth after spending nearly 22 years in space, bringing an extraordinary era of astronomical discovery to a close. The spacecraft re-entered Earth's atmosphere on Wednesday, ending a mission that lasted more than ten times longer than originally planned.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局尼尔·盖尔斯·斯威夫特天文台在太空度过近 22 年之后返回地球，结束了一个非凡的天文发现时代。该航天器于周三重新进入地球大气层，结束了比原计划持续十倍以上的任务。

paras.en: Launched in 2004, Swift was a pioneering space observatory equipped with three telescopes designed to study some of the most powerful explosions in the universe. Its instruments could detect different types of light, allowing scientists to investigate energetic cosmic events that would be difficult to understand using a single telescope.
paras.zh: Swift 于 2004 年发射，是一个开创性的太空天文台，配备了三台望远镜，旨在研究宇宙中一些最强大的爆炸。它的仪器可以探测不同类型的光，使科学家能够研究使用单一望远镜难以理解的高能宇宙事件。

paras.en: NASA's Swift Observatory Re-Enters Earth's Atmosphere
paras.zh: 美国宇航局雨燕天文台重返地球大气层

paras.en: The U.S. Space Force confirmed that Swift entered the atmosphere at 7:39 a.m. EST on Wednesday above North Sumatra, Indonesia. The reported location was approximately 3.4 degrees north latitude and 98.6 degrees east longitude.
paras.zh: 美国太空军证实，雨燕号于美国东部时间周三上午 7 点 39 分进入印度尼西亚北苏门答腊岛上空的大气层。报告的位置约为北纬 3.4 度和东经 98.6 度。

paras.en: NASA anticipated that most of the spacecraft would burn up as it plunged through the atmosphere. However, officials acknowledged that some components might have survived the intense heat of re-entry.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局预计，航天器的大部分会在坠入大气层时烧毁。然而，官员们承认，一些部件可能在重返大气层的高温下幸存下来。

paras.en: A Two-Year NASA Mission That Lasted Nearly 22 Years
paras.zh: NASA 为期两年的任务持续了近 22 年

paras.en: Swift was originally developed to investigate gamma-ray bursts, extraordinarily powerful flashes of high-energy radiation associated with some of the most extreme events in the cosmos. These bursts can occur when massive stars collapse or when certain compact objects, such as neutron stars, merge.
paras.zh: Swift 最初是为了研究伽马射线暴而开发的，伽马射线暴是与宇宙中一些最极端事件相关的异常强大的高能辐射闪光。当大质量恒星坍塌或某些致密天体（例如中子星）合并时，就会发生这些爆发。

paras.en: Although NASA initially planned for Swift to operate for just two years, the observatory continued making scientific contributions for more than two decades.
paras.zh: 尽管美国宇航局最初计划让斯威夫特天文台运行两年，但该天文台在二十多年的时间里继续做出了科学贡献。

paras.en: One of its most important capabilities was its ability to respond quickly to sudden cosmic events. When Swift detected an energetic outburst, it could rapidly redirect its telescopes toward the source and notify observatories around the world. This coordinated approach allowed astronomers to study brief astronomical phenomena before they faded from view.
paras.zh: 它最重要的功能之一是能够快速响应突发的宇宙事件。当斯威夫特探测到能量爆发时，它可以迅速将望远镜转向源头并通知世界各地的天文台。这种协调一致的方法使天文学家能够在短暂的天文现象从视野中消失之前对其进行研究。

paras.en: Swift also observed multiple wavelengths of light, giving researchers different ways to examine the same event and better understand the physical processes behind it.
paras.zh: 斯威夫特还观察了多个波长的光，为研究人员提供了不同的方法来检查同一事件并更好地了解其背后的物理过程。

paras.en: Over its remarkably long lifetime, Swift's scientific contributions expanded far beyond its original focus on gamma-ray bursts.
paras.zh: 在其相当长的生命周期中，斯威夫特的科学贡献远远超出了其最初对伽马射线爆发的关注。

paras.en: The observatory helped astronomers investigate active galaxies powered by supermassive black holes, stars that produce powerful X-ray flares, and supernovae, the enormous explosions that mark the deaths of certain stars.
paras.zh: 该天文台帮助天文学家研究由超大质量黑洞提供动力的活跃星系、产生强大X射线耀斑的恒星以及超新星（标志着某些恒星死亡的巨大爆炸）。

paras.en: Its observations also extended much closer to home, including studies of comets and asteroids within our own solar system.
paras.zh: 它的观测范围也延伸到离地球更近的地方，包括对太阳系内彗星和小行星的研究。

paras.en: By combining rapid observations with the ability to detect different forms of radiation, Swift became a valuable tool for exploring both distant cosmic explosions and nearby objects. Its re-entry marks the end of a mission that greatly exceeded its planned lifespan and helped transform scientists' understanding of some of the universe's most energetic phenomena.
paras.zh: 通过将快速观测与检测不同形式辐射的能力相结合，斯威夫特成为探索遥远宇宙爆炸和附近物体的宝贵工具。它的重返标志着一项远远超出其计划寿命的任​​务的结束，并帮助改变了科学家对宇宙中一些最具活力现象的理解。

articles.title: Don't miss: Meteor showers, fireballs, and a supermoon light up November's night sky

paras.en: Don't miss: Meteor showers, fireballs, and a supermoon light up November's night sky
paras.zh: 不要错过：流星雨、火球和超级月亮照亮了十一月的夜空

paras.en: - November's night sky is packed with celestial wonders, from bright meteor fireballs and a close pairing of Mars and Jupiter to a spectacular supermoon. Meanwhile, NASA's Voyager 1 is making history by becoming the first spacecraft to reach a distance of one light-day from Earth.
paras.zh: - 十一月的夜空充满了天体奇观，从明亮的流星火球、火星和木星的紧密配对，到壮观的超级月亮。与此同时，美国宇航局的旅行者一号正在创造历史，成为第一艘到达距地球一光日距离的航天器。

paras.en: November 2026 is packed with celestial events worth watching, from brilliant meteors streaking across the sky to a striking encounter between Mars and Jupiter. NASA's Voyager 1 spacecraft is also approaching an extraordinary milestone, while a dazzling supermoon will close out the month.
paras.zh: 2026 年 11 月充满了值得观看的天体事件，从划过天空的明亮流星到火星与木星的惊人相遇。美国国家航空航天局 (NASA) 的航海者 1 号宇宙飞船也正在接近一个非凡的里程碑，而令人眼花缭乱的超级月亮将在这个月结束。

paras.en: Three meteor showers offer multiple opportunities to catch shooting stars, including occasional fireballs bright enough to stand out dramatically against the night sky. Meanwhile, two of the solar system's most recognizable planets will appear unusually close together just before sunrise.
paras.zh: 三场流星雨提供了多种捕捉流星的机会，包括偶尔出现的明亮火球，在夜空中引人注目。与此同时，太阳系中两颗最知名的行星将在日出前异常接近。

paras.en: As if that weren't enough, humanity's most distant spacecraft is reaching a point where radio signals from Earth take an entire day to arrive.
paras.zh: 似乎这还不够，人类最遥远的航天器正在达到一个地步，来自地球的无线电信号需要一整天才能到达。

paras.en: Here's what NASA recommends watching for in November.
paras.zh: 以下是 NASA 建议在 11 月份关注的内容。

paras.en: - Around November 5: The Southern Taurid meteor shower reaches its peak, with the possibility of exceptionally bright fireballs.
paras.zh: - 11 月 5 日左右：南金牛座流星雨达到顶峰，可能会出现异常明亮的火球。

paras.en: - Around November 12: The Northern Taurids peak, producing approximately five meteors per hour under ideal viewing conditions.
paras.zh: - 11 月 12 日左右：北金牛座流星雨达到峰值，在理想的观测条件下每小时产生约 5 颗流星。

paras.en: - November 15 and 16: Mars and Jupiter appear just 1.2 degrees apart in the southeastern sky before sunrise.
paras.zh: - 11 月 15 日和 16 日：日出前，火星和木星在东南天空中出现的位置仅相距 1.2 度。

paras.en: - November 17: NASA celebrates Voyager 1's historic distance milestone with its Shine Bright for Voyager's Light-Day activation.
paras.zh: - 11 月 17 日：NASA 庆祝航海家 1 号的历史性距离里程碑，并启动航海家光日活动的 Shine Bright。

paras.en: - November 17 and 18: The Leonid meteor shower offers its best viewing opportunities before dawn, after the Moon sets, with potentially 15 meteors per hour under ideal conditions.
paras.zh: - 11 月 17 日和 18 日：狮子座流星雨在黎明前、月亮落下后提供最佳观赏机会，在理想条件下每小时可能有 15 颗流星。

paras.en: - November 24: A full supermoon illuminates the evening sky, beginning a sequence of three consecutive supermoons.
paras.zh: - 11 月 24 日：一轮完整的超级月亮照亮了夜空，开始了一系列连续的三个超级月亮。

paras.en: Three Meteor Showers Could Light Up November's Sky
paras.zh: 三场流星雨可能照亮十一月的天空

paras.en: November gives skywatchers several chances to see meteors flash across the darkness. The first opportunities come from the Southern and Northern Taurids, two related meteor showers that reach their highest activity levels about a week apart.
paras.zh: 十一月为天文观测者提供了几次看到流星划过黑暗的机会。第一个机会来自南金牛座流星雨和北金牛座流星雨，这两个相关的流星雨大约相隔一周达到最高活动水平。

paras.en: The Southern Taurids peak around November 5, followed by the Northern Taurids around November 12. Both showers get their names from the constellation Taurus, where their meteors appear to originate when viewed from Earth.
paras.zh: 南金牛座流星雨在 11 月 5 日左右达到峰值，随后北金牛座流星雨在 11 月 12 日左右达到峰值。这两场流星雨的名字都来自金牛座，从地球上看，它们的流星似乎起源于金牛座。

paras.en: Neither shower is especially prolific. Even under excellent conditions, each typically produces only about five meteors per hour. However, the Taurids are known for occasionally producing impressive fireballs, exceptionally bright meteors that can make even a relatively quiet night of skywatching memorable.
paras.zh: 两次阵雨都不是特别多产。即使在良好的条件下，每个流星通常每小时仅产生约五颗流星。然而，金牛座流星雨以偶尔产生令人印象深刻的火球而闻名，这些火球是异常明亮的流星，甚至可以让相对安静的夜晚观测天空变得令人难忘。

paras.en: The Leonids provide another opportunity later in the month. Their best viewing periods are expected during the early morning hours of November 17 and 18, particularly after the Moon has disappeared below the horizon. Under ideal conditions, observers could see approximately 15 meteors per hour, although actual counts will generally be lower.
paras.zh: 狮子座流星雨在本月晚些时候提供了另一个机会。预计最佳观赏期为 11 月 17 日至 18 日凌晨，尤其是在月亮消失在地平线以下之后。在理想条件下，观测者每小时可以看到大约 15 颗流星，但实际数量通常会更低。

paras.en: For the best chance of spotting meteors, travel somewhere away from bright city lights. Allow your eyes roughly 30 minutes to become accustomed to the darkness, then watch a broad section of the sky rather than concentrating on one small area.
paras.zh: 为了获得观赏流星的最佳机会，请前往远离明亮城市灯光的地方。让您的眼睛大约 30 分钟适应黑暗，然后观察广阔的天空，而不是专注于一小块区域。

paras.en: Mars and Jupiter Appear Almost Side by Side
paras.zh: 火星和木星几乎并排出现

paras.en: Meteor showers aren't the only reason to get outside before dawn. On November 15 and 16, Mars and Jupiter will create an eye-catching pairing in the southeastern sky.
paras.zh: 流星雨并不是黎明前外出的唯一原因。 11月15日至16日，火星和木星将在东南天空形成引人注目的配对。

paras.en: The two planets will appear separated by only about 1.2 degrees, slightly more than the apparent width of two full Moons placed next to each other.
paras.zh: 两颗行星的间距仅为约 1.2 度，略大于两个相邻满月的视宽度。

paras.en: Jupiter will be the brighter of the two, making it relatively easy to identify. Nearby, Mars will stand out with its characteristic reddish appearance.
paras.zh: 木星将是两者中较亮的，因此相对容易识别。在附近，火星将以其特有的微红色外观而引人注目。

paras.en: No telescope or binoculars will be necessary to enjoy the sight. Both planets should be readily visible to the unaided eye under suitable viewing conditions.
paras.zh: 无需望远镜或双筒望远镜即可欣赏这一景象。在合适的观察条件下，两颗行星都应该可以用肉眼轻易地看到。

paras.en: Although they will appear remarkably close from Earth's perspective, Mars and Jupiter remain separated by enormous distances in space. Their apparent proximity is simply a result of their positions along our line of sight.
paras.zh: 尽管从地球的角度来看它们非常接近，但火星和木星在太空中仍然相距甚远。它们明显的接近只是由于它们沿着我们视线的位置而造成的。

paras.en: Watching the planets over several consecutive mornings will reveal another interesting feature of their motion. They will gradually appear to move closer together before their positions shift and they begin separating again.
paras.zh: 连续几个早晨观察行星将揭示它们运动的另一个有趣特征。在位置发生变化并再次开始分离之前，它们会逐渐显得更加靠近。

paras.en: Voyager 1 Reaches an Extraordinary Deep Space Milestone
paras.zh: 航海家一号达到非凡的深空里程碑

paras.en: While November offers plenty to observe in Earth's skies, something equally remarkable is happening far beyond the planets.
paras.zh: 虽然十一月在地球的天空中有很多值得观察的地方，但同样引人注目的事情正在遥远的行星之外发生。

paras.en: NASA's Voyager 1 spacecraft is reaching a historic distance of one light-day from Earth, becoming the first human-made object ever to travel that far from our planet.
paras.zh: 美国国家航空航天局 (NASA) 的航海家一号宇宙飞船距离地球达到了历史性的一光日距离，成为有史以来第一个距离地球如此远的人造物体。

paras.en: A light-day is the distance light travels through space in 24 hours. Because radio signals move at the speed of light, a message transmitted from Earth will require an entire day to reach Voyager 1 at that distance.
paras.zh: 光日是光在 24 小时内穿过太空的距离。由于无线电信号以光速传播，因此从地球发送的消息需要一整天才能到达该距离的旅行者一号。

paras.en: If the spacecraft sends a response immediately, the return signal will take another 24 hours to arrive. That means even the fastest possible round-trip communication will require approximately 48 hours.
paras.zh: 如果航天器立即发出响应，返回信号还需要24小时才能到达。这意味着即使最快的往返通信也需要大约 48 小时。

paras.en: The milestone illustrates just how far Voyager 1 has traveled since leaving Earth and how challenging it has become to communicate with a spacecraft exploring such distant regions of space.
paras.zh: 这一里程碑说明了航海者一号自离开地球以来已经走了多远，以及与探索如此遥远的太空区域的航天器进行通信变得多么具有挑战性。

paras.en: To get a sense of the spacecraft's current direction, look toward the constellation Ophiuchus, also known as the Serpent Bearer. Voyager 1 is traveling through space in that general direction, far beyond anything visible to the unaided eye.
paras.zh: 要了解航天器当前的方向，请看向蛇夫座，也称为蛇夫座。航海家一号正在沿着这个大致方向穿越太空，远远超出肉眼可见的范围。

paras.en: NASA is marking the achievement on November 17 with its Shine Bright for Voyager's Light-Day activation, inviting people to celebrate this extraordinary accomplishment in space exploration.
paras.zh: NASA 将于 11 月 17 日启动 Shine Bright for Voyager 光日活动来纪念这一成就，邀请人们庆祝这一太空探索领域的非凡成就。

paras.en: November's Supermoon Begins a Three-Month Celestial Show
paras.zh: 十一月的超级月亮开始了为期三个月的天象表演

paras.en: The final major skywatching highlight arrives on November 24, when a full supermoon will rise into the evening sky.
paras.zh: 11 月 24 日是最后一个主要的星空观赏亮点，届时一轮满月将升入夜空。

paras.en: A supermoon occurs when a full Moon coincides with a period when the Moon is relatively close to Earth in its orbit. Because the Moon follows a slightly elliptical path rather than a perfect circle, its distance from our planet changes throughout the month.
paras.zh: 当满月与月球在其轨道上距离地球相对较近的时期重合时，就会出现超级月亮。由于月球的轨道略呈椭圆形，而不是完美的圆形，因此它与地球的距离在整个月内都会发生变化。

paras.en: When a full Moon occurs near the closer portion of that orbit, it can appear somewhat larger and brighter than an average full Moon. Although the difference is real, it is often subtle enough that casual observers may not immediately notice it.
paras.zh: 当满月出现在该轨道较近的部分附近时，它可能会比平均满月显得更大、更亮。尽管这种差异是真实存在的，但它通常非常微妙，以至于不经意的观察者可能不会立即注意到它。

paras.en: November's event is particularly noteworthy because it begins a sequence of three consecutive supermoons. Another will follow in December, with a third arriving in January.
paras.zh: 十一月的事件特别值得注意，因为它开始了一系列连续三个超级月亮。另一次将于 12 月抵达，第三次将于 1 月抵达。

paras.en: For an especially memorable view, NASA recommends looking toward the eastern horizon around sunset on November 24, when the full Moon will be rising.
paras.zh: 为了获得特别难忘的景色，NASA 建议在 11 月 24 日日落时分向东方地平线观看，届时满月将会升起。

paras.en: The Moon may seem unusually enormous when it first appears near the horizon. However, much of that dramatic impression comes from a familiar visual phenomenon called the Moon illusion.
paras.zh: 当月亮第一次出现在地平线附近时，它可能看起来异常巨大。然而，这种戏剧性的印象很大程度上来自一种熟悉的视觉现象，称为月亮错觉。

paras.en: This optical effect makes the Moon appear larger when it is close to the horizon than when it is high overhead, even though its actual apparent size changes very little. The illusion can occur during any full Moon, not just a supermoon.
paras.zh: 这种光学效应使得月球在靠近地平线时看起来比在高处时更大，尽管它的实际表观尺寸变化很小。这种错觉可能发生在任何满月期间，而不仅仅是超级月亮。

paras.en: With three meteor showers, a close planetary pairing, a historic Voyager 1 milestone, and the beginning of a supermoon series, November offers plenty of reasons to look up and explore the night sky.
paras.zh: 十一月有三场流星雨、一对紧密的行星配对、历史性的航行者一号里程碑以及超级月亮系列的开始，为仰望和探索夜空提供了充足的理由。

paras.en: Materials provided by NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由 NASA 喷气推进实验室提供。注意：内容的风格和长度可能会被编辑。

articles.title: AST SpaceMobile announces new 'Blacklift' rocket, targets 2028 launch debut
articles.author: Mike Wall

paras.en: Another new private rocket is in the works.
paras.zh: 另一枚新的私人火箭正在研制中。

paras.en: AST SpaceMobile announced today (Nov. 6) that it's building a reusable rocket called Blacklift to launch its broadband satellites to low Earth orbit (LEO), with first flight targeted in 2028.
paras.zh: AST SpaceMobile 今天（11 月 6 日）宣布，它正在建造一枚名为 Blacklift 的可重复使用火箭，用于将其宽带卫星发射到近地轨道 (LEO)，预计于 2028 年进行首次飞行。

paras.en: The news comes just 10 days after Cowboy Space unveiled Big Iron, a rocket designed to launch its constellation of 20,000 AI data centers. Cowboy Space is also targeting 2028 for its first liftoff.
paras.zh: 就在这一消息发布前 10 天，Cowboy Space 推出了 Big Iron，这是一枚旨在发射其由 20,000 个人工智能数据中心组成的星座的火箭。 Cowboy Space 也计划在 2028 年首次发射。

paras.en: "The Blacklift rocket is the springboard to significantly expand our total addressable market, providing AST SpaceMobile with regular unconstrained access to orbit and providing for most favorable owners’ economics in the industry," Abel Avellan, the company's founder, chairman and CEO, said in a statement today.
paras.zh: 该公司创始人、董事长兼首席执行官阿贝尔·阿维兰 (Abel Avellan) 在今天的一份声明中表示：“Blacklift 火箭是显着扩大我们总体目标市场的跳板，为 AST SpaceMobile 提供定期不受限制的进入轨道的机会，并为该行业提供最有利的业主经济效益。”

paras.en: "This will accelerate our mission to build a new layer of global connectivity, extending connectivity beyond terrestrial networks and helping to bring AI-enabled services wherever people live, work and travel," Avellan added.
paras.zh: 阿维兰补充道：“这将加速我们构建新的全球连接层的使命，将连接扩展到地面网络之外，并帮助将人工智能服务带到人们生活、工作和旅行的任何地方。”

paras.en: Texas-based AST SpaceMobile is building a LEO constellation composed of its BlueBird satellites, which beam internet service directly to cell phones. The company has launched 13 BlueBirds to date, including eight "Block 2" variants. The antennas on each of these next-gen spacecraft cover a whopping 2,400 square feet (223 square m) — the largest ever deployed in LEO by a commercial satellite.
paras.zh: 总部位于德克萨斯州的 AST SpaceMobile 正在建造一个由蓝鸟卫星组成的低地球轨道星座，这些卫星将互联网服务直接传输到手机。迄今为止，该公司已推出 13 款 BlueBirds，其中包括 8 款“Block 2”变体。这些下一代航天器上的天线覆盖面积高达 2,400 平方英尺（223 平方米），这是商业卫星有史以来在近地轨道部署的最大天线。

paras.en: BlueBirds have flown atop three different rockets to date — SpaceX's Falcon 9, Blue Origin's New Glenn and India's Launch Vehicle Mark-3. But AST SpaceMobile wants to get more vertically integrated, which explains the push to develop Blacklift.
paras.zh: 迄今为止，BlueBirds 已搭载三种不同的火箭进行飞行：SpaceX 的 Falcon 9、Blue Origin 的 New Glenn 和印度的 Mark-3 运载火箭。但 AST SpaceMobile 希望实现更加垂直的整合，这也是推动 Blacklift 开发的原因。

paras.en: The company won't be starting from scratch. It has signed a deal with another Texas-based outfit, Firefly Aerospace, to provide the engines (and associated engineering services) for the first three Blacklift launches. After that, AST SpaceMobile will build the engines itself, under a licensing agreement with Firefly.
paras.zh: 公司不会从头开始。该公司已与另一家位于德克萨斯州的公司 Firefly Aerospace 签署了一项协议，为前三轮 Blacklift 发射提供发动机（及相关工程服务）。之后，AST SpaceMobile 将根据与 Firefly 的许可协议自行制造发动机。

paras.en: Those engines are Miranda, which will power Blacklift's booster, and Vira, which will power the upper stage.
paras.zh: 这些发动机是米兰达（Miranda）和维拉（Vira），前者将为 Blacklift 的助推器提供动力，后者将为上层提供动力。

paras.en: Neither engine has flight experience. (Firefly's currently operational rocket, Alpha, uses Reavers in its booster and Lightnings in its upper stage.) But Miranda has been tested extensively on the ground, firing for more than 4,200 seconds over the course of 175 hot fires, according to AST SpaceMobile.
paras.zh: 两台发动机都没有飞行经验。 （萤火虫号目前正在运行的火箭 Alpha 在其助推器中使用掠夺者火箭，在其上级使用闪电火箭。）但根据 AST SpaceMobile 的说法，米兰达号已经在地面上进行了广泛的测试，在 175 次热火的过程中发射了 4,200 秒以上。

paras.en: "The Miranda engine will allow us to leapfrog the traditional five-to-10-year development cycle as we build Blacklift," AST SpaceMobile President Scott Wisniewski said in the same statement.
paras.zh: AST SpaceMobile 总裁 Scott Wisniewski 在同一份声明中表示：“Miranda 发动机将使我们能够在建造 Blacklift 时跨越传统的 5 到 10 年的开发周期。”

paras.en: The "supply and services" agreement for the first three launches is worth $500 million. The licensing agreement cost AST SpaceMobile about $800 million, with half of that paid in cash and half in stock, according to the statement.
paras.zh: 前三次发射的“供应和服务”协议价值 5 亿美元。声明称，该许可协议耗资约 8 亿美元，其中一半以现金支付，一半以股票支付。

paras.en: Blacklift will be able to haul 20 tons to LEO. Each launch will therefore be able to loft up to five BlueBird satellites, according to today's announcement. (For perspective: The Falcon 9's LEO lift capacity is about 25 tons.)
paras.zh: Blacklift 将能够向 LEO 运送 20 吨货物。根据今天的公告，每次发射将能够发射最多五颗蓝鸟卫星。 （仅供参考：猎鹰9号的LEO运载能力约为25吨。）

paras.en: BlueBirds will continue going up while AST SpaceMobile gets Blacklift ready to fly: The company already holds contracts with other providers to launch more than 100 of the satellites over the course of 2027 and 2028.
paras.zh: BlueBirds 将继续上升，而 AST SpaceMobile 则让 Blacklift 做好飞行准备：该公司已与其他提供商签订了合同，将在 2027 年和 2028 年期间发射 100 多颗卫星。

paras.en: The launch landscape will likely be very different when Blacklift, Big Iron and other new rockets come online. SpaceX has said that it plans to phase out the Falcon 9, as well as its Falcon Heavy heavy lifter, after its Starship megarocket gets up and running.
paras.zh: 当 Blacklift、Big Iron 和其他新型火箭上线时，发射情况可能会非常不同。 SpaceX 表示，计划在其 Starship 巨型火箭投入运行后，逐步淘汰 Falcon 9 及其 Falcon Heavy 重型运载火箭。

paras.en: That milestone could come in the next few years, ushering in something of a launch crunch for satellite operators. SpaceX has indicated that it will prioritize launches of its own satellites with Starship. And there will be a lot of them to loft — 100,000 Starlink V3 satellites and a million Starmind AI data centers, company founder and CEO Elon Musk has suggested.
paras.zh: 这一里程碑可能会在未来几年内实现，为卫星运营商带来发射危机。 SpaceX 表示将优先利用 Starship 发射自己的卫星。公司创始人兼首席执行官埃隆·马斯克表示，将会有很多卫星可供发射——10万颗 Starlink V3 卫星和 100 万颗 Starmind 人工智能数据中心。

paras.en: Michael Wall is the Spaceflight and Tech Editor for Space.com and joined the team in 2010. He primarily covers human and robotic spaceflight, military space, and exoplanets, but has been known to dabble in the space art beat. His book about the search for alien life, "Out There," was published on Nov. 13, 2018. Before becoming a science writer, Michael worked as a herpetologist and wildlife biologist. He has a Ph.D. in evolutionary biology from the University of Sydney, Australia, a bachelor's degree from the University of Arizona, and a graduate certificate in science writing from the University of California, Santa Cruz. To find out what his latest project is, you can follow Michael on Twitter.
paras.zh: Michael Wall 是 Space.com 的太空飞行和技术编辑，于 2010 年加入该团队。他主要报道人类和机器人太空飞行、军事太空和系外行星，但以涉足太空艺术领域而闻名。他关于寻找外星生命的书《Out There》于 2018 年 11 月 13 日出版。在成为科普作家之前，迈克尔曾是一名爬行动物学家和野生动物生物学家。他拥有博士学位。澳大利亚悉尼大学进化生物学博士学位、亚利桑那大学学士学位以及加州大学圣克鲁斯分校科学写作研究生证书。要了解他的最新项目是什么，您可以在 Twitter 上关注 Michael。

paras.zh: 评论前您必须确认您的公开显示名称

paras.en: Please logout and then login again, you will then be prompted to enter your display name.
paras.zh: 请注销并重新登录，系统将提示您输入您的显示名称。

articles.title: On this day in space! Nov. 6, 1572: A German astronomer discovers the Tycho supernova with the naked eye, but everyone thought the cosmic explosion was a 'new star'
articles.author: Hanneke Weitering

paras.en: On Nov. 6, 1572, the German astronomer Wolfgang Schulër observed a supernova with his bare eyes. He spotted the exploding star in the constellation Cassiopeia. It was as bright as Venus and could even be seen during the day.
paras.zh: 1572 年 11 月 6 日，德国天文学家沃尔夫冈·舒勒 (Wolfgang Schulër) 肉眼观测到了一颗超新星。他在仙后座发现了这颗爆炸的恒星。它像金星一样明亮，甚至在白天也能看到。

paras.en: Astronomers were really confused, because it looked like a star just appeared out of nowhere. Schulër may have been the first to see it, but the Danish astronomer Tycho Brahe is widely credited for the discovery. Brahe studied it in detail and wrote a whole book about this so-called "new star." It then became known as "Tycho's Star."
paras.zh: 天文学家真的很困惑，因为它看起来就像一颗星星突然出现。舒勒可能是第一个发现它的人，但这一发现被广泛认为是丹麦天文学家第谷·布拉赫 (Tycho Brahe)。布拉赫详细研究了它，并写了一整本书关于这个所谓的“新星”。后来它被称为“第谷之星”。

paras.en: At the time, supernovas had not yet been discovered. Tycho's Star was finally classified as a supernova in the 1940s. Scientists now think it was a small star called a white dwarf that exploded thousands of years ago. Because Tycho's Star is 13,000 light-years from Earth, it took a while before anyone could see it.
paras.zh: 当时，超新星尚未被发现。第谷星最终在 20 世纪 40 年代被归类为超新星。科学家现在认为这是一颗称为白矮星的小恒星，在数千年前爆炸。因为第谷星距离地球 13,000 光年，所以过了一段时间才有人看到它。

paras.en: The Tycho supernova, known technically as SN 1572, is known today as a Type Ia supernova, which is a star explosion in a binary star system in which a white dwarf star draws material away from its partner, then explodes. But in 1572, the Tycho supernova appeared as something very different: a bright new star.
paras.zh: 第谷超新星，技术上称为 SN 1572，今天被称为 Ia 型超新星，这是双星系统中的恒星爆炸，其中一颗白矮星从其伙伴那里吸取物质，然后爆炸。但在 1572 年，第谷超新星以一种截然不同的姿态出现：一颗明亮的新星。

paras.en: While Schulër was first, other astronomers also observed the apparently new star in the sky. Tycho Brahe's numerous observations are the most well known, in no small part becuause he wrote a book all about them in "De Stella Nova" (Latin for "On The New Star." At the time, the prevailing theory among scientists was that the stars were unchanging, yet here was a new star -- a changed sky.
paras.zh: 虽然舒勒是第一个，但其他天文学家也观察到了天空中这颗明显的新星。第谷·布拉赫的众多观察结果最为人所熟知，这在很大程度上是因为他在《De Stella Nova》（拉丁语，意为“论新星”）中写了一本关于这些观察结果的书。当时，科学家们流行的理论是，恒星是不变的，但这里却出现了一颗新星——一片改变了的天空。

paras.en: "The 16th century exploding star, which appeared in the constellation Cassiopeia, was seen in daylight for about two weeks, and remained visible to the naked eye for 16 months," the University of California Berkeley wrote in 2004. "Brahe's meticulous record of the brightening and dimming of the supernova now allows astronomers to identify its 'light signature" as that of a Type Ia supernova."
paras.zh: 加州大学伯克利分校在 2004 年写道：“这颗出现在仙后座的 16 世纪爆炸恒星，在白天可见了大约两周，肉眼可见的时间长达 16 个月。布拉赫对超新星变亮和变暗的细致记录现在使天文学家能够将其‘光特征’识别为 Ia 型超新星。”

paras.en: "This was at the end of the Dark Ages in Europe, and these observations were an important piece of evidence that the heavens were not immutable," astronomer Alex Filippenko, who led a 2004 study on the origins of the Tycho supernova, said at the time.
paras.zh: 天文学家亚历克斯·菲利彭科 (Alex Filippenko) 领导了 2004 年第谷超新星起源研究，他当时表示：“当时正值欧洲黑暗时代末期，这些观测结果是证明天空并非一成不变的重要证据。”

paras.en: Today, astronomers are closely watching another star that might explode. Called T Corona Borealis, or the Blaze Star, the object is expected to be on the verge of exploding in a nova (a star explosion that is smaller than a supernova and may not destroy the star). is one of 11 known stars observed to have recurring nova explosions within gaps of 100 years or so.
paras.zh: 今天，天文学家正在密切关注另一颗可能爆炸的恒星。该物体被称为T Corona Borealis，或火焰星，预计将处于新星爆炸的边缘（比超新星更小的恒星爆炸，可能不会摧毁恒星）。是观测到在 100 年左右的时间间隔内反复发生新星爆炸的 11 颗已知恒星之一。

paras.en: Want more space history? Check out our full On This Day In Space Story archive and watch our On This Day In Space videos on YouTube.
paras.zh: 想要更多太空历史吗？查看我们完整的“太空中的这一天”故事存档，并在 YouTube 上观看“太空中的这一天”视频。

paras.en: Hanneke Weitering is a multimedia journalist in the Pacific Northwest reporting on the future of aviation at FutureFlight.aero and Aviation International News and was previously the Editor for Spaceflight and Astronomy news here at Space.com. As an editor with over 10 years of experience in science journalism she has previously written for Scholastic Classroom Magazines, MedPage Today and The Joint Institute for Computational Sciences at Oak Ridge National Laboratory. After studying physics at the University of Tennessee in her hometown of Knoxville, she earned her graduate degree in Science, Health and Environmental Reporting (SHERP) from New York University. Hanneke joined the Space.com team in 2016 as a staff writer and producer, covering topics including spaceflight and astronomy. She currently lives in Seattle, home of the Space Needle, with her cat and two snakes. In her spare time, Hanneke enjoys exploring the Rocky Mountains, basking in nature and looking for dark skies to gaze at the cosmos.
paras.zh: Hanneke Weitering 是西北太平洋地区的一名多媒体记者，在 FutureFlight.aero 和 Aviation International News 报道航空业的未来，此前曾担任 Space.com 的航天和天文学新闻编辑。作为一名拥有 10 多年科学新闻经验的编辑，她曾为学术课堂杂志、MedPage Today 和橡树岭国家实验室计算科学研究所撰写文章。在家乡诺克斯维尔的田纳西大学学习物理学后，她在纽约大学获得了科学、健康和环境报告 (SHERP) 研究生学位。 Hanneke 于 2016 年加入 Space.com 团队，担任专职撰稿人和制作人，涵盖航天和天文学等主题。她目前与她的猫和两条蛇住在太空针塔所在地西雅图。在业余时间，汉内克喜欢探索落基山脉，沐浴在大自然中，寻找黑暗的天空凝视宇宙。

articles.title: SpaceX launches mystery mission for US Space Force in gorgeous sunset liftoff from California (photos)
articles.author: Mike Wall

paras.en: SpaceX just launched a classified mission for the U.S. military.
paras.zh: SpaceX 刚刚为美国军方启动了一项机密任务。

paras.en: A Falcon 9 rocket lifted off from California's Vandenberg Space Force Base this evening (Nov. 6) at 7:48 p.m. EST (4:48 p.m. local California time; 0048 GMT on Nov. 7), rising into the sky as the sun sank toward the Pacific.
paras.zh: 今晚（11 月 6 日）晚上 7 点 48 分，一枚猎鹰 9 号火箭从加利福尼亚州范登堡太空部队基地升空。美国东部时间（加利福尼亚州当地时间下午 4:48；格林尼治标准时间 11 月 7 日 0048），随着太阳落入太平洋而升入天空。

paras.en: The launch kicked off the USSF-432 mission for the U.S. Space Force, which we know little about. Neither SpaceX nor the Space Force told us much about USSF-432 beforehand, and we learned tonight; SpaceX cut its webcast off about 10 minutes into the flight, shortly after the Falcon 9's first stage came back to Earth for a landing.
paras.zh: 这次发射拉开了美国太空军 USSF-432 任务的序幕，对此我们知之甚少。 SpaceX 和太空部队事先都没有告诉我们太多有关 USSF-432 的信息，我们今晚才了解到；在猎鹰 9 号第一级返回地球着陆后不久，SpaceX 在飞行约 10 分钟后切断了网络直播。

paras.en: That touchdown occurred aboard the SpaceX droneship "Of Course I Still Love You," which was stationed downrange in the Pacific Ocean. It wrapped up the eighth flight for this particular booster, which is designated 1095.
paras.zh: 这次着陆发生在 SpaceX 无人机“当然我仍然爱你”上，该船驻扎在太平洋的下游。它完成了这个特殊助推器的第八次飞行，该助推器被指定为 1095。

paras.en: The Falcon 9's upper stage, meanwhile, continued carrying its mystery payload skyward. It could be headed to low Earth orbit, outside observers speculate.
paras.zh: 与此同时，猎鹰 9 号的上级继续将其神秘有效载荷升向天空。外部观察家推测，它可能会前往近地轨道。

paras.en: "It is possibly a batch of classified LEO satellites for the USSF's Space Based Sensing and Targeting (SBST) portfolio based on SpaceX's Starshield satellite bus, based on locations of rocket stage drop zones being exact fits with previous Starlink Group 15 launches," NextSpaceflight.com wrote in a mission description.
paras.zh: NextSpaceflight.com 在任务描述中写道：“这可能是 USSF 天基传感和瞄准 (SBST) 产品组合的一批机密 LEO 卫星，基于 SpaceX 的 Starshield 卫星总线，其火箭级降落区的位置与之前的 Starlink Group 15 发射完全吻合。”

paras.en: Starlink is SpaceX's LEO broadband megaconstellation, which consists of more than 11,000 active satellites. Starshield is a similar system designed to provide services to the U.S. military and its allies. Starshield satellites are believed to be based heavily on the Starlink spacecraft bus.
paras.zh: Starlink 是 SpaceX 的 LEO 宽带巨型星座，由 11,000 多颗活跃卫星组成。星盾是一个类似的系统，旨在为美国军方及其盟友提供服务。据信，星盾卫星主要基于星链航天器总线。

paras.en: USSF-432 was the 119th Falcon 9 launch of 2026, and the 14th national-security flight of the rocket so far this year. The vast majority of Falcon 9 missions in 2026 — more than 70% — have been devoted to building out the Starlink megaconstellation.
paras.zh: USSF-432 是猎鹰 9 号 2026 年第 119 次发射，也是今年迄今为止该火箭的第 14 次国家安全飞行。 2026 年猎鹰 9 号任务的绝大多数（超过 70%）都致力于建设星链巨型星座。

paras.en: SpaceX has also launched six other missions this year. Three were operational flights of the company's Falcon Heavy rocket, while the other three were test missions of its next-gen Starship vehicle. SpaceX plans to retire both the Falcon 9 and Falcon Heavy shortly after the fully reusable Starship, the biggest and most powerful rocket ever built, is up and running.
paras.zh: SpaceX 今年还发射了其他六次任务。其中三架是该公司猎鹰重型火箭的运行飞行，另外三架是其下一代星舰飞行器的测试任务。 SpaceX 计划在完全可重复使用的星际飞船（有史以来最大、最强大的火箭）投入运行后不久，让猎鹰 9 号和猎鹰重型火箭退役。

paras.en: Michael Wall is the Spaceflight and Tech Editor for Space.com and joined the team in 2010. He primarily covers human and robotic spaceflight, military space, and exoplanets, but has been known to dabble in the space art beat. His book about the search for alien life, "Out There," was published on Nov. 13, 2018. Before becoming a science writer, Michael worked as a herpetologist and wildlife biologist. He has a Ph.D. in evolutionary biology from the University of Sydney, Australia, a bachelor's degree from the University of Arizona, and a graduate certificate in science writing from the University of California, Santa Cruz. To find out what his latest project is, you can follow Michael on Twitter.
paras.zh: Michael Wall 是 Space.com 的太空飞行和技术编辑，于 2010 年加入该团队。他主要报道人类和机器人太空飞行、军事太空和系外行星，但以涉足太空艺术领域而闻名。他关于寻找外星生命的书《Out There》于 2018 年 11 月 13 日出版。在成为科普作家之前，迈克尔曾是一名爬行动物学家和野生动物生物学家。他拥有博士学位。澳大利亚悉尼大学进化生物学博士学位、亚利桑那大学学士学位以及加州大学圣克鲁斯分校科学写作研究生证书。要了解他的最新项目是什么，您可以在 Twitter 上关注 Michael。
