paras.zh: 公众的愤怒日益强烈。当参议员们周五进行审议时，抗议者要求退回被冻结的储蓄，并为上野的失败承担责任，他们在亚松森市中心游行，高呼“桑蒂佩纳到塔库姆布！” ——指的是首都的主要监狱，上野的创始人兼前首席执行官米格尔·巴斯克斯 (Miguel Vázquez) 目前被关押在那里。

paras.en: "This was an enormous betrayal of trust," said Yinal López, a worker at the state electricity company, whose employee pension fund also had money at Ueno.
paras.zh: “这是对信任的巨大背叛，”国家电力公司的员工伊纳尔·洛佩斯 (Yinal López) 说，该公司的员工养老基金也在上野有资金。

paras.en: Peña's fall, from feted Washington ally meeting with U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent in late October to prisoner in his own home, came at dizzying speed.
paras.zh: 佩纳从 10 月底与美国财政部长斯科特·贝森特会面时受到盛赞的华盛顿盟友，到被囚禁在自己家里，其倒台速度令人目眩。

paras.en: Ueno was seized before dawn Tuesday. By Thursday afternoon, Peña had offered to resign as his conservative Colorado Party turned on him, led by former president Horacio Cartes, the party chief and Peña's longtime mentor. By Friday, he was under arrest, with impeachment denying him the immunity he would have enjoyed if the Senate had accepted his resignation.
paras.zh: 周二黎明前，上野被抓获。周四下午，佩纳提出辞职，因为他所在的保守派科罗拉多党对他发起了攻击，该党由前总统奥拉西奥·卡特斯（Horacio Cartes）领导，该党主席也是佩纳的长期导师。到周五，他被捕，弹劾剥夺了他在参议院接受他的辞呈时本应享有的豁免权。

paras.en: A telegenic technocrat and a former International Monetary Fund economist, Peña owed his political ascent to Cartes, a tobacco magnate who made him finance minister and twice backed him for president.
paras.zh: 佩纳是一位上镜的技术专家和前国际货币基金组织经济学家，他的政治崛起归功于烟草大亨卡特斯，卡特斯任命他为财政部长，并两次支持他竞选总统。

paras.en: Once in office, though, Peña quietly amassed a rival power base, analysts say. Ueno, flush with public funds, became its linchpin.
paras.zh: 不过，分析人士称，佩纳上任后就悄悄积累了竞争对手的权力基础。拥有充足公共资金的上野成为其关键人物。

paras.en: "It's like a Shakespearean drama. He tried to displace his mentor, his political patron," said Miguel Carter, director of DEMOS, a Paraguayan research centre. "But he did so on very fragile grounds."
paras.zh: “这就像一部莎士比亚戏剧。他试图取代他的导师、他的政治赞助人，”巴拉圭研究中心 DEMOS 主任米格尔·卡特 (Miguel Carter) 说。 “但他这样做的理由非常脆弱。”

paras.en: Police stand guard outside of a closed Ueno Bank branch in Nemby, Paraguay, on Tuesday. (Cesar Olmedo/Reuters)
paras.zh: 周二，警察在巴拉圭内姆比一家已关闭的上野银行分行外守卫。 （塞萨尔·奥尔梅多/路透社）

paras.en: Cartes struck back. In September, senators loyal to him demanded answers from the central bank about Ueno's lending, citing leaked internal reports that warned its loans to related companies put its solvency at risk.
paras.zh: 卡特斯进行了反击。 9月，忠于他的参议员要求央行就上野的贷款问题给出答案，理由是泄露的内部报告警告上野向相关公司提供的贷款将使其偿付能力面临风险。

paras.en: When Ueno collapsed this week, so did Peña's leverage, and Cartes, once sanctioned by the U.S. Treasury over alleged corruption, publicly called for the ouster of his erstwhile protégé.
paras.zh: 当上野本周垮台时，佩尼亚的影响力也随之垮台，卡特斯曾因涉嫌腐败而受到美国财政部的制裁，公开呼吁推翻他昔日的门生。

paras.en: "Cartes put the nail in the coffin," said Andrew Nickson, a Paraguay expert at the University of Birmingham. "Peña had no political base to rely on, and he was left high and dry."
paras.zh: 伯明翰大学的巴拉圭专家安德鲁·尼克森说：“卡特在棺材上钉下了钉子。” “佩纳没有可以依赖的政治基础，他陷入了困境。”

paras.en: A view of the headquarters of Ueno Bank in Asunción, on Tuesday. (Jorge Saenz/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 周二，亚松森上野银行总部一景。 （豪尔赫·萨恩斯/美联社）

articles.title: Cornell faculty vote no confidence in university's leadership

paras.en: Cornell faculty vote no confidence in university's leadership
paras.zh: 康奈尔大学教师对大学领导层投票不信任

paras.en: Advocates hope symbolic vote will pressure school to address longstanding institutional failures
paras.zh: 支持者希望象征性投票能够向学校施压，解决长期存在的制度缺陷

paras.en: The faculty senate of Cornell University approved a resolution Friday declaring no confidence in the school's top leaders, a symbolic gesture reflecting deep discontent on campus in the wake of a former student's lawsuit saying she was gang raped at a fraternity party in 2024.
paras.zh: 康奈尔大学教师参议院周五批准了一项决议，宣布对学校最高领导人不信任，这一象征性举动反映了校园内对一名前学生提起诉讼，称她在 2024 年在兄弟会聚会上遭到轮奸后的强烈不满。

paras.en: The resolution passed 75-50, with five faculty senators abstaining and five others not voting, according to an email sent to senate members on Friday afternoon.
paras.zh: 根据周五下午发送给参议院成员的一封电子邮件，该决议以 75 比 50 获得通过，其中五名教职参议员弃权，另外五名没有投票。

paras.en: The vote followed weeks of debate among professors over whether Cornell President Michael Kotlikoff and other administrators handled the woman's allegations properly and have done enough to curtail sexual misconduct at the prestigious Ithaca, N.Y., university.
paras.zh: 此次投票之前，教授们就康奈尔大学校长迈克尔·科特利科夫(Michael Kotlikoff)和其他管理人员是否妥善处理了这名女子的指控，以及是否采取了足够的措施来遏制纽约伊萨卡这所著名大学的不当性行为进行了数周的辩论。

paras.en: While the faculty body has no power over the university's top leaders, backers of the resolution had said they hoped it would pressure Cornell's trustees to address longstanding institutional failures they identified.
paras.zh: 虽然教职员工团体对大学高层领导没有权力，但该决议的支持者表示，他们希望该决议能够向康奈尔大学的受托人施加压力，解决他们发现的长期存在的机构缺陷。

paras.en: Board of Trustees chair Anne Smalling said in a statement the faculty vote "reflects the deep anger across our campus" and sent a clear signal that what happened to the woman was unacceptable, but added that Kotlikoff and his administration were the right leaders to "thoughtfully and comprehensively" address the issue.
paras.zh: 董事会主席安妮·斯莫林在一份声明中表示，教职员工的投票“反映了整个校园的深深愤怒”，并发出了一个明确的信号，即发生在这名妇女身上的事情是不可接受的，但她补充说，科特利科夫和他的政府是“深思熟虑和全面”解决这一问题的正确领导人。

paras.en: Thomas Giuffra, an attorney for the woman who filed the lawsuit, expressed hope in a statement that "this will be yet another step forward to educate and support the Cornell community by addressing the longstanding scourge of sexual assault on campus."
paras.zh: 提起诉讼的女子的律师托马斯·朱夫拉(Thomas Giuffra)在一份声明中表示希望“通过解决校园内长期存在的性侵犯祸害，这将是教育和支持康奈尔社区的又一步。”

paras.en: The Cornell community has been distressed since mid-September, when a former student, identified only by the pseudonym Jane Doe in court documents, filed a lawsuit against the university and seven former members of the Chi Phi fraternity, saying she was given ketamine and raped at a fraternity house in October 2024.
paras.zh: 自 9 月中旬以来，康奈尔大学社区一直陷入困境，当时一名前学生（法庭文件中仅化名 Jane Doe）对大学和 Chi Phi 兄弟会的七名前成员提起诉讼，称她于 2024 年 10 月在兄弟会之家服用氯胺酮并遭到强奸。

paras.en: All of the men have denied her allegations, saying the sex was consensual or that they weren't involved. The local district attorney initially decided the woman had consented to the encounter and that no crime had been committed, but the investigation has since been reopened and handed to New York's attorney general.
paras.zh: 所有男子都否认了她的指控，称性行为是双方自愿的，或者他们没有参与。当地地方检察官最初判定该女子同意了这次遭遇，并且没有犯下任何罪行，但此后调查已重新启动并移交给纽约总检察长。

paras.en: Cornell disciplined several of the accused students following a monthslong investigation.
paras.zh: 经过长达一个月的调查，康奈尔大学对几名被指控的学生进行了纪律处分。

paras.en: Kotlikoff also convened a task force to study the problem of sexual misconduct on campus, which released certain recommendations.
paras.zh: 科特里科夫还召集了一个工作组来研究校园内的不当性行为问题，并发布了一些建议。

paras.en: Some faculty members have criticized Kotlikoff for not acting more forcefully to strengthen the school's disciplinary process, push for criminal investigations and change campus party culture.
paras.zh: 一些教职员工批评科特里科夫没有采取更有力的行动来加强学校的纪律程序、推动刑事调查和改变校园党文化。

paras.en: Speaking to faculty senate members on the first day that they debated the no-confidence resolution, Kotlikoff pledged to make the university a leader in addressing sexual assault and asked for more time to make changes.
paras.zh: 在对不信任决议进行辩论的第一天，科特里科夫在教职参议院成员面前发表讲话，承诺让学校成为解决性侵犯问题的领导者，并要求更多时间做出改变。

paras.en: Kotlikoff defended his leadership, arguing that replacing him would do little to solve complex problems and could damage Cornell's reputation. He acknowledged he had not read the campus police report, explaining that university policy barred top administrators from interfering in criminal investigations. He also rejected suggestions he had been indifferent to the woman's case, though he acknowledged only recently learning she had left Cornell.
paras.zh: 科特里科夫为自己的领导地位进行了辩护，认为取代他对解决复杂问题无济于事，而且可能会损害康奈尔大学的声誉。他承认自己没有读过校园警察的报告，并解释说大学政策禁止高级管理人员干预刑事调查。他还否认了他对这名女子的案件漠不关心的说法，尽管他承认最近才得知她已经离开康奈尔大学。

paras.en: A Cornell University banner hangs in Willard Straight Hall during a town hall meeting about the university’s handling of the case, in Ithaca, N.Y. on Oct. 6. (Angelina Katsanis/Reuters)
paras.zh: 10 月 6 日，在纽约州伊萨卡举行的关于该大学处理此案的市政厅会议上，康奈尔大学的横幅悬挂在 Willard Straight Hall。（Angelina Katsanis/路透社）

paras.en: Some professors had said faculty should wait to vote until the release of an independent investigation by former U.S. deputy attorney general Sally Yates, whom the university hired to examine Cornell's inital response to the rape report in 2024 and its overall procedures for handling similar reports.
paras.zh: 一些教授表示，教师们应该等到美国前副总检察长莎莉·耶茨(Sally Yates)发布独立调查结果后才投票。康奈尔大学聘请耶茨负责审查康奈尔大学对 2024 年强奸报告的初步反应以及处理类似报告的总体程序。

paras.en: Yasmeen Masoud, a Cornell undergrad who spoke Friday at a news conference organized by the resolution's sponsors, called the vote encouraging for students frustrated with the university's response.
paras.zh: 康奈尔大学本科生亚斯明·马苏德周五在该决议发起人组织的新闻发布会上发表讲话，他称这次投票对那些对大学反应感到沮丧的学生来说是鼓舞人心的。

paras.en: "We should not have to beg for answers, demand basic transparency or generate media attention just to get our concerns acknowledged," she said. "It reminds us that there are people across this university who care deeply about its future and are willing to stand together to demand a better Cornell."
paras.zh: “我们不应该仅仅为了让我们的担忧得到承认而乞求答案、要求基本的透明度或引起媒体关注，”她说。 “这提醒我们，这所大学里有人深切关心其未来，并愿意团结起来要求一个更好的康奈尔大学。”

paras.en: The no-confidence resolution did not call for Kotlikoff's resignation.
paras.zh: 不信任决议并未要求科特利科夫辞职。

articles.title: Zambia's civil service overhaul raises questions

paras.en: Many people living in Zambia seek careers in the civil service because of the stability and security traditionally associated with government employment. But recent retirements, dismissals and restructuring exercises across several public institutions have unsettled that perception and sparked a national debate about the government's use of "national interest" provisions.
paras.zh: 许多生活在赞比亚的人寻求公务员职业，因为传统上与政府就业相关的稳定和安全。但最近多个公共机构的退休、解雇和重组活动动摇了这种看法，并引发了关于政府使用“国家利益”条款的全国性辩论。

paras.en: Among those affected is former public relations officer Godfrey Chilabi, whose departure from the Zambia Police Service was announced in October. Choosing not to publicly discuss the circumstances surrounding his exit, Chilabi simply told media that he had been retired in the national interest.
paras.zh: 受影响的人包括前公共关系官员戈弗雷·奇拉比（Godfrey Chilabi），他于 10 月宣布离开赞比亚警察局。奇拉比选择不公开讨论他退出的情况，他只是告诉媒体​​，他是为了国家利益而退休的。

paras.en: "Yes, I have been retired in national interest," Chilabi said. "I can't give any reason, but know I'm in retirement."
paras.zh: “是的，为了国家利益，我已经退休了，”奇拉比说。 “我无法给出任何理由，但我知道我已经退休了。”

paras.en: Chilabi's departure came amid a series of changes affecting public institutions in Zambia.
paras.zh: 奇拉比的离职正值赞比亚公共机构发生一系列变化之际。

paras.en: Charity Munganga, a Zambia Police Service deputy inspector general, was dismissed, and all staff members at the Zambia Medicines and Medical Supplies Agency were let go as part of a "reset" following a government audit.
paras.zh: 赞比亚警察局副总监查里蒂·蒙甘加被解雇，赞比亚药品和医疗用品局的所有工作人员都被解雇，作为政府审计后“重置”的一部分。

paras.en: Additionally, all directors in senior management at the Zambia Environmental Management Agency (ZEMA) were put on administrative leave to facilitate an institutional realignment exercise.
paras.zh: 此外，赞比亚环境管理局（ZEMA）的所有高级管理层董事都被安排行政休假，以促进机构重组。

paras.en: The affected ZEMA directors will be assessed for their competence, performance and suitability for their positions before a final decision is made on whether they will be reinstated or separated from the institution, according to an October 20 statement by the Green Economy and Environment Ministry cited by the news portal Mwebantu.
paras.zh: 新闻门户网站 Mwebantu 援引绿色经济和环境部 10 月 20 日的一份声明称，受影响的 ZEMA 董事将接受能力、绩效和职位适合性评估，然后才能做出是否复职或从该机构离职的最终决定。

paras.en: The issue moved to the center of public debate in October, when opposition lawmakers questioned the government in parliament over retirements and dismissals taking place across public institutions following Zambia's general election in August.
paras.zh: 十月份，这个问题成为公众辩论的焦点，当时反对派立法者在赞比亚八月份大选后就公共机构中发生的退休和解雇问题向议会政府提出质疑。

paras.en: Governance and political commentator Andrew Nguvu told DW that retirements carried out in the national interest raise important questions about transparency, fairness and the protection of a professional public service.
paras.zh: 治理和政治评论员安德鲁·恩古武 (Andrew Nguvu) 告诉德国之声，为了国家利益而进行的退休引发了有关透明度、公平性和专业公共服务保护的重要问题。

paras.en: "If at all, there are legitimate reasons for retiring any particular civil servant, then obviously the government should clearly explain," Nguvu said.
paras.zh: 恩古武说：“如果有正当理由让任何特定公务员退休，那么显然政府应该明确解释。”

paras.en: He said public institutions should operate according to established procedures and the law rather than political considerations that could undermine institutional independence.
paras.zh: 他表示，公共机构应按照既定程序和法律运作，而不是根据可能破坏机构独立性的政治考虑。

paras.en: Zambian law allows service commissions to retire established officers in the national interest under provisions governing public service employment. Previous governments have also used the measure. However, the current exercise has generated significant scrutiny because it is occurring alongside broader restructuring efforts affecting multiple institutions.
paras.zh: 赞比亚法律允许服务委员会根据公共服务就业条款，为了国家利益而退休现有官员。历届政府也曾使用过这一措施。然而，目前的行动引起了严格的审查，因为它是与影响多个机构的更广泛的重组工作同时进行的。

paras.en: Critics argue that the issue is particularly sensitive because Zambia's ruling United Party for National Development (UPND) previously opposed the use of retirements in the national interest while in opposition.
paras.zh: 批评者认为，这个问题特别敏感，因为赞比亚执政的国家发展联合党(UPND)此前在反对党期间反对为了国家利益而利用退休金。

paras.en: As a result, opposition lawmakers, led by Stephen Kampyongo, have criticized the measures, which they view as inconsistent with the ruling party's earlier position.
paras.zh: 因此，以斯蒂芬·坎皮永戈（Stephen Kampyongo）为首的反对派议员批评了这些措施，他们认为这些措施与执政党此前的立场不一致。

paras.en: Kampyongo, speaking during Vice President's Question Time in the National Assembly on October 17, asked what assurances the government was giving public servants, who are "working in fear," and what measures were being taken to ensure that government workers retired in the national interest did not become destitute.
paras.zh: 坎平戈于 10 月 17 日在国民议会副总统质询时间发言，询问政府向“在恐惧中工作”的公务员提供哪些保证，以及采取哪些措施确保为国家利益退休的政府工作人员不会陷入贫困。

paras.en: Responding on behalf of the government, Vice President Mutale Nalumango rejected suggestions that the exercise amounted to a political purge and described it as part of a lawful process of institutional realignment.
paras.zh: 副总统穆塔莱·纳卢曼戈代表政府回应，否认此次演习相当于政治清洗的说法，并将其描述为机构重组合法程序的一部分。

paras.en: Nalumango acknowledged the concerns surrounding the changes but defended the government's authority to make personnel adjustments within the public service framework.
paras.zh: 纳卢曼戈承认对这些变化的担忧，但捍卫了政府在公共服务框架内进行人事调整的权力。

paras.en: "As provided for in section 39 of the Public Service Pensions Act, there are situations that arise and people fall by the way side," Nalumango told the parliament. "[It is] unfortunate that a life was lost, but maybe it is an issue that public servants/public service workers must brace themselves for."
paras.zh: 纳卢曼戈对议会表示：“根据《公共服务养老金法》第 39 条的规定，在某些情况下，人们会半途而废。” “不幸的是，有人丧生，但也许这是公务员/公共服务工作者必须做好准备的问题。”

paras.en: Nalumango's comments have been cited by critics as evidence that additional changes could occur as the government continues to restructure public institutions.
paras.zh: 纳卢曼戈的评论被批评者引用作为证据，表明随着政府继续重组公共机构，可能会发生更多变化。

paras.en: The debate has been amplified by comments from UPND National Youth Chairperson Gilbert Liswaniso, who said governments naturally sought to work with people aligned with their vision.
paras.zh: UPND全国青年主席吉尔伯特·里斯瓦尼索的评论加剧了这场争论，他表示，政府自然会寻求与与他们的愿景一致的人合作。

paras.en: "Every political party [that] comes to power has to flush out!" Liswaniso said. "[It] has to work with the people aligned with the vision of that political party!"
paras.zh: “每个上台的政党都必须退出！”利斯瓦尼索说道。 “[它]必须与与该政党愿景一致的人们合作！”

paras.en: Critics say such statements reinforce concerns that political considerations may be influencing decisions within the public service.
paras.zh: 批评人士表示，此类声明加剧了人们的担忧，即政治考虑可能会影响公共服务部门的决策。

paras.en: The civil rights activist David Chishimba rejects the notion that perceived political affiliation should determine a person's future in government employment.
paras.zh: 民权活动家大卫·奇辛巴（David Chishimba）拒绝接受这样一种观点，即政治立场应该决定一个人在政府就业的未来。

paras.en: "The constitution, however, is very clear on this," Chishimba told DW. "It restricts public officers from participating in partisan politics while in office. This safeguards an impartial civil service. However, it does not prohibit private political belief or otherwise."
paras.zh: “然而，宪法对此非常明确，”奇辛巴告诉德国之声。 “它限制公职人员在任职期间参与党派政治。这保障了公务员队伍的公正性。但是，它并不禁止私人政治信仰或其他方面。”

paras.en: Chishimba said civil servants served the country rather than any political organization. "Civil servants serve Zambia," he said, "not a party, the president or a campaign."
paras.zh: 奇辛巴说，公务员是为国家服务，而不是为任何政治组织服务。 “公务员为赞比亚服务，”他说，“而不是为政党、总统或竞选活动服务。”

paras.en: Nguvu said the shift was deeply unsettling for public workers caught in the middle of the administrative realignments.
paras.zh: 恩古武表示，这一转变对于陷入行政重组的公职人员来说深感不安。

paras.en: The measures come as the cost of living and household debt burdens increase in Zambia.
paras.zh: 这些措施出台之际，赞比亚的生活成本和家庭债务负担不断增加。

paras.en: Nguvu said abrupt personnel changes could affect morale throughout the public service and leave workers uncertain about their professional future.
paras.zh: 恩古武表示，突然的人事变动可能会影响整个公共服务部门的士气，并使员工对自己的职业未来感到不确定。

paras.en: "This can weaken morale and help to destroy institutional memory," Nguvu said. "Most of these decisions lack clear explanations."
paras.zh: “这会削弱士气并有助于破坏机构记忆，”恩古武说。 “大多数这些决定都缺乏明确的解释。”

paras.en: Nguvu said such concerns had become more acute when explanations for personnel decisions were not communicated clearly.
paras.zh: Nguvu 表示，当对人事决定的解释没有得到明确传达时，这种担忧变得更加严重。

paras.en: The reported dismissals have also raised concerns among civil society groups about due process and accountability.
paras.zh: 据报道，解雇事件还引起了民间社会团体对正当程序和问责制的担忧。

paras.en: Chishimba, who is also the president of the Zambia Council of Activists (ZACA), called for greater transparency from the authorities.
paras.zh: 奇辛巴也是赞比亚​​活动家委员会（ZACA）主席，他呼吁当局提高透明度。

paras.en: "ZACA respectfully calls on the government to publish the names and evidence of those facing dismissal, submit every case to due process, and allow the Civil Service Commission to assert its constitutional independence," Chishimba said
paras.zh: 奇辛巴说：“ZACA 恭敬地呼吁政府公布面临解雇者的姓名和证据，将每个案件提交正当程序，并允许公务员制度委员会维护其宪法独立性。”

articles.title: Ueno Bank scandal plunges Paraguay into political crisis

paras.en: The Ueno Bank collapse is turning into one of the biggest financial and political scandals in the history of Paraguay. At issue are suspected banking irregularities, hundreds of millions of dollars in public funds, and business ties between the bank and the country's president, Santiago Pena.
paras.zh: 上野银行倒闭正在成为巴拉圭历史上最大的金融和政治丑闻之一。问题包括涉嫌银行业违规行为、数亿美元的公共资金以及该银行与该国总统圣地亚哥·佩纳之间的商业关系。

paras.en: The crisis was triggered on November 3, when the Paraguayan central bank (BCP) initiated resolution procedures against Ueno after determining that it had breached minimum solvency requirements. The public prosecutor has since announced three investigations into suspected financial crimes. 27 individuals have already been formally charged.
paras.zh: 此次危机于 11 月 3 日引发，当时巴拉圭中央银行 (BCP) 在确定 Ueno 违反了最低偿付能力要求后启动了针对 Ueno 的解决程序。此后，检察官宣布对涉嫌金融犯罪进行三项调查。已有 27 人受到正式指控。

paras.en: Pressure on President Pena intensified. On November 5, he tendered his resignation, but the Paraguayan Congress did not accept it. Instead, the Chamber of Deputies voted unanimously to impeach him. A joint session of both legislative chambers was called to consider the resignation, but the session was not quorate, so no decision could be taken. Pena remains in office for now, and the Senate has opened impeachment proceedings.
paras.zh: 佩纳总统面临的压力越来越大。 11月5日，他提出辞呈，但巴拉圭国会没有接受。相反，众议院一致投票弹劾他。两院联席会议被召集审议辞职，但会议未达到法定人数，因此无法做出决定。佩纳目前仍留任，参议院已启动弹劾程序。

paras.en: Ueno Bank is a Paraguayan digital bank belonging to the Grupo Vazquez, a big Paraguayan conglomerate. Launched in 2021, it expanded remarkably fast: It recently had around three million customers, almost half the population of Paraguay. At the same time, there were warnings that the bank might have extended excessive loans to companies associated with its owners.
paras.zh: Ueno Bank 是一家巴拉圭数字银行，隶属于巴拉圭大型企业集团 Grupo Vazquez。该公司于 2021 年推出，扩张速度非常快：最近拥有约 300 万客户，几乎相当于巴拉圭人口的一半。与此同时，有人警告称，该银行可能向与其所有者相关的公司提供了过多的贷款。

paras.en: On November 3, 2026, the Paraguayan Central Bank (BCP) intervened, having determined that the bank had breached minimum solvency requirements: It no longer had sufficient capital to provide security for risks it had incurred. Business operations were abruptly suspended, leaving millions of customers unable to access their accounts.
paras.zh: 2026 年 11 月 3 日，巴拉圭中央银行 (BCP) 进行干预，认定该银行违反了最低偿付能力要求：它不再有足够的资本为其所发生的风险提供担保。业务运营突然暂停，导致数百万客户无法访问他们的帐户。

paras.en: Investigations are primarily focused on three potential problems.
paras.zh: 调查主要集中在三个潜在问题。

paras.en: First, Ueno Bank is believed to have extended credit to other companies from the same group, and these may have exceeded legal limits.
paras.zh: 首先，据信上野银行向同一集团的其他公司提供了信贷，这些信贷可能已经超出了法定限额。

paras.en: Some business dealings may also have served to conceal the lack of capital, and make the bank's financial situation appear better than it actually was.
paras.zh: 一些业务往来也可能掩盖了资本的缺乏，使银行的财务状况看起来比实际情况要好。

paras.en: There is also the question of why the Central Bank didn't intervene sooner, despite indications that there were problems.
paras.zh: 还有一个问题是，尽管有迹象表明存在问题，但央行为何不尽早干预。

paras.en: How much public money is managed by Ueno Bank?
paras.zh: 上野银行管理着多少公共资金？

paras.en: Ueno Bank held huge deposits of public money. Its most important investors include the Instituto de Prevision Social (IPS), the Paraguayan social security agency responsible for pensions and social welfare payments. According to media reports, Ueno Bank administers public funds totalling as much as 800 to 850 million US dollars.
paras.zh: 上野银行持有大量公款存款。其最重要的投资者包括负责养老金和社会福利支付的巴拉圭社会保障机构Instituto de Prevision Social (IPS)。据媒体报道，上野银行管理的公共资金总额高达800至8.5亿美元。

paras.en: Not only is the size of the amount problematic, so is the concentration of public funds in a single financial institution — one that has had to be placed under state control. Other state institutions are also said to have continued to deposit funds with the bank.
paras.zh: 不仅数额大小存在问题，而且公共资金集中在单一金融机构中也存在问题——该机构必须置于国家控制之下。据说其他国家机构也继续在该银行存入资金。

paras.en: This raises questions about how state institutions make their investment decisions, and the risks to which they have exposed public funds.
paras.zh: 这引发了关于国家机构如何做出投资决策以及它们使公共资金面临的风险的问题。

paras.en: What are the bank's connections to Santiago Pena?
paras.zh: 该银行与圣地亚哥佩纳有什么关系？

paras.en: There is Pena's business relationship with Grupo Vazquez, to which the Ueno Bank belongs. The Paraguayan president maintained business connections with the conglomerate until March 2025, long after his election as head of state. However, he denies having had any direct involvement with the bank.
paras.zh: Pena 与上野银行所属的 Grupo Vazquez 存在业务关系。这位巴拉圭总统在 2025 年 3 月之前一直与该集团保持业务联系，此时距他当选国家元首很久之后。不过，他否认与该银行有任何直接参与。

paras.en: On the other hand, Pena's appointment of Carlos Carvallo as president of the Central Bank in 2023 has come under scrutiny. The decision is controversial because until then Carvallo was the chair of the finance company that became Ueno Bank, Financiero Ueno. It raises questions about possible conflict of interest, and the independence of banking supervision.
paras.zh: 另一方面，佩纳任命卡洛斯·卡瓦洛于2023年担任央行行长也受到密切关注。这一决定颇具争议，因为在此之前卡瓦洛一直担任上野银行金融公司 Financiero Ueno 的董事长。它引发了有关可能的利益冲突和银行监管独立性的问题。

paras.en: Carvallo resigned on November 3, at Pena's request.
paras.zh: 应佩纳的要求，卡瓦洛于 11 月 3 日辞职。

paras.en: On November 4, the public prosecutor's office formally charged 27 people: eight Ueno Bank executives, and 19 others with connections to companies associated with the bank.
paras.zh: 11 月 4 日，检察机关正式对 27 人提出指控，其中包括 8 名上野银行高管和 19 名与该银行相关公司有联系的人。

paras.en: The investigations are looking into suspected breach of trust, attempted fraud, breach of duty in crisis situations, and violation of the legal obligation to keep records.
paras.zh: 调查正在调查涉嫌违反信任、企图欺诈、危机情况下失职以及违反保存记录的法律义务的行为。

paras.en: On November 5, a judge remanded several former bank executives in custody, including Federico Miguel Vazquez Villasanti, the president of Grupo Vazquez. Two other accused were placed under house arrest.
paras.zh: 11 月 5 日，法官将几名前银行高管还押，其中包括巴斯克斯集团总裁费德里科·米格尔·巴斯克斯·维拉桑蒂 (Federico Miguel Vazquez Villasanti)。另外两名被告被软禁。

paras.en: The Central Bank has initiated winding-up proceedings against Ueno Bank. Deposits of sums up to the equivalent of 37,600 US dollars per customer are protected by law. A law has also been passed that will enable around 20,000 US dollars per saver to be paid out early. However, it is still not clear when the affected customers will actually get their money back, or what will happen to deposits greater than the legally protected maximum.
paras.zh: 央行已对上野银行启动清算程序。每个客户最多相当于 37,600 美元的存款受法律保护。一项法律也已通过，允许每个储户提前支付约 20,000 美元。然而，目前尚不清楚受影响的客户何时能真正收回资金，也不清楚超过法定保护上限的存款会怎样。

paras.en: The political situation is more complicated. Santiago Pena tendered his resignation, but remains in office. A joint session of the two chambers of Congress could not decide whether or not to accept his resignation as the meeting was not quorate. The Senate has now initiated impeachment proceedings on charges of serious breaches of duty. Pena has announced that he will face the proceedings and exercise his right to defend himself.
paras.zh: 政治局势更加复杂。圣地亚哥·佩纳提出辞呈，但仍留任。由于会议未达到法定人数，国会两院联席会议无法决定是否接受他的辞职。参议院现已以严重失职指控启动弹劾程序。佩纳宣布他将面对诉讼并行使为自己辩护的权利。

paras.en: What is at stake here is political immunity. If Pena leaves office in a regular way – by resigning — he will automatically become a senator for life, and this will give him parliamentary immunity from prosecution. If he is impeached, he loses this status, and can be prosecuted.
paras.zh: 这里的关键在于政治豁免权。如果佩纳以正常方式离任——通过辞职——他将自动成为终身参议员，这将使他获得议会免受起诉的豁免权。如果他被弹劾，他就会失去这一地位，并可能受到起诉。

paras.en: Should Pena leave office, the constitution decrees that his vice-president, Pedro Alliana, would take over as president. Congress would then have to elect a new vice-president. The current term of office runs until August 2028.
paras.zh: 如果佩纳离任，宪法规定他的副总统佩德罗·阿利亚纳将接任总统。然后国会必须选举一位新的副总统。目前任期至2028年8月。

paras.en: This article has been translated from German.
paras.zh: 本文是从德文翻译而来。

articles.title: US asks China to uphold Busan trade deal commitments

paras.en: Top officials of United States President Donald Trump's administration have called on China to "fully and immediately" implement its commitments under a 2025 trade agreement between the two nations, including on rare earth and other critical minerals.
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普政府的高级官员呼吁中国“立即全面”履行其在2025年两国贸易协定中的承诺，包括稀土和其他关键矿产的承诺。

paras.en: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and Trade Representative Jamieson Greer on Friday held a videoconference with Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng on the trade and economic relationship between Washington and Beijing, a statement from Greer's office said.
paras.zh: 格里尔办公室的一份声明称，美国财政部长斯科特·贝森特和贸易代表杰米森·格里尔周五与中国国务院副总理何立峰就华盛顿和北京之间的贸易和经济关系举行了视频会议。

paras.en: Greer "emphasized the critical importance of China taking concrete actions to fully implement its past commitments, particularly as they relate to agricultural purchases, rare earths, and other critical minerals.” it added.
paras.zh: 格里尔“强调中国采取具体行动全面履行其过去的承诺至关重要，特别是在农产品采购、稀土和其他关键矿产方面。”它补充道。

paras.en: The US officials were referring to an accord reached between the world's two largest economies in 2025 in a meeting between Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping in South Korea's Busan, on the sidelines of an Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit.
paras.zh: 美国官员指的是特朗普与中国国家主席习近平在亚太经济合作组织 (APEC) 峰会期间在韩国釜山举行的会晤中，世界最大的两个经济体于 2025 年达成的协议。

paras.en: The deal had been reached during a period that saw the two countries exchange tariff escalations prompted by Trump's wider tariffs policy, which particularly targeted China, among other countries.
paras.zh: 该协议是在特朗普更广泛的关税政策（特别针对中国等国家）促使两国关税升级的时期达成的。

paras.en: The accord capped US tariffs on Chinese goods — enforced during Trump's second stint as president — at about 20%.
paras.zh: 该协议将美国对中国商品征收的关税（在特朗普第二任总统期间实施）限制在 20% 左右。

paras.en: China agreed to buy 25 million metric tons of US soybeans for the next three years.
paras.zh: 中国同意未来三年购买2500万吨美国大豆。

paras.en: Beijing also said it would keep China's rare earth exports flowing, suspending new export curbs.
paras.zh: 北京还表示将保持中国稀土出口畅通，暂停新的出口限制。

paras.en: The minerals are critical for the technological industry, and the Trump administration has in the past complained that Beijing was not meeting its commitments regarding supply.
paras.zh: 这些矿物对科技行业至关重要，特朗普政府过去曾抱怨北京没有履行其供应承诺。

paras.en: "The Trump Administration will continue pursuing policies that benefit American workers, farmers, and businesses and strengthen our economic and national security,” Bessent wrote on X after the high-level call.
paras.zh: “特朗普政府将继续奉行有利于美国工人、农民和企业的政策，并加强我们的经济和国家安全，”贝森特在高层通话后在 X 上写道。

paras.en: China raises concern over US trade restrictions
paras.zh: 中国对美国贸易限制表示担忧

paras.en: He, who is Beijing's lead negotiator on trade ties with the US, during Friday's interaction expressed "serious concern" over recent US trade restrictions targeting his country, Chinese state news agency Xinhua reported.
paras.zh: 据中国官方通讯社新华社报道，作为北京与美国贸易关系的首席谈判代表，他在周五的互动中对美国最近针对中国的贸易限制表示“严重关切”。

paras.en: The report did not elaborate which measure the vice premier was referring to.
paras.zh: 该报告没有详细说明副总理指的是哪项措施。

paras.en: But both parties agreed to "continuously strengthen cooperation”and "properly manage differences" to promote a "stable" US-China trade relationship, Xinhua said.
paras.zh: 但新华社称，双方同意“不断加强合作”并“妥善管控分歧”，以促进“稳定”的美中贸易关系。

paras.en: The Busan trade deal at first covered only one year, but the US and China extended their trade pact until January 10 next year, as Trump hosted Xi at the White House in September.
paras.zh: 釜山贸易协定最初只持续一年，但随着特朗普9月在白宫接待习近平，美国和中国将贸易协定延长至明年1月10日。

paras.en: The two leaders are expected to meet again at the upcoming APEC forum in Shenzhen, China, slated from November 18 to 19.
paras.zh: 两国领导人预计将于11月18日至19日在中国深圳举行的亚太经合组织论坛上再次会面。

paras.en: Meanwhile, in a separate development, China has confirmed for the first time that it is discussing a historic trilateral summit of Xi, Trump and Russian President Vladimir Putin on the sidelines of the APEC gathering.
paras.zh: 与此同时，另一项进展是，中国首次确认正在亚太经合组织会议期间讨论习近平、特朗普和俄罗斯总统普京的历史性三边峰会。

paras.en: China "is in communication with relevant parties regarding a meeting between the three heads of state,” Mao Ning, a spokesperson for the Chinese Foreign Ministry, said at a media briefing in Beijing this week.
paras.zh: 中国外交部发言人毛宁本周在北京举行的媒体吹风会上表示，中方“正在就三位国家元首会晤事宜与有关方面进行沟通”。

articles.title: President Herzog faces key choice as Israel struggles to form government

paras.en: Israeli President Isaac Herzog must decide who gets the first attempt at forming a government, after an inconclusive election left both Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and his main rival, former army chief Gadi Eisenkot, short of a parliamentary majority.
paras.zh: 以色列总统艾萨克·赫尔佐格必须决定谁最先尝试组建政府，此前一场无结果的选举导致总理本雅明·内塔尼亚胡和他的主要竞争对手、前陆军参谋长加迪·艾森科特都未能获得议会多数席位。

paras.en: Herzog has said he will task a candidate with forming a government on Sunday. Eisenkot has received the endorsement of a majority of lawmakers – but only thanks to parties representing Palestinian citizens of Israel, which won a record 19 seats in October’s election, but whom Eisenkot has ruled out bringing into government.
paras.zh: 赫尔佐格表示，他将在周日任命一名候选人组建政府。艾森科特获得了大多数议员的支持，但这要归功于代表以色列巴勒斯坦公民的政党，该政党在 10 月份的选举中赢得了创纪录的 19 个席位，但艾森科特已经排除了将他们带入政府的可能性。

paras.en: Who is Herzog likely to ask to form a government?
paras.zh: 赫尔佐格可能会要求谁组建政府？

paras.en: During consultations between party heads and Herzog, which ended on Thursday, 67 out of 120 Knesset members endorsed Eisenkot, while only 46 endorsed Netanyahu.
paras.zh: 在周四结束的党魁和赫尔佐格之间的磋商中，120 名议会议员中有 67 人支持艾森科特，而只有 46 人支持内塔尼亚胡。

paras.en: Netanyahu’s endorsements fell seven short of his bloc’s 53 seats after United Torah Judaism, one of his longtime allies, withheld endorsements over his coalition’s failure to exempt ultra-Orthodox Israelis from military service.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡的长期盟友之一联合托拉犹太教因他的联盟未能免除以色列极端正统派人士服兵役而拒绝为其提供支持，因此内塔尼亚胡的支持率比其集团的 53 个席位少了 7 个。

paras.en: Herzog has not publicly committed to either side, saying that while the numbers may look clear, “mutual vetoes between the blocs and within the blocs themselves” made it hard to tell who could build a coalition.
paras.zh: 赫尔佐格没有公开向任何一方做出承诺，他表示，虽然数字看起来很清楚，但“集团之间以及集团内部的相互否决”使得很难判断谁可以建立联盟。

paras.en: Prior to the October 27 elections, reports emerged that the president wanted to push for a national unity government between Netanyahu and Eisenkot’s rival parties to avoid another election.
paras.zh: 在 10 月 27 日选举之前，有报道称总统希望推动内塔尼亚胡和艾森科特的敌对政党组建民族团结政府，以避免再次举行选举。

paras.en: How difficult will it be to form a government?
paras.zh: 组建政府有多困难？

paras.en: No bloc has secured the 61 seats needed to form a majority government. Netanyahu’s right-wing and religious alliance has 53, four Jewish-led parties backing Eisenkot hold 48, and the Arab-led parties hold 19.
paras.zh: 没有一个集团能够获得组建多数政府所需的 61 个席位。内塔尼亚胡的右翼和宗教联盟拥有 53 个席位，支持艾森科特的四个犹太人领导的政党拥有 48 个席位，阿拉伯领导的政党拥有 19 个席位。

paras.en: Eisenkot has ruled out forming a government with the Arab-led parties, which would give him a 67-seat bloc. Winning over the two ultra-Orthodox parties, United Torah Judaism and Shas, would give him exactly 61 seats.
paras.zh: 艾森科特排除了与阿拉伯领导的政党组建政府的可能性，这将使他拥有 67 个席位。如果赢得联合托拉犹太教和沙斯这两个极端正统政党的支持，他将获得 61 个席位。

paras.en: United Torah Judaism has signalled that its support was available for the right price, but Shas endorsed Netanyahu on Wednesday.
paras.zh: 联合托拉犹太教已表示可以以合适的价格获得支持，但沙斯周三支持内塔尼亚胡。

paras.en: Netanyahu, meanwhile, would need to lure an opposition party to his side. A unity government with the two men rotating as prime minister – and excluding Arab-led parties from government – is another option, but many Netanyahu rivals have ruled out serving under him.
paras.zh: 与此同时，内塔尼亚胡需要吸引反对党站在他一边。两人轮流担任总理的联合政府 — — 并将阿拉伯领导的政党排除在政府之外 — — 是另一种选择，但内塔尼亚胡的许多竞争对手已经排除了在他手下任职的可能性。

paras.en: Will Arab-led parties be part of the next government?
paras.zh: 阿拉伯领导的政党会成为下一届政府的一部分吗？

paras.en: So far, it seems unlikely that they will.
paras.zh: 到目前为止，他们似乎不太可能这样做。

paras.en: The Arab-led parties are the Joint List, an alliance of three parties, and the United Arab List (Ra’am). They hold 11 and eight seats, respectively.
paras.zh: 阿拉伯领导的政党是联合名单（三个政党的联盟）和阿拉伯联合名单（Ra'am）。他们分别拥有 11 个和 8 个席位。

paras.en: Ra’am says it is willing to join an Eisenkot-led government, while the Joint List has ruled out joining but offered to help put him in office from the outside.
paras.zh: 拉姆表示愿意加入艾森科特领导的政府，而联合名单则排除了加入的可能性，但愿意从外部帮助他上任。

paras.en: Both endorsed Eisenkot during consultations with President Herzog, but he has refused to bring either into government unless they meet certain conditions, including recognising Hamas as a “terrorist organisation”.
paras.zh: 两人在与赫尔佐格总统协商期间都支持艾森科特，但总统拒绝将其中任何一人带入政府，除非他们满足某些条件，包括承认哈马斯为“恐怖组织”。

paras.en: Ra’am leader Mansour Abbas, whose party joined an anti-Netanyahu coalition in 2021 and became the first party representing Palestinians to enter government in Israel, has expressed support for disarming Hamas, but declined to label it as a “terror” group.
paras.zh: 拉姆党领导人曼苏尔·阿巴斯表示支持解除哈马斯武装，但拒绝将其称为“恐怖”组织。该党于2021年加入反内塔尼亚胡联盟，并成为第一个代表巴勒斯坦人进入以色列政府的政党。

paras.en: However, Israeli law allows Eisenkot to become prime minister with fewer than 61 seats if his proposed government wins a parliamentary confidence vote – which the two could help him secure.
paras.zh: 然而，如果艾森科特提议的政府赢得议会信任投票，以色列法律允许艾森科特以少于 61 个席位成为总理 — — 两人可以帮助他获得议会信任投票。

paras.en: Eisenkot could form a minority government in the meantime and later secure a majority by luring the two ultra-Orthodox parties by making concessions on the conscription issue.
paras.zh: 艾森科特可以同时组建一个少数派政府，然后通过在征兵问题上做出让步来吸引两个极端正统政党，从而获得多数派政府。

paras.en: In positions that many observers see as highlighting the second-class nature of Palestinian citizens in Israel, some of Eisenkot’s allies have opposed any reliance on Palestinian lawmakers, while Netanyahu’s Likud has threatened that cooperating with the Arab-led parties would be “dangerous to Israel”.
paras.zh: 许多观察家认为，艾森科特的一些盟友的立场凸显了巴勒斯坦公民在以色列的二等性质，他们反对对巴勒斯坦立法者的任何依赖，而内塔尼亚胡的利库德集团则威胁称，与阿拉伯领导的政党合作将“对以色列构成危险”​​。

paras.en: Senior Joint List member Ahmad Tibi told The Associated Press that rejecting a partnership would prove Israel is “an ethnocracy, not an absolute democracy for all citizens”.
paras.zh: 联合名单高级成员艾哈迈德·提比告诉美联社，拒绝建立伙伴关系将证明以色列是“一个民族统治国家，而不是一个对所有公民来说绝对民主的国家”。

paras.en: What do Palestinian-led parties want from the next government?
paras.zh: 巴勒斯坦领导的政党希望下一届政府做什么？

paras.en: The Joint List said its unanimous backing for Eisenkot answered a “public demand” to stop Netanyahu and his government returning to power.
paras.zh: 联合名单表示，对艾森科特的一致支持回应了阻止内塔尼亚胡及其政府重新掌权的“公众要求”。

paras.en: By widening Eisenkot’s lead, it said, it hoped to narrow the path to a unity government that keeps Netanyahu in office. Its support, it added, did not mean dropping its reservations about an opposition that had not shown readiness to confront Netanyahu’s approach or incitement against Palestinian citizens of Israel.
paras.zh: 报告称，通过扩大艾森科特的领先优势，希望缩小联合政府的道路，让内塔尼亚胡继续执政。它补充说，它的支持并不意味着放弃对反对派的保留，因为反对派没有表现出准备好对抗内塔尼亚胡针对以色列巴勒斯坦公民的做法或煽动。

paras.en: In return for outside support, Arab-led parties are seeking guarantees for Palestinian citizens, including an end to house demolitions and incitement, action against crime, and a political horizon for Palestinians.
paras.zh: 作为对外部支持的回报，阿拉伯领导的各方正在寻求对巴勒斯坦公民的保障，包括停止拆毁房屋和煽动、打击犯罪以及巴勒斯坦人的政治前景。

paras.en: Tibi told The AP he had no illusions that this would end Israel’s wars or bring a Palestinian state, but said a “repair government” would improve Palestinian citizens’ lives, including, potentially, by tackling violent crime in their communities.
paras.zh: 蒂比告诉美联社，他对这将结束以色列的战争或建立巴勒斯坦国不抱任何幻想，但表示“修复政府”将改善巴勒斯坦公民的生活，包括可能通过解决社区中的暴力犯罪问题。

paras.en: Ra’am leader Abbas has also said ending the government of Netanyahu, and far-right figures such as Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich and National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir, is a priority.
paras.zh: 伊斯兰革命党领导人阿巴斯还表示，结束内塔尼亚胡政府以及财政部长贝扎莱尔·斯莫特里奇和国家安全部长伊塔马尔·本·格维尔等极右翼人物是当务之急。

paras.en: What happens if no government can be formed?
paras.zh: 如果无法组建政府怎么办？

paras.en: The nominee chosen by Herzog will have 28 days to form a coalition, extendable by 14 more. If they fail, another nominee will be chosen and granted 28 days.
paras.zh: 赫尔佐格选出的提名人将有 28 天的时间组建联合政府，还可再延长 14 天。如果失败，将选出另一位被提名者并给予 28 天的时间。

paras.en: If the second nominee fails, a parliament majority can back a third candidate, and be granted a final 14 days.
paras.zh: 如果第二位候选人失败，议会多数可以支持第三位候选人，并获得最后 14 天的任期。

paras.en: If once again no government is formed, the Knesset will be dissolved and an entirely new election called within 90 days. This would mean Netanyahu staying on as caretaker prime minister.
paras.zh: 如果再次没有组建​​政府，议会将被解散，并在 90 天内举行全新的选举。这意味着内塔尼亚胡继续担任看守总理。

paras.en: Nehru Jamhour, an analyst of Israeli affairs, told Al Jazeera that this drawn-out impasse was the likeliest outcome, and Netanyahu’s preferred one. He said that Netanyahu was hoping that a repeat election could weaken his rivals and depress turnout among Palestinian citizens of Israel.
paras.zh: 以色列事务分析师尼赫鲁·贾姆霍尔 (Nehru Jamhour) 告诉半岛电视台，这种旷日持久的僵局是最有可能的结果，也是内塔尼亚胡更喜欢的结果。他说，内塔尼亚胡希望再次选举能够削弱他的竞争对手，并降低以色列巴勒斯坦公民的投票率。

articles.title: Khawaja claims entire Australia team knew about 2018 ball-tampering scandal

paras.en: Former opener Usman Khawaja claimed on Saturday that the entire Australian team knew about the 2018 “Sandpapergate” scandal in Cape Town and said they also employed the tactic during the previous Test at Port Elizabeth.
paras.zh: 前揭幕战选手乌斯曼·卡瓦贾 (Usman Khawaja) 周六声称，整个澳大利亚队都知道 2018 年开普敦的“砂纸门”丑闻，并表示他们在之前伊丽莎白港的测试中也采用了这一策略。

paras.en: Captain Steve Smith, his deputy David Warner and Cameron Bancroft were sent home in disgrace and found by a Cricket Australia investigation to be the only three players with prior knowledge of the ball-tampering plot.
paras.zh: 队长史蒂夫·史密斯、他的副手大卫·沃纳和卡梅伦·班克罗夫特被羞辱地送回家，澳大利亚板球协会的调查发现，他们是仅有的三名事先了解篡球阴谋的球员。

paras.en: Smith was banned for a year and sacked as skipper, Warner was suspended for 12 months and stripped of all leadership roles, while Bancroft was slapped with a nine-month ban. Head coach Darren Lehmann was cleared of direct involvement but resigned soon after the series.
paras.zh: 史密斯被禁赛一年并被解除队长职务，华纳被停赛 12 个月并被剥夺所有领导职务，而班克罗夫特则被禁赛 9 个月。主教练达伦·莱曼（Darren Lehmann）被澄清没有直接参与，但在系列赛结束后不久就辞职了。

paras.en: But Khawaja, who retired this year after 88 Tests, told The Sydney Morning Herald everyone had prior knowledge.
paras.zh: 但今年在 88 次测试后退休的 Khawaja 告诉《悉尼先驱晨报》，每个人都已经有所了解。

paras.en: “It was all of us. Not the batters, not the bowlers, not the staff. All of us,” he said ahead of the release of his autobiography next week, where a chapter is dedicated to the issue.
paras.zh: “是我们所有人。不是击球手，不是投球手，不是工作人员。是我们所有人，”他在下周出版他的自传之前说道，其中有一章专门讨论这个问题。

paras.en: Bowlers Pat Cummins, Mitchell Starc, Josh Hazlewood and Nathan Lyon all denied publicly in 2021 that they knew about it.
paras.zh: 保龄球手帕特·康明斯 (Pat Cummins)、米切尔·斯塔克 (Mitchell Starc)、乔什·黑兹尔伍德 (Josh Hazlewood) 和内森·里昂 (Nathan Lyon) 都在 2021 年公开否认他们知道此事。

paras.en: Khawaja said he spoke in the dressing room after the Cape Town Test, urging the team to take collective responsibility, rather than scapegoating Warner, Smith and Bancroft.
paras.zh: 卡瓦贾表示，他在开普敦测试后在更衣室发表讲话，敦促球队承担集体责任，而不是把华纳、史密斯和班克罗夫特当作替罪羊。

paras.en: “In an ideal world, I don’t want to do this,” Khawaja said.
paras.zh: “在理想的世界里，我不想这样做，”卡瓦贾说。

paras.en: “I don’t want to be the one who comes out and talks about the truth. The issue is that I genuinely thought after eight years the truth would have been out by now.
paras.zh: “我不想成为那个站出来谈论真相的人。问题是，我真的以为八年后真相现在就已经大白了。

paras.en: “Maybe I thought Davey [Warner] would have exposed it, or someone else would have talked about it more. I just didn’t think it was going to come down to this.”
paras.zh: “也许我认为戴维（华纳）会揭露它，或者其他人会更多地谈论它。我只是不认为事情会归结为这个。”

paras.en: In the book, according to the newspaper, Khawaja recounts that discussions about ways to rough up the ball were also held in the dressing room during the second Test at Port Elizabeth, now known as Gqeberha.
paras.zh: 据该报报道，卡瓦贾在书中回忆道，在伊丽莎白港（现称为 Gqeberha）的第二次测试期间，更衣室里也进行了有关如何粗暴对待球的讨论。

paras.en: It culminated in the discovery that sandpaper was effective, and at this point Smith allegedly walked away, saying he did not want to know about it.
paras.zh: 最终发现砂纸是有效的，据称史密斯此时走开了，说他不想知道这件事。

paras.en: Bancroft then allegedly volunteered to use sandpaper in South Africa’s first innings in Gqeberha, where the ball swung significantly.
paras.zh: 据称，班克罗夫特随后自愿在南非格克贝哈的第一局比赛中使用砂纸，当时球的摆动幅度很大。

paras.en: Cricket Australia said in a statement it was “comfortable” with the findings of its original investigation, but remained open to new evidence.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚板球协会在一份声明中表示，对最初的调查结果感到“满意”，但仍对新证据持开放态度。

paras.en: “There has been a great deal of speculation in the eight years since the 2018 Cape Town Test, including extensive media coverage throughout last month’s series in South Africa,” it said.
paras.zh: “自 2018 年开普敦测试以来的八年里，有很多猜测，包括媒体对上个月在南非举行的系列赛的广泛报道，”它说。

paras.en: “During this time there has been the ongoing opportunity to present any relevant information, and this remains the case.
paras.zh: “在此期间，一直有机会提供任何相关信息，而且情况仍然如此。

paras.en: “All relevant information presented to CA to date has been properly considered and we remain comfortable with the findings of our integrity process.”
paras.zh: “迄今为止向 CA 提交的所有相关信息都已得到适当考虑，我们对诚信流程的调查结果仍然感到满意。”

articles.title: ‘Alien-cortical’ mice: Can human brain cells grow inside animals?

paras.en: In a laboratory in California, in the United States, mice are scurrying around their cages, as mice do. But inside their brains are millions of working human neurons.
paras.zh: 在美国加利福尼亚州的一个实验室里，老鼠像老鼠一样在笼子里乱窜。但它们的大脑内部有数百万个正在工作的人类神经元。

paras.en: Researchers at Stanford University have implanted lab-grown human cells into mice genetically engineered to lack parts of their brains, including the cerebral cortex, the outer region that plays a major role in perception, movement, decision-making and attention.
paras.zh: 斯坦福大学的研究人员将实验室培养的人类细胞植入经过基因工程改造的小鼠体内，这些小鼠的大脑部分缺失，包括大脑皮层，即在感知、运动、决策和注意力中发挥重要作用的外部区域。

paras.en: According to a study published in Nature, these so-called “alien-cortical mice” may offer a new way to study neural circuits and brain disorders such as schizophrenia, cerebral palsy and dementia.
paras.zh: 根据《自然》杂志发表的一项研究，这些所谓的“外星皮质小鼠”可能为研究神经回路和大脑疾病（如精神分裂症、脑瘫和痴呆症）提供一种新方法。

paras.en: Putting human brain tissue inside an animal sounds like something out of Mary Shelley’s Frankenstein, but how “human” are these mice, really? And what have the researchers found?
paras.zh: 将人类脑组织放入动物体内听起来就像玛丽·雪莱的《弗兰肯斯坦》中的情节，但这些老鼠到底有多“人类”？研究人员发现了什么？

paras.en: Researchers genetically modified the mice so they were born and grew without most of the cerebral cortex and the neighbouring hippocampus, which are needed for movement, learning and memory.
paras.zh: 研究人员对小鼠进行了基因改造，使它们在出生和成长时没有大部分大脑皮层和邻近的海马体，而这些是运动、学习和记忆所必需的。

paras.en: When the animals were two days old, researchers injected human “organoids” into the empty spaces. Organoids are miniature masses of cells grown in a laboratory from stem cells or tumour tissue which mimic real human organs. Each was grown from healthy donors’ stem cells and holds about 100,000 human cells.
paras.zh: 当这些动物两天大时，研究人员将人类“类器官”注射到空旷的空间中。类器官是在实验室中从干细胞或肿瘤组织中生长出来的微型细胞团，模仿真实的人体器官。每个细胞均由健康捐赠者的干细胞培养而成，含有约 100,000 个人类细胞。

paras.en: Overall, researchers removed about 14 million mouse neurons and added about 4 million human ones.
paras.zh: 总体而言，研究人员移除了约 1400 万个小鼠神经元，并添加了约 400 万个人类神经元。

paras.en: This is not the same thing as a brain transplant, and the animals are not “mice that think like humans”, the researchers emphasised.
paras.zh: 研究人员强调，这与大脑移植不同，这些动物也不是“像人类一样思考的老鼠”。

paras.en: They tried the transplants on 29 mice, and it worked on 25 of them.
paras.zh: 他们在 29 只小鼠身上进行了移植试验，其中 25 只发挥了作用。

paras.en: Within three months, the human tissue had grown about five times larger inside the mice’s brains, connected to their blood supply and filled more than 90 percent of the cavities.
paras.zh: 三个月内，小鼠大脑内的人体组织体积增大了约五倍，与血液供应相连，并填充了 90% 以上的空腔。

paras.en: The “alien cortex” mice walked and vocalised mostly normally, even though human tissue made up about half their brain volume.
paras.zh: “外星皮层”小鼠的行走和发声大多正常，尽管人类组织约占其大脑体积的一半。

paras.en: In a maze test, mice without the implanted human tissue kept getting lost, however, while those with human cells did better, suggesting the human tissue contributed to cognition.
paras.zh: 然而，在迷宫测试中，没有植入人体组织的小鼠不断迷路，而植入人体细胞的小鼠则表现更好，这表明人体组织有助于认知。

paras.en: Unexpectedly, some of the tissue developed into von Economo neurons, which are long, rare cells normally absent in mice and almost impossible to make in a lab. They are found in highly social animals such as humans, apes, whales and elephants.
paras.zh: 出乎意料的是，一些组织发育成冯·伊科诺莫神经元，这是一种长而稀有的细胞，通常在小鼠体内不存在，几乎不可能在实验室中制造。它们存在于高度社会化的动物中，如人类、猿、鲸鱼和大象。

paras.en: The experiment might also help explain cerebral palsy.
paras.zh: 该实验也可能有助于解释脑瘫。

paras.en: While human infants can suffer from oxygen deprivation as a result of more frequent complications during much longer and trickier childbirth, mice infants rarely do, which has made the condition hard to study in rodents.
paras.zh: 虽然人类婴儿可能​​会因在更长和更棘手的分娩过程中更频繁的并发症而遭受缺氧的困扰，但小鼠婴儿却很少这样做，这使得在啮齿类动物中研究这种情况变得困难。

paras.en: When the modified mice in this case were exposed to low oxygen, they showed brain damage, an altered gait and poor limb coordination.
paras.zh: 当这种情况下的改良小鼠暴露于低氧环境时，它们表现出脑损伤、步态改变和四肢协调性差。

paras.en: Human brain diseases are among the hardest conditions to study. The brain contains about 86 billion nerve cells linked by trillions of connections. Ethical and safety barriers, along with the brain’s high biological complexity, limit access to living human brain tissue.
paras.zh: 人类大脑疾病是最难研究的疾病之一。大脑包含约 860 亿个神经细胞，通过数万亿个连接连接起来。道德和安全障碍，以及大脑的高度生物复杂性，限制了对活人脑组织的获取。

paras.en: Scientists have spent years growing “organoids” instead: Small clusters of human nerve cells grown in a lab. But they are not brains in a dish. They lack the connections, inputs and environment of a living brain.
paras.zh: 科学家们花了数年时间培育“类器官”：在实验室中培育的一小群人类神经细胞。但它们不是盘子里的大脑。它们缺乏活体大脑的连接、输入和环境。

paras.en: Sergiu Pasca, senior author of the research paper and a professor of psychiatry and behavioural sciences at Stanford University, said this has the potential to give researchers unprecedented insight into the human brain.
paras.zh: 该研究论文的资深作者、斯坦福大学精神病学和行为科学教授塞尔吉乌·帕斯卡 (Sergiu Pasca) 表示，这有可能让研究人员对人类大脑产生前所未有的洞察力。

paras.en: “For the past two decades, there’s been a quest to try to build models of the human brain outside of the human body,” he said.
paras.zh: “在过去的二十年里，人们一直在寻求在人体之外建立人脑模型，”他说。

paras.en: “This is not going to replace all the models we had before, but it’s going to provide us access to other aspects of human brain function that would be very difficult to study otherwise.”
paras.zh: “这不会取代我们之前拥有的所有模型，但它将使我们能够了解人类大脑功能的其他方面，否则这些模型将很难研究。”

paras.en: As research into brain organoids advances, so too do calls for clear regulations and oversight, given the sensitive ethical questions raised by these technologies.
paras.zh: 随着脑类器官研究的进展，考虑到这些技术引发的敏感伦理问题，对明确监管和监督的呼声也越来越高。

paras.en: These questions centre on the possibility that cell clusters and brains grown outside the bodies of their owners possess the capacity for sensation or consciousness, and whether this can be scientifically verified.
paras.zh: 这些问题集中在细胞簇和大脑在其主人体外生长的可能性上，它们具有感觉或意识的能力，以及这是否可以得到科学验证。

paras.en: The researchers stopped the experiments when the human nerve cells implanted in the brains of mice were six months old, before they could form more neural connections with the animals’ brains, and before any signs of consciousness appeared.
paras.zh: 当植入小鼠大脑的人类神经细胞六个月大时，研究人员停止了实验，当时它们还没有与动物大脑形成更多的神经连接，也没有出现任何意识迹象。

paras.en: John Evans, a sociology professor at the University of California, San Diego, who was not involved in the study, said this experiment does not in itself raise major ethical issues, but it provides evidence that other animals could be created that might raise more serious ethical concerns.
paras.zh: 加州大学圣地亚哥分校的社会学教授约翰·埃文斯（John Evans）没有参与这项研究，他表示，这项实验本身并没有引起重大的伦理问题，但它提供了证据，表明可以创造其他动物，这可能会引起更严重的伦理问题。

paras.en: Setting clear boundaries for this research remains a challenge.
paras.zh: 为这项研究设定明确的界限仍然是一个挑战。

paras.en: According to Evans, the problem lies in the lack of clear stopping points on the gradual path that research could take from mice to non-human primates.
paras.zh: 埃文斯认为，问题在于从小鼠到非人类灵长类动物的研究循序渐进的道路上缺乏明确的停止点。

paras.en: Accordingly, he suggested that researchers should not go beyond rodents for the time being, in order to avoid creating neurohybrid organisms that combine human and animal characteristics and could provoke an ethical controversy.
paras.zh: 因此，他建议研究人员暂时不要超越啮齿类动物，以免创造出结合了人类和动物特征的神经杂交生物，从而引发伦理争议。

articles.title: Ex-lawmaker gets 12.5 years in Macao's first national security case
articles.author: The Associated Press

paras.en: Ex-lawmaker gets 12.5 years in Macao's first national security case
paras.zh: 澳门首例涉国家安全案 前立法会议员获刑12.5年

paras.en: HONG KONG — Macao pro-democracy former lawmaker Au Kam San was sentenced to 12½ years in prison Friday in the Chinese casino hub's first national security case following a closed-door trial that raised concerns about fairness.
paras.zh: 香港——周五，澳门亲民主前立法会议员区锦新在闭门审判后被判处 12.5 年监禁，这是中国赌场中心的首例国家安全案件，引发了人们对公平性的担忧。

paras.en: Au's arrest last year was the first publicly known prosecution under Macao's national security law since it was enacted in 2009. A Macao court found him guilty of subverting state power, breaching confidentiality and establishing contact with organizations, groups or people outside Macao to commit acts endangering national security.
paras.zh: 欧区去年被捕，是自2009年澳门维护国家安全法实施以来首例公开起诉的案件。澳门法院认定他犯有颠覆国家政权、违反保密规定以及与澳门以外的组织、团体或人士建立联系实施危害国家安全行为。

paras.en: Critics said that his case reflected Beijing's emphasis on security and intolerance of dissent, even though Macao's pro-democracy movement has never been as influential as that in neighboring Hong Kong.
paras.zh: 批评人士表示，他的案件反映了北京对安全的重视和对异见的不容忍，尽管澳门的民主运动从未像邻国香港那样有影响力。

paras.en: The 69-year-old assisted and cooperated with "hostile organizations" outside Macao for a long period of time in collecting and disseminating political views laden with ideas of subverting state power and false information, according to a court statement. They conspired to incite hatred among Macao residents against the central government, with an intent to overthrow and undermine the country's fundamental system, it said.
paras.zh: 法庭声明称，69岁的他长期协助和配合澳门以外的“敌对组织”收集和传播带有颠覆国家政权思想和虚假信息的政治观点。他们密谋煽动澳门居民对中央的仇恨，意图推翻和破坏国家的根本制度。

paras.en: "Although the defendant is a first-time offender and admitted to a considerable portion of the criminal facts, he demonstrated a high degree of intent. The degree of unlawfulness and the potential consequences of his crimes are both very serious," the statement said.
paras.zh: 声明称：“被告人虽然是初犯，承认了相当一部分犯罪事实，但表现出高度的故意，其犯罪行为的违法程度和可能造成的后果均十分严重。”

paras.en: Macao is a former Portuguese colony that has operated, like Hong Kong, as a special administrative region since its return to Chinese rule in 1999.
paras.zh: 澳门是前葡萄牙殖民地，自 1999 年回归中国以来，与香港一样，作为一个特别行政区运作。

paras.en: Au's wife says it's a groundless persecution
paras.zh: 欧妻称这是毫无根据的迫害

paras.en: In a public letter, Au's wife, Virginia Cheang, wrote that she only hoped authorities would allow his family to exchange letters with Au and visit him regularly without conditions.
paras.zh: 欧的妻子Virginia Cheang在一封公开信中写道，她只希望当局允许欧的家人与欧互信，并无条件定期探望他。

paras.en: "From a closed-door trial to a public verdict, what kind of operation is this? It's a political trial and it's a groundless persecution to humiliate one's character," Cheang said.
paras.zh: “从闭门审判到公开宣判，这是什么样的操作？这是政治审判，是毫无根据的羞辱人格的迫害，”郑说。

paras.en: Au's daughter in London, Au Hon I, told The Associated Press that her father is a peaceful family man who cares deeply about Macao, and the thought of him spending more time in prison without having done anything criminal was unbearable. She said that a lawyer earlier arranged by her family wasn't able to see him.
paras.zh: 欧汉仪在伦敦的女儿欧汉仪告诉美联社，她的父亲是一个爱好和平的家庭男人，非常关心澳门，一想到他在监狱里度过更多的时间而没有犯下任何罪行，就令人难以忍受。她说，她的家人早些时候安排的律师未能见他。

paras.en: She felt that the ruling was setting boundaries of what citizens can do and what rights they have, saying "it's a very scary chapter that they're starting."
paras.zh: 她认为这项裁决为公民可以做什么和拥有什么权利设定了界限，并表示“他们正在开始一个非常可怕的篇章”。

paras.en: "It just doesn't feel like a safe space anymore being in Macao. And it's very heartbreaking," she said.
paras.zh: “在澳门感觉不再是一个安全的地方。这非常令人心碎，”她说。

paras.en: The court said that a lawyer approved by Au was appointed to act for him during the legal proceedings, and that he had exercised his right to a defense. The court also approved his family's request to visit him regularly.
paras.zh: 法院表示，已指定区某认可的律师在诉讼过程中代理其行为，且区某已行使辩护权。法院还批准了他家人定期探望他的请求。

paras.en: Jorge Menezes, a Portuguese lawyer who practices in Macao, said that the trial was held in secret and that specific details — which organizations were involved and what information Au had provided to them — weren't revealed. Menezes noted that the statement said that Au had acknowledged some facts and it might have led people to believe that he had confessed to the crimes.
paras.zh: 在澳门执业的葡萄牙律师豪尔赫·梅内塞斯(Jorge Menezes)表示，审判是秘密进行的，具体细节——涉及哪些组织以及欧向他们提供了哪些信息——没有透露。梅内塞斯指出，声明称区某承认了一些事实，这可能会让人们相信他已经承认了罪行。

paras.en: "From what I see, he did not plead guilty. Otherwise, they would have said. So this is misleading and unfortunate," he said. "It violates his dignity."
paras.zh: “据我所知，他没有认罪。否则，他们会说。所以这是误导和不幸的，”他说。 “这侵犯了他的尊严。”

paras.en: He said that Au's case was used to send a message to Macao residents that it was about anyone who challenges the authorities. The case could also carry a message for Hong Kong, because Macao is "a sort of laboratory" for the financial hub in situations like this.
paras.zh: 他说，区某的案件是向澳门居民传达的信息，即这是关于任何挑战当局的人的事。此案也可能为香港带来信息，因为在这种情况下，澳门是金融中心的“某种实验室”。

paras.en: Michael Polak, Au's international counsel, urged Portugal and the European Union to demand that Au, a Portuguese citizen, be allowed to leave Macao.
paras.zh: 区的国际律师迈克尔·波拉克敦促葡萄牙和欧盟要求允许葡萄牙公民区离开澳门。

paras.en: "A sentence like that for someone of that age is a sentence for life," he said. "If he was left in Macao, he could die in prison."
paras.zh: “对于那个年龄的人来说，这样的判决就是终身监禁，”他说。 “如果把他留在澳门，他可能会死在监狱里。”

paras.en: The court found Au colluded with multiple overseas groups
paras.zh: 法院认定区某与多个海外集团勾结

paras.en: Macao has its own political and legal systems and Macao is the only Chinese city where casino gambling is legal. It has resorts run by affiliates of the American gaming companies MGM Resorts, Las Vegas Sands and Wynn Resorts.
paras.zh: 澳门有自己的政治和法律制度，澳门是中国唯一赌场赌博合法的城市。它拥有由美国博彩公司米高梅度假村、拉斯维加斯金沙集团和永利度假村的附属公司运营的度假村。

paras.en: The court found that Au helped overseas organizations spread false and distorted information between 2023 and 2024 to induce foreign countries to take hostile actions against China and Macao, incite hatred against the central government and undermine the smooth running of the 2024 city leader election.
paras.zh: 法院认为，区某于2023年至2024年期间，协助境外组织散布虚假、歪曲信息，诱导境外对中国和澳门采取敌对行动，煽动对中央政府的仇恨，破坏2024年市领导选举的顺利进行。

paras.en: As a lawmaker in 2021, Au leaked to overseas groups confidential information obtained during closed-door committee meetings over the renewal of gaming licenses, it said.
paras.zh: 声明称，作为2021年立法会议员，区向海外团体泄露了在有关更新博彩牌照的闭门委员会会议上获得的机密信息。

paras.en: Au's trial was held behind closed doors in September.
paras.zh: Au 的审判于 9 月闭门进行。

paras.en: The court earlier said that the judge decided against an open trial to ensure that national security interests wouldn't be undermined.
paras.zh: 法院早些时候表示，法官决定不公开审理，以确保国家安全利益不会受到损害。

paras.en: Au was seen as a mild pro-democracy activist
paras.zh: 欧被视为温和的民主活动人士

paras.en: Au, a teacher-turned-lawmaker, served in the legislature dominated by Beijing loyalists for 20 years before stepping down in 2021. Au was also an organizer of Macao's commemoration of the 1989 Tiananmen Square crackdown in Beijing.
paras.zh: 区议员出身为立法会议员，在由北京拥护者主导的立法机关工作了 20 年，于 2021 年辞职。区还是澳门纪念 1989 年北京天安门广场镇压活动的组织者。

paras.en: Au said that he entered politics because he saw many social problems in daily life that required people to speak out. He said that the Tiananmen Square pro-democracy movement in 1989 brought him and his like-minded friends together, and he later felt Macao needed people to push forward an open and democratic society.
paras.zh: 欧说，他进入政界是因为他在日常生活中看到很多社会问题需要人们发声。他表示，1989年的天安门民主运动让他和志同道合的朋友走到了一起，后来他觉得澳门需要人来推动一个开放民主的社会。

paras.en: Before his arrest, Au was a rare voice in Macao who regularly criticized government measures and political developments on Facebook and in interviews, although many considered his critiques to be mild.
paras.zh: 在被捕之前，欧是澳门罕见的经常在脸书和采访中批评政府措施和政治发展的人，尽管许多人认为他的批评很温和。

paras.en: But the Macao government supported the ruling, urging all sectors to respect it. It said that the government would continue to strictly enforce the security law.
paras.zh: 但澳门政府支持这一裁决，并敦促各界尊重该裁决。声明称，政府将继续严格执行国安法。

paras.en: Beijing's Hong Kong and Macao Affairs Office said that the ruling demonstrated Macao's firm resolve in safeguarding national security. It said that the ruling also reminded people to remain vigilant about the risks even in times of stability.
paras.zh: 北京港澳办表示，这一裁决体现了澳门维护国家安全的坚定决心。报道称，该裁决也提醒人们即使在稳定时期也要保持风险警惕。

paras.en: China's Foreign Ministry said that it firmly opposes any external forces using individual cases as a pretext to interfere in Macao's affairs.
paras.zh: 中国外交部表示，坚决反对任何外部势力借个别案件干涉澳门事务。

articles.title: The leader of a Kenyan doomsday cult is sentenced to 200 years in prison
articles.author: The Associated Press

paras.en: The leader of a Kenyan doomsday cult is sentenced to 200 years in prison
paras.zh: 肯尼亚末日邪教头目被判200年监禁

paras.en: MOMBASA, Kenya — The leader of a Kenyan doomsday cult linked to the deaths of more than 400 people was sentenced on Friday to 200 years in prison for the murders of 191 people.
paras.zh: 肯尼亚蒙巴萨——周五，肯尼亚末日邪教领导人因谋杀 191 人而被判处 200 年监禁，该邪教造成 400 多人死亡。

paras.en: The High Court in Kenya's coastal city of Mombasa issued the sentence for Pastor Paul Mackenzie. He was convicted of murdering 190 children and one adult after he ordered his followers to starve themselves to death in order to meet Jesus.
paras.zh: 肯尼亚沿海城市蒙巴萨高等法院对保罗·麦肯齐牧师作出了判决。他被判谋杀 190 名儿童和一名成人，因为他命令追随者绝食以见耶稣。

paras.en: Mackenzie is also facing terrorism and manslaughter charges for the more than 200 other victims, as well as child abuse and torture charges in two other courts.
paras.zh: 麦肯齐还面临恐怖主义和其他 200 多名受害者的过失杀人指控，以及另外两个法庭的虐待儿童和酷刑指控。

paras.en: Justice Diana Kavedza said that Mackenzie, leader of the Good News International Church, bore the "primary criminal culpability" for relocating his followers to a remote location and ordering them to fast to death.
paras.zh: 法官戴安娜·卡维扎表示，好消息国际教会领袖麦肯齐因将其追随者转移到偏远地区并命令他们绝食而负有“主要刑事责任”。

paras.en: Mackenzie was charged with the murders alongside 28 of his followers, including guards who enforced his fasting directives and gravediggers who helped conceal the mass graves. All denied the charges, except for one person who confessed and pleaded for leniency.
paras.zh: 麦肯齐和他的 28 名追随者被指控犯有谋杀罪，其中包括执行他的禁食指令的警卫和帮助隐藏乱葬坑的掘墓人。除一名人认罪并请求宽大处理外，所有人均否认指控。

paras.en: On Oct. 19, the court found all 29 of them guilty of the murder of 191 people.
paras.zh: 10月19日，法庭判定这29人全部犯有谋杀191人罪。

paras.en: In 2023, more than 400 bodies were exhumed from shallow graves on the 800-acre (320-hectare) Chakama Ranch in coastal Kilifi County, where Mackenzie's followers lived in mud huts, away from the scrutiny of local communities and authorities.
paras.zh: 2023 年，在沿海基利菲县 800 英亩（320 公顷）查卡马牧场的浅坟中挖出了 400 多具尸体，麦肯齐的追随者住在泥屋里，远离当地社区和当局的监督。

paras.en: More than 60 bodies were positively identified and reburied by their relatives, while many others remain unidentified and unclaimed.
paras.zh: 超过 60 具尸体已被确认身份，并由其亲属重新埋葬，而许多其他尸体仍然身份不明且无人认领。

paras.en: During the sentencing, Kavedza said that 183 victims died of starvation, defined as a complete lack of food, and the deaths of the other eight were classified as murder by direct homicide.
paras.zh: 卡维扎在宣判时表示，183名受害者死于饥饿，定义为完全缺乏食物，另外8人的死亡被归类为直接杀人谋杀。

paras.en: Kavedza said the killings were "cold and calculated" and dismissed claims by some of the accused that the loss of their own children altered the fact that they had participated in the killings of many other children.
paras.zh: 卡维扎表示，这些杀戮是“冷酷且有计划的”，并驳斥了一些被告的说法，即自己孩子的去世改变了他们参与杀害许多其他儿童的事实。

paras.en: The justice said that the perpetrators didn't show remorse and declared they were ready to fast to death as well. During the sentencing, Mackenzie often smiled and chatted with his assistant pastor, Smart Mwakalama, who was sentenced to 160 years in prison.
paras.zh: 法官表示，肇事者没有表现出悔意，并宣称他们也准备好绝食致死。在宣判期间，麦肯齐经常微笑着与他被判处160年监禁的助理牧师斯玛特·姆瓦卡拉马聊天。

paras.en: All of those who were convicted have been granted 14 days to file an appeal.
paras.zh: 所有被定罪的人都有 14 天的时间提出上诉。

paras.en: The prosecution had argued for the death penalty for Mackenzie and life imprisonment for his accomplices.
paras.zh: 检方主张对麦肯齐判处死刑，对其同伙判处无期徒刑。

paras.en: Defense lawyer Lawrence Obonyo, who represents Mackenzie and several others who were convicted, told The Associated Press that he had already launched an appeal. He said that the decision was "circling around the constitution to give a sentence that is unattainable" since the sentences of between 160 and 200 years amount to life sentences.
paras.zh: 麦肯齐和其他几名被定罪者的代理律师劳伦斯·奥博尼奥告诉美联社，他已经提出上诉。他表示，这一决定是“绕着宪法判处不可能的刑罚”，因为160至200年的刑期相当于无期徒刑。

paras.en: A father of seven, Suleiman Ziro, who traveled 120 kilometers (75 miles) for the sentencing, lost six of his children and his wife to the cult in 2023. He said that the sentence wasn't enough especially because he has yet to recover the bodies of his loved ones, calling for the death penalty in the case.
paras.zh: 苏莱曼·齐罗 (Suleiman Ziro) 是七个孩子的父亲，他长途跋涉 120 公里（75 英里）前往宣判，他在 2023 年因邪教而失去了六个孩子和妻子。他说，判决还不够，特别是因为他尚未找回亲人的尸体，因此呼吁对此案判处死刑。

paras.en: Mackenzie's son, Dan Mackenzie, said that he felt sorry for his father over the conviction, but it was "justice served to the victims." He said that he escaped by "rebelling" against his father's teachings and was often punished for it, but was glad he survived. Two of his younger brothers and three sisters were rescued and are currently at a children's home.
paras.zh: 麦肯齐的儿子丹·麦肯齐表示，他对父亲的定罪表示遗憾，但这“为受害者伸张了正义”。他说，他通过“反抗”父亲的教诲而逃脱，并经常因此受到惩罚，但很高兴自己活了下来。他的两个弟弟和三个姐妹获救，目前在儿童之家。

paras.en: Those sentenced to death in Kenyan courts serve a life sentence. Kenya's last execution was in 1987.
paras.zh: 肯尼亚法院判处死刑的人将被判处无期徒刑。肯尼亚最后一次执行死刑是在 1987 年。

articles.title: Israel's Arab-led parties in spotlight after inconclusive election
articles.author: Ruth Sherlock

paras.en: Israel's Arab-led parties in spotlight after inconclusive election
paras.zh: 以色列阿拉伯领导的政党在选举无果后成为焦点

paras.en: KUFR QASI, Israel — In recent years many Palestinian citizens of Israel shunned elections, believing there was little to gain from participating in the politics of a state which, they say, regularly marginalizes their communities and oppresses their fellow Palestinians in the West Bank and Gaza.
paras.zh: 以色列库弗尔卡西——近年来，许多以色列巴勒斯坦公民回避选举，认为参与一个国家的政治没有什么好处，他们说，这个国家经常边缘化他们的社区，并压迫约旦河西岸和加沙的巴勒斯坦同胞。

paras.en: But last month, Palestinian Arabs in Israel came to the ballot boxes in record numbers, helping strip Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's most far-right government in Israel's history of its majority, and giving Arab-led parties the votes they needed to become a powerful force in Israeli politics.
paras.zh: 但上个月，以色列的巴勒斯坦阿拉伯人以创纪录的数量来到投票箱，帮助以色列总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡（Benjamin Netanyahu）剥夺了以色列历史上最右翼政府的多数席位，并为阿拉伯领导的政党提供了成为以色列政治中强大力量所需的选票。

paras.en: "We blocked the government of Netanyahu from continuing," said Jamal Zahalka, chairman of the High Follow-Up Committee, the main umbrella body representing Palestinian citizens of Israel. "It's a historical achievement. I think our community found its strength."
paras.zh: “我们阻止内塔尼亚胡政府继续执政，”代表以色列巴勒斯坦公民的主要保护伞机构高级后续委员会主席贾马尔·扎哈卡说。 “这是一项历史性成就。我认为我们的社区找到了自己的力量。”

paras.en: Neither Netanyahu's coalition, nor his main challenger Gadi Eisenkot's center-right opposition, reached the threshold of 61 seats needed to form a government. Arab-led parties won 19 out of 120 seats — enough to give them a critical role in the negotiations that will now determine who governs Israel at this turbulent moment in the country's history.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡的联盟及其主要挑战者加迪·艾森科特的中右翼反对派都没有达到组建政府所需的 61 个席位的门槛。阿拉伯领导的政党赢得了 120 个席位中的 19 个，这足以使它们在谈判中发挥关键作用，而谈判现在将决定谁在以色列历史上这个动荡的时刻统治以色列。

paras.en: The election results strike at the heart of the decades-long questions about how Israel defines itself and the role of Palestinian Arabs in its society.
paras.zh: 选举结果触及了数十年来以色列如何定义自己以及巴勒斯坦阿拉伯人在其社会中的角色等问题的核心。

paras.en: At a park in the Palestinian-majority town of Kufr Qasim two days after the election, hundreds of people gathered for the annual commemoration of residents gunned down in 1956 by Israeli border police on the opening day of the Suez Crisis in the violent early years of the state, when Israel, Britain and France attacked Egypt after it nationalized the Suez Canal.
paras.zh: 选举两天后，在巴勒斯坦人占多数的库夫尔卡西姆镇的一个公园里，数百人聚集在一起，参加一年一度的纪念活动，纪念1956年苏伊士危机爆发当天被以色列边防警察枪杀的居民，当时以色列、英国和法国在埃及将苏伊士运河收归国有后袭击了埃及。

paras.en: "And today we stand here, 70 years later," the speaker told the large crowd from a podium: "And the story still isn't over."
paras.zh: “70 年后的今天，我们站在这里，”演讲者在讲台上对一大群人说道，“故事还没有结束。”

paras.en: The crowd at this event, mostly dressed in black — some wearing the keffiyeh, the black and white stitched scarf symbolizing Palestinian resistance — mourned not only their lost relatives all those years ago, but also the suffering of Palestinians now: the sharp rise in discrimination against their communities in Israel since the deadly Hamas-led attacks on Israel on Oct. 7, 2023; Israel's war against Hamas in Gaza that has killed more than 74,000 Palestinians and left a population to survive amid the ruins of the enclave. And the actions of Netanyahu's extreme right-wing government in the occupied West Bank, where rights groups and the U.N. say it has armed and supported settlers as they force Palestinians from their homes and agricultural lands with unprecedented violence.
paras.zh: 参加这次活动的人群大多身着黑衣，其中一些人戴着阿拉伯头巾，这是一种象征巴勒斯坦抵抗的黑白缝制围巾，他们不仅哀悼多年前失去的亲人，也哀悼巴勒斯坦人现在所遭受的苦难：自 2023 年 10 月 7 日哈马斯领导的对以色列发动致命袭击以来，以色列境内对其社区的歧视急剧增加；以色列在加沙对哈马斯发动的战争已造成 74,000 多名巴勒斯坦人死亡，只剩下一些人在飞地的废墟中生存。还有内塔尼亚胡极右翼政府在被占领的约旦河西岸的行动，人权组织和联合国表示，内塔尼亚胡政府武装并支持定居者，以前所未有的暴力迫使巴勒斯坦人离开家园和农田。

paras.en: Worsening rights inside Israel was one reason, residents of Kufr Qasm told NPR, why so many Palestinian citizens in Israel went to the ballot boxes. "There is no freedom anymore," said Intisar Sarsur, 65, sitting with relatives beside an olive tree in the park in Kufr Qasim. " We are seeking for our basic rights as human beings."
paras.zh: 库夫尔·卡斯姆的居民告诉美国公共广播电台，以色列境内人权状况恶化是众多以色列巴勒斯坦公民前往投票箱的原因之一。 “不再有自由了，”65 岁的因蒂萨尔·萨尔苏尔 (Intisar Sarsur) 说，他和亲戚坐在库夫卡西姆公园的一棵橄榄树旁。 “我们正在寻求作为人类的基本权利。”

paras.en: "Everybody that I know participated in the elections. Not one person stayed home," Sarsur said. She and her family were sharing platters of mutabbaq, a sweet Palestinian layered pastry, and freshly pressed olive oil from this year's olive harvest — usually a joyous moment in the Palestinian calendar, that she said now felt bittersweet. This year the olive harvest for Palestinians in the occupied West Bank was marred by frequent attacks by Israeli settlers trying to disrupt this economically and culturally significant time of year.
paras.zh: “我认识的每个人都参加了选举。没有人呆在家里，”萨苏尔说。她和她的家人正在分享穆塔巴克拼盘，这是一种甜美的巴勒斯坦分层糕点，还有来自今年收获的橄榄的新鲜压榨的橄榄油——这在巴勒斯坦日历上通常是一个欢乐的时刻，她说现在感觉苦乐参半。今年，被占领的约旦河西岸巴勒斯坦人的橄榄收成因以色列定居者的频繁袭击而受到破坏，他们试图扰乱一年中这个具有重要经济和文化意义的时期。

paras.en: Palestinian citizens of Israel, descendants of those who remained as the state of Israel was established in 1948 (when a majority of the prewar population was forcibly expelled or fled during the war) now make up about 20% of the population.
paras.zh: 以色列的巴勒斯坦公民是 1948 年以色列建国时留下的人的后裔（当时大多数战前人口在战争期间被强行驱逐或逃离），现在约占人口的 20%。

paras.en: This election, Arab-led parties received a 64% increase in votes compared to the last elections, according to the Central Elections Committee. The gains they made have stirred anger, and even fear, among many on Israel's political right, who see them as a threat to the country's Jewish character.
paras.zh: 据中央选举委员会称，这次选举中，阿拉伯人领导的政党获得的选票比上次选举增加了 64%。他们所取得的成果激起了许多以色列政治右翼人士的愤怒甚至恐惧，他们认为这些成果对该国的犹太性格构成了威胁。

paras.en: Netanyahu and his allies made the large Arab turnout a rallying cry. On election day, Netanyahu posted a video calling it an "emergency." Itamar Ben Gvir, the far-right national security minister, filmed his own appeal at the entrance to Kufr Qasim: "If you want this country to remain Jewish and Zionist … then get out and vote!"
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡和他的盟友以阿拉伯人的大量投票作为战斗口号。选举日当天，内塔尼亚胡发布了一段视频，称其为“紧急情况”。极右翼国家安全部长伊塔马尔·本·格维尔 (Itamar Ben Gvir) 在库夫尔·卡西姆 (Kufr Qasim) 入口处拍摄了自己的呼吁：“如果你希望这个国家继续是犹太人和犹太复国主义者……那就出去投票吧！”

paras.en: As results came in, Netanyahu's Likud party went further. It claimed Arab parties had "stolen" the election through bribery, threats and forgery, and later warned of a foreign takeover of the Knesset and the "Islamization of Israel." The party has made no evidence public. Police say they found no basis for the claims, and election officials say there was no widespread fraud. The head of the elections committee separately asked the Shin Bet security service to investigate suspected foreign funding of efforts to boost Arab turnout. But he and the attorney general say the vote was conducted properly and the results were not compromised.
paras.zh: 随着结果的公布，内塔尼亚胡领导的利库德集团走得更远。它声称阿拉伯政党通过贿赂、威胁和伪造“窃取”了选举，并随后警告外国接管以色列议会和“以色列伊斯兰化”。该党尚未公开任何证据。警方表示，他们没有发现这些说法的依据，选举官员表示，不存在普遍存在的欺诈行为。选举委员会负责人另外要求辛贝特安全部门调查涉嫌外国资助提高阿拉伯投票率的努力。但他和司法部长表示，投票进行得当，结果没有受到影响。

paras.en: The messaging by Netanyahu's bloc is widely seen as an attempt to prevent Eisenkot's center-right grouping from partnering with Arab parties — a reality that would give Eisenkot the majority he needs to form a government. But the sharp rise in anti-Arab sentiment since the Oct. 7, 2023 attacks, in which some 1,200 people were killed, has made an alliance with any Arab party potentially politically treacherous and could cause other Jewish right wing members of his bloc to split off in fury.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡集团发出的信息被广泛视为试图阻止艾森科特的中右翼集团与阿拉伯政党合作——这一现实将使艾森科特获得组建政府所需的多数席位。但自 2023 年 10 月 7 日造成约 1,200 人死亡的袭击事件以来，反阿拉伯情绪急剧上升，与任何阿拉伯政党结盟都可能具有政治危险，并可能导致其集团中的其他犹太右翼成员愤怒地分裂。

paras.en: Eisenkot is not a natural ally for Arab parties either. A former military chief of staff whose son was killed fighting in Gaza, he served as an observer in Netanyahu's war cabinet early in the war. And he still cuts a hawkish figure. As a general, he is credited with formulating the "Dahiyeh doctrine," which he laid out in 2008: using "disproportionate force" against villages from which militants fire on Israel, which he called "not civilian villages" but "military bases." It is named after Beirut's southern suburbs, a Hezbollah stronghold that Israel largely decimated in heavy bombardment in 2006.
paras.zh: 艾森科特也不是阿拉伯政党的天然盟友。作为一名前军事参谋长，他的儿子在加沙战斗中丧生，他在战争初期担任内塔尼亚胡战时内阁的观察员。而且他仍然保持着鹰派的形象。作为一名将军，他因制定了“达希耶学说”而受到赞誉，他在 2008 年提出了这一学说：对武装分子向以色列开火的村庄使用“不成比例的武力”，他称这些村庄“不是平民村庄”，而是“军事基地”。它以贝鲁特南郊命名，贝鲁特南郊是真主党的据点，以色列在 2006 年的猛烈轰炸中大部分被摧毁。

paras.en: So Arab parties are divided on how to use the power they gained in this election. Ra'am, a socially conservative Islamist party, campaigned on joining a governing coalition and put a Jewish former police official second on its list. But for now the Joint List alliance that won 11 of the 19 Arab-led party seats in this election won't formally partner with Eisenkot. Its leaders have said they could back his government from the outside, but won't join it, citing Israel's ongoing war in Gaza and its occupation of the West Bank.
paras.zh: 因此，阿拉伯政党对于如何使用他们在这次选举中获得的权力存在分歧。拉姆是一个社会保守的伊斯兰政党，在竞选中主张加入执政联盟，并将一名犹太前警察官员列入其名单的第二位。但目前，在这次选举中赢得阿拉伯领导政党 19 个席位中 11 个席位的联合名单联盟不会与艾森科特正式合作。其领导人表示，他们可以从外部支持他的政府，但不会加入其中，理由是以色列在加沙正在进行的战争以及对约旦河西岸的占领。

paras.en: President Isaac Herzog has been consulting with parties over who they would support to try to form a coalition. He is expected to announce which candidate he'll give a mandate to next week, to try to form a coalition. That candidate will have 28 days and can ask for a further two-week extension. If he fails, another candidate is given only 28 days (without extension) to try to form a government. And if no one manages to form a coalition, there will be repeat elections next year.
paras.zh: 艾萨克·赫尔佐格总统一直在与各党派协商他们将支持谁来组建联合政府。预计他将在下周宣布将授权给哪位候选人，以尝试组建联盟。该候选人将有 28 天的时间，并且可以要求再延长两周。如果他失败了，另一位候选人只有 28 天（不得延期）的时间尝试组建政府。如果没有人能够组建联合政府，明年将再次举行选举。

paras.en: In Kufr Qasim, as the readings and re-enactments of the 1956 killings unfurled on stage, Mansour Shaaban said he would vote again in an instant. Aged 33, this was the first election he had voted in. But now he said it's necessary to try to stop what he called the racism and oppression of Palestinians by Israel's extreme right. "There are Israelis we eat with and live alongside," Shaaban said. But Netanyahu and Ben-Gvir and other leaders in these last years he said "are making it impossible to co-exist," he said.
paras.zh: 在库夫尔卡西姆，当 1956 年大屠杀的朗诵和重演在舞台上展开时，曼苏尔·沙班表示他将立即再次投票。 33岁的他参加了第一次选举。但现在他表示，有必要努力制止他所谓的以色列极右翼对巴勒斯坦人的种族主义和压迫。 “我们和以色列人一起吃饭、一起生活，”沙班说。但他说，内塔尼亚胡和本格维尔以及其他领导人在过去几年“正在使共存变得不可能”。

paras.en: "Even if we don't succeed to create change this time," he said, now right-wing Israeli politicians know that Palestinian citizens of the country have found their voice.
paras.zh: 他说：“即使我们这次未能成功创造变革，”现在以色列右翼政客知道该国的巴勒斯坦公民已经找到了自己的声音。

articles.title: Tiger Woods and ex-wife Elin Nordegren reunite to celebrate son Charlie's college golf commitment

paras.en: It was a family reunion for Charlie Woods on Friday, as both his father and mother, whose divorce was highly publicized, were together again to celebrate his college commitment.
paras.zh: 周五，查理·伍兹 (Charlie Woods) 举行了一次家庭聚会，他的父母（他们的离婚广为人知）再次聚在一起庆祝他的大学承诺。

paras.en: Woods, the son of 15-time major winner Tiger, announced earlier this year his commitment to play golf at Florida State University.
paras.zh: 伍兹是 15 届大满贯赛冠军泰格的儿子，今年早些时候宣布他将在佛罗里达州立大学打高尔夫球。

paras.en: The Woods family, including Tiger's ex-wife, Elin Nordegren, were on hand at Charlie's high school to celebrate.
paras.zh: 伍兹一家，包括泰格的前妻艾琳·诺德格伦，都在查理的高中庆祝。

paras.en: Tiger and Elin got divorced after the former's infidelity had been exposed.
paras.zh: 泰格和艾琳在前者的不忠行为曝光后离婚了。

paras.en: Charlie announced the commitment in February.
paras.zh: 查理在二月份宣布了这一承诺。

paras.en: "Excited to announce my commitment to play golf at Florida State University — go Noles!" he wrote.
paras.zh: “很高兴宣布我承诺在佛罗里达州立大学打高尔夫球 - 诺尔斯加油！”他写道。

paras.en: "Congratulations Charlie. I'm so proud of you on entering this next chapter of your life," Tiger commented.
paras.zh: “恭喜查理。我为你进入人生的下一个篇章感到非常自豪，”泰格评论道。

paras.en: It is a rare public appearance for Tiger, who has remained out of the spotlight most of the time since he was arrested in March.
paras.zh: 对于老虎来说，这是一次罕见的公开露面，自三月份被捕以来，他大部分时间都没有出现在聚光灯下。

paras.en: He was arrested on charges of DUI following a car crash in which police later found hydrocodone pills in his pocket. It was his second DUI in less than a decade. Woods previously told law enforcement prior to the field sobriety tests that he underwent seven back surgeries and "over 20 operations on his leg." He told law enforcement that "I take a few" prescription medications.
paras.zh: 他在一场车祸后因酒后驾车被捕，警方后来在他的口袋里发现了氢可酮药片。这是他不到十年内第二次酒后驾车。伍兹此前在现场清醒测试之前告诉执法部门，他接受了七次背部手术和“超过 20 次腿部手术”。他告诉执法部门，“我服用了一些”处方药。

paras.en: According to an arrest affidavit obtained by Fox News Digital, deputies with the Martin County Sheriff’s Office reported observing several signs of impairment at the scene, noting that the golf legend was "sweating profusely" and that his movements appeared "lethargic and slow." Law enforcement proceeded to perform field sobriety tests because of their suspicions. Woods was instructed to remove his eyeglasses, and the deputy conducting the tests stated that his eyes appeared to be "bloodshot and glassy" and "extremely dilated."
paras.zh: 根据福克斯新闻数字频道获得的一份逮捕证词，马丁县治安官办公室的代表报告称，他们在现场观察到了一些受伤的迹象，并指出这位高尔夫传奇人物“大汗淋漓”，动作显得“昏昏欲睡、缓慢”。出于怀疑，执法部门开始进行现场清醒测试。伍兹被指示摘下眼镜，负责测试的副手表示，他的眼睛似乎“充血且呆滞”并且“极度扩张”。

paras.en: Shortly after the arrest, Woods announced he was seeking treatment.
paras.zh: 被捕后不久，伍兹宣布他正在寻求治疗。

paras.en: Nordegren was reportedly "concerned" after the legendary golfer’s arrest.
paras.zh: 据报道，诺德格伦在这位传奇高尔夫球手被捕后感到“担忧”。

paras.en: Tiger's return to the golf course remains to be determined — he has not played since the 2024 Open Championship. When he was arrested in March, he said he was "hoping to" play in April's Masters, but he ultimately missed the entire 2026 season.
paras.zh: 老虎是否重返高尔夫球场仍有待确定——他自 2024 年公开赛以来就没有参加过比赛。当他在 3 月份被捕时，他表示“希望”参加 4 月份的大师赛，但他最终错过了整个 2026 年赛季。
