articles.title: Further bomb threats disrupt at least another 18 flights across Europe
articles.author: Rory Carroll in Dublin and Jakub Krupa

paras.en: A fresh wave of bomb threats disrupted air traffic across Europe on Friday but the affected aircraft landed safely and searches revealed no explosive devices.
The latest alerts affected at least 18 flights to or from Bulgaria, Cyprus, Czechia, France, Hungary, Italy, Portugal, Romania and the UK.
Danish police investigated a threat against Copenhagen airport but the airport’s management said it was operating normally.

The warnings followed separate threats on Tuesday and Thursday that forced at least 35 flights to be diverted or searched, raising questions over an apparently coordinated effort to cause chaos for travellers.

A number of European media outlets – including news organisations in Bulgaria, Ireland and the UK – have reported that a group claiming responsibility for this week’s threats sent an email to several outlets warning of further attacks on transport across Europe.
“This is only the beginning,” it reportedly said.

The latest threats affected at least nine flights to and from Prague, four flights over France, two flights en route to Sofia and a flight from Lisbon to Rome. Hungary scrambled fighter jets three times to escort civilian flights in its airspace, the defence minister, Romulusz Ruszin-Szendi, said on Facebook.

The affected flights had knock-on effects but were a tiny percentage – just 0.0674% – of the 26,709 flights that according to the air traffic control agency Eurocontrol were scheduled in Europe on Friday.
A separate spate of threats on Friday against media organisations in Ireland disrupted broadcasts and prompted staff evacuations and police searches of offices and newsrooms.
The taoiseach, Micheál Martin, told RTÉ Radio 1 after it resumed scheduled broadcasting that such threats had to be taken seriously and were an effort to sow fear and anxiety.

“It shows how relatively simple it can be to cause disruption and undermine the normal operation of society,” said Martin, adding that European security agencies would seek to identify those responsible and hold them accountable.
The British broadcaster Sky said on Friday it had also received a security threat and reported the matter to the relevant authorities.
Earlier this week, cyber-attacks targeted supermarket refrigeration systems in at least seven European countries.
The Italian prime minister, Giorgia Meloni, said it was unclear whether the hoaxes and recent cyber-attacks were “all connected”.
She added: “But they definitely all tell us the same thing: today, what is under attack are civilian infrastructures.”
The Nato alliance continued to monitor the situation and was working closely with allies, according to a senior Nato military official.

Investigators have said there was no evidence that hoaxes against airlines and other targets were being orchestrated by a hostile terror group or state actor, such as Russia or Iran, but that inquiries were continuing.

Several European media outlets in Bulgaria, Ireland, the UK and elsewhere reported that a group claiming responsibility for this week’s threats warned in an email of further actions against transport across Europe.
“This is only the beginning,” it reportedly said. The Guardian has chosen not to reproduce the email in full, given its unsubstantiated claims.

Some of the threats on Thursday were signed “fighters of the Male State”, a reference to a Russian far-right, ultranationalist and misogynistic movement founded in 2016. In a Telegram post on Friday the group’s founder, Vladislav Pozdniakov, denied involvement and said the group had not existed since 2021.
Some officials suspect the waves of disruption are linked to European support for Ukraine in its war against the Russian invasion.
Spain’s foreign minister, José Manuel Albares, said authorities needed more time to identify culprits but that there appeared to be a pattern.
“It cannot be mere coincidence that so many incidents with exactly the same modus operandi are happening across Europe,” he told the national broadcaster TVE.
“The most reasonable assumption is that we are facing an attempt at hybrid aggression and a form of psychological warfare,” he said, adding that Europe must be prepared for more such challenges.
Mark Rowley, the chief of London’s Metropolitan police, urged a measured response, saying past experience with the paramilitary Irish Republican Army offered valuable lessons.
He recalled the phrase “10p terrorism”, when a hoax bomb call made from a coin-operated phone box could disrupt an entire city, forcing authorities to distinguish between genuine and false threats.
The authorities would need to adapt to an evolving threat landscape involving actors around the world, some backed by hostile states, he said.
“We are going to have to adapt to that same methodology to make sure that we don’t overreact to every message we get online,” he told BBC Radio 4.

articles.title: Activists break into building site of Microsoft datacentre in Amsterdam
articles.author: Ajit Niranjan

paras.en: Activists have stormed the site of a Microsoft datacentre being built in Amsterdam, as the backlash to the social and environmental harms of the AI boom spreads across Europe.
paras.zh: 活动人士冲击了正在阿姆斯特丹建造的微软数据中心的网站，因为人工智能热潮对社会和环境危害的强烈反对蔓延到整个欧洲。

paras.en: Protesters from Geef Tegengas, a Dutch direct action group, clashed with police while breaking into a construction site at Westpoort Amsterdam, where some members climbed a crane, lit flares and tied helium balloons to equipment.
paras.zh: 来自荷兰直接行动组织Geef Tegengas的抗议者在闯入阿姆斯特丹西港的一个建筑工地时与警方发生冲突，一些成员爬上起重机，点燃照明弹，并将氦气球绑在设备上。

paras.en: The action comes amid Europe-wide resistance to the rapid expansion of energy-hungry AI, with more than 100 groups involved in a two-day series of protests to demand moratoria on the construction of new datacentres.
paras.zh: 此举正值全欧洲范围内对耗能人工智能快速扩张的抵制之际， 100多个团体参与了为期两天的一系列抗议活动，要求暂停建设新数据中心。

paras.en: The break-in at the Dutch site, where protesters hung banners objecting to Microsoft’s services to the Israeli military and US Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE), was separate from the pan-European “Stop Dirty Data Centres” campaign, which targeted the same site but whose affiliated members stayed outside the perimeter fence.

“The police attempted to prevent [the occupation] and arrest protesters, but were unable to prevent it and force was used,” the police said in a statement to NOS, a Dutch public broadcaster. “An officer was slightly injured during the protest.”

Protesters from both groups said police used force and teargas to dispel the activists trying to enter the construction site. Organisers and local media reported hundreds of protesters on each side of the fence.

Smaller protests took place in the centre of Bristol, in the UK, at a datacentre in Berlin, Germany, outside the Polish parliament in Warsaw and at the main square in Zagreb, Croatia. Further protests are expected on Saturday.

Stop Dirty Data Centres, a coalition of independent groups that include national branches of Greenpeace and Friends of the Earth, said it had not coordinated or promoted the direct action that took place in the Netherlands, but that is was “understandable” communities would turn to a range of tactics when they were unable to meaningfully participate in decision-making.

“Big tech and government are racing ahead with large-scale datacentre development despite significant public concern about the impacts on local communities, natural resources and other industries,” said Owen Espley, campaign coordinator. “Many datacentre developments are planned with limited transparency or scrutiny, while communities across Europe are being shut out of decisions that will shape their local environments and futures.”

The ecological fallout of the datacentre boom has alarmed some climate scientists, while growing frustration with AI’s societal impact – from energy bills and job losses to the role of tech companies in undermining democracy – has increased public anger. In the US midterm elections this week, nearly every proposed moratorium on datacentres on the ballot was approved.

Roos Molenaar, an activist from Geef Tegengas, said the struggle against big tech was inseparable from the fight against oppression and fascism. “We won’t accept Amsterdam being used for the creation of AI slop and the facilitation of genocide,” said Molenaar. “This datacenter is gulping up our drinking water to make the rich even richer.”

A spokesperson for Microsoft said it was aware of the demonstration and that its first concern was the wellbeing of everyone at and around the site. “We understand that people feel strongly about the project, and we respect their right to express those views peacefully. However, we do not condone any actions that are unlawful or that put people’s safety at risk.”
A spokesperson for Pure Data Centres, the site owner, said it respected the right to peaceful protest but that entering a live construction site was unlawful and dangerous.

“Our immediate priority is everyone’s safety, and we respectfully ask those on site to leave safely and engage with us in dialogue about the development and any concerns they may have,” a Pure DC spokesperson said.

Governments across Europe have supported the building of AI datacentres to boost tax revenues and catch up with the breakneck deployment of computing power in the US and China, with some framing the AI race as a matter of national security.

But datacentres have emerged as a flashpoint for public anger over issues from environment and energy to human rights and democracy. Last week, an investigation by the Guardian and Investigate Europe found evidence of dangerous conditions for some of the workers building them.

articles.title: Sebastián Lelio, director of A Fantastic Woman and Gloria, dies aged 52
articles.author: Benjamin Lee

paras.en: Chilean film-maker Sebastián Lelio has died at the age of 52.
paras.zh: 智利电影制片人塞巴斯蒂安·莱里奥（ Sebastián Lelio ）去世，享年52岁。

paras.en: He was best known for the Oscar-winning trans drama A Fantastic Woman and his English-language films included Gloria Bell and The Wonder.
paras.zh: 他以获得奥斯卡奖的变性剧《神奇女侠》而闻名，他的英语电影包括《格洛丽亚·贝尔》和《奇迹》。

paras.en: His partner Amalia Kassai announced his death on Instagram without specifying the cause of death but telling followers, in Spanish, that it was a painful time for his family. Chilean media reports that he died at his home in Las Condes, Santiago.
paras.zh: 他的伴侣Amalia Kassai在Instagram上宣布了他的死讯，但没有具体说明死因，但用西班牙语告诉追随者，这对他的家人来说是一段痛苦的时期。智利媒体报道说，他死在圣地亚哥拉斯孔德斯的家中。

paras.en: Lelio was born in Argentina but moved to Chile at the age of two. He studied journalism for one year before graduating from film school and then released 9/11 documentary Cero in 2003. His first narrative film The Sacred Family premiered at the San Sebastián film festival in 2005.
paras.zh: Lelio出生在阿根廷，但两岁时搬到了智利。他学习了新闻学一年，然后从电影学院毕业，然后在2003年发行了9/11纪录片CERO。他的第一部叙事电影《神圣的家庭》于2005年在圣塞瓦斯蒂安电影节上首映。

paras.en: His follow-up, 2009’s Christmas, premiered at Cannes but it was 2013’s Gloria that provided him with a major international breakthrough. The drama, about a woman in her late 50s who starts dating again, premiered at Berlin and won its lead star Paulina García an acting award at the festival.
paras.zh: 他的后续作品2009年的圣诞节在戛纳首映，但2013年的格洛丽亚为他带来了重大的国际突破。这部戏剧讲述了一位50多岁的女性再次开始约会，在柏林首映，并在电影节上获得了主角PaulinaGarcía的表演奖。

paras.en: Lelio followed it up with A Fantastic Woman, a drama about the life of a trans woman, another breakout that became the first Chilean film to win the Oscar for best international feature. In a five-star review, the Guardian’s Peter Bradshaw called it “a sublime study in the exalted ordeal of grief”.
paras.zh: 莱利奥随后推出了《神奇女侠》（ A Fantastic Woman ） ，这是一部关于跨性别女性生活的戏剧，也是第一部获得奥斯卡最佳国际长片奖的智利电影。在一篇五星评价中，《卫报》的彼得·布拉德肖（ Peter Bradshaw ）称之为“对悲伤的崇高考验的崇高研究”。

paras.en: “When we released it in 2017, a gender identity bill had been dormant in congress for seven years,” he said in a Guardian interview in 2018. “Somehow, the film’s release, and the year in which it became globally known, helped to reactivate the discussion in Chile.”
paras.zh: 他在2018年接受《卫报》采访时说： “当我们在2017年发布该法案时，一项性别认同法案已经在国会休眠了七年。” “不知何故，这部电影的发行以及它在全球范围内广为人知的那一年，有助于重新激活智利的讨论。”

paras.en: He made his English language debut with London-set drama Disobedience which told a queer love story between women played by Rachel Weisz and Rachel McAdams. It was nominated for five British independent film awards.
paras.zh: 他以伦敦剧集《不服从》（ Disobedience ）首次亮相英语，该剧讲述了雷切尔·魏斯（ Rachel Weisz ）和雷切尔·麦克亚当斯（ Rachel McAdams ）饰演的女性之间的它被提名为五个英国独立电影奖。

paras.en: Lelio then remade Gloria as Gloria Bell, then set in America and starring Julianne Moore in the lead role. He followed it with a critically acclaimed adaptation of Emma Donoghue’s novel The Wonder starring Florence Pugh.
paras.zh: 莱利奥随后将格洛丽亚重拍为格洛丽亚·贝尔（ Gloria Bell ） ，然后以美国为背景，由朱丽安·摩尔（ Julianne Moore ）主演。他随后对艾玛·多诺霍（ Emma Donoghue ）的小说《奇迹》（ The Wonder ）进行了广受好评的改编，该小说由佛罗伦萨·普（ Florence

paras.en: “I love working with actors, and need to know they trust me and can explore, get lost, be foolish or brave, and I’ll take care of them,” he said to the Guardian. “I love working on set – it is where the sparkle is.”
paras.zh: “我喜欢与演员合作，需要知道他们信任我，可以探索，迷路，愚蠢或勇敢，我会照顾他们，”他告诉卫报。“我喜欢在片场工作，这是闪耀的地方。”

paras.en: His final film was 2025’s The Wave, a musical protest drama that premiered at Cannes.
paras.zh: 他的最后一部电影是2025年的《浪潮》，这是一部在戛纳首映的音乐抗议剧。

paras.en: “Making a film is like a gift you leave somewhere – you then hide and see what happens,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说： “拍电影就像是把礼物留在某个地方，然后躲起来看看会发生什么。”

articles.title: Dozens of Democrats eyeing 2028 presidential run, says former Obama aide

paras.en: More than two dozen Democrats are eyeing runs for the White House in 2028, following their party's success in the US midterm elections this week, according to the man behind Barack Obama's successful re-election bid.
paras.zh: 根据巴拉克•奥巴马（ Barack Obama ）成功竞选连任的幕后推手的说法，在本周的美国中期选举中获胜后，二十多名民主党人正在关注2028年的白宫竞选。

paras.en: Jim Messina, who led Obama's 2012 campaign, said that since Democrats saw major victories in congressional races as well as state elections, he's spoken to "over two dozen campaigns" that are actively considering running in 2028 and have begun the financing process and hiring staff.
paras.zh: 领导奥巴马2012年竞选活动的吉姆·梅西纳（ Jim Messina ）表示，自从民主党在国会竞选和州选举中取得重大胜利以来，他已经与“二十多个竞选活动”进行了交谈，这些活动正在积极考虑在2028年竞选，并已开始融资流程和招聘员工。

paras.en: "I think you're going to start having Democrats announce exploratory committees next week or the next couple of weeks, probably after Thanksgiving", Messina told the BBC's Americast podcast.
paras.zh: “我认为你将开始让民主党人下周或未来几周宣布探索委员会，可能是在感恩节之后，”墨西拿告诉BBC的Americast播客。

paras.en: He said he already knows someone relocating to work on a governor's presidential campaign.
paras.zh: 他说，他已经知道有人搬迁到州长的总统竞选工作。

paras.en: He also predicted that the number could shrink as candidates faced pressure to raise large sums needed for the primary contests that will decide the party's nominee.
paras.zh: 他还预测，由于候选人面临着为决定该党候选人的初选筹集大笔资金的压力，这一数字可能会减少。

paras.en: Messina gave some insight into the conversations he's had, saying: "When I sit down with candidates or their campaigns, I say to them, 'Tell me your economic vision for the future of this country. What are you going to do on AI?'"
paras.zh: 墨西拿对他的对话提出了一些见解，他说： “当我与候选人或他们的竞选活动坐下来时，我对他们说， '告诉我你对这个国家未来的经济愿景。你打算在人工智能上做什么？'”

paras.en: Then there's another factor: the outgoing president, Donald Trump, who will still be in office during the campaign season.
paras.zh: 还有另一个因素：即将离任的总统唐纳德·特朗普（ Donald Trump ） ，他将在竞选季节继续任职。

paras.en: "And so, do the Democrats take the bait and talk about Donald Trump every day, or do you stay focused on your message?" he said.
paras.zh: “所以，民主党人是每天上钩谈论唐纳德·特朗普，还是你专注于你的信息？”他说。

paras.en: "It's going be the most interesting presidential [election] since 2008."
paras.zh: “这将是自2008年以来最有趣的总统选举。”

paras.en: Messina, who went on to become Obama's deputy chief of staff at the White House, said the party's success in the US midterm elections was down to their ability to stay focused on the economy and the effect of Donald Trump's tariffs, which were "devastating to rural voters".
paras.zh: 墨西拿后来成为奥巴马在白宫的副幕僚长，他表示，该党在美国中期选举中的成功取决于他们继续关注经济的能力，以及唐纳德特朗普关税的影响，这些关税“对农村选民来说是毁灭性的”。

paras.en: "When you're a farmer and you're paying $7 for a gallon of diesel to put in your tractor, the economics just don't work, and at the same time you're paying more for everything," he said.
paras.zh: 他说： “当你是一个农民，你花$ 7购买一加仑柴油来放入拖拉机时，经济效益就不起作用了，同时你为所有东西都付出了更多。”

paras.en: Staying on message about the economy helped them flip seats in traditionally strong Republican states like Iowa, Kansas, and Texas, he said.
paras.zh: 他说，保持对经济的信息帮助他们在爱荷华州、堪萨斯州和德克萨斯州等传统上强大的共和党州换了席位。

paras.en: "The common criticism of Democrats is that we can't stick to one message. And for the first time in a very long time, Democrats stuck to the economy. They didn't take the bait on the social wars," he said.
paras.zh: “民主党人的普遍批评是，我们不能坚持一个信息。在很长一段时间内，民主党人第一次坚持经济。他们没有在社会战争中上钩，”他说。

paras.en: Messina cautioned Democrats that success in this year's midterm elections was not a ringing endorsement of the party and that "the MVP of the election for the Democrats was Donald Trump".
paras.zh: 墨西拿警告民主党人，今年中期选举的成功并不是对该党的支持， “民主党选举的MVP是唐纳德特朗普”。

paras.en: The hard part will now be bringing the party's progressive and centrist wings together in Congress, he said.
paras.zh: 他说，困难的部分现在将把党的进步和中间派聚集在国会。

articles.title: AI stocks climb after trillions wiped from market values

paras.en: Shares in artificial intelligence and technology firms have been climbing following an enormous sell-off that wiped trillions of dollars off stock values.
paras.zh: 人工智能和技术公司的股价一直在攀升，此前一场大规模的抛售使股票价值蒸发了数万亿美元。

paras.en: The tech-heavy Nasdaq stock index opened higher following a market rout that began in the US on Thursday before spilling over to Asian and European markets into Friday.
paras.zh: 科技股重磅的纳斯达克股指周四在美国开始市场溃败后开盘走高，然后蔓延到亚洲和欧洲市场，直至周五。

paras.en: Investors had been selling off tech shares in part due to concerns the Democrat victory in the midterm elections would mean slower artificial intelligence development.
paras.zh: 投资者一直在抛售科技股，部分原因是担心民主党在中期选举中获胜将意味着人工智能发展放缓。

paras.en: However the latest US employment figures added to a mixed picture for American markets on Friday morning, with an unexpectedly strong 165,000 jobs added to the economy in September.
paras.zh: 然而，最新的美国就业数据在周五上午为美国市场增添了一幅喜忧参半的图景， 9月份为经济增加了出人意料的165,000个就业岗位。

paras.en: On Thursday, businesses closely linked to artificial intelligence development took a hammering on stock markets, particularly chip and semiconductor makers.
paras.zh: 周四，与人工智能开发密切相关的企业受到股市的冲击，尤其是芯片和半导体制造商。

paras.en: But the Nasdaq Composite opened up on Friday and flattened out around 1.7% higher by lunchtime, reversing some of its 5.5% fall.
paras.zh: 但纳斯达克综合指数周五开盘，到午餐时间上涨约1.7% ，扭转了5.5%的部分跌幅。

paras.en: The S&P 500, which tracks the share prices of the largest publicly-traded US companies, was around 0.9% higher by lunchtime. The Dow Jones Industrial Average opened a little down before nudging into positive territory.
paras.zh: 跟踪美国最大上市公司股价的标准普尔500指数在午餐时间上涨约0.9%。道琼斯工业平均指数在进入正值区域之前略有下跌。

paras.en: Nvidia, which shed hundreds of billions in market value on Thursday after shares slid more than 9%, began Friday up more than 6% but settled around 4% higher as trading continued.
paras.zh: 在股价下跌超过9%后，英伟达周四市值下跌了数千亿美元，周五开始上涨超过6% ，但随着交易的继续，结算价格上涨了约4%。

paras.en: SpaceX and Tesla shares, which were also hammered on Thursday, saw more mixed gains, up more than 6% and nearly 5% respectively.
paras.zh: SpaceX和特斯拉股价周四也受到重创，涨幅喜忧参半，分别上涨逾6%和近5%。

paras.en: Chipmakers AMD and Micron both dropped by more than 17% on Thursday, but AMD shares had risen by about 12% on Friday while Micron was up more than 8%.
paras.zh: 芯片制造商AMD和美光周四均下跌逾17% ，但AMD股价周五上涨约12% ，而美光上涨逾8%。

paras.en: However, stock markets in Asia and Europe fared worse on Friday.
paras.zh: 然而，亚洲和欧洲的股市周五表现更糟。

paras.en: The Kospi in South Korea closed down 6% on Friday, with shares in chipmaker SK Hynix plunging more than 10%. European markets also fell, with the main indexes in Germany, France and Spain ending the day down.
paras.zh: 韩国Kospi周五收盘下跌6% ，芯片制造商SK海力士的股价暴跌逾10%。欧洲市场也下跌，德国、法国和西班牙的主要指数当天下跌。

paras.en: In the UK, the FTSE 100, which tracks the largest companies on the London Stock Exchange, declined 1.01%.
paras.zh: 在英国，追踪伦敦证券交易所最大公司的富时100指数下跌1.01%。

paras.en: In addition to the recent market volatility, UK traders were also digesting the latest Bank of England decision to raise interest rates and the signal that another rate rise could be on the cards to curb rising prices.
paras.zh: 除了最近的市场波动外，英国交易员还在消化英格兰银行最近提高利率的决定，以及可能再次加息以遏制价格上涨的信号。

paras.en: Dan Coatsworth, head of markets at AJ Bell, said it had been a brutal week for markets, and the key question was whether the jump in the S&P 500 and Nasdaq would be sustained.
paras.zh: AJ Bell市场主管Dan Coatsworth表示，对于市场来说，这是一个残酷的一周，关键问题是标准普尔500指数和纳斯达克指数的上涨能否持续。

paras.en: "While no-one knows what happens next, it's clear that we've just seen a significant shift in market sentiment," he said.
paras.zh: “虽然没有人知道接下来会发生什么，但很明显，我们刚刚看到市场情绪发生了重大转变，”他说。

paras.en: "Once investors have had the weekend to catch their breath, next week could give a clearer indication of whether the tech trade is going down the pan or fighting back."
paras.zh: “一旦投资者在周末喘口气，下周可能会更清楚地表明科技行业是在下跌还是在反击。”

paras.en: The market fluctuations come after the sweeping Democrat victory in the midterm elections.
paras.zh: 市场波动是在民主党在中期选举中大获全胜之后发生的。

paras.en: A number of Democrats campaigned for new rules and regulations for artificial intelligence (AI) and data centres, and the party has since won control of both houses of congress as well as key contests in states that have been part of the AI data centre race.
paras.zh: 许多民主党人竞选人工智能（ AI ）和数据中心的新规则和法规，该党此后赢得了国会两院的控制权，以及参与人工智能数据中心竞赛的各州的关键竞赛。

paras.en: US President Donald Trump on Friday reiterated his supported for what he calls "super intelligence", saying only "foolish leadership" would "say no to the riches they bring".
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德特朗普周五重申支持他所谓的“超级情报” ，称只有“愚蠢的领导”才会“对他们带来的财富说不”。

paras.en: However, there have also been concerns over whether the enormous amounts of money being spent on AI will pay off.
paras.zh: 然而，人们也担心在人工智能上花费的巨额资金是否会得到回报。

paras.en: Russ Shaw, founder of global tech advocacy firm Tech London Advocates, said the election result was sending a message that a rethink was needed on AI.
paras.zh: 全球科技倡导公司Tech London Advocates的创始人Russ Shaw表示，选举结果发出了一个信息，即需要重新思考人工智能。

paras.en: "The incoming Congress is going to really focus on AI in a very dramatic way," he told the BBC's Business Today.
paras.zh: “即将到来的国会将以非常戏剧性的方式真正关注人工智能，”他告诉英国广播公司的“今日商业”。

paras.en: "I'm a big fan of AI, but I'm watching what these companies are doing, and they're not communicating effectively at all, particularly in the US, about what the benefits of AI are all about."
paras.zh: “我是人工智能的忠实粉丝，但我正在关注这些公司在做什么，他们根本没有就人工智能的好处进行有效的沟通，特别是在美国。”

paras.en: He said people were watching firms come into their communities and build data centres while their own energy costs were going up, and those companies "have to be better neighbours".
paras.zh: 他说，人们正在观看公司进入他们的社区并建立数据中心，而他们自己的能源成本正在上升，这些公司“必须成为更好的邻居”。

paras.en: Strong jobs figures could ease market fears
paras.zh: 强劲的就业数据可以缓解市场担忧

paras.en: As well as the fallout of the midterms and the plunge in artificial intelligence stocks, US traders will also be digesting the latest jobs figures.
paras.zh: 除了中期选举的影响和人工智能股票的暴跌，美国交易员也将消化最新的就业数据。

paras.en: And those numbers were better than expected: US employers added 165,000 new jobs in October, well above the average monthly increase and more than double what analysts had expected.
paras.zh: 这些数字好于预期：美国雇主在10月份增加了165,000个新工作岗位，远高于平均每月增长率，是分析师预期的两倍多。

paras.en: Overall the unemployment rate, which counts the number of people who are out of work but actively looking for a job, eased slightly to 4.1% from 4.2% in September.
paras.zh: 总体失业率（包括失业但积极寻找工作的人数）略有下降，从9月的4.2%降至4.1%。

paras.en: The Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) said the unemployment rate has remained in the narrow range of 4.1% to 4.3% since March.
paras.zh: 劳工统计局（ BLS ）表示，自3月以来，失业率一直保持在4.1 ％至4.3 ％的狭窄范围内。

paras.en: Neil Birrell, chief investment officer at investment firm Premier Miton, said while the jobs figures may feel like second billing to the market movements they were still important.
paras.zh: 投资公司Premier Miton的首席投资官尼尔•比雷尔(Neil Birrell)表示，虽然就业数据可能感觉像是市场走势的第二个账单，但它们仍然很重要。

paras.en: "The US economy is running hard which may mean the risks the markets are worrying about at the moment are not such a risk to the real economy as is being feared," he said.
paras.zh: 他说： “美国经济运行艰难，这可能意味着市场目前担心的风险并不像人们担心的那样对实体经济构成风险。”

articles.title: Nigerian court rules opposition candidate cannot stand in elections

paras.en: Nigeria's Federal High Court has sacked the leadership of the opposition African Democratic Congress (ADC) party - and also ruled that the nomination of its presidential candidate, former Vice-President Atiku Abubakar, is invalid.
paras.zh: 尼日利亚联邦高等法院解雇了反对党非洲民主大会党（ ADC ）的领导层，并裁定其总统候选人、前副总统阿提库·阿布巴卡尔（ Atiku Abubakar ）的提名无效。

paras.en: A statement from the ADC said the ruling was another desperate attempt to cripple the opposition.
paras.zh: ADC的一份声明称，这项裁决是另一次绝望的企图削弱反对派。

paras.en: Presidential elections are scheduled to take place on 16 January when President Bola Tinubu's main challengers are again expected to be Abubakar and former Anambra State Governor Peter Obi.
paras.zh: 总统选举定于1月16日举行，届时博拉蒂努布总统的主要挑战者预计将再次是阿布巴卡尔和前阿南布拉州州长彼得奥比。

paras.en: Several high-profile politicians joined the ADC in 2025 - disillusioned by the factional infighting in the once powerful Peoples Democratic Party (PDP).
paras.zh: 几位备受瞩目的政治家于2025年加入了ADC ，他们对曾经强大的人民民主党（ PDP ）的派系内斗感到失望。

paras.en: Among them were Abubakar - who had served as vice-president between 1999 and 2007 when the PDP was in power - and former Senate president David Mark.
paras.zh: 其中包括阿布巴卡尔（ 1999年至2007年PDP执政期间曾担任副总统）和前参议院议长大卫·马克（ David Mark ）。

paras.en: As accommodations were made for the line-up of political heavyweights, Mark took over as its interim chairman.
paras.zh: 由于为政治重量级人物的阵容做出了调整，马克接任了临时主席。

paras.en: But Nafiu Bala Gombe, a former ADC national deputy chairman, argued before the court that this was not lawful as Mark and others had not been elected at a national convention.
paras.zh: 但前ADC国家副主席Nafiu Bala Gombe在法庭上辩称，这是不合法的，因为Mark和其他人没有在国民大会上当选。

paras.en: Instead, he said, he himself should have taken over the party's leadership following the resignation of the ADC's former chairman in 2025.
paras.zh: 他说，相反，在ADC前主席于2025年辞职后，他自己应该接管党的领导权。

paras.en: This is not first time the Federal High Court in the capital, Abuja, has ruled on the leadership of the party.
paras.zh: 这不是首都阿布贾的联邦高等法院首次就该党的领导层做出裁决。

paras.en: In July, judge Musa Liman said Mark had been chosen in accordance with the country's laws and the party's constitution - in a case brought by another former ADC member.
paras.zh: 今年7月，穆萨·利曼（ Musa Liman ）法官表示，马克是根据该国的法律和该党的宪法选出的-在另一名前ADC成员提起的案件中。

paras.en: Abubakar said the latest case raised serious legal concerns: "Why, after that judgment, was another case filed to reopen the same dispute?"
paras.zh: 阿布巴卡尔说，最新的案件引起了严重的法律问题： “为什么在那次判决之后，又提出了重新审理同一争议的案件？”

paras.en: In a statement, the ADC added that Thursday's judgement by Justice Peter Lifu was aimed at stifling the opposition momentum and "was a calculated attempt to weaken the ADC and frustrate" Abubakar's candidacy.
paras.zh: ADC在一份声明中补充说，周四法官Peter Lifu的判决旨在扼杀反对派的势头，并且“是故意削弱ADC并挫败” Abubakar的候选资格。

paras.en: The ADC says it will challenge the ruling at the Court of Appeal.
paras.zh: ADC表示，它将在上诉法院对该裁决提出质疑。

paras.en: In a statement on Facebook, Abubakar, 79, said he would contest the election despite the ruling, external.
paras.zh: 79岁的阿布巴卡尔在Facebook上的一份声明中表示，尽管有外部裁决，他仍将参加选举。

paras.en: "Let me be clear to every Nigerian who has stood with us: I am in this race. I am not going anywhere. We will be on the ballot. No threat, blackmail or court manoeuvre will make me abandon you or the cause we share," he wrote on Friday.
paras.zh: “让我向所有与我们站在一起的尼日利亚人明确表示：我参加了这场比赛。我哪儿也不去。我们将参加投票。任何威胁、敲诈或法庭动作都不会让我抛弃你或我们共同的事业，”他在周五写道。

paras.en: He had previously questioned the timing of the judgment, coming "barely a day after a mammoth crowd turned out in Sokoto [northern Nigeria] to welcome him" as he launched his campaign.
paras.zh: 他此前曾质疑判决的时机，在他发起竞选活动时， “在庞大的人群出现在索科托（尼日利亚北部）欢迎他之后不到一天”。

paras.en: Political parties in Nigeria have increasingly been taking internal issues to court.
paras.zh: 尼日利亚的政党越来越多地将内部问题诉诸法庭。

paras.en: But as it stands, the electoral commission has issued its final list of candidates, external - and Abubakar is on the ticket for the ADC with former Rivers State Governor Rotimi Amaechi as his running mate.
paras.zh: 但就目前而言，选举委员会已经发布了最终的外部候选人名单，而阿布巴卡尔也在ADC的门票上，前河流州州长Rotimi Amaechi是他的竞选伙伴。

paras.en: Will the latest ruling affect the opposition?
paras.zh: 最新的裁决会影响反对派吗？

paras.en: The ADC is seen as the most powerful opposition to President Tinubu. Many influential politicians opposed to the ruling All Progressives Congress (APC) have already defected to the party.
paras.zh: ADC被视为对蒂努布总统最强大的反对派。许多反对执政的全进步大会党（ APC ）的有影响力的政治家已经叛逃到党内。

paras.en: The legal saga could complicate things - it may cause uncertainty for hundreds of ADC candidates as well as raise questions over who has the authority to represent them.
paras.zh: 法律传奇可能会使事情变得复杂-它可能会给数百名ADC候选人带来不确定性，并引发谁有权代表他们的问题。

paras.en: Peter Obi - the other main presidential candidate, who is on the ballot for a second time - said he was shocked by Thursday's high court ruling.
paras.zh: 第二次参加投票的另一位主要总统候选人彼得·奥比（ Peter Obi ）表示，他对周四的高等法院裁决感到震惊。

paras.en: He released a statement on X with the heading, external: "Do not undermine democracy".
paras.zh: 他在X上发表了一份声明，标题为外部： “不要破坏民主”。

paras.en: The 65-year-old went on to say: "My concern is that three months before a general election, it is in the public interest to have certainty.
paras.zh: 这位65岁的老人接着说： “我担心的是，在大选前三个月，确定是否符合公众利益。

paras.en: Obi had briefly joined the ADC before leaving earlier this year to join the Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC) - in part because of the legal challenges within the ADC.
paras.zh: 奥比在今年早些时候加入尼日利亚民主大会党（ NDC ）之前曾短暂加入过ADC ，部分原因是ADC内部存在法律挑战。

paras.en: "The sustenance of democracy in Nigeria, in the midst of encroaching military rule in West Africa, should strengthen our resolve to protect opposition politics and not stamp out opposition parties," he said.
paras.zh: 他说： “在西非的军事统治正在侵蚀之中，尼日利亚民主的维持应该加强我们保护反对派政治的决心，而不是消灭反对党。”

paras.en: The NDC's candidate said that, as president, he would ensure that the existence of opposition parties would be respected.
paras.zh: NDC的候选人表示，作为总统，他将确保尊重反对党的存在。

paras.en: "This is a time to strengthen our democracy by allowing the opposition to thrive."
paras.zh: “这是通过允许反对派蓬勃发展来加强我们民主的时候。”

paras.en: Additional reporting by Chris Ewokor in Abuja
paras.zh: Chris Ewokor在阿布贾的补充报道

articles.title: Carlisle Launches EL121 Disc Brakes for Improved Performance and Wear Life

paras.en: Carlisle Launches EL121 Disc Brakes for Improved Performance and Wear Life
paras.zh: Carlisle 推出 EL121 盘式制动器，以提高性能和磨损寿命

paras.en: (MEDINA, OH, September 12, 2023) – Carlisle Brake & Friction is excited to announce the launch of EL121 Disc Brake Pads for mine haul truck applications. The new product series will be named Extended Life, or the EL Series, and EL121 will be the first friction formulation of the series to launch.
paras.zh: （俄亥俄州梅迪纳，2023 年 9 月 12 日）——Carlisle Brake & Friction 很高兴地宣布推出适用于矿用卡车应用的 EL121 盘式制动片。新产品系列将被命名为Extend Life，即EL系列，EL121将是该系列中首款推出的摩擦配方。

paras.en: Carlisle’s EL121 Series friction material nearly doubles the service life of front-axle, mine haul truck brake pads. The result is increased equipment uptime, and reduced maintenance costs when utilizing the OEM calipers and rotors.
paras.zh: 卡莱尔的 EL121 系列摩擦材料使前轴、矿用运输卡车刹车片的使用寿命几乎延长了一倍。使用 OEM 卡钳和转子时，可以增加设备的正常运行时间并降低维护成本。

paras.en: Autonomous haul trucks experience higher pad temperatures, which drive elevated pad wear from increased braking cycles as the retarder and the service brake are applied. EL121 features a highly wear-resistant friction material blend that provides extended brake pad life with consistent and fade-resistant braking performance. EL121 is the ideal solution for today’s autonomous mine haul trucks (may also be used in manned mine haul trucks for increased performance and longevity).
paras.zh: 自动运输卡车的刹车片温度较高，当使用缓速器和行车制动器时，制动周期的增加会导致刹车片磨损加剧。 EL121 采用高度耐磨的摩擦材料混合物，可延长刹车片的使用寿命，并具有一致且防褪色的制动性能。 EL121 是当今自动矿用运输卡车的理想解决方案（也可用于载人矿用运输卡车，以提高性能和使用寿命）。

paras.en: “We understand that mine operators need to keep their haul trucks on the job and not in the shop for brake service. Our latest innovation allows for up to double the service life of the front-axle mine haul truck brake pads and are a will-fit replacement to existing OEM pads. These were thoroughly lab tested as well as field tested on Komatsu 830E-1 trucks,” said Ron Ratell, Product Line Director Friction Products at Carlisle Brake & Friction.
paras.zh: 卡莱尔制动与摩擦公司摩擦产品产品线总监 Ron Ratell 表示：“我们了解矿山运营商需要让运输卡车继续工作，而不是在车间进行制动维修。我们的最新创新技术可将前轴矿用运输卡车制动片的使用寿命延长一倍，并且是现有 OEM 制动片的理想替代品。这些制动片经过了彻底的实验室测试以及小松 830E-1 卡车的现场测试。”

paras.en: EL121 friction has been dyno tested to replicate the application and is proven to deliver an innovative, high-energy material to meet market needs. EL121 disc brake pads also feature an industry-proven mechanical retention system with backing plate technology designed for superior bonding and durability, capable of withstanding abusive conditions in even the harshest Off-Highway environments.
paras.zh: EL121 摩擦力经过测功机测试以复制应用，并被证明可以提供创新的高能材料来满足市场需求。 EL121 盘式刹车片还采用经过行业验证的机械固定系统，采用背板技术，旨在实现卓越的粘合性和耐用性，甚至能够承受最恶劣的非公路环境中的恶劣条件。

paras.en: Carlisle’s EL121 Series disc brake pads are available now through authorized Carlisle dealers and distributors. To learn more, visit https://www.carlislecbf.com/products/brake-friction/disc-brake-pads/off-highway-disc-brake-pads/el. To locate an authorized Carlisle dealer near you, search our online distributor listing https://www.carlislecbf.com/support/find-a-distributor.
paras.zh: Carlisle 的 EL121 系列盘式刹车片现已通过 Carlisle 授权经销商和分销商发售。要了解更多信息，请访问 https://www.carlislecbf.com/products/brake-friction/disc-brake-pads/off-highway-disc-brake-pads/el。要查找您附近的卡莱尔授权经销商，请搜索我们的在线经销商列表 https://www.carlislecbf.com/support/find-a-distributor。

paras.en: Carlisle Brake & Friction is a globally recognized leader in the development and manufacture of highly innovative brake and friction system solutions to service a diverse range of motion control applications. The comprehensive nature of Carlisle’s brake system expertise includes hydraulic control products, industrial brake assemblies, wet and dry friction material for brake, clutch, and transmission applications as well as aftermarket replacement products. Our full-system product offering, supported by our industry-experience staff of experts, provides our customers with brake system solutions that set them apart from their competition. www.carlislecbf.com
paras.zh: Carlisle Brake & Friction 是全球公认的高度创新制动和摩擦系统解决方案开发和制造领域的领导者，为各种运动控制应用提供服务。卡莱尔制动系统专业知识的综合性包括液压控制产品、工业制动组件、用于制动、离合器和变速箱应用的湿式和干式摩擦材料以及售后替换产品。我们的全系统产品由具有行业经验的专家团队提供支持，为我们的客户提供制动系统解决方案，使他们在竞争中脱颖而出。 www.carlislecbf.com

articles.title: Carlisle Releases Video Highlighting Solutions for Ag

paras.en: Carlisle Releases Video Highlighting Solutions for Ag
paras.zh: Carlisle 发布 Ag 视频突出显示解决方案

paras.en: Carlisle Brake & Friction launches a new product solutions video: Carlisle Solutions for Tractor Applications, to showcase all of the latest motion control technologies available for agriculture equipment, specifically tractor applications.
paras.zh: 卡莱尔制动与摩擦公司推出了新产品解决方案视频：卡莱尔拖拉机应用解决方案，展示适用于农业设备（特别是拖拉机应用）的所有最新运动控制技术。

paras.en: From power valves, to disc brakes, to PTO and shuttle clutch friction options, this video breaks down all of the features and benefits of Carlisle’s newest brake system and powertrain solutions.
paras.zh: 从动力阀到盘式制动器，再到取力器和梭式离合器摩擦选项，该视频详细介绍了卡莱尔最新制动系统和动力总成解决方案的所有功能和优点。

paras.en: For improved visualization, the video features 3D animation and demonstrations of the product fitments within a standard tractor model.
paras.zh: 为了提高可视化效果，该视频采用 3D 动画和标准拖拉机模型中的产品配件演示。

articles.title: Carlisle Suzhou Achieves Caterpillar SER Certification

paras.en: Carlisle Suzhou Achieves Caterpillar SER Certification
paras.zh: 卡莱苏州获得卡特彼勒 SER 认证

paras.en: (MEDINA, January 25, 2024) – Carlisle Brake & Friction announced its Suzhou facility has won a Supplier Excellence Recognition (SER) Certification from Caterpillar Inc. The Caterpillar SER is a new supplier management system featuring "Certified" and "Excellent" levels. Caterpillar officially launched the program in 2022. Carlisle's Suzhou manufacturing facility achieved a "Certified" level of recognition and celebrated the achievement alongside the Caterpillar team with a ceremony at the Carlisle Suzhou plant.
paras.zh: （梅迪纳，2024 年 1 月 25 日）——卡莱尔制动与摩擦公司宣布其苏州工厂获得卡特彼勒公司颁发的供应商卓越认可 (SER) 认证。卡特彼勒 SER 是一种新的供应商管理体系，具有“认证”和“优秀”级别。卡特彼勒于 2022 年正式启动该计划。卡莱尔苏州制造工厂获得了“认证”级别的认可，并与卡特彼勒团队在卡莱尔苏州工厂举行了仪式，庆祝这一成就。

paras.en: Of 27,000 suppliers, 250 were among the selected companies awarded by Caterpillar. Carlisle, a leading global supplier of brake, clutch, and transmission friction products, is the only friction products manufacturer worldwide to win the coveted certification.
paras.zh: 在 27,000 家供应商中，有 250 家入选卡特彼勒授予的奖项。 Carlisle 是全球领先的制动器、离合器和变速箱摩擦产品供应商，也是全球唯一一家获得这一令人垂涎的认证的摩擦产品制造商。

paras.en: "We are honored to be recognized by Caterpillar as a Certified level supplier," said Doug Wagner, Global VP of Sales, Carlisle Brake & Friction. "This award recognizes the superior efforts and dedication of the entire Suzhou team that supports our global business."
paras.zh: “我们很荣幸被 Caterpillar 认可为认证级供应商，”Carlisle 制动与摩擦部全球销售副总裁 Doug Wagner 说道。 “该奖项是对支持我们全球业务的整个苏州团队的卓越努力和奉献精神的认可。”

paras.en: Carlisle earned SER Certification in recognition of the company's exemplary commitment to supporting Caterpillar's global growth strategy goals.
paras.zh: Carlisle 获得了 SER 认证，以表彰该公司对支持 Caterpillar 全球增长战略目标的模范承诺。

paras.en: Carlisle Brake & Friction is a globally recognized leader in the development and manufacture of highly innovative brake and friction system solutions to service a diverse range of motion control applications. The comprehensive nature of Carlisle’s brake system expertise includes hydraulic control products, industrial brake assemblies, wet and dry friction material for brake, clutch, and transmission applications as well as aftermarket replacement products. Our full-system product offering, supported by our industry-experience staff of experts, provides our customers with brake system solutions that set them apart from their competition. www.carlislecbf.com
